International Universal Health Coverage Day

International Universal Health Coverage Day aims to raise awareness of the

need for strong and resilient health systems and universal health coverage

with multi-stakeholder partners. Each year on 12 December, UHC advocates

raise their voices to share the stories of the millions of people still

waiting for health, champion what we have achieved so far, call on leaders

to make bigger and smarter investments in health, and encourage diverse

groups to make commitments to help move the world closer to UHC by 2030.

UHC means that everyone, everywhere, should have access to the health

services they need without the risk of financial hardship. It is embedded

in the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG target 3.8)

Dear Students,

The Tamil Nadu State AIDS project cell was formed in 1993 and in 1994, it

has been registered as a Society under the Societies Act, as Tamil Nadu

State AIDS Control Society (TANSACS), the first of its kind for the nation.

The State Health Secretary is the President of the Society and an IAS

officer is the Member Secretary and Project Director of the Society.

TANSACS is fully funded by the National AIDS Control Organization (NACO)

which is a division of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare of the

Central Government of India. The Programs of TANSACS are governed by the

guidelines of National AIDS Control Program (NACP), which is in its fourth

phase. At the district level the programs and oversight to the

interventions are provided by the District AIDS Prevention Control Units

(DAPCU).

TANSACS is organising a State Level Online Quiz Competition to raise

awareness on HIV/STI. All the participants of the Quiz competition will be

awarded participation certificates in electronic form.

subject: Congratulations to Team Unlabeled for Achievement at Data Science Hackathon 2026 | IIT Kharagpur
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team Unlabeled has secured Second Place at

the IIT Kharagpur in Data Science Hackathon 2026, a prestigious

national-level competition, with a cash prize of ₹1,25,000.

The competition was conducted from 5th to 12th January 2026, with the final

round held on 17th January 2026 at IIT Kharagpur. Out of 13,500+

registrations, only 18 teams were shortlisted nationwide, and Team

Unlabeled was the only team representing VIT Vellore among the finalists.

The team presented a project focused on enabling Large Language Models

(LLMs) to incorporate global contextual understanding for more accurate and

informed predictions. The project was highly appreciated by the judging

panel, which included industry experts from HSBC Bank and Pathways, for its

innovation, technical rigor, and real-world relevance.

Team Members (Team Unlabeled):

1. Kavya Jain – 23BIT0006

2. Puniti Jodhwani – 23BCB0107

3. Hitanshi Arora – 23BIT0230

4. Arya Mulay – 23BIT0131

We express our sincere appreciation to the Faculty Coordinator, Prof.

Sathiyamoorthy E (Emp ID: 10297) for their guidance, encouragement, and

continuous support, which played a vital role in the team’s success.

Congratulations to Team Unlabeled on this commendable national-level

achievement.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [15th April

] events.

World Art Day

Each year, on 15 April, World Art Day celebrations help reinforce the links

between artistic creations and society, encourage greater awareness of the

diversity of artistic expressions and highlight the contribution of artists

to sustainable development. It is also an occasion to shine a light on arts

education in schools, as culture can pave the way for inclusive and

equitable education.

Art nurtures creativity, innovation and cultural diversity for all peoples

across the globe and plays an important role in sharing knowledge and

encouraging curiosity and dialogue. These are qualities that art has always

had, and will always have if we continue to support environments where

artists and artistic freedom are promoted and protected. In this way,

furthering the development of art also furthers our means to achieve a free

and peaceful world. There is much to learn, share and celebrate on World

Art Day, and UNESCO encourages everyone to join in through various

activities such as debates, conferences, workshops, cultural events and

presentations or exhibitions.

C&C is organizing Three events as part of World Art Day.

Today's Events:

 - విశ్వ చిత్రకళ దినోత్సవం

celebrates World Art Day, acknowledging the profound influence of Indian

and Telugu arts on our cultural heritage. Within this mosaic of artistic

expressions, Telugu arts hold a special place. Telugu-speaking regions,

particularly Andhra Pradesh and Telangana, have nurtured a vibrant artistic

tradition. Telugu art is characterized by its vibrant colours, detailed

patterns, and often narrative-driven themes.

subject: Invitation to Participate – National Green Earth Challenge 2026
body:
Dear VITians,

The Prem Jain Memorial Trust, in collaboration with the Indian Green

Building Council (IGBC), YLAC, Daikin India, NIUA, Association of

Designers of India – Bangalore, and the Council of Architecture,

is launching the National Green Earth Challenge 2026.

This nationwide competition invites young minds from architecture,

engineering, design, and allied fields to pioneer sustainable solutions

for a greener tomorrow.

Competition Categories

 -

 Sustainable Product Design – creating innovative, eco-friendly products

 -

 Sustainable Habitat – reimagining how we live and build for a

 sustainable future

Key Details:

 -

 Eligibility: Undergraduate students (Architecture, Engineering, Design

 & Allied Fields)

 -

 Prize Pool: Prizes worth Rs. 10 lakhs | National Winners: Rs. 1,50,000

 each

 -

 Timeline:

 -

 Submissions Open: 1st Sept 2025

 -

 Submissions Close: 31st Oct 2025

 -

 Preliminary Jury: Nov 2025

 -

 Zonal Jury: Jan 2026

 -

 National Grand Finale: Feb 2026, New Delhi

Apply Here: https://pjmtngec.premjainmemorialtrust.com/index.php

Website: https://pjmtngec.premjainmemorialtrust.com/index.php

We encourage students to make the best use of this opportunity to showcase

their creativity and contribute towards a sustainable, greener future.

subject: VIT International Relations Office is pleased to announce an International Seminar-25–27 March 2026
body:
Dear All,

VIT International Relations Office is pleased to announce an International

Seminar, to be held during 25–27 March 2026, sponsored by the

Department of Youth Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports,

Government of India.

The seminar is centered on the theme “Digital Dreamscapes: Youth

Navigating AI, Creativity & Virtual Expression.” It aims to explore how

young minds can harness artificial intelligence and emerging technologies

to reimagine fields such as performing arts, architecture, and content

creation, while emphasizing responsible innovation and ethical foresight.

The main objective of this international conference is to provide Indian

youth with a comprehensive understanding of global issues and international

research, and to equip them with perspectives on themes relevant to their

context, thereby enhancing their knowledge and confidence to articulate

their views at international forums.

Eligibility:

Open to faculty members, research scholars, and students under 35 years of

age who have an interest and relevant expertise in the seminar theme.

 Submission & Selection Process:

 - Interested applicants are invited to submit abstracts and concise

 research summaries aligned with the seminar theme.

 - All submissions will undergo academic review by an expert committee

 constituted by the Vellore Institute of Technology(VIT).

 - Selected participants will be invited to present their research

 papers during the seminar sessions.

 Important Dates:

 - Registration & Abstract Submission Link:

We have devised a set of systems, which can reduce the damage caused to vehicles and deaths and injury caused to Passengers and Pedestrians in vehicular accidents by more than SEVENTY-FIVE PERCENT We have already filed and are in process of filing further, multiple and appropriate D isclosure D ocuments, P rovisional P atent A pplications at the U nited S tates P atent & T rademarks O ffice (USPTO) , and also applications under the P atent C o-operation T reaty at W orld I ntellectual P roperty O rganization (WIPO) at Geneva. There is absolutely no doubt that our idea is new and innovative. Moreover, we are very confident and very sure that this will help reducing/minimizing human suffering to a very large extent. There is no doubt that the product devised by us will change the face of the earth forever. Brief details relating to our product are detailed in the annexures under the following headings : Statistics Advantages Options Economics We are looking for the followings: 01. Business consultancy and advice regarding the most viable, practical and profitable course of action under the circumstances and also consultancy on patents & protection of intellectual property. 02. Financial, Technical and/or Commercial Collaborations with any collaborating agency including Angel Investors, Venture Capitalists, Government Agencies, Automobiles and/or automobile accessories manufacturers or in short, any body and every body from anywhere and all over the world. We are open to all options including outright sale, licensing and their permutations and combinations. Also, we can incorporate a company anywhere a world for implementing this project. This project has the potential of considerably reducing human trauma and misery and also saving substantial amounts of money by way of damage to property etc. We are available at the following contact point : mailto:largeinv@indiatimes.com largeinv@indiatimes.com In case, you feel that some of your friends, acquaintances and associates could be interested and/or helpful in our project aimed at human welfare kindly forward our mail to them. In case you are in a position to provide us with the above named services, or interested in any further dialogue please contact us. Hoping to hear from you. With Best Wishes and Kind Regards, Thanking you, Yours sincerely JCPPL GROUP ANNEXURE The STATISTICS pertaining to road transport worldwide: - (a) Number of people dying worldwide - More than 1.2 million per year = More than 1,00,000 per month = More than 3300 per day = More than 120 per hour = More than 2 per minute = At least 1 person is dying every 30 seconds (b) Number of people getting injured worldwide - = More than 32 million per year = More than 2 million per month = More than 60,000 per day = More than 4000 per hour = at least 1 person every second. (One person seriously injured every three seconds; one person moderately injured every three seconds; one person mildly injured every three seconds.) (c) Current yearly automobile sales worldwide - more than 1000 Billion US$. (d) Number of automobiles worldwide - more than 1000 billion pieces (e) Daily loss caused due to vehicular accidents worldwide More than 2 Billion US$ per day. (2% of the worldwide Gross National Product of more than 36500 Billion US $ = More than 730 US$ per year= More than 2 Billion US$ per day) The ADVANTAGES of the technology developed by us: a. The introduction of such technology will dramatically reduce the expenses of auto-insurance. This reduction of insurance cost will be at par with or even more that the expenses incurred towards the introduction of such technology in modern day vehicles. Accordingly, the Life Insurance premier will also undergo drastic reduction. Additionally, because of saving of lives, the outgo of the insurance companies will reduce substantially. b.As per the WHO studies and projections, road accidents occupy the number nine positions by way of causes of death in the world today. It is projected by WHO that by the year 2020 they will occupy the number three positions, next only to Heart disease and Depression. By introduction of this technology, we are sure that this will not happen. On the contrary there will be massive reduction in the number of deaths due to road accidents and road accidents may not figure on the list of major causes of death, in the year 2020 at all. c. This technology will therefore, make all vehicles cheaper and safer. Not only will the cost be reduced, safety which is priceless in itself, will also be greatly enhanced. As and when the regular Patent Application is filed and patent is granted, the life of the patent will be 20 years. Even at the current levels, with road accidents placed at number nine on the WHO list as a major cause of death, there is a daily loss of Two Billion US$. Even at the present level, over a period of twenty years, without any interest and without any compounding, this loss works out to be: 2 Billion US$ X 365 days X 20 years - 14,600 Billion US$. d. Our technology will ensure that at least SEVENTY-FIVE PERCENT of the above losses are prevented. Such figure works out to be more that 10,000 Billion US$. It is important to note that this is the projection at the current level. As per the future projections, the incidents of road accidents are expected to increase. Hence, the figure is likely to be increase very substantially. In addition the Time factor and the interest factor will inflate this figure further. e. At the current levels, more than 1.2 million persons are dying every year due to road accidents. Even at the current rates, more than 24 million lives will be lost in road accidents over the next twenty years (i.e. life of the patent, when granted). Besides, at the current levels. 3.2 million people are injured every year. In the next twenty years, the number of people injured due to road accident, will therefore be more than half a Billion. f. If we add to that the personal, physical and psychological traumas to those directly involved in and also to those who are associated with the people involved in the road accidents. The trauma and the misery and henceforth the value of the savings, are all unmeasurable in quantities, presently known to human kind. g. Considering the figures and dynamics as explained hereinabove, it may not be improper or out of place to compare this technology with the introduction of electricity, computer or aircrafts in terms of its value to mankind. h. The benefits of this technology will be so obvious and essential that, in the very near future, the use of this technology will become unavoidable. It should and will become mandatory by law, to install such technology and the installation of such technology should and will be a pre-requisite for granting or renewal of the registration and license of all vehicles in future. i. As described hereinabove; this technology and its utility are incomparable, outthought of, and unheard of till date. It will open a new floodgate in human travel and safety measures. In future, it can and will be applied to other mode of transport, like aircrafts and trains also. . Among other things, we have the following OPTIONS available to us: - OPTIONS available to us: - a- OUTRIGHT SALE (a) Immediate outright sale of the idea and the concept along with our filed Applications for one time lump sum consideration. (b) Further development of the concept and further filing of Patent and all Patent related applications, before taking steps as outlined in "a". The process (b) will obviously increase the realization in terms of price. b- LICENCING OPTIONS i) New vehicles - Granting of licenses to manufacturers of automobiles, individually or collectively, all over the world for incorporation in the automobiles to be manufactured in future on fixed time or per piece basis. ii) Conversion of existing vehicles - To independent agents for conversion of the existing more than 1000 Billion vehicles all over the world. c - COMBINED OPTIONS A collaborative arrangement with some private and/or government agency wherein we receive a certain down payment and then jointly distribute the licensing rights on a pre-decided sharing (partnership) arrangement. The ECONOMICS of the project will be as follows: - 1) In case any/all processes and systems described by us are incorporated in the design of new vehicles and the new vehicles are manufactured in accordance with the modified designs, the cost escalation may not be more than 5% to 8%, and the safety and the protection will be ten times (More than) the price escalation. Hence, drop in insurance premier will compensate for the cost escalation. 2) In case, the existing vehicles are modified, the cost involved will be approximately 10% to 15% of the value of the vehicle. But partial modifications at a lower cost, which will give partial protection, may also be carried out. As a thumb rule, the cost of modification in percentage terms will be about one fifth of the percentage of safety and protection provided. 3) In case the value of the vehicles is low or the life of the vehicle is about to expire, the partial modifications may be practically and economically viable, as incorporation onto a new vehicle is relatively less expensive and more protective. 4) There are more than 1000 Billion motor vehicles in the world at present. Besides there are an unspecified number of non-motorized ehicles. 5) Almost all of them can be converted in phased manner to a variable degree. The cost of conversion will be directly proportional to their current market value and the safety shield to be generated there from. 6) Among the motorised vehicles, the conversion cost may work out of few dollars for every percent of safety shield created The exact calculation can be worked out, but over all, some of the methods may provide more safety at lower cost compared to the other which may differ in efficiency. 7) Even if we consider a very vague and approximate cost of conversion of 300 US$ per vehicle, the conversion industry works out to be worth 3,00,000 Billion US$. 8) Realising the potential of the product in terms of human safety, it will be reasonable to presume that majority of such conversion will be completed over a period of three years from the starting date. 9) As pointed hereinabove, the size of the conversion industry may be estimated to, in the range of 1,00,000 Billion US$ per year over the next three years. 10) Alternatively, considering the diversity of available motorised vehicles all over the world, conversion licensing can also be commercially viable proposition. For such conversion, licenses can be granted on-line, on receipt of on-line payments. In that case, different rates for granting conversion to vehicles having specific registration numbers can be granted in accordance with and in proportion to the size, carrying capacity and the engine power of the vehicle. 11) In case, licensing is done, the creation and installation of the concerned systems will be done by the end-user, as per his circumstances and needs. However, piracy is likely to be a major problem in such licensing. 12) It is likely that as and when the systems are introduced in the motorised vehicles, unusual and unprecedented demand of new vehicles is created. This will result in massive rejection of the vehicles currently playing all over the world and stimulate an entirely new market as far as motorised vehicle is concerned. The size of such market is difficult to either comprehend and/or estimate. P.S. 1) Some of the figures have been rounded off but generally the figures are correct. 2) We have tried to keep this communication brief and to the point. More details, including website references are available with us and can be provided, if required. ------=_NextPart_AAXPMNBMET-- http://xent.com/mailman/listinfo/fork

subject: Congratulations to Team Ojas Racing for their Achievement at Formula Student Concept Class (FSCC) 2025 - Formula Bharat
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team Ojas Racing participated in the Formula

Student Concept Class (FSCC) 2025, an online competition organized by Formula

Bharat, held from 18th of October to the 22nd of November 2025.

The competition evaluates Formula Student vehicle concepts through multiple

technical and strategic assessments, including the Engineering Design

Report (EDR), Cost Report (CR), and Business Plan Presentation (BPP). Teams

are assessed on their engineering design approach, financial planning, and

the overall feasibility and impact of their vehicle concept.

Demonstrating exceptional performance in the Electric Vehicle (EV)

Category, Team Ojas Racing secured the following accolades:

1st Place – Engineering Design Report (EDR)1st Place – Cost Report (CR)1st

Place – Business Plan Presentation (BPP)Overall Winner – Electric Vehicle

(EV) Category

subject: UG Research - ULINK Update _ ULINK | New Labs Added – Bioinspired Design Lab (SBST) & 20 Labs from SMEC
body:
Dear Students,

Greetings!

We are pleased to inform you that additional laboratories have been

included under the ULINK initiative to provide enhanced undergraduate

research opportunities.

Newly Added Lab from SBST

Bioinspired Design Lab (G29A-SMV) - This lab focuses on developing products

based on biomimetic principles to support the regeneration of traumatic

injuries and lost body parts. The research objectives align with SDG-3:

Good Health and Well-Being.

Eligibility:

Interested UG students from SBST, SHINE, and SMEC, 2nd year onwards,

are encouraged to apply.

https://forms.gle/gCRCcHYHBnLg3ZVo6

Also, the following 20 laboratories from SMEC have been added. Students

are advised to check the attached eligibility details and enroll based on

their interests.

 1.

 Centre for Additive Manufacturing

 2.

 Thermal Engineering Systems Lab

 3.

 Engine Testing Lab

 4.

 Composites Lab

 5.

This is to inform all that the VIT International Relations office is

organizing two sessions on 7th Nov'23 on the International Transfer

Strathclyde, Scotland. Students who are interested in understanding the 2+2

and 4+1 transfer process to the University of Strathclyde can come to

the International

Relations office (Dr.MGR Block,105) from 12:30 Noon to 1:00 PM on 7th

Mr Robert Graham, Faculty Officer (International)

Dr Kepa Mendibil, Associate Dean (International), Faculty of Engineering

Dr Athanasios Toumpis, Department of Mechanical and Aerospace Engineering

Strathclyde. This will include presentations from Robert Graham, Dr Kepa

Mendibil, and Dr Athanasios Toumpis. The presentations will cover the key

elements of the 2+2 and 4+1 articulation programs

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students' Welfare welcomes you to the Day 1 events of

Counselling Week, organized by the Counselling Division as part of VIT’s

40th Anniversary: Ruby Jubilee Celebrations.

Talk on Past, Present and Future Trends of Counselling Services

Counselling provides a safe and confidential space to express concerns,

develop coping skills, and build resilience. It helps students enhance

self-awareness, improve decision-making, and maintain emotional well-being.

Dr. B. J. Prashantham, Chairman and Managing Director of Dr. Prashantham

Institute for Counselling Psychology is a pioneer in the field of

Counselling and Mental Health and he will provide insights into the Past,

Present and Future Trends of Counselling Services. He will enlighten us on

how Counselling has evolved over the years and its growing significance in

today's fast-paced world.

Music Therapy Workshop

Music therapy is a healthcare profession in which a qualified music

therapist designs your sessions with specific, individualized goals in

mind. Therapeutic music is a method for relaxing you or lifting your

emotions in times of need. It doesn’t require a music therapist.

Music therapy Helps you relax.

Helps you explore your emotions.

Reduces anxiety or depression.

Regulates your mood.

subject: Earn $139,000 a year as a DAY TRADER!
body: It was the Spring of 1979. I was just a tall, goofy looking kid in middle school with buck-teeth and freckles. Each day in the cafeteria, I walked from table to table ... Stealing other kids' lunch money. No, I didn't rob them with a gun or a knife - I just made them a little deal. "Let me borrow two dollars today," I said, "and I'll bring you five dollars next week." The investment was too good to pass up, and other kids were throwing their lunch money at me like gravy on mashed potatoes. Of course when "next week" rolled around and I couldn't pony up the cash, I promised to pay them even more the week after that, if they would just let me keep their investment a little bit longer. Eventually the end of the year came and went, high school started and with it came girls, and homework, and parties, and sports, and those poor kids from eighth grade had more things on their mind than last year's lunch money. I made off with a tidy sum for a middle school kid, and I didn't even get beat up. Hidden inside this story are the two greatest stock market secrets you will ever learn. First of all, greed is your number one enemy. You're not going to turn $2 into $5 in a week, so cash out when you're ahead. Don't wait for the boat to sink before grabbing the lifejacket. Second, never trust an investment adviser of any kind. They are looking out for their own money, not yours. The "professionals", those stuffy investment counselors and money managers, will always tell you that the best time to buy is NOW. According to those guys, the longer you keep your money in the market, the more money you're going to make. Ask them when is the best time to sell and their answer is "NEVER". In a sense, they are right. If you put $250,000 in an index fund right now, you'll probably have over a million dollars in thirty or forty years. But here's the problem: Do you want to WAIT thirty or forty years to be rich? Hell no! You want the money NOW - so you can enjoy it. It's hard to make use of your fortune when you're seventy years old in a wheelchair. If you could make a million dollars in the next few years, what would you do with it? Where would you travel? What kind of car would you buy? The fact is ... youth is the best time to be rich. If your goal is to make quick profits in the market, volatility is your ally, and stability your enemy. You want to see those large upswings, two hundred points in a day, followed by the four hundred point crash a week later. You don't care if the market went up or down 20% this year as long it was UNSTABLE. That's how you're going to make the money. What I'm talking about here is day trading. My father invests the traditional way; he holds some good stocks and he goes up 30K and down 30K. In the long term of 5-10 years he makes money. The day trader buys or sells 5,000 shares of XYZ for a $25,000 profit in a 5-10 minute trade. He acts quickly, taking advantage of all the information at his disposal about a certain stock, and estimating whether it will go up or down within hours, sometimes within minutes. I can teach you how to do this - and how to make amazing amounts of money at it. It's not rocket science, and you only need to learn a few basic principles to get started. Society would have you believe that successful trading is complicated and requires formal training. The truth is, wealthy people use very simple investment strategies to make money. Popular media and investment professionals portray successful trading as difficult and complex to scare you out of the boxing ring. They don't want the competetion - and they sure as hell don't want you paying a few dollars to an online trading firm to execute a trade for which they'd charge you forty or fifty dollars. They make their money only if you believe two lies: 1) That investing is too difficult and risky for the average person. 2) That using an investment adviser who charges a high commission is safer than trading online for a few bucks per trade. Here is what the financial gurus in today's society absolutely, positively DO NOT WANT YOU TO KNOW ... The strategies for profitable day trading are in fact so simple that anyone can do it - provided they spend a few hours of studying. After reading over 200 financial books and publications during the past decade, and after using day trading to successfully make more than four million dollars in the stock market, I've learned the following lessons: ** Achieving financial success is incredibly simple. ** Anyone can do it. ** It only takes a few hours to learn. When I discovered the secret to day trading, I didn't become wealthy overnight. If you want instant cash, drive to Wal-mart. Buy a ski mask and a shotgun, and rob your local bank. The only way to get rich, quick or otherwise, is through hard work, knowledge, and determination. After learning the fundamentals of day trading, I started practicing the trading art itself, and the first few weeks brought modest gains. The next few months gave me the practical experience I needed to really earn a living, and I was pulling close to a six figure income. In less than three years with no formal financial training, minimal effort and only moderate risk, I had made my first million. The knowledge that I gained during those formative trading years I am willing to share with you in my new book, the Master Trader. You will learn from my mistakes, and from my successes, as I teach you the simple, secret formula for day trading that I've used profitably year after year. The income of the day trader can be staggering. Thousands, even hundreds of thousands of dollars can be made or lost within minutes. The difference between making money and losing your shirt is simply this: knowledge. I will provide that knowledge, and I will give you a winning edge at this high-stakes game. Average Income of a Day Trader: 5% average an income in excess of $500,000 per year 22% average an income in excess of $250,000 per year 35% average an income in excess of $100,000 per year. 27% average an income between $50,000 and $99,999 per year 11% average an income between $20,000 and $49,999 per year After reading the Master Trader, you will discover extremely profitable, simple yet powerful trading methods that give you an almost unfair trading advantage and make you win DESPITE the current market weakness. Here is just a snippet of what I will teach you: *** Make money whether a stock goes up or down. *** Learn how to get in and out of stocks within split seconds. *** Learn exactly what stocks to trade, the exact price to buy them and the exact price to sell them. *** Save thousands of dollars by learning to avoid the mistakes beginners make. *** Learn how to trade stocks like a pro and how to make money consistently in every market! *** Learn proven strategies that give you the highest chance for great success. *** Profit on huge intraday price swings. *** Make money on the biggest news stories. *** Actively manage your risks and learn how to realize maximum returns. *** Learn how to use the tools and information Wall Street professionals use. *** Learn how to develop and maintain a winning state of mind. It's time to ask yourself: "Am I going to listen to the Professionals who say BUY BUY BUY but never sell? Or am I going to take control of my own financial future, and start making money RIGHT NOW in the stock market?" Who is looking out for your best economic interests - some wealthy Wall Street stockbroker, or yourself? With the Master Trader e-book, you will learn everything you need to know in order to get started with Day Trading ... from choosing the best broker in order to take advantage of the lowest commissions and instant order executions to professional trading strategies that make professional traders millions of dollars. The Master Trader e-book is the most comprehensive yet easy to understand and straight-forward book ever written about active trading. If you are serious about success in short term stock trading - ORDER TODAY and start paving the road to your own financial future. Oh, and remember that scraggly kid in the eighth grade? His high school friends laughed when he said he was going to make money in the stock market. Six years later, he bought a beach-front home on the California coast - WITH CASH. Oops, they weren't laughing anymore. In a rollercoaster market like we have today, day trading is the fastest track to wealth. body:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Centre for VIT Happiness and Well Being.

Life can be challenging at times but by being resilient is how you can

stay strong and move forward even when things feel difficult. Remember that

struggles are a natural part of learning in life, and with small and

We are pleased to inform you about an exclusive 45-day internship 

opportunity with Slarox, a company dedicated to enhancing skill 

development, employability, and productivity solutions for students and 

professionals. This opportunity will provide hands-on experience working 

on live projects in various domains, helping you gain valuable industry 

exposure.

Slarox is committed to bridging the gap between education and industry 

by offering innovative solutions to students, professionals, and 

corporates. Through this internship, students will work directly on 

impactful projects, gaining practical knowledge and professional skills.

Internship Details:

 Duration: 45 Days

 Mode: Online

 Internship Fee: ₹2400

 Eligibility Criteria:

 Open to UG/PG students from all disciplines.

 Minimum CGPA: 5.5 or equivalent academic record.

 Strong communication, problem-solving, and teamwork skills.

Roles and Responsibilities:

Selected interns will be assigned to various teams based on their skills 

and interests, including:

Technical Roles:

 Software Development - Assisting in coding, debugging, and small 

project development.

 Web Development - Handling website updates, front-end/back-end 

development, and UI enhancements.

 App Development - Supporting Android/iOS app development and 

testing.

 Technical Assistance - Providing IT support, troubleshooting, and 

maintaining system performance.

 Data Analysis - Collecting and organizing data, generating reports, 

and working with Excel/SQL.

 Cybersecurity Assistance - Identifying vulnerabilities, researching 

security trends, and basic network security tasks.

 Cloud & Hosting Management - Managing website hosting, basic server 

maintenance, and cloud setup.

 Testing & Quality Assurance - Identifying bugs, writing test cases, 

and ensuring software functionality.

 Automation & Scripting - Writing small scripts to automate routine 

tasks.

MARKETING & BUSINESS ROLES:

 Marketing & Branding - Assisting in digital marketing campaigns, 

branding strategies, and promotional content.

 Digital Marketing - Managing SEO, running ads, and handling content 

marketing initiatives.

 Social Media Handler - Creating and scheduling posts, engaging with 

audiences, and growing online presence.

 Sales & Business Development - Engaging with colleges and 

corporates, working on partnerships, and assisting in proposals.

 Event & Operations Management - Planning and executing webinars, 

workshops, and company events.

 Content Creation & Copywriting - Writing blog posts, promotional 

content, and educational materials.

Key Benefits:

 Real-time industry exposure and hands-on experience.

 Certificate of Internship from Slarox.

 Opportunity for Pre-Placement Offers (PPOs) based on performance.

 Experience in a corporate work environment with direct project 

involvement.

 Development of essential professional skills, including 

communication, teamwork, and leadership.

Interested students are required to register through the following link: 

GOOGLE FORM [1]

Deadline for registration: 15th Feb.

For any queries, please contact at placementcellhelpdesk@slarox.com

body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

We are delighted to announce that the 5th Indian International Conference

on Industrial Engineering and Operations Management (IEOM 2025) will be

held from 6th to 8th November 2025 at VIT, Vellore. The conference is

jointly organized by the School of Mechanical Engineering, VIT Business

School, School of Electronics Engineering, and the IEOM Society

International, USA.

The event will feature an inspiring lineup of plenary talks, keynote

addresses, invited expert lectures, and oral presentations, providing an

excellent platform for knowledge exchange, collaboration, and innovation.

On behalf of the Organizing Committee, we cordially invite you to the

Inaugural

Ceremony of the conference, scheduled for 6th November 2025 (Thursday) at

10:00 AM, at the Dr. M. Channa Reddy Auditorium, Dr. M.G.R. Block, VIT,

Vellore.

We are also pleased to share that our Honourable Chancellor will be

conferred

with the "Transformative Education Leadership Award" by the IEOM Society

International, USA, during the inaugural session.

Please find attached the formal invitation and the detailed programme

schedule for the three-day conference.

We sincerely look forward to your gracious presence and active

participation in making this international event a grand success.

subject: Important Notice:No CHANGE in NPTEL Exam Schedule for April 2024
body:
Dear Student,
 
We wanted to take a moment to address an important matter regarding the upcoming election dates and their potential impact on your exam schedule.
 
None of the election dates clash with scheduled exam dates. If we schedule additional dates, we will ensure they again do not clash with elections in your state. 
Hence this is to confirm that there will be 
no changes to the exam dates and they are the same as previously scheduled.
 We may have exams in some cities on 
April 19 and April 26 
depending on seat availability on scheduled dates. But again this will be done ensuring we don't conduct exams on election dates in your state. 
Your academic progress and success remain our top priority, and we are committed to maintaining the integrity of the examination process.
We have more than 6 lakh learners registered for April exams and logistics has been a huge challenge. 
We understand that some of you may need to travel to your native cities to participate in the voting process. Please remember that you selected your exam cities during registration, and it is crucial that you return to these cities to take your exams as scheduled. Since hall ticket and center allocation is under process, 
exam cities selected by you during exam registration cannot be changed now. 
 
Hence we kindly request that you make the necessary arrangements to ensure you can both exercise your right to vote and fulfill your academic obligations.

55th Death Anniversary of Dr. C. N. Annadurai

Conjeevaram Natarajan Annadurai (15 September 1909 – 3 February 1969),

popularly known as Anna, also known as Arignar Anna or Perarignar

Anna (Anna, the scholar or Elder Brother), was an

Indian Tamil politician who served as the fourth and last Chief Minister of

Madras State from 1967 until 1969 and first Chief Minister of Tamil

Nadu for 20 days (after Madras State was renamed Tamil Nadu) before his

death.

Annadurai was known as one of the best Tamil orators during his time. He

developed a style in Tamil public speaking using metaphors and pleasing

alliterations, both in spoken and written language. Anna was also best

known for his extempore speaking ability being very well affluent on

rhetoric skills.

subject: Reminder: Navigating Your Career in Management
body:
Dear Students,

When people hear "management," they often think of boardrooms and power

suits. But in reality, management is the engine behind every tech startup,

global NGO, and creative agency. It’s about solving complex problems,

leading teams, and turning ideas into scalable reality.

Whether you are an aspiring entrepreneur or simply curious about how

organizations actually work, we invite you to our upcoming session: "Careers

in Management: Paths, Skills, and Strategies."

Why Attend?

The world of management is vast, and it can be hard to know where you fit.

We’re breaking down the jargon to help you understand:

 -

 1) Detailed overview of the MBA curriculum and academic structure.

 2) Career opportunities across major management streams—finance,

 marketing, sales, operations, and HR.

 3) Understanding management degree options such as MBA, MIM, and

 deferred MBA programs.

 4) Key components of a strong academic and professional profile for MBA

 aspirants.

 5) Important considerations for MBA/MiM applications in India and abroad.

------------------------------

Event Logistics

 -

 📅 Date: 5th March 2026

 -

 ⏰ Time: 6:00 pm

 -

 📍 Location: Zoom Platform

 -

 🔗 Register

 Here: https://vit-ac-in.zoom.us/meeting/register/3ZBMBeMQRQqzXomzPXYrkw

 https://vit-ac-in.zoom.us/meeting/register/3ZBMBeMQRQqzXomzPXYrkw

Who is this for?

This session is designed for students from all academic backgrounds. You

don’t need to be a business major to succeed in management—some of the best

managers in the world started in engineering, the arts, or the social

sciences.

Come with your questions and leave with a roadmap for your future.

Welcome to the New Academic Year with the Arm School Program

Empowering educators. Inspiring learners. Shaping the future.

We’re excited to share what’s new and what’s next from the Arm School Program (ASP), your go-to for free, high-quality teaching and learning materials in computing, AI, and physical computing.

What’s New? Say Hello to AI.

Earlier this year we launched our Introduction to AI course, a friendly, accessible way for teachers and students to understand the fundamentals of AI. From everyday AI applications to machine creativity, the course demystifies AI and sparks curiosity. It’s ideal for upper-secondary students (especially post-16) and a strong springboard into further study or projects.

Explore it here on [EdX](https://www.edx.org/learn/computer-science/arm-education-introduction-to-ai) or [Coursera.](https://www.coursera.org/learn/intro-to-ai-arm)

Inspiring the Next Generation: The CAS micro:bit Challenge

This summer, we supported Computing At School in their [micro:bit competition](https://www.computingatschool.org.uk/forum-news-blogs/2025/july/cas-physical-computing-competition-review/), where students tackled real-world problems with creative tech solutions. Their impressive innovations were a reminder of the power of physical computing in education.

[The CAS micro:bit Challenge](https://www.computingatschool.org.uk/forum-news-blogs/2025/july/cas-physical-computing-competition-review/)

Looking Ahead: Sneak Peek at What’s Coming

We know teachers love planning ahead, so here’s a look at what’s in the pipeline:

Wildlife Tracker Project

Imagine tracking endangered animals in the wild using a Raspberry Pi Zero W and GPS! This project links real-world conservation with computing, ideal for upper-secondary learners working towards UN Sustainable Development Goal 15: Life on Land.

Micro:bits Meet Formula 1

In an exciting collaboration between Arm and Aramco Aston Martin, we’re creating a new resource using micro:bits and CreateAI. Students will explore how AI and sensors can support high-performance racing, from track telemetry to pit stop predictions, then train micro:bits to recognize gestures.

Join the Community: CAS & CSTA Groups

Want to swap ideas, share triumphs, and pick up new tricks for the classroom? Join the Physical Computing groups in both [CAS](https://community.computingatschool.org.uk/) (UK) and [CSTA](https://csteachers.org/) (US). These growing educator communities are full of creativity, and we’re proud to help fuel the conversation.

ASP Resources: Always Free, Always Expanding

If you haven’t visited our [resource hub](https://www.arm.com/resources/education/schools?#community), now’s the time! You’ll find a growing collection of free classroom materials that blend computing, science, and AI, grounded in evidence-based pedagogy, and powered by real-world tech.

Thanks for being part of the ASP community. Whether you’re just starting out or a seasoned STEM superhero, we’re here to support you every step of the way.

Here’s to another year of curious learners, creative classrooms, and computing with purpose.

subject: ULINK Credit Transfer Guidelines
body:
ULINK – Credit Transfer Guidelines

Dear Student,

In order to strengthen the undergraduate research engagement and outcomes,

a new initiative titled “Undergraduate–Lab Integration for Knowledge &

Innovation (ULINK)” is being introduced. This program aims to integrate

undergraduate students with active research laboratories, fostering

hands-on learning, innovation, and collaborative research at an early stage.

1. Eligibility for Credit Transfer:

Students participating in the ULINK initiative are eligible to receive

credit transfer under the following categories:

Ø Open Elective (OE)

Ø Discipline Elective (DE)

2. Publication Requirement:

Ø To qualify for credit transfer, students must publish their research

output in a Scopus-indexed journal or conference.

Ø Once the paper is indexed, students must submit the Digital Object

Identifier (DOI) as proof of publication.

3. Award of Credits

Ø Credits will be awarded once a tangible outcome is achieved.

4. Group Projects:

Ø The number of students in a group will be decided by the mentor, based

on the nature and scope of the project.

with regards

M. Anthony Xavior PhD

Dean Academics

subject: Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for Fall 2023-24 Freshers (except Freshers 3Yr Programme / B.Sc – Agri / B.Des) FAT – Theory
body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2024/24002

 Date: 04-January-2024

Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for

Fall 2023-24 Freshers (except Freshers 3Yr Programme / B.Sc – Agri / B.Des)

FAT – Theory

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Fall Semester

2023-24”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during Dec 2023 has

been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 10 January 2024 (Wednesday).

The Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics

→ Regulations Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for each

paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Fall Semester

2023-24→Paper Seeing. You can choose course(s) you want to apply for

paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a payment

through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, within one or two working days, the paper

and question wise marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra

login. You need to use the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this

process. After seeing the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a

particular question is not sufficient and the evaluator has missed

something and there is a need to recheck the mark, then you can apply for

Revaluation of the Course. You need to give suitable reason for the same in

the comments section available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also needs to be paid through online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper).

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by CoE office . For other

components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode courses)

there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· Actual Grades will be released after the completion of

“Paper-Seeing” and Revaluation Registration Processes. The links for Paper

seeing and Revaluation payments have been enabled in VTop Students login.

Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for re-evaluation and is

in online mode only.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 04- Jan -2024 to 08- Jan -2024

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

05- Jan -2024 to 09- Jan -2024

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

05- Jan -2024 to 09- Jan -2024

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which needs to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation request will summarily be rejected.

Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

S. No.

Description

Supporting Evidence(s) Required

1.

Calamity in the family [Death of father / mother / own brother / sister]

Death certificate or Prior communication to the Proctors

2.

Hospitalization of the student

(for in-patient treatment only)

Medical Certificate, Investigation Report, Bills and Discharge Summary.

· Eligible students should apply in VTop student login (

Examination > Re-Exam Application) between 11th January 2024 and 25th

January 2024 and upload the necessary evidences.

· Re-FAT requests will be scrutinized by the School Dean and then

by the ‘Re‐examinations Committee’. If needed the student may be asked to

appear before the Committee for presenting the case.

· For the ReFAT approved courses the Grade assigned will be

converted to “---“ by February end. ReFAT will be scheduled along with the

Winter 2023-24 Regular Arrear and the Winter/Regular Arrear Process will be

followed for Re-FAT.

· Any student who fails to apply for Re‐FAT through VTop will NOT

be considered for further processing and has to repeat the course(s) by

registering again in subsequent semesters.

· Please note that this process is only for getting approval for

Re-FAT. After it is approved, students need to register in Arrear / Re-FAT

Tab for registering the course when it is permitted. The schedule will be

available only in Arrear/ Tab. If someone misses the approved Re-FAT, no

second chance will be given and it will be treated as absent accordingly

grade will be published.

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

World Telecommunication and Information Society Day (WTISD) is observed

annually on May 17th. As World Telecommunication and Information Society

Day serves as an opportunity to reaffirm our collective commitment to

promoting digital inclusion and harnessing the power of digital

technologies for sustainable development, here is all you need to know

about the day.

Telecommunication & Campus Life

We would like to see your unique perspective of telecommunication on

campus. Capture the essence through your cell phone.

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence of our

 campus in a unique and interesting way?

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by today 05:00 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts today at 06:00 am and ends by 05:00

pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

subject: Selling Travel in Today's Economy
body: Selling Travel in Today's Economy Good morning! Since it may have been awhile since you visited us at http://www.mailpound.com www.mailpound.com I wanted to update you on what is happening. When we launched the MailPound almost two years ago, our focus was on saving "Time, Toner and Trees" by providing an alternative for organizing the huge number of faxes suppliers sent travel agents each week. Our most popular feature was the FAM section, followed by the Weekly Sweepstakes. But that has changed. Like many involved in selling retail travel, we have been striving to find ways to succeed in a challenging environment. Additional commission cuts, the aftermath of 9/11, and the drop in the stock market, has had a cumulative effect on all of us. To survive, to succeed, we know that we will need to work harder, work smarter, and work together. subject: Innovation week
body:
In an effort to recognize and groom the young talents of VIT, Office of

Innovation, Startup and Technology Transfer along with IIC, E-Cell, IPR

cell, VITAA, VIT Business School and Alumni Entrepreneurs of VIT is

planning to conduct an Innovation week between 22nd to 25th January 2023.

During this week a series of events like Hackathons, Workshops are planned

to be conducted. During the first three days of the event (22nd to 24th

of Jan), Hackathons in various themes will be conducted. For Hacakathon, a

team can have a maximum of three members out of which one girl student is

compulsory. The team members should be interdisciplinary. Last date for the

registration is 10 of January 2024. Grand Prices are planned for the

Hackathon. For more details see the attached Flyer. I request all the

students to make use of this opportunity.

C Ramesh Kumar

Professor and Director

subject: Congratulations to Team Impact Innovators for their Achievement at Vibrance '26 – VIT Chennai
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Impact Innovators secured 1st place in

the event Global Idea Roulette at Vibrance '26, the annual cultural

fest of VIT Chennai, held from 18th to 21st February 2026.

The event was a fast-paced entrepreneurial simulation where teams developed

and pitched scalable business ideas aligned with the Sustainable

Development Goals (SDGs) within strict time limits. The event witnessed

participation from around 100 competitors, and our team proudly emerged as

the champions among the strong field.

Team Members:

 1. Aayush Keshwani – 24MIC0103

 2. Arshia Ghosh – 24BCI0093

 3. Traya Jawahar – 24MIS0435

We express our gratitude to the Faculty Mentor, Dr. Jayakumar S (Emp. ID:

12566), whose guidance and mentorship played a key role in the team’s

success.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Team Impact Innovators on

their remarkable achievement and wish them continued success in their

future endeavors.

subject: RoboVITics Club Magazine 2025 | Celebrating 15 Years of Innovation
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to unveil the Crystal Edition of our annual magazine,

commemorating 15 remarkable years of innovation, learning, and excellence

within the RoboVITics community.

Rooted in a passion for robotics and engineering, RoboVITics has

continually evolved since its inception. Over the years, this passion has

transformed into a culture of creativity, collaboration, and technical

excellence, bringing together like-minded innovators dedicated to pushing

boundaries and turning ideas into impactful solutions.

This edition captures our journey through 2025, showcasing the technical

projects developed by our teams, the events we successfully conducted, and

the milestones achieved by our members throughout the year, reflecting the

dedication, teamwork, and growth that define our community.

We invite you to dive into our journey here:

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Ycd76P7kxszbPqTYpeSCTFRmOsU1qTWY/view?usp=sharing

We hope you enjoy revisiting our story as much as we enjoyed bringing it to

life.

 PrepFree AI tool access for Mock Interview and Resume building.

 Weekly Bootcamps, Job Recommendation with Leading Companies.

Guidelines for course registration and evaluation process

# Students are advised to check the curriculum and plan accordingly.

For the students of B. Tech Core Programmes, this project type course will

be considered under Programme Elective Category and for the students of

"Specialization Programmes", it will be considered under "Open Elective

Category". If the students of "Specialization Programmes" have already

earned sufficient credits under "Open Elective Category", then it is not

necessary to register for this project type course.

# Students are expected to form a team and identify a faculty guide

from any School to initiate the process.

# Project Team should comprise a minimum of two to a maximum of five

students only from any B. Tech Programme of any School / Five Year

Integrated Programme as applicable. (students of B. Tech Programme and Five

Year Integrated Programme can not be in the same team)

# Domain specific / Interdisciplinary / Multidisciplinary /

Cross-disciplinary projects are encouraged.

# Guide will finalize the tentative title / area of the work and

the team of students to work on each project. Course Registration is opened

on VTOP Login for the faculty members (Guide). (Preliminary discussion

between the guide and the student is essential)

# Students can work for one project type course at any point of

time.

# Course Registration will be done by the respective Guide only. The

Guide will fill in the necessary data (Project title and the Registration

Number of all the students proposed to work on each of the projects) on

VTOP Faculty Login.

# Subsequently the course will reflect on the list of registered

courses for that particular semester on VTOP Student Login. This three

credit course will not affect the upper limit of 27 credits allowed for a

regular semester.

# Minimum duration of the project period is six months and the

maximum duration is 12 months.

# Once the Project work is completed and a tangible

outcome (Research / Review Paper published / accepted in Scopus / WoS,

Journal / Conference Proceedings: Product Design / Patent Application) is

reached, the Guide will post the marks out of 100 for each student on VTOP

and submit.

# Absolute Grading System will be followed for the listed project

type courses as per VIT Grading Policy

# Even after 12 months, if the team fails to complete the project,

then the course will be de-registered for the students.

Faculty Members are requested to note the message and proceed accordingly.

Project Course Registration is enabled for all the faculty members on "VTOP

- Faculty Login"

with regards

M. Anthony Xavior PhD

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [02nd September]

events.

World Coconut Day

World Coconut Day is observed every year on September 2 to promote the

importance of coconuts and their contributions to various aspects of life,

including the economy, agriculture, and health. The theme for World Coconut

Day 2023 is 'Coconuts: Transforming Lives'. The day is particularly

important for countries that heavily rely on coconut farming for their

livelihoods and economies.

National Nutrition Week (01st - 07th September)

National Nutrition week (NNW) is an annual nutrition event of great

importance and is observed in the country from 1st to 7th September every

year since 1982. The week-long observance aims to address the multifaceted

challenges of malnutrition and promote healthier lifestyles across the

nation. This week-long observance, organized by the Ministry of Women and

Child Development (M Ministry of Women and Child Development (MWCD) in

collaboration with the Food and Nutrition Board (FNB), encourages healthy

eating habits and highlights the profound impact of nutrition on health. It

also celebrates the rich diversity of food cultures across the country.

The theme for National Nutrition Week 2024 is 'Nutritious Diets for

Everyone.' The theme supports the United Nations' goals for sustainable

development.

Dear Students,

As part of our ongoing efforts to strengthen practical learning and

research-oriented skill development, we propose to conduct a series

of hands-on

training programs for UG students.

As the first initiative, a PCB Board Design Training Program is planned

during January 2026. The training will focus on fundamentals and

practical aspects of schematic design, PCB layout, and design workflows

relevant to laboratory work, academic projects, and research activities.

Interested students are requested to register using the link given below:

https://forms.gle/69n5tmmGzqXzeAnq8

In addition, students are asked to indicate any

other hands-on or skills-oriented training programs they believe are

required to strengthen their technical understanding, research

capabilities, and practical problem-solving skills (e.g., embedded

systems, EV technologies, power electronics, AI/ML tools, CAD, simulation

software, etc.).

https://forms.gle/a2nYeGcJnLhLSZXK6

The collected inputs will be used solely for planning future academic and

research-focused training programs.

Further details regarding the schedule and mode of training will be

communicated to the registered students in due course.

subject: Global Internship & Job Bridge Program for Odd Semester Students
body:
Hello Students,

Congratulations on being shortlisted for the internship program!

[IMPORTANT]

We are excited to announce the Unlox - Tech driven

https://unlox.com/ 3-month Job Bridge Program 2025 for UG/PG students, in

collaboration with the 83+ Academic and Employment Partners, NATIONAL SKILL

DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NSDC).

Fill out the Google Form today to reserve your place in the program:

 https://forms.gle/TT9bzrTVywGFe4n98

https://forms.gle/TT9bzrTVywGFe4n98 

Here is an outline of the program's structure.

1. Training Outline

 - Live Mentoring with Industry Experts: Evening classes (6:30 PM -

 8:00 PM) are conducted live (Which is only Live) on the Zoom platform to

 fit your schedule. Get guidance at every step.

- From Basics to Advanced: Perfect for beginners and those looking to

 refine advanced skills, starting from scratch.

 - BLU AI-Powered Development Made Easy: Build applications with

 minimal coding, create innovative solutions using BLU AI, and easily design

 effective AI prompts.

 - LMS Access for Flexibility: Recorded live sessions will be uploaded

 to the Learning Management System (LMS) and available for 6 months from the

 batch start date. Login credentials will be shared after registration,

 ensuring uninterrupted learning at your own pace.

2. Internship Conduct

 - 10+ Minor Project: The minor project is an individual project,

 where students will work on projects related to each topic they are

 learning.

 - Major Project (CAPSTONE): The major project is a group project, and

 you will work in a group of 3-4 interns, with specific responsibilities

 assigned to each intern. The company will provide you with all the required

 data and materials for the project.

 - Resume Building: Get expert guidance to craft a standout resume that

 gets noticed.

 - Mock Interviews: Receive feedback from industry experts to sharpen

 your interview skills.

 - Masterclasses: Learn from top leaders in global companies through

 exclusive sessions.

Certifications Provided

 - Blu – Your AI Mentor: Get 24/7 support with instant doubt solutions

 and personalized learning feedback.

 - Edu-let Tablet – Built for Learning: Stay focused with your

 dedicated tablet preloaded with content & mentor access. Learn on campus

 or at home—no distractions

 - Course Certificate: Receive a prestigious certificate from Unlox

 Verified by Skill India, Startup India.

 - Internship Certificate: Earn a certificate from our partnered MNCs &

 StartUps.

 - Career Launchpad – Powered by PrepFree https://www.prepfree.in/

 -

 Smart, ATS-friendly resume building

 -

 AI-powered mock interviews for real-time feedback

 -

 Weekly boot camps led by industry experts

 -

 Job Recommendations matched to your skills and goals

subject: University of Queensland (UQ), Australia and the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) Research Academy Call for applications / Expression of Interest for Joint PhD programme July 2026
body:
Dear Students,

The University of Queensland (UQ), Australia and the Indian Institute of

Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) have announced the opening of Expressions of

Interest (EOI) for their prestigious Joint Doctor of Philosophy (PhD)

Programme, commencing in July 2026.

The collaborative programme offers candidates the opportunity to undertake

cutting-edge research under the supervision of leading academics from both

institutions, while experiencing the academic environments of India and

Australia. Graduates will be awarded a joint PhD degree from UQ and IIT

Delhi upon successful completion.

Applications are invited from exceptional candidates across diverse

disciplines including Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics,

Humanities, and Social Sciences. EOIs can be submitted online until 7:00

PM (IST) on Wednesday, 7 January 2026, via the official website:

https://uqiitd.org/study.

Prospective students are encouraged to participate in the upcoming online

information session on 10 December 2025 (registration link) to learn more

about the programme structure, eligibility, and application process.

The UQ–IIT Delhi Joint PhD Programme exemplifies the growing commitment

between Australia and India to promote high-impact research collaborations,

foster innovation, and strengthen academic ties.

body:
Dear VITians,

We are happy to announce that our Student Team Eximus (C.S.E.D) has

secured First Place in the event Launcher at Shaastra 2024 organised

by IIT Madras.

Launcher was a marketing event wherein participants showcased their

strategic prowess by presenting innovative marketing strategies for

existing products and brands. The competition challenged participants to

redefine these products while preserving their core essence. Participants

engaged in a formal presentation format, addressing a judge panel that

evaluates the depth, creativity, and feasibility of their proposed

marketing strategies. The competition served as a platform for aspiring

marketers to demonstrate their analytical skills, strategic thinking, and

ability to adapt existing products to meet the evolving needs of diverse

consumer segments.

The presentation was based on a case about a hypothetical SUV car called

Tiger, that the team was presented with data and records and were to deduce

marketing strategies for rebranding and relaunching of the product,

differentiating from its competitors.

Team Members:

1. Ruchita Maurya (21BBT0005)

2. Souvik Mukherjee (21BEC0345)

3. Urva Dhoriyani (21BEC0702)

Congratulations and Best Wishes to Team Eximus!

Martyrs' Day

January 30 is observed as the Martyrs' Day every year across the country to

mark the death anniversary of Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, popularly known

as Mahatma Gandhi or Bapu. Martyrs' Day or 'Shaheed Diwas' also aims at

paying respect to the freedom fighters who gave up their lives in the fight

for India's independence.

Gandhi died at the spot on January 30, 1948, some five months after India

gained independence from the British. Ever since then, India observes that

day as Shaheed Diwas to mourn the loss of its greatest freedom fighter.

This year, the Central government has directed all state governments and

union ministries to observe two minutes of silence on January 30 in the

memory of martyred freedom fighters.

subject: CO2 Research Centre Newsletter - Volume 2/Open for New Student Projects & Collaborations.
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

I am pleased to present the second volume of our CO2 Research and Green

Technologies Centre's newsletter, covering the period from June 2023 to

July 2024. Please find the attached file.

We extend our sincere gratitude to the VIT Management for their unwavering

support in enhancing our Centre's research infrastructure and fostering

research excellence.

Our Centre serves as an interdisciplinary research hub dedicated to:

 - Carbon Capture Utilization Systems (CCUS)

 - Biomass and Biogas-based Energy Production

 - Green Technological Methods: Including electrochemical,

 bio-electrochemical, and biochemical approaches for sensing and energy

 systems.

Since its establishment in 2010, our Centre has achieved a commendable

research output, producing approximately 500 publications with nearly 6000

citations and an average impact factor of 4.1.

A significant milestone in the past year was the publication of a research

article in Nature Energy (Impact Factor: 46.7) focused on Electrochemical

Energy Systems. We are also proud to have successfully transferred

technology based on our patented work (patent no : 372595; Related Green

Cement production) on "Development of Eco-Bacterial Lime Mortars" to ALCON,

LLP, Goa, India, marking a first for VIT, Vellore.

Furthermore, we have secured substantial funding through various government

funding agencies and consultancy projects, totalling ₹2.4 crores from

funding agencies and ₹31 lakhs from consultancy. Notably, the funding

received for consultancy work surpasses that of all other schools and

centres within the VIT, Vellore campus.

We warmly invite enthusiastic students to consider our Centre for their

capstone projects and encourage faculty members to collaborate with us on

interdisciplinary funded projects, consultancy work, publications, and the

development of impactful and target-oriented patents.

For your convenience, the newsletter is also accessible online as an e-book

at https://online.flippingbook.com/view/103136345/

Thank you once again for your continued support.

With best regards,

Annamalai Senthil Kumar, CChem., FRSC

Senior Professor & Director, CO2 Research and Green Technologies Centre,

Vellore Institute of Technology(VIT), Vellore - 632014, India

subject: International Happiness Day 2026 – Join the Celebration with Cultural Performances at Greenos!
body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students' Welfare warmly invites you to a vibrant celebration

of the International Happiness Day 2026, brought to life through an

evening of spectacular cultural programs!

In celebration of the International Happiness Day 2026, established by the

UN to recognize happiness as a fundamental human goal, this year’s

theme, “Caring

and Sharing”, highlights kindness, connection, and the impact of social

media on well-being.

This special occasion is dedicated to spreading joy, positivity, and

togetherness across our campus. Experience an exciting showcase of talent,

diversity, and creativity as students come together to celebrate happiness

through music, dance, and artistic expression.

Get ready for an evening filled with energy, colors, and unforgettable

moments that reflect the true spirit of unity and joy at VIT.

Venue: Greenos

Time: 5:00 PM onwards

Date: 25th March, 2026

Let’s celebrate happiness together—through culture, connection, and

collective joy. Your presence will make the celebration even more

meaningful!

Today's Events by Clubs and Chapters:

 - Inithu Inithu

 - Happiness Through Nostalgia

 - Cultural Performances

 - International Happiness Day 2026 - Stalls

Tamil Literary Association

Event Name: Inithu Inithu

Event Time: 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM

Event Description: Inithu Inithu is a lively and engaging event designed to

spread joy, laughter, and positivity among students. The session includes a

variety of fun activities such as creative games like Green Screen,

interactive conversations about the stories behind students' smiles, and

sharing memorable moments connected to meaningful places. Participants will

also have the opportunity to write special notes to the world, expressing

thoughts that inspire happiness and strength.

Venue: PRP Annexe 302

Anokha NGOEvent Name: Happiness Through Nostalgia

Event Time: 10:30 AM - 1:00 PM

Event Description: The Happiness Through Nostalgia event celebrates the

International Day of Happiness through interactive activities like

dialogue-guessing games and a Kahoot quiz. By revisiting nostalgic movie

moments and shared memories, it promotes laughter, connection, and friendly

competition, creating a joyful and refreshing experience for students.

Venue: CBMR 203

SIGMA.XIEvent Name: Compliments & Mini Talent Showcase – Spread

Kindness, Share Your Spark

Event Time: 5:00 PM onwards

Event Description: This interactive event combines a Compliment Booth and a

Mini Talent Showcase to spread positivity and celebrate student creativity.

Participants can write and share kind compliments with others while also

enjoying short performances where students showcase their hidden talents

such as singing, dancing, poetry, comedy, or other unique skills. The event

aims to create a joyful and supportive environment that encourages

confidence, appreciation, and community bonding.

Venue: Greenos

SESI VIT

Event Name: International Happiness Day 2026 Celebrations - Stalls

Event Time: 5:00 PM onwards

Event Description: As part of Happiness Week, interactive stalls are set up

to spread joy and positivity. Participants can visit anytime to enjoy quick

fun activities, relax, and share cheerful moments. The stalls create a

lively space for connection, laughter, and refreshing breaks from routine,

leaving everyone with a happy and positive vibe.

Venue: Greenos

Enajori (ALA VIT)Event Name: International Happiness Day 2026

Celebrations - Stalls

Event Time: 5:00 PM onwards

Event Description: Celebrate joy at our Enajori (ALA VIT) Happiness Day

stall! Enjoy fun mini games like “Throw the Ball & Take a Dare,” the “Make

Us Laugh Challenge,” and classic marble games. Bring your friends, share

laughter, and create cheerful memories. Exciting surprises and smiles

await, along with small takeaways to brighten your day—because happiness

grows when shared. Join us at greenos from 5pm onwards and spread

positivity, one game at a time!

Venue: Greenos

Anokha NGOEvent Name: International Happiness Day 2026 Celebrations -

Stalls

Event Time: 5:00 PM onwards

Event Description: The Happiness Day Stall is an interactive space designed

to promote positivity and stress relief through fun activities.

Participants can engage in games like Burst Your Anger, Blindfold

Placement, Tissue Pop Dare, and Stack Your Mood, while also expressing

themselves through the Happiness Chart and Self-Care Chits. The stall aims

to create a cheerful atmosphere, encourage interaction, and spread smiles

among everyone.

Venue: Greenos

We are glad to inform you that the Grievance Portal is now live and

available for use on the VITian app. This portal has been created to help

students easily report and resolve their concerns in a transparent and

efficient manner.

You can raise grievances under various categories such as:

 - Scholarships

 - Proctoring

 - ECA Course

 - NRI / Foreign Students

 - Female Students Grievances

 - Lost and Found items

 - External Participation

 - Day Scholar / Day Boarder

 - Health Centre

 - Campus Amenities

 - Clubs / Chapters / Teams

 - Disciplinary Issues / Misconducts

 - Counselling Support

We encourage every student to make use of this feature whenever required.

Your feedback and concerns will help us ensure a better campus experience

for everyone.

We extend our sincere appreciation to Dr. Vijayakunmar T, Director, SDC,

and his team for their dedicated efforts in making this possible.

subject: UGC Confidential Youth Survey on Anti-Ragging Mechanisms
body:
Dear VITians

In alignment with our shared commitment to fostering safe, inclusive, and

respectful campus environments, we wish to bring to your attention an

important initiative led by the University Grants Commission (UGC)

Anti-Ragging National Monitoring Agency.

A “Confidential Youth Survey” is currently being conducted to assess the

effectiveness of anti-ragging measures across Higher Educational

Institutions (HEIs) in India. This nationwide effort seeks candid feedback

from students regarding their experiences and perceptions of anti-ragging

systems in place at their respective institutions.

 Survey Link: https://www.antiragging.in/youth-survey.php

 We earnestly request your support in encouraging students to participate

in this survey. Their insights will be instrumental in shaping stronger,

more responsive anti-ragging frameworks across the country.

 Key points to note:

- Participation is voluntary and confidential.

- The survey is open to all students enrolled in HEIs.

- All the institutions, including VIT, are encouraged to circulate the

survey link through emails, websites, notice boards, and student WhatsApp

groups.

Your proactive involvement will greatly enhance the reach and impact of

this initiative, reinforcing our collective dedication to student welfare

and campus safety.

Anti-Ragging Helpline: 1800-180-5522 and website: www.antiragging.in
