body:
UBS Campus Hackathon 2025 is here - where talent meets tech and coding

skills are put to the test!

We’re excited to invite students from your campus to join our on-site

Hackathon at offices in Mumbai and Pune, where they’ll collaborate and

compete in a professional, dynamic environment.

As we celebrate 10 years of impact in India, we remain committed to

engineering

excellence, simplification, and continuous learning to deliver

best-in-class solutions to our colleagues and clients.

What’s in it for them?

· Tackle real-world tech challenges

· Receive mentorship from industry experts

· Engage with UBS senior leadership

· Get a chance to fast-track into our Graduate Program

· What’s more? Winner gets a Home Pod mini by Apple; 1st Runner Up gets

JBL Live headphones and 2nd Runner up gets the JBL Bud earphones

How can they join?

The journey starts with a HackerRank test at your respective campus. The

top performers will qualify for the in-person Hackathon in March 2025!

HackerRank test details

· Test dates: 27 / 28 February (final date as confirmed by Training and

Placement Office)

· Test link: Sent one day in advance to eligible candidates via email

· Eligibility: Students pursuing their second/third year of Bachelor’s

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and

Communication, Data Science with a CGPA of 8+ (applications to be

processed through campus Training and Placement Office)

· Results announced: Between 28 February to 1 March (confirmation from

respective Training and Placement Office)

Hackathon details

· Teams of up to six members

· In-person event at UBS Mumbai and Pune offices in March 2025

· UBS will cover travel, accommodation, and meals for outstation

participants

Local candidates from Mumbai and Pune will manage their own travel. UBS

will cover flights and cabs for outstation participants.

Interested and eligible students can register in the below link on or

subject: SW Special Event: Speaker Session on World Suicide Prevention Day - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

On the occasion of World Suicide Prevention Day, the Office of Students'

Welfare is pleased to invite you to a special speaker session aimed at

raising awareness about mental well-being and suicide prevention.

The session will be conducted by Dr. Shiva Prakash Srinivasan, a renowned

expert in the field, on 11th September 2024, from 10:00 AM at Channa Reddy

Auditorium. Dr. Srinivasan will share valuable insights on mental health,

offer coping strategies, and foster a deeper understanding of suicide

prevention.

We encourage all students and faculty to attend this important session as

we work together to promote mental well-being within our community.

Event Details:Date: 11th September 2024Time: 10:00 AMVenue: Channa Reddy

Auditorium

Your presence would be greatly appreciated. Let’s make mental health a

priority and come together to support one another.

Christmas is celebrated every year on December 25th. The festival marks the

Messiah of God in Christian Mythology. During the Christmas festival,

family, friends, and relatives come together to joyfully celebrate the

country commemorates the birth anniversary of the Former Prime Minister and

recipient of the highest civilian award in India - Bharat Ratna, Shri. Atal

Bihari Vajpayee.

Literary Association (ELA), secured Second Place in the writing

event “Lights!

Camera! Fiction!” at Saarang 2026, the annual cultural festival of IIT

Madras, held on 10th January 2026 at IIT Madras, Chennai.

incomplete drama enacted live on stage, testing their imagination,

sender: VIT Finlatics <applications@finlatics.info>
subject: Live Project - Financial Markets and Investment Banking (Financial Analyst)
body:
Dear NAYAN SHARMA,

We're pleased to open applications for the Finlatics Financial Analyst program, an online live project that helps students gain work experience in Financial Markets and Investment Banking (private equity & venture capital) at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

The project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Delhi, IIT Bombay, IIM Ahmedabad, IIM Bangalore, and BITS Pilani, among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

Financial Markets

1. Equity trading, research, and analysis based program.

2. Create, manage and maintain a real-time simulated portfolio on BSE 500 listed companies.

3. The simulated portfolio will be assessed by linking it to the real-time BSE 500 INDEX, akin to an asset management company.

4. Learn and apply Fundamental & Technical Analysis to companies.

Investment Banking

1. Assess investment proposals and identify companies with high growth potential and understand various stages of private equity investing.

2. Engage in setting up a Private Equity Fund, emphasizing investor onboarding, investing cycles & sectoral orientation.

3. Author case-based projects on successful exits in the private equity space, by analyzing mergers & acquisitions.

4. Learn how to apply Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Valuation & Excel-based modeling to companies.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience in:

a. Financial Markets as an Equity Markets Analyst

b. Private Equity and venture Capital as an Investment Banking Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. Engage in an Artificial Intelligence-driven mock interview

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch :

https://www.finlatics.com/fa_applications?utm_src=vitv

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in this project. Personalized guidance and mentoring, as well as live sessions, will be provided to train students.

Project Duration: 2 months (4 - 5 hours per week)

Project Start: Flexible Start date option on selected student choice. 100% Online.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

Incentives: up to Rs. 6000 (to monthly top-performing students)

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee: Rs.2999 / Rs.3999 (on student choice)

Fee Waiver: A 20 - 25% Fee Waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technology students on the above mentioned minimal induction fee.

To be eligible for the fee waiver, kindly apply through the above-mentioned link only.

We are looking forward to a fruitful engagement.

sender: 'Vice Chancellor' via B.Tech. - Comp  Sci Engg 2023 Group, Vellore Campus <23bce@vitstudent.ac.in>
subject: Hearty Congratulations to our Honorable Chancellor Sir from all VITians
body:
Dear VITians,

I am greatly pleased to extend our warmest congratulations to our beloved

and Honorable Chancellor who will receive the State University of New York

(SUNY) honorary Doctor of Laws degree on May 10 during Binghamton

University’s Commencement ceremony for the Thomas J. Watson College of

Engineering and Applied Science.

Receiving this honorary doctorate is a well-deserved acknowledgment of our

Honorable Chancellor’s outstanding contributions and it is a testament to

his relentless pursuit of excellence, our founder’s exceptional dedication

to educational administration, for the cause of higher education in India,

his thriving visionary leadership in international higher education, and his

humanitarian efforts and entrepreneurship. This will be the second Honorary

Doctorate conferred on our Chancellor Sir, after the previous honor from

West Virginia University in 2009. As he receives this well-deserved honor,

it also signifies the immense potential for future endeavors with his

passion and vision continuing to shape the landscape of higher education.

Binghamton University's President, Prof. Harvey Stenger, commended

Chancellor Sir for his remarkable accomplishments and highlighted the

university's strong partnership with VIT. He emphasized the significance of

ongoing collaborations between the two institutions through research and

student exchanges. The successful 15-year partnership between Watson

College, Binghamton University, and VIT has resulted in joint academic

programmes, faculty exchanges, and collaborative research, strengthening

academic connections and facilitating knowledge sharing. For more details,

please refer to the link given below.

Thirukkural says thus:

அஞ்சாமை ஈகை அறிவூக்கம் இந்நான்கும்

எஞ்சாமை வேந்தர்க் கியல்பு.

Translation: Courage, generosity, knowledge (wisdom), motivation (Zeal)

are the four essential elements of a successful leader (King). 

His dedication to excellence in the path of the above four serves as a

beacon light of inspiration for all of us to follow him. Hearty

Congratulations from all of us, to our Honorable Chancellor Sir on this

remarkable achievement. We pray for his continued success, fulfillment, and

boundless opportunities in all his future endeavors.

Binghamton University News Link

https://www.binghamton.edu/news/story/4875/vellore-institute-of-technology-chancellor-to-receive-honorary-degree-at-watson-college-commencement

Thanks and warm regards.

Dr. V S Kanchana Bhaaskaran

Vice-Chancellor

Vellore Institute of Technology

Vellore – 632 014, Tamil Nadu, India

subject: Instructions on BCSE399J - Summer Industrial Internship (1 Credit Course) - Reg.
body:
Dear Students,

Greetings. The general guidelines to be followed for undergoing BCSE399J -

Summer Industrial Internship (1 Credit Course):

It is mandatory to undergo the Internship only during the regular semester

break, and a Minimum of 28 days is expected.

The internship must be related to Computer Science and Engineering.

Students can apply for an INDUSTRIAL INTERNSHIP BONAFIDE certificate on

VTOP. If you need bonafide in any other format, you can request it through

the mail along with complete details (company name, website, contact person

details - name, mobile, and email), and the school will issue the same.

It is the responsibility of the students to approach companies.

Students are expected to opt for any one of the modes to complete the

internship and claim the credits.

· The internship must be from a reputed industry.

· The internship offered by VIT – TBI (Technology Business

Incubation).

· Value Added Courses relevant to Computer Science and Engineering.

· Certification courses shared by O/o CDC (Meet/ Mail to Prof. S

Jayakumar for details).

The contact details (company name, website, contact person details - name,

mobile, and email) must be submitted wherever required. A report on the

training needs to be prepared and the format for the same will be shared

after the internship.

After successful registration:

To be uploaded on VTOP:

· Activity Log (Day to Day Activities)

· Certificate Issued

As a part of the evaluation, A review will be conducted by the school to

assess the work carried out during the internship.

Not Considered for Credits

· Internships from the training centre

· Skill development programs

· Other Online Courses

For clarifications, Students can contact the undersigned/ Coordinator

(Prof. Lydia Jane. G).

Best Regards,

Dr.K.S.Umadevi

Professor and Head

Department of Software Systems

School of Computer Science and Engineering

Greetings from HCLTech!

We are excited to announce the launch of AMPlified: The AI Challenge.

This is HCLTech’s flagship campus hackathon experience under the AMP

program - created to identify and empower the next generation of AI-native

talent.

As a preferred primus campus, we are delighted to invite students from your

institution to apply for AMPlified. Each participating college can

nominate up to 50 bright and coding-oriented engineering students from

the 5th to 7th semester.

As part of the experience, students will participate in daily, weekly and

quarterly hackathon formats, giving them multiple opportunities to learn,

improve and compete throughout the quarter.

What makes AMPlified unique is its token-based scoring model. Students

can earn up to 1,075 tokens per quarter through daily submissions, weekly

challenges, leaderboard performance and prototype-building rounds. The

higher the tokens earned, the higher the student moves on the individual

leaderboard.

At the same time, every student’s performance will contribute to the

college’s overall score. Colleges will be ranked based on the combined

inter-college ranking system.

Each college will also receive a dedicated admin login to track student

scores, participation status, individual rankings and overall college

performance through the platform dashboard.

To make the competition even more rewarding, top-performing students each

quarter will have the chance to win exciting prizes such as a MacBook and

iPads. They will also be invited to an HCLTech campus for a special one-day

experience, including interactions with senior leaders, visits to

innovation labs and exposure to some of the advanced technology work being

delivered by HCLTech teams.

subject: Undergraduate (UG) Research publications and Achievements for June 2026
body:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Office of Academic Research (UG Research).

We are pleased to share the June 2026 UG Student Publication Summary and

Achievement posters, highlighting the research accomplishments of our

undergraduate students.

During June 2026, 186 undergraduate students from different disciplines

contributed to 87 research publications. In addition, 277 undergraduate

students actively participated in patent-related research, resulting in

the publication of 145 patents during the month.

As of June 30, 2026, our UG students have already published 522 research

papers this year. This represents nearly 98% of the 532 publications

achieved during the entire calendar year of 2025. This remarkable

progress reflects the dedication of our students and the continuous

guidance and support of our faculty mentors.

We sincerely thank all faculty mentors for their valuable guidance and

congratulate every student author and inventor on these outstanding

achievements.

Let us continue this momentum and achieve even greater milestones by the

end of 2026.

subject: YANTRA'26: Day-5 Events (11-02-26) - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details:

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 5:

CODECHEF VIT

Event Name : DevSOC'26

Date : 08-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 2 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : DevSOC (Developers' Sprint Of Code), in its seventh

edition, is the flagship annual event by CodeChef-VIT, aiming at empowering

young minds by fostering meaningful connections between tech enthusiasts

and innovators. This 48-hour sprint-style hackathon is designed to

encourage creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving in an intense yet

engaging environment. As a Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) event,

DevSOC’26 emphasizes innovation, teamwork, and technological advancement

over four days of continuous ideation and development.

ROBOVITICS

Event Name : Cruise the Web3Verse

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : CS HALL

Event Details : Step into the future of technology with a 2-day Web3

workshop designed to bridge theory and real-world impact. Participants will

dive into blockchain fundamentals, smart contracts, and decentralized

identity, then experience these concepts in action through an interactive,

multiplayer game. Teams will play unique roles in a dynamic simulation,

navigating challenges, earning points, and facing real-time chaos as they

manage digital certificates and system integrity. The workshop blends

lectures, hands-on coding, and live simulations, making complex Web3

concepts accessible and exciting. With quizzes and expert guidance, this

event is perfect for anyone curious about blockchain, smart contracts, and

digital innovation. You’ll also get the chance to build real blockchain

projects and see how Web2 and Web3 approaches differ in practice.

STUDENTS FOR THE EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF SPACE (SEDS) & AMERICAN

SOCIETY OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERS (ASME)

Event Name : HERMES

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SHAKESPEARE GALLERY - TT

Event Details : The Satellite Design Challenge is a 36-hour competition

where teams of 2–4 participants design, document, and demonstrate

innovative small satellite concepts. The event begins with a Fusion 360

workshop, followed by two rounds: documentation and final working model

presentation. Participants tackle real-world challenges such as

environmental monitoring, disaster response, and Earth observation,

designing feasible satellite systems with defined payloads, power budgets,

and orbits. All submissions are made through the official event website.

Judged by experts, HERMES encourages creativity, technical precision, and

teamwork, offering participants a deep dive into practical aerospace

systems design. The top three designs will be specially rewarded with a

physical 3D-printed model of their satellite, bringing the best concepts

from screen to reality.

IEEE SOCIETY ON SOCIAL IMPLICATIONS OF TECHNOLOGY (IEEE-SSIT)

Event Name : Code4Change 3.0

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : Continuing from the success of code4change 1.0 and 2.0,

IEEE-SSIT brings you code4change 3.0 where we'll be continuing our flagship

hackathon event for yantra considering the success we have had the past 2

years. It will be an overnight 48 hour hackathon event where we will have 4

panels of judges who will judge the teams and their ideas/products based on

a set rubrics.

IEEE WOMEN IN ENGINEERING (IEEE-WIE)

Event Name : TRIATHLON: Code for Social Trust

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 1 PM

Venue : SAROJINI GALLER - SJT

Event Details : Understand the problem. Enforce trust through logic. Defend

your design. TRIATHLON: Code for Social Trust challenges participants to

move beyond writing code and start designing systems people can rely on.

Through three progressive rounds, teams analyze persona-based social

scenarios, implement trust-enforcing logic, and explain how their systems

ensure fairness, transparency, and responsible technology. TRIATHLON is

where technical thinking meets real-world impact.

SOCIETY OF AUTOMOTIVE ENGINEERS (SAE)

Event Name : Trace to Pace: The Race Car Telemetry and Strategy Workshop

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 3 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY - TT

Event Details : Ever wondered how top-tier teams in F1, DTM, and F4 shave

milliseconds off their lap times? It isn’t just about the driver’s right

foot , rather it’s about the data. We are excited to announce Trace to

Pace: The Race Car Telemetry & Strategy Workshop, a comprehensive 6-hour

workshop dedicated to the high-stakes world of motorsport engineering.

INDIAN SOCIETY OF EARTHQUAKE TECHNOLOGY(ISET)

Event Name : Structur - A- Thon

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : BHAGAT SINGH GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Structr-a-Thon: Seismic Edition (Design, Test, Fail,

Improve, Survive the Shake) is a hands-on structural design challenge where

participants conceptualise, design, and construct scaled building models

and test their performance under simulated earthquake loading. The event

bridges theory and practice by allowing students to experience how

structures behave during seismic excitation and understand the principles

of earthquake-resistant design in a fun, competitive, and practical

environment. Teams will be provided with limited materials and a design

brief, after which they must create a structure optimised for stability,

strength, and ductility. These models will then be tested on a shake table

that simulates ground motion of varying intensity. Performance will be

evaluated based on structural integrity, damage patterns, lateral

displacement, and efficiency of material usage.

SOLAR ENERGY SOCIETY OF INDIA & AYUDA

Event Name : OriginX

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 2 PM

Venue : SJT G07

Event Details : This event challenges participants to solve the "First Mile

Problem," the difficulty of verifying data at the very start of a supply

chain. Teams must select a problem statement prone to fraud or unethical

practices. Their goal is to design a "Digital Product Passport"—a

blockchain-based system that tracks the item from raw material to the final

consumer.

SOCIETY FOR INDUSTRIAL AND APPLIED MATHEMATICS (SIAM)

Event Name : Trace the Traitor

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 1 PM to 9 PM

Venue : TT 725

Event Details : Trace the traitor is a three-round investigative challenge

that simulates a real-world crypto fraud case, where participants

progressively clean corrupted blockchain data, trace wallets and

cross-chain fund movements, and finally reconstruct the complete scam.

Teams of 2 to 4 members must strictly use the provided datasets and tools,

adhere to time limits, and maintain fair play, as plagiarism or unfair

collaboration will result in disqualification.

IEEE POWER ELECTRONICS SOCIETY (IEEE - PELS)

Event Name : impact.js

Date : 11-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 7 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY

Event Details : Impact.js – Web Impact Sprint is a 4-hour team-based coding

event where participants create a single-page web experience around

real-world social issues. The idea is to use the web in a meaningful

way—whether it’s spreading awareness, encouraging better choices, or

helping people take action. Through simple yet creative web solutions,

teams show how technology can be used to make a positive difference.

INDIAN GEOTECHNICAL SOCIETY

Event Name : MODEL MAYHEM : Revit Edition

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 6 AM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : This intensive hands-on workshop introduces Autodesk Revit

through practical, step-by-step software training. You will learn core

Revit tools and techniques in astructured environment designed for

immediate application.

AMERICAN INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGINEERS (AICHE)

Event Name : Night at the Chem-Museum

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 3 PM to 6 AM

Venue : VOC GALLERY - TT

Event Details : As the sun sets, the "Grand Museum of Chemical History"

transforms. Participants act as the Night Security Squad, trapped with the

spirits of legendary scientists like James Watt and Marie Curie. Offended

by modern reliance on AI, the Ghosts have stolen all data books. Teams must

prove their worth by winning challenges to unlock missing formulas, then

apply fundamental engineering principles to stabilize the chaos before dawn.

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students' Welfare,VAIAL School, HOT School, Department of

Physical Education & Tamil Literary Association, invite you all for

the PONGAL CELEBRATION 2026. We have a lot of traditional events and games

lined up to help you experience the traditional festival of Tamil Nadu!

Here are some of the exciting features that we have got for you:

 - Special traditional cultural events like Tanjavur Melam, Karagattam,

 Poikkal Kuthiraiattam, Bharathanatyam, Sevaiattam, Jikkaattam,

 Silambattam, Devarattam, Parayattam and Periya Melam performed by

 invited professional artists and VIT students.

 - Pongal Making Competition for Faculty, Staff Members and Research

 Scholars

 - Distribution of Sweet Pongal and Sugarcane for all the attendees.

 - Food stalls (40+ traditional food items)

 - Pottery Making Stall

 - Palm Leaf Craft Stall

 - Mulai pari procession by VAIAL School students

 - VAIAL School Students Exhibition Stall

 - Release of Agriculture-related booklets authored by faculty

 - Fun events stall by SW Office: Bambaram, Pallankuzhi & Karumbudaithal.

VAIAL School presents a Model Village reflecting the holistic Tamil

culture, inspired by the Five Landscapes of Tamil Culture.

 - Kurinji (Mountain region)

 - Mullai (Forest region)

 - Marutham (Rice field)

 - Neithal (Coastal region)

 - Pallai (Dry region)

The village showcases traditional bulls, heritage village homes, grain

shops and a native lifestyle. Visitors can experience traditional games,

rural practices and the spirit of Tamil agrarian life, simple, sustainable

and rooted in tradition.

 - Students' cultural performances start by 10:00 AM.

 - Event Schedule and Stall Details Attached.

All are invited!

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [22nd July]

Pi Approximation Day

Pi Approximation Day is observed on July 22 (22/7 in the day/month format),

since the fraction 22⁄7 is a common approximation of π, which is accurate

to two decimal places and dates from Archimedes.

Mr. Rajveer Meena, who has a B.Tech degree from VIT, participated in the 'Most

Pi Places Memorised' was hosted at VIT University on March 21, 2015. He

has set a Guinness World Record by memorizing 70,000 post-decimal

digits of Pi, beating Lu Chao, a Chinese who had held the record for 10

years (67,890 digits).

He was awarded the certificate of Guinness World Record for memory on

October 1, 2015. Rajveer wore a blindfold throughout the entire recall,

which took nearly 10 hours," the official website of the Guinness World

Records states. The record-breaking event was held in VIT.

https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/most-pi-places-memorised

National Mango Day

National Mango Day, Celebrated every year on June 22, National Mango Day is

solely dedicated to the delicious fruit that people love to eat, or at

times drink, during the summer. It's summer and do you know what that

means? It means it is that time of the year when most people become mango

people. There is hardly any person who doesn’t love the delicious and juicy

fruit mango. And, as an extremely popular fruit, it is fitting that there

is a special day dedicated to it.

Yes, we are talking about National Mango Day. Celebrated every year on June

22, this day is solely dedicated to the delicious fruit that people love to

eat, or at times drink, during the summer. On this day, here are some viral

stories related to the king of fruits that you may love to gobble up.

subject: Important Update: CAT 2 Pattern and Assessment 2 Dates
body:
Dear Student,

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to inform you about some important updates regarding the

upcoming assessments. Firstly, I want to share the pattern for CAT 2,

 which will consist of 40 multiple-choice questions to be completed within

a duration of 45 minutes.

Moreover, Assessment 2 (15 MCQ - 15 Marks) has been scheduled for "09 Oct",

and it covers the same syllabus as CAT 2. This assessment holds significant

importance in our academic calendar, and we encourage you to prepare

diligently for it.

In line with these updates, I am pleased to inform you that the relevant

study materials have been updated and are now available on Vtop. I highly

recommend reviewing these materials to ensure your preparedness for the

assessments and CAT exam.

CAT 2 Syllabus: Topics covered till October 8.

Students with valid proof will be allowed to write a Reassessment.

If you have any questions or require further clarification regarding the

updated material or assessment schedule, please feel free to reach out to

us at vitfaceprepassistance@gmail.com. Our team is here to assist you and

address any concerns you may have.

Thank you for your attention to this matter, and I wish you the best of

luck with your preparations for the upcoming assessments.

Thanks,

Ramalakshmi B

Senior Trainer-FACEPrep

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [5th June] events.

World Environment Day (WED)

World Environment Day (WED) is celebrated annually on 5 June and is the

United Nations' principal vehicle for encouraging awareness and action for

the protection of the environment. First held in 1974, it has been a

platform for raising awareness on environmental issues such as marine

pollution, human overpopulation, global warming, sustainable consumption,

and wildlife crime. World Environment Day is a global platform for public

outreach, with participation from over 143 countries annually. Every World

Environment Day is hosted by a different country, in which official

celebrations take place. Each year, the program has provided a theme and

forum for businesses, non-government organizations, communities,

governments, and celebrities to advocate environmental causes. Millions of

people have taken part over the years, helping drive change in our

consumption habits as well as in national and international environmental

policy.

This year’s observance of World Environment Day will be on the theme "Only

One Earth". It calls for transformative changes to policies and choices to

enable cleaner, greener, and sustainable living in harmony with nature. It

will focus on the need to live sustainably in harmony with nature, and our

possibilities for shifting to a greener lifestyle through both policies and

individual choices.

subject: Fwd: Invitation to VIT Students – ACEi Hackathon ’26 @ Aravind Eye Care System-reg
body:
Dear Students,

Warm greetings from the Office of Innovation, Startup and Technology

Transfer - (VIT-IST)

We are pleased to invite students from Vellore Institute of Technology

(VIT) to participate in ACEi Hackathon ’26, the annual innovation

challenge organized by the Aravind Center for Eye Care Innovation (ACEi).

The event will be held from 02nd to 04th January 2026 at Aravind Eye

Hospital, Pondicherry.

We are proud to share that a few innovations from previous hackathons,

developed jointly by VIT students and Aravind teams, have been jointly

patented, and several students have also secured internship opportunities

at Aravind Eye Hospitals and Aurolab. These achievements stand as testimony

to the strength and success of our partnership.

In continuation of this long-standing collaboration, we are delighted to

invite VIT students once again to participate in ACEi Hackathon ’26 with

the same enthusiasm and innovative spirit.

Event Highlights:

· Work on real-world problems in eye care and public health

· Platform for collaborative research and innovation

· Guidance from experts at Aravind Eye Hospitals, Aurolab, and

partner institutions

· Attractive cash prizes for the top 5 best solutions

· Internship and placement opportunities at Aravind Eye Hospitals

& Aurolab

· No registration fee – food and accommodation provided for all

participants

📅 Event Dates: 02–04 January 2026

📍 Venue: Aravind Eye Hospital, Pondicherry

🗓Last Date to Apply: 23rd November 2025

Interested students can register using the link below:

👉 Registration form https://forms.gle/je1S4gUTNa9KXXbP7

Association of Energy Engineers

Event Name: Quizergy 1.1 - Vertical Axis Wind Turbines

Event Time: 5:00 PM - 7:00 PM

Event Description: AEE presents Energy Session 1.1 - Global Energy

Scenario, which explores the global energy landscape, shifting from

ambition to rapid execution. We analyze how record-breaking expansion in

solar and wind, green hydrogen, and advanced storage are decarbonizing the

industry. We will also examine the geopolitical shifts driven by the

transition to decentralized power grids. This session provides a critical

look at the infrastructure required to sustain a zero-emission future.

Venue: GDN 123

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: http://goog_604621741https://www.instagram.com/aee.vit/

Malayalam Literary Association

Event Name: Ezhuthachan 2.0

Event Time: 6:00 PM - 8:00 PM

Event Description: In this event, the participants can choose a famous

phrase from Malayalam movies and can have a physical copy of the same

written in plain handwriting. This phrase has to be written in calligraphic

font within a specified time limit. They can either select a famous

Malayalam phrase, a famous poem or even traditional sayings of Kerala.

Venue: TT 205

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: http://goog_604621737https://www.instagram.com/mla_oruma/

Dream Merchants

Event Name: Finance 101: Stock Market Simplified

Event Time: 8:30 AM - 11:30 PM

Event Description: It will cover what a stock is, how stock exchanges like

NSE and BSE function, and how the market operates through demand and

supply. Participants will learn why investing is important, how it helps in

wealth creation, and the difference between trading and long-term

investing. The session will also introduce basic fundamental analysis,

including how to evaluate a company using simple financial indicators,

along with an overview of candlestick charts and essential concepts.

Venue: Google Meet

Registration: VTOP

subject: Live Project: Investment Banking (PE & VC)
body:
Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Investment Banking Experience Program (IBEP), an online live project that helps students gain work experience in private equity & venture capital at the Vellore Institute of Technology. The project provides glimpses into start-ups, their way of working, and financing.

The project is running at leading campuses including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Kanpur and BITS Pilani among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Investment banking, private equity & venture capital-oriented project

2. Assess investment proposals and identify start-ups with high growth potential

3. From a private equity fund perspective, understand various stages of PE investing

4. Engage in the set-up of a Private Equity Fund, with emphasis on investor onboarding, investing cycles & sectoral orientation

5. Author case-based projects on successful exits in the private e quity space, by analyzing mergers & acquisitions

6. Learn how to apply Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Valuation & Excel-based modeling to companies

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience as an Investment Banking Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation based on performance

Apply Here (takes 2-3 mins):

https://www.finlatics.com/ibep_application?src=vit

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of this project. All necessary training and mentoring will be imparted.

Project Duration: 1 month / 2 months (on selected student choice, with a flexible start date option on selected student choice.

Students will also be eligible for a break or extension during the project if they need it for any academic or personal commitments.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee: Rs. 1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all students of Vellore Institute of Technology on the above-mentioned minimal induction fee.

To be eligible for the fee waiver, kindly apply through the above link only.

We are looking forward to a fruitful engagement.

subject: Quality Week 24-25: Day-2 Special Events- reg
body:
Dear VITians,

VIT celebrates Quality Week 24-25, a four-day journey of learning,

innovation, and performance, presented by the Office of Students' Welfare.

In celebration of VIT’s 40 years of excellence, we proudly bring you 40

impactful events. This year’s theme, “QUALITY: From Compliance to

Performance”, embodies our dedication to exceeding standards and fostering

a culture of excellence in all that we do. The Office of Students’ Welfare

invites you for today’s [Day 2] Quality Week events, brought to you by

the Student Council and various Clubs and Chapters.

Day 2 Events:

· Quality Week: Cybersecurity

· Quality Week: Clash of Minds

· Quality Week: Reelay

· Quality Week: AutoShield

· EcoVision

· PCB NEXUS

· Tashan-e-Bhangra

· Alochonar Ashor

Scroll down for more details

IEEE-ComSoc

Event Name: Quality Week: Cybersecurity

Event Time: 2:30 PM – 5:30 PM

Event Description: As part of Quality Week 2025, IEEE ComSoc VIT presents

an insightful session on "Quality in Cybersecurity", led by S. M. Farooq,

Assistant Professor. This session will delve into the critical aspects of

cybersecurity quality assurance, including secure software development,

risk management, compliance standards, and best practices for building

robust defense mechanisms. Join us in exploring how quality and

cybersecurity go hand in hand to create a safer digital future.

Venue: Shakespeare Gallery, TT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/vitieeecomsoc/

LinkedIn link: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ieeecomsocvit/

ROTARACT CLUB-VIT

Event Name: Quality Week: Clash of Minds

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Event Description: Clash of Minds is a dynamic debate event where

participants shape the conversation. Engage in lively discussions on

societal, technological, and ethical issues. Raise a red flag to vote

someone out, a green flag to challenge an opponent, or vote yourself in if

you have the strongest argument. This event encourages critical thinking,

persuasive communication, and active participation. Whether experienced or

new, step in and control the debate!

Venue: Ambedkar Auditorium, TT

Registration: VTOP

MATRIX

Event Name: Quality Week: Reelay

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM

Event Description: Reelay is a two-phase event where participants will

first search for movie clips based on a given theme. In the second half,

they creatively edit the clips into a seamless video using transitions,

effects, and music. The event tests creativity, storytelling, and editing

skills under a time limit.

Venue: Rajaji Hall, MB (Offline)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/matrix.vit?igsh=MTdkYWRzZ21zMGFkNw

SAE-VIT

Event Name: Quality Week: Quality Week: AutoShield

subject: vivo KanyaGyaan Scholarship Program 2025-26
body:
Attn: All first-year and Second Female students enrolled in undergraduate

courses such as B.Tech / B.E., B.Sc, BCA, etc .

Dear Students,

Greetings!

Applications are invited from All first-year and second year Female

students enrolled in STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E.,

B.Sc, BCA, etc .

Eligibility Criteria:

 -

 - Open to young women across India who are currently enrolled in

 full-time, regular STEM undergraduate courses such as B.Tech / B.E.,

 B.Sc, BCA, etc. (first or second year) .

 - Annual parental income must not exceed INR 5 lakh from all sources.

 - Applicants must have secured at least 70% marks in both Class 10

 and Class 12, as well as in their most recent academic year/semester.

 - Children of employees of Buddy4Study or vivo India are ineligible.

 - Note: Students already receiving full financial assistance under

 other scholarships or government schemes are also not eligible.

Preference will be given to the following applicants:

 - Single-parent children 

 - Children from the Aspirational District 

 - Have deceased parents

 - Children from SC, STs and De-Notified Tribes

 - Priority for first-generation learners or those from marginalised

 communities.

 - Children of Police Forces/Armed Forces/Martyr families

 - Girls Representing State and National Level Sports

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a final interview conducted by

a selection panel.

body:
Dear Students,

In collaboration with VIT Business School and WorldQuant, Dream

Merchants Club is organising QuantTradeX, an exclusive workshop

introducing students to high-frequency trading and quantitative strategy

while bridging academic finance concepts with real-world algorithmic

trading practices and offering insight into how quantitative researchers

build mathematical models to analyse and predict market movements.

Event Details

Date: 25 March 2026

Time: 2:00 p.m. -5:00 p.m. 

Venue: Era Sezhiyan Auditorium, MGB, VIT Vellore

On-Duty (OD) will be provided for registered participants.

Students interested in attending the workshop are requested to register

using the Google Form provided below:

Registration Link:

https://forms.gle/qVRyGQkEcESaCXag8

first-served basis.

During the workshop, participants will:

• Get an introduction to Quantitative Finance and the WorldQuant BRAIN

platform

• Learn about the International Quant Championship (IQC) 2026

• Watch a live demonstration on building trading alphas

• Understand opportunities within the WorldQuant BRAIN Research Consultant

Program

Benefits of Attending

• Opportunity to network with students interested in quantitative finance

and trading

• Chance to receive exclusive WorldQuant merchandise

• Internship, consultant, and full-time opportunities may be offered to

top performers

Participants are advised to bring their laptops for the hands-on

demonstration during the session.

subject: UG research- ULINK – Mentor Confirmation and Next Steps
body:
Dear ULINK Enrolled Students,

Greetings.

We are pleased to inform you that the details of students enrolled under

the ULINK (Undergraduate–Lab Integration for Knowledge & Innovation)

initiative have been shared with the respective Schools centres for

further processing.

Important instructions regarding mentor allocation and project initiation

are given below:

 -

 If you have already approached and finalized a faculty mentor for ULINK,

 kindly continue with the same mentor. You are requested to initiate the

 project work by discussing the scope, objectives, and timeline with your

 mentor at the earliest.

 -

 If you have not yet identified a mentor, please note that the

 concerned School/Centre will shortly circulate the list of available

 faculty mentors along with project details. You may choose your mentor

 based on your interest and eligibility.

 -

 Students are requested to strictly adhere to the ULINK norms,

 including group size, project duration, and mentor continuity.

 -

 Once the mentor and project are finalized, kindly email the confirmed

 details (student name(s), registration number(s), mentor name,

 School/Centre, and project title) to the undersigned for record and further

 processing.

Project Guidelines

 -

 Group size

 • Individual projects are permitted.

 • Group projects may consist of a maximum of 5 students.

 -

 Project duration

 • The expected project duration is 6 to 8 months.

 -

 Mentorship and progress

 • Faculty mentors will monitor progress periodically and guide you

 throughout the project duration.

 -

subject: Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for Fall Semester 2024-25 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT – Theory
body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2024/24030

 Date: 26-December-2024

Paper Seeing, Revaluation and Re-FAT Process for 

Fall Semester 2024-25 (Regular & Week End Intra Semester) FAT – Theory

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Fall

Semester 2024-25”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during

Nov-Dec 2024 has been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 01 January 2025 (Wednesday).

The Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics →

Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for each

paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Fall

Semester 2024-25→Paper Seeing. You can choose course(s) you want to

apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, within one or two working days, the

paper and question

wise marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need

to use the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After

seeing the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is

not sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need

to recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reason for the same in the comments section available

just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also needs to be paid through online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated only

after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and is in online mode only.

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by CoE office . For other

components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode courses)

there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Fall Semester 2024-25

examination malpractices are not eligible for paper seeing/ Re-valuation

process.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 26 - Dec -2024 to 30 - Dec -2024

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

 27- Dec -2024 to 31- Dec -2024

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

 26- Dec -2024 to 31- Dec -2024

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which needs to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation request will summarily be rejected.

Re-FAT:

As per VIT Academic regulations (Page 22) Re-FAT will be permitted for the

following reasons only:

subject: UG Research Work -Appreciation – International Media Recognition
body:
Dear Students and Faculty Members,

Greetings!

Our UG students Aayushi Agrawal (21BEC2073), Akshit Saxena (21BEC2127),

Bhavya Nagrath (21BEC0399), CARMEL Sanjana Jayavanth (21BEC2095), and Shamita

Thulasidoss (21BML0014) have achieved a significant milestone by

publishing a research article in Scientific Reports as an outcome of their

Project Type Course under the Discipline / Open Electives category.

Their paper titled “Deep learning-driven IoT solution for smart tomato

farming” (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-15615-3) presents an

IoT-enabled smart greenhouse platform using ESP32-based sensors, Raspberry

Pi, and a YOLOv8 deep learning model to monitor environmental conditions

and classify tomato ripeness stages in real time, supporting precision

agriculture and sustainable tomato production.

Importantly, this work has been featured in the international agriculture

technology news portal Hortidaily

(https://www.hortidaily.com/article/9759011/deep-learning-solutions-to-aid-tomato-growers/

https://www.hortidaily.com/article/9759011/deep-learning-solutions-to-aid-tomato-growers/),

 for

its potential to aid tomato growers worldwide through deep learning–based

solutions.

This recognition highlights the practical relevance of the research, the

strength of our UG research culture, and the effective mentorship enabled

through our project-based learning ecosystem.

 Congratulations to the entire team and the faculty mentors, Dr. P.

Sasikumar, Associate Professor & Assistant Dean – Academic Research, SENSE,

and Dr. S. Maheswri, SCOPE, Chennai Campus, on this achievement.

With best wishes

subject: Invitation to Participate – CII Case Study Competition on Building India’s Higher Education Ecosystem
body:
Dear VITians,

The Confederation of Indian Industry (CII), as part of the 15th CII

Global Education Summit scheduled on 17th December 2025 at The Lalit, New

Delhi, invites UG and PG students to participate in a nationwide Case Study

Competition on “Building India’s Higher Education Ecosystem for Global

Excellence by 2035.”

This is a unique opportunity for students to propose innovative solutions,

apply critical thinking, and contribute to shaping the future of higher

education in India.

Key Highlights:

 - Eligibility: All full-time UG and PG students in India (teams of 2–3

 members, cross-disciplinary teams encouraged).

 - Mode & Presentation: Initial submissions are online; the top 5 teams

 will present their ideas in-person to the jury during the Summit.

 - Registration Fee: Rs 1,180 per team (inclusive of GST,

 non-refundable).

 - Guidelines: After registration via the QR code on the flyer,

 participating teams will receive the detailed Rules & Guidelines PDF via

 email.

Registration Deadline: 12th November 2025.

Competition Themes:

 - Enhancing Quality and Accessibility in Higher Education

 - Digital Transformation & Innovation in Education

 - Strategies for Global Competitiveness of Indian Higher Education

Registration & Flyer:

Please refer to the below flyer and use the QR code to register your team.

Detailed Rules & Guidelines are attached for reference.

We encourage students to take this opportunity to propose actionable

solutions and contribute to building a more inclusive, innovative, and

globally competitive higher education ecosystem in India.

Kind Attention: Pre final-year B.Tech. students interested in the 3+2

Program Pathway between VIT and the University of California, Irvine (UCI),

USA

Dear Students,

Greetings from the International Relations Office!

University of California, Irvine (UCI), USA—one of VIT’s partner

universities—recently conducted an orientation session on various academic

partnership programs for all VIT campuses. Among these opportunities

is the 3+2

Program Pathway between VIT and UCI. The key details of the program are

provided below for your reference.

Program Eligibility Criteria

 -

 Applicants must be from an Engineering discipline

 -

 Completion of at least three full academic years at VIT

 (Students must complete all coursework at the home institution; only

 the final-year Capstone Project and Senior Design Project (SDP) may remain.

 Only such students are strictly eligible.)

 -

 Minimum GPA: 3.3 on a 4.0 scale

 -

 English Language Proficiency: TOEFL: 85 (iBT) / 550 (PBT), or IELTS:

 Overall band score of 7.0

Kindly refer to the attached documents and presentation for detailed

information.

Program Website: http://sites.uci.edu/engr32/

We are now inviting self-nominations from interested and eligible

students. All nominations will be reviewed and forwarded to UCI through the

respective International Relations Offices of each VIT campus. Deadline

for self-nomination: 15 January 2026.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfSrX21mtEMFu8jCovxE-YmR9XpacTwARtrTxVlpAruYWVWBQ/viewform?usp=dialog

body:
CDC Summer Internship Opportunity with PwC

Dear Students,

Greetings from CDC.

CDC is facilitating a Summer Internship opportunity with PwC for eligible

VIT students. As part of this collaboration, PwC, along with SAP University

Alliances Program India, may also provide structured learning and

certification opportunities related to SAP technologies.

The programme is expected to include structured learning modules,

assessments, and the opportunity to work on industry-relevant areas aligned

with PwC requirements.

Eligibility Criteria

• B.Tech - Computer Science Engineering (CSE) and specialization

• B.Tech - Information Technology (IT) and specialization

• B.Tech - Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE) and specialization

• Minimum CGPA: 8.5 and above

Further details will be shared with shortlisted students.

Registration link: https://forms.gle/a6HmKtnNap6Zdu748

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

 Vacationing with Grandparents

Who doesn't enjoy vacations with grandparents? Old time stories, sharing

secrets and pampering... Grandparents are everything that we need!

We would like to see your unique perspective of this bonding. Capture a pic

through your cell phone!

Subject: Invitation to Attend ISRO-IIRS Online Course on "Overview of

Geographical Information System (GIS)" – Free Enrollment

Dear Mam,

I request you to forward the invitation for online course on Overview

of Geographical Information System (GIS) conducted by the Indian Space

Research Organisation (ISRO) and Indian Institute of Remote Sensing

(IIRS). to all students, faculty, and research scholars.

Thankyou

Dear All,

Greetings!

We are pleased to inform you about an exciting opportunity to participate

in a comprehensive online course on Overview of Geographical Information

System (GIS) conducted by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)

and Indian Institute of Remote Sensing (IIRS). This course, delivered

through the IIRS Learning Management System, will be held from October 14,

2024, to November 1, 2024.

The course is aimed at UG/PG students, research scholars, and faculty

members interested in gaining in-depth knowledge of GIS principles,

spatial analysis, data modeling, and visualization techniques. This

course will also explore GIS applications, open-source software, and the

latest trends in geoinformatics and big data analytics. Resource persons

will be from ISRO.

Key Course Details:

· Duration: October 14, 2024 – November 1, 2024

(Daily 1 hour 30 minutes live interactive sessions, with recorded sessions

available post-session on the portal)

· Mode of Delivery: Online through IIRS Learning Management System

Portal.

· Course Fee: Free (Sponsored by ISRO)

· Nodal Center: Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore

Coordinator: Dr. Jagannathan J.

· Only limited seats available - Which will be approved by the nodal

centre coordinator based on FCFS and Students, Scholar, Faculty ratio

guidelines. Certificate will be provided by ISRO through Nodal Center

Coordinator. 80% attendance is mandatory to get certificate.

------------------------------

Course Highlights:

 - GIS Overview and Concepts

 - Geographic Phenomena and Map Projections

 - Spatial and Non-Spatial Data Models

 - Data Input, Editing, and Spatial Analysis

 - Open-Source GIS Software and Tools

 - Spatial Data Quality, Uncertainty, and Error Propagation

 - Network Analysis and Map Visualization

 - Big Data Analytics and Emerging Trends in Geoinformatics

------------------------------

Learning Outcomes:

Upon successful completion of this course, participants will:

 - Gain a strong understanding of GIS fundamentals and applications.

 - Learn spatial analysis and data modeling techniques.

 - Familiarize themselves with open-source GIS software and tools.

 - Develop skills in map visualization and spatial data analysis.

 - Stay updated on emerging trends in geoinformatics and big data

 analytics.

------------------------------

How to Enroll:

 1. Use the following link to complete the one-time registration: ISRO-IIRS

 Registration Portal

https://elearning.iirs.gov.in/edusatregistration/ (Use

 official Mail Id only)

 2. Select the course titled "Overview of Geographical Information

 System."

 3. Under “Mode of Registration,” choose Registration Through ISRO Nodal

 Center.

 4. Search for "Vellore Institute of Technology" and select the

 coordinator name "Dr. Jagannathan J."

 5. Complete the remaining details and submit your application.

Note: Your registration will be verified and approved by the coordinator.

To get the certificate with the institution name and to get other

benefits, registration has to be done through a nodal center only.

------------------------------

We highly encourage all those interested in GIS, geoinformatics, and big

data analytics to take advantage of this valuable learning opportunity. If

you have any further questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

Attached the Detailed schedule for your kind reference.

Looking forward to your participation.

--

Dr.J.Jagannathan,

Assistant Professor Senior Grade I,

Department of Software and Systems Engineering,

School of Computer Science Engineering and Information Systems (SCORE),

Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT),

subject: Wishing you all a happy Lohri, Pongal, Makar Sankranti, and Magh Bihu!
body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare wishes you all a Happy Lohri, Pongal, Makar

Sankranti, and Magh Bihu!

Lohri, Pongal, Makar Sankranti and Bihu are festivals that represent

different cultures but unite under one country – India. All the festivals

are loosely related to one single premise – crops, but vary depending on

the part of the country it is celebrated in. Let’s look at each of these

four festivals that people celebrate together.

Pongal, the four-day harvest festival celebrated in South India, especially

Tamil Nadu, will be celebrated with great enthusiasm from January 15-18

this year. Celebrated in mid-January every year, it also marks the

beginning of Uttarayan- the sun's journey towards the north and the end of

the winter season.

A large bonfire with people dancing, singing, and having a good time is

what contains the essence of this festival. Lohri is celebrated a day

before Makar Sankranti and is primarily celebrated in North India,

especially in the agricultural state of Punjab. It marks the end of the

sowing season. Delicacies and snacks, for example, Rewri, Peanuts, Sarson

Ka Saag, Makke Ki Roti, etc., are enjoyed with full vigor.

Makar Sankranti follows Lohri by a day and is a popular festival in most

parts of the country, but the festivity is at its prime, mainly in North

India. The festival marks the advent of the harvest season and also

signifies the end of Winter as the days start getting longer. Many people

dip in the sacred waters of the Ganga and offer their prayers to the Sun.

In many parts of North India, kites take over the skies, and delicious

sweets such as Til Ke Laddoo are enjoyed.

The same spirit and the same premise, when it travels all the way to North

East India, takes the shape of Magh Bihu. The end of the harvest season is

what the festival represents. Traditional dance, traditional games, and

activities such as Cooking in Meji (Bamboo Huts) define the festival in the

state of Assam.

subject: Live Project in Data Science & Machine Learning with Python
body:
Dear VIT Students,

We're pleased to open applications for the Finlatics Data Science & Machine Learning Experience Program, an online live project that helps students gain experience in data science with Python and using machine learning algorithms at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

This project runs at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, and BITS Pilani.

Finlatics is recognized for Skill Development & Assessment by the Department for Promotion of Industry & Internal Trade, Ministry of Commerce & Industry, and was incubated at the Atal Incubation Centre - NMIMS, supported by Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog and Government of India.

STRUCTURE of the live project:

1. Learn the basics of Python and Machine Learning and how it can be used in data science.

2. Get hands-on learning and experience in writing various Python codes.

3. Dive into practical data manipulation and visualization using essential Python libraries.

4. Become proficient in using the Google Collab Notebook for machine learning

5. Gain an understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Python libraries

6. Explore statistical methods crucial for accurate data analysis, empowering learners with essential analytical skills.

7. Complete industry-specific case projects to understand the application of Python and Machine Learning in business scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience in Data Science

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. A Certificate of Proficiency in Python and Machine Learning

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch with them:

https://www.finlatics.com/bads_application?src=vitve3

As Python would be taught in the program, all students must note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of the program.

Personalized guidance & mentoring would also be provided to help students learn Python.

Live Sessions will be provided to help you practice coding with Python.

Project Duration: 2 months

Project Start: Flexible on selected student choice. Students can choose to start the project post-exams to balance the project along with any upcoming exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments. They can also take an extension in duration if they cannot complete it in the given time.

Time Commitment: 3 - 4 hours per week

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST (on student choice)

Fee Waiver: Vellore Institute of Technology students will be given a 20% fee waiver on the above mentioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2399 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply via the link above.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

subject: Request to participate in GeoRift Hackathon 8th Jan 2026 !!
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

We are pleased and delighted to announce that the School of Biosciences

and Technology (SBST), in association with the Society for Biological

Engineering (SBE-VIT), proudly presents GEORIFT: Geographic Exploration &

Innovation Fest, a multidisciplinary innovation event open to students from

all the branches across the VIT campus.

GEORIFT will be conducted as a fully offline event on 8th & 9th January,

2026, focusing on the theme “Exploration of life: Beyond Boundaries.” This

event challenges participants to explore extreme and unconventional

environments, such as the deep sea, outer space, radioactive zones, mining

habitats, and microbial ecosystems, and develop biotechnology-driven

solutions to survive, adapt, or thrive in these settings.

GEORIFT is designed to foster creativity, scientific thinking, and

interdisciplinary collaboration. Participants will work in teams to ideate,

pitch, and develop innovative concepts, supported by expert insights and

structured evaluation rounds.

Who can participate?:

Undergraduate and postgraduate students from all disciplines, including

biotechnology, life sciences, biomedical engineering, agriculture,

bioinformatics, mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, electronics,

computer science, and other technical or non-technical fields.

Key Highlights of GEORIFT:

• Expert Session – Learn from specialists in applied and environmental

biotechnology.

• Creative Ideation & Pitching – Translate complex problems into compelling

concepts through structured pitching rounds.

• Prototype Development – Design digital or conceptual prototypes

showcasing scientific feasibility and innovation.

• IoT Workshop for Beginners – A hands-on workshop introducing prototyping

from scratch, making the event accessible even to students with no prior

experience.

• Crisis Challenge Round – Test adaptability and problem-solving skills

through a surprise scenario.

GEORIFT offers students a unique opportunity to apply classroom learning to

real-world challenges, develop critical research and innovation skills, and

collaborate across disciplines.

Registration Link:

https://events.vit.ac.in/Home/eventDetails/000827

Contact: Dr. Debasish Mishra: +91 9787116291

 Dr. Aanchal Mittal +91 9501052690 for more details !!

Thank you

subject: Congratulations to Team HVACERS for their Achievement at AQUEST 2026 – ACREX 2026, Mumbai
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team HVACERS secured an impressive 5th

Position in the All-India Finals of the AQUEST 2026 – All-India HVAC

Technical Quiz Competition, organized by ISHRAE, held at BEC, Mumbai, as

part of ACREX 2026, from 12–14 March 2026.

The competition involved multiple rounds of elimination at the Chapter,

Zonal, and Inter-Zonal levels, with participation from over 250 engineering

colleges across the country. Notably, this marks the third consecutive

year that VIT students have qualified for the final round of this

prestigious national-level competition.

The event also featured participation from leading HVAC&R companies and

included insightful workshops, providing valuable exposure to industry

practices. The team had the opportunity to interact with industry

professionals and domain experts, enhancing their technical and practical

knowledge.

Team Members:

 1. Guru Prasath P – 23BME0127

 2. Navin Sidhaarth A. R – 22BME0664

We also express our sincere gratitude to the Faculty Coordinators, Dr. K.

Balaji (Emp. ID: 16371) and Dr. G. Praveen Kumar (Emp. ID: 16348), for

their guidance and support throughout this achievement.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Team HVACERS on this

commendable achievement and wish them continued success in their future

endeavors.

subject: Congratulations to Team Levitate Hyperloop - Achievements at the Global Hyperloop Competition 2026
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to inform you that Team Levitate Hyperloop proudly

represented Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore at the second edition

of the Global Hyperloop Competition (GHC 2.0), held from 22nd to 25th

January 2026 at the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras.

At GHC 2.0, the team reached a major milestone by unveiling VIT’s first

Linear Electromagnetic Propulsion unit, marking a significant step toward

full-scale prototype development. Continuing last year’s legacy, the team

emerged as the top performer, securing the maximum number of awards at the

competition.

The team is proud to share the following achievements:

Winning Titles

• Design X – Best Traction System

• Design X – Best Mechanical Systems

• Innoquest – Stationing & Boarding of Passengers

• Innoquest – Vacuum Pump Technology

Runner-Up Titles

• Innoquest – Tube Material

The Global Hyperloop Competition is a premier platform that brings together

student teams, industry experts, researchers, and academia to advance the

future of hyperloop transportation. Over four days of intensive technical

evaluations, design reviews, and jury interactions, teams were assessed on

engineering depth, innovation, and feasibility.

Securing Five Awards at GHC 2.0 reflects Team Levitate Hyperloops

consistent performance, strong research-driven approach, and collaborative

effort. This achievement further strengthens VIT’s presence on National

and International platforms in the domain of next-generation

transportation systems.

subject: SENSE-Students Achievements-reg
body:
Dear all,

Greetings!!

The School of Electronics Engineering at Vellore Institute of Technology

(VIT) is proud to announce that Mr. Kushagra Narang (21BML0031) and Ms.

Jhanvi Chaturvedi (21BML0053) have been awarded the Second Prize for their

outstanding paper oral presentation at the International Conference on "AI

Systems and Sustainable Technologies" (IISU-ASSET 2025).

The conference, organized by the Department of Computer Science & IT, IIS

(deemed to be University), Jaipur, took place on March 28th and 29th, 2025.

Mr. Narang and Ms. Chaturvedi presented their research paper titled "A

Data-Driven Aircraft Health Monitoring System: IoT Integration, Predictive

Maintenance, and Cybersecurity Validation" in the oral presentation

category.

Their research focused on developing an innovative system for monitoring

aircraft health using data-driven techniques, integrating IoT technologies,

implementing predictive maintenance strategies, and ensuring robust

cybersecurity measures. The project showcases the students' exceptional

technical skills and their ability to address complex challenges in the

field of aerospace engineering.

This achievement highlights the high caliber of research and academic

excellence fostered at VIT. Mr. Narang and Ms. Chaturvedi were guided and

mentored by Dr. Sasikumar P, whose expertise and support were instrumental

in their success.

The proceedings of IISU-ASSET 2025 will be published in Springer Nature's

Scopus/ SCI Indexed book series "Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems"

Thanks and Regards,

Dr. Jasmine

Professor & Dean

School of Electronics Engineering

Vellore Institute of Technology

Vellore -632014, Tamil Nadu, India

subject: Important Rules and Guidelines for the Assessment! | HackOn with Amazon - Season 5
body:
HackOn With Amazon - Season 5

Hi Nayan Sharma,

We're delighted to have you on board for the HackOn with Amazon - Season 5 journey! With the Assessment round just around the corner, make sure you're well-versed with the key instructions and guidelines to ensure a smooth experience.

Please note that only eligible teams will be permitted to attempt the Assessment. Teams that do not meet the eligibility criteria will unfortunately not be allowed to proceed. Eligibility requires at least two team members to be enrolled in eligible programs (B.Tech, M.Tech, Integrated Dual Degree, or MCA) from specified branches (CS, IT, Electrical/Electronics, or related) and to have a minimum CGPA of 6.5.

The final eligibility confirmation will be shared on the day of the Assessment.

Your overall performance in both the MCQ and Coding sections will be combined to determine your ranking and qualification for the next stage.

Kindly read through the following instructions carefully regarding the structure, timeline, and rules for the quiz and coding rounds to ensure a smooth experience.

  • Online Assessment Window: 29th May 2025, 12:00 PM IST to 29th May 2025, 11:59 PM
  • Online Assessment Duration: 1 Hour 40 Minutes (100 minutes)
  • Total Questions to be answered: 23 (20 MCQ Questions + 3 Coding Problem Statements)
  • 20 MCQs and 3 problem statements ought to be solved in 100 minutes for this round.
  • The Coding Problem Statements will be based on Data Structures & Algorithms and SQL.
  • You can attempt the round anytime between the provided round window.
  • Please ensure that you attempt the round in one sitting, as once you start the round, the timer won’t stop.
  • You will see the “Verify/Play” button in the Assessment round to initiate the assessment.
  • You will be allowed to switch between Sections and browse through the questions.
  • It is mandatory for all team members to attempt the Assessment.
  • Each team member must attempt and clear the coding round individually for the team's submission to be eligible for evaluation and qualification.
  • Please note, that any participant resorting to unfair practices will be directly disqualified from the challenge. All decisions in the matter of eligibility, authenticity & final judgment will be with Unstop and Amazon.

System Requirements:

  • A laptop/desktop (for attempting the assessment) with at least 8GB RAM.
  • Ensure that the device has webcam & microphone access and is connected to a stable internet connection (> 10 Mbps). Please note that an unstable internet connection can result in your assessment being terminated.
  • Ensure all notifications & interruptions are turned off on the device OR do-not-disturb (DND) is enabled.
  • Ensure that the device is fully charged or is connected to a power outlet.

Proctoring Related:

  • You can attempt the assessments only on a desktop/laptop with webcam access.
  • The assessments will be hosted in full-screen mode.
  • Anything that disturbs the full-screen mode of the assessment is treated as a violation. It may be due to any of the following reasons but not limited to:
    • Tab Switching
    • Screen Sharing with anyone
    • Clicking on the escape button
    • Computer going on Sleep (Adjust your power or sleep mode settings)
    • Windows or Browser or any Application specific notifications (Put them in No Disturb Mode or switch them off while the quiz is on)
    • Anything else that may result in disturbing the full-screen mode
  • The assessment does not get terminated on the first such instance. Only repeated violations will result in disqualification and termination of the assessment immediately.
  • Your face will be verified before the start of the assessment from the photo that was captured during registration. 
  • Your face may be verified again during the assessment.
  • Your face will be constantly detected and violations will be tracked and reported while the assessment is on. Eg: Two faces in front of the camera, No one in front of the camera, etc.

All the best!

Regards,
Team HackOn with Amazon

subject: Medical/Emergency Leave Procedure - reg.
body:
Dear Student,

Best Wishes !!!

The procedure to be followed for Medical/Emergency Leave.

 1. For any kind of leave, students are advised to use the permitted 25%

 relaxation in attendance, including medical reasons, and a minimum of 75%

 is mandatory to appear for the exams.

 2. In case of emergency (Medical reasons / Hospitalization / Death in

 family), the first intimation must be given to the proctor. Then, the

 request must be sent to the Head of the Department (hod.ss@vit.ac.in

 <hod.ss@vit.ac.in>) recommended by Proctor with a copy to the

 Programme Secretary (secretary.ss@vit.ac.in).

 3. If he/she has been admitted to the hospital as an inpatient due to

 medical reasons, they have to submit their discharge summary, fitness

 certificate, and hospital bills along with a request letter signed by the

 Proctor and HoD to the Programme Secretary in SJT322 within three days

 after rejoining or before the last working day whichever is early.

 4. For Re-CAT, the documents shall be submitted to the Programme

 Secretary and signed by the Proctor. Medical prescriptions are not

 considered under any circumstances. The reFAT is permitted based on CoE

 norms (refer to reFAT norms mail sent by CoE).

Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team SANTRA secured First Place at the DR

DEV Hackathon, conducted at SRM Institute of Science and Technology,

Kattankulathur (SRM-KTR) on 4th and 5th February 2026.

Team SANTRA emerged as the winner after presenting a final 3-minute pitch,

supported by a working prototype and a dedicated website, achieving an

impressive final score of 58.5 out of 60.

The team presented “LATERAL X”, an innovative fall-prevention and

rehabilitation support device designed to assist patients facing

balance-related challenges. The solution focuses on posture correction and

movement stabilization over time, offering significant potential in

rehabilitation and assistive healthcare technologies.

inter-university platform.

subject: Contact email updated: Paid Internship opportunities for VIT Vellore students (UG /Integrated M.Tech preferred)
body:
Dear Students,

Please apply if you are interested.

Contact email updated

Paid Research Internship Opportunity

School of Science, UK–Liverpool Joint Campus (China)

Supervisor: Dr. Akhil Garg, Associate Professor

We are inviting two highly motivated undergraduate or Integrated M.Tech

students to join cutting-edge research in Electric Vertical Take-Off and

Landing (eVTOL) vehicles—future “flying taxis.” This field is rapidly

evolving in Europe, the US, and China, offering exceptional academic and

career opportunities.

------------------------------

Research Areas 1. Advanced Battery Thermal Management System Design

 -

 Objective:

 Design a cold plate for eVTOL battery packs to control high heat

 generation and maintain temperature stability within 10°C.

 -

 Methods:

 Use topology optimization and AI-based design approaches to develop

 a next-generation cooling system.

2. Intelligent Flight Control Algorithm Development

 -

 Objective:

 Develop and simulate robust flight control algorithms for safe

 low-altitude flight, focusing on obstacle avoidance and passenger safety.

 -

 Methods:

 Model eVTOL dynamics in Simulink and implement AI-driven control

 strategies.

------------------------------

Internship Details

 -

 Mode: Offline or Online

 -

 Stipend: ₹10,000 per month (higher stipend possible based on

 performance)

 -

 Progress Review: Every 10–12 days to ensure consistent development

 -

 Goal: Publication-oriented research with strong technical output

------------------------------

Eligibility

Students from the following backgrounds are encouraged to apply:

 -

 Mechanical Engineering

 -

 Aerospace Engineering

 -

 Electrical / Electronics Engineering

------------------------------

Training & Support

 -

 Initial simulation files, reading materials, and research papers will be

 provided.

 -

 Former Indian students from the lab will help with task-specific

 training.

 -

 Outstanding interns may be invited for Master’s or Doctoral studies at

 our China campus (degree awarded by the University of Liverpool).

------------------------------

Offline Internship (China)

Deserving students will receive guidance and support for obtaining a 3–6

month internship visa.

------------------------------

How to Apply

Send your CV to: Akhil.Garg@xjtlu.edu.cn <Akhil.Garg@xjtlu.edu.cn>

(Subject line: Application for eVTOL Research Internship – [Your Name and

Reg.No])

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations
