Congratulations.You have been selected to participate in the Official

Off-Campus Internship Drive, a collaborative initiative between Skillumni

and Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), recognized by Startup India and

the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME).

This program provides a structured, project-based learning experience

designed to help students strengthen their industry-relevant skills through

professional mentorship and hands-on project implementation.

------------------------------

How to Confirm Your Enrollment

Seats are limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served

basis.To confirm your participation, please complete the onboarding form

using the link below:

Enrollment Form: https://forms.gle/rf82ozDtAoQT15TM9

https://forms.gle/rf82ozDtAoQT15TM9

------------------------------

Internship Domains

Participants will have the opportunity to gain practical exposure in one

or more of the following domains:

 -

 Data Science with Python: Python programming, data preprocessing,

 machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and big data.

 -

 Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: Neural networks (CNNs,

 RNNs), reinforcement learning, robotics, and NLP.

 -

 Web Development: Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js) and Backend

 (Node.js, Laravel, Django).

 -

 Additional Domains: Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, Digital Marketing,

 Business Analytics, Finance, and Human Resources.

------------------------------

Program Benefits

Upon successful completion, participants will receive:

 -

 An Internship Certificate from recognized partner organizations

 -

 A Course Completion Certificate co-branded by Skillumni and Microsoft

 -

 A Letter of Recommendation, based on performance and engagement

------------------------------

Key Program Features

 -

 Flexible start dates aligned with academic schedules

 -

 Option to pause during examination periods

 -

 Adjustable project timelines

 -

 Mentorship from experienced industry professionals

 -

 Structured modules with assessments and applied projects

------------------------------

Contact for Support

For any queries or assistance, please reach out via WhatsApp at +91 63638

79292.

We look forward to your participation in this initiative, designed to

enhance your practical learning and prepare you for future professional

opportunities.

Best regards,The Skillumni Team(In collaboration with VIT)

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [02nd October]

Gandhi Jayanti / International Day of Non-Violence

Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi was born on October 2, 1869, in Porbandar,

Gujarat. Mahatma Gandhi shares his birthday with another Indian politician

and statesman, Lal Bahadur Shastri. The day honours Mahatma Gandhi, the

values of non-violence and tolerance he preached, and pays tribute to the

freedom fighter. People celebrate the day to promote peace, harmony, and

unity worldwide.

[image:

Mahatma-Gandhi-Jayanti-2nd-October-International-Day-of-Non-Violence.jpg]

In 2007, the United Nations General Assembly designated October 2 as

International

Day of Non-Violence to honour Gandhi's principles. It reaffirms "the

universal relevance of the principle of non-violence" and the desire "to

secure a culture of peace, tolerance, understanding and non-violence".

subject: Yantra’26 Results: Hackathon & Technical Event Winners - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

We are thrilled to celebrate the grand success of Yantra’26, A Week of

Technical Innovation. Held from 7th to 15th February 2026, this week-long

festival of innovation brought together bright minds across disciplines to

engage in cutting-edge workshops, tech talks, hackathons, and tech

competitions, fostering a spirit of creativity, collaboration, and

excellence.

With the successful execution of over 65 events across diverse domains,

Yantra’26 emerged as a vibrant hub of innovation and problem-solving. At

the heart of the fest was Central Hack, Yantra's premier and most

prestigious hackathon, where students collaborated to develop

interdisciplinary solutions addressing real-world challenges.

We are delighted to announce the winners of all the hackathons and

technical competitions conducted during Yantra’26. The comprehensive list

of winners is available in the attached document. Each achievement reflects

exceptional innovation, strategic thinking, and technical expertise.

We extend our heartfelt gratitude to all the Clubs and Chapters for

successfully organizing and conducting the various events, to the esteemed

faculty members who dedicated their time and expertise to judging and

mentoring, and to every participant whose enthusiasm and commitment made

this celebration of innovation truly remarkable.

Congratulations to all participants and winners for making Yantra’26 a

resounding success. Your passion, creativity, and dedication truly embody

the spirit of technological excellence and collaboration.

The details regarding certificate collection and prize money transfer will

be notified shortly.

For any queries or clarifications, please feel free to reach out to us at

yantra.sw@vit.ac.in

body:
Kind attn: 4th year BTECH

Dear Students,

We are pleased to inform you that a webinar on the 4+1 Transfer Program to

Nanyang Technological University (NTU), Singapore, will be held on 7th

November 2025 (Friday) at 2:00 PM.

Under this arrangement, students can complete 4 years at VIT and then

transfer to NTU for their Master’s program.

Event Details:

 -

 Topic: 4+1 Transfer to NTU, Singapore

 -

 Date: 7th November 2025 Friday 

 -

 Time: 2:00 PM

 -

 Platform: Online Webinar

Join the Webinar:

https://ntu-sg.zoom.us/j/82812323570?pwd=tdiRM9ScPZ86prdcWapwDgEdDyaQCD.1

Meeting ID: 828 1232 3570

Passcode: NTUVIT

All interested students are encouraged to attend to learn more about this

exciting academic opportunity in NTU.

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations

Senior Professor- Center for Nanobiotechnology

Project Co-ordinator -EU Erasmus+ Mobility & CBHE Projects

subject: Congratulations to Suhani Mohapatra for Securing 1st Place at Classique – Vibrance 2026, VIT Chennai
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Suhani Mohapatra (24BCE2844) from SPIC

MACAY secured 1st Place in Classique, the solo classical dance

competition held during Vibrance 2026 at VIT Chennai.

The event celebrated India’s rich cultural heritage through classical dance

performances and consisted of two rounds of evaluation. In the first round,

participants performed a pre-choreographed classical dance and were judged

on technique, expressions, and adherence to traditional style. The second

round required dancers to pick an emotion and create an impromptu routine

based on it. Participants were evaluated on beat sense, expressions, stage

presence, and costume presentation.

Competing against 14 participants and progressing through two rounds of

elimination (one online round and the final round), Suhani demonstrated

exceptional grace and artistic excellence to secure the top position in the

competition.

We sincerely acknowledge the invaluable guidance and continuous support of

the Faculty Coordinator, Mr. Sudheer C V (Emp. ID: 13573), whose mentorship

significantly contributed to this achievement.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Suhani Mohapatra on this

commendable achievement and wish her continued success in her future

endeavors.

subject: World Suicide Prevention Day 2025-Changing the Narrative on Suicide
body:
Dear VITians,

Today, 10th September 2025, we join the global community in observing World

Suicide Prevention Day. This year’s theme, “Changing the Narrative on

Suicide” emphasizes the importance of breaking silence, challenging

stigma, and fostering open conversations about mental health.

https://www.who.int/campaigns/world-suicide-prevention-day/2025

University life brings both challenges and opportunities, and it is

important to remember that seeking help is a sign of strength. By

supporting one another with empathy and care, we can create a campus where

no one feels alone in their struggles.

 We encourage you to support your peers and friends, listen with empathy

and without judgment, and make use of the Counseling Division under the

Office of Students’ Welfare whenever needed. Together, let us nurture a

compassionate community where every voice is heard and every life is

subject: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HUTECH), VIETNAM, SEMESTER EXCHANGE PROGRAM IN FALL 2026
body:
Kind Attention Pre-final and Final Year Students,

The Department of International Relations and Project Management, Ho Chi

Minh City University of Technology (HUTECH), Vietnam, has announced the

HUTECH Semester Student Exchange Program in Fall 2026, a unique opportunity

for our students to experience Vietnamese culture, language and academics.

 1.

 About the program:

Established in 1995, HUTECH is a prominent Vietnamese multidisciplinary

institution that focuses on academic excellence, practical training and

innovation. HUTECH offers a diverse range of programs across various

fields, including technology, engineering, health sciences, arts and

humanities.

The exchange program will run from September 1, 2026 to January 15, 2026.

Academic programs available for exchange students include:

No.

Academic programs

Language

1

Information Technology

English

2

Automotive Engineering

3

Business Administration

4

International Economics

5

Marketing

6

Digital Marketing

7

Logistics and Supply Chain Management

8

English Language

9

Public Relations

10

Electronic Engineering (Fall 2027)

11

Multimedia Communication (Fall 2027)

 2.

 Tuition fee:

Tuition at HUTECH is waived for students from partner institutions, who are

only required to fulfill their tuition obligations at their home

institutions.

 3.

 Process:

 -

 The home institution is required to nominate students before June 1,

 2026.

 -

 Following the nomination, HUTECH will directly contact the students and

 guide them to complete the online application. Application deadline:

 June 15, 2026

 -

 Further details about the program are attached in the following file:

HUTECH SEMESTER STUDENT

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iBvefRj2RBQEQZslr4p_TnpAhS0B6CFK/view?usp=sharing

EXCHANGE PROGRAM IN SPRING 2026

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iBvefRj2RBQEQZslr4p_TnpAhS0B6CFK/view?usp=sharing

(PDF)

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iBvefRj2RBQEQZslr4p_TnpAhS0B6CFK/view?usp=sharing

 4.

 Number of students:

Each partner institution with a valid and effective Memorandum of

Understanding (MOU) with HUTECH is entitled to nominate up to five

(05) students

per semester for participation in the exchange program.

Interested students may contact Dr. Sainu Franco, International Relations

Officer, Vellore Institute of Technology, MB 105 and register your interest

on or before 25th May, 2026.

subject: Introducing the 5-Year Integrated M.Sc. (Data Science) Programme – Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

We are happy to announce that 5 Year Integrated M.Sc. Programmes online

application is launched for VIT - Vellore. The live link is enabled in the

VIT home page bulletin board and PG admissions landing page.

Live link URL:

https://admissions.vit.ac.in/integrated-msc-2026-applications/?utm_source=V6G6N0R4&utm_campaign=integratedmsc2026

The last date for submission of applications is 25th May 2026. For any

inquiries, please contact 0416-2202188, 0416-2202055, or email

intmscadmission@vit.ac.in.

We are introducing the new 5-Year Integrated M.Sc. (Data Science) Programme

at the Vellore campus from this academic year onwards. We encourage you to

share this information with your friends and family.

Yours Sincerely,

Dr. S.Sasikumar M.Sc., M.Phil., Ph.D., AMRSC.

Director - PG Admissions

Professor in Chemistry

subject: IANC 2026 - Autodesk Fusion CAD/CAM Simulation Challenge | Learn for Free and Win from a 35K Prize Pool!
body:
Dear Students,

We are excited to invite you to the IANC 2026 - Pre Conclave students

event Autodesk

Fusion CAD/CAM Simulation Challenge, organized by the School of Mechanical

Engineering in Association with Student Welfare office, in collaboration

with the SME Chapter and the Standards Club.

This event is powered by Autodesk and offers a fantastic opportunity for

students to test their design, manufacturing, and simulation skills using

industry-standard tools. Whether you are looking to sharpen your technical

expertise or gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge software, this

challenge is for you. Experts from industry will handle a one hour

workshop on CAM simulation and AUTODESK certificates will be provided free

of cost.

Event Details

· Event Title: AUTODESK FUSION CAD CAM SIMULATION CHALLENGE

· Date: March 12, 2026

· Time: 09:00 AM – 06:00 PM

· Venue: Shakespeare Gallery

· Prize pool: INR 35000.00

· Max Team Size: 3

· Reg Amount / Head: INR 100.00

Participants will have the chance to work through real-world engineering

problems, network with peers, and showcase their proficiency in Fusion.

How to Register: https://events.vit.ac.in/

We encourage all students passionate about mechanical design and

manufacturing to participate. Don’t miss this chance to elevate your

CAD/CAM skills!

We look forward to seeing your innovative designs in action.

[image: ASME CHAPTER in Association with STANDARDS CLUB

Presents_page-0001.jpg]

For More information kindly contact:

SME Chapter and Standards Club Team

subject: [Oracle University Learning Community] Kris-Ann -Oracle Started a new discussion. Transforming Employee Support: Solving HR Helpdesk Challenges with Oracle HCM
body:
Oracle University Learning Community http://community.oracle.com/ou/

Kris-Ann -Oracle Started a new discussion. Transforming Employee Support: Solving HR Helpdesk Challenges with Oracle HCM

In today’s dynamic business environment, employees expect fast, reliable, and personalized support from their HR departments. The HR Helpdesk plays a critical role in meeting these expectations, acting as the first line of support for everything from payroll queries to policy clarifications. However, many organizations still rely on outdated or inefficient systems, leading to frustration, delays, and operational inefficiencies.

Let’s explore the common challenges employees face with traditional HR Helpdesks—and how Oracle HCM offers a powerful solution.

The Most Common HR Helpdesk Challenges

Despite their best efforts, many HR teams struggle to keep up with the increasing demands of today’s workforce. Here are some of the key issues that employees encounter:

1. Slow Response Times

Delays in resolving queries can negatively impact employee satisfaction and productivity. Employees often have to follow up multiple times to get the information they need.

2. Lack of Personalization

Many helpdesk systems provide one-size-fits-all responses, which don't address the unique needs or circumstances of each employee.

3. Disjointed Communication Channels

When queries come in via email, phone, or intranet portals with no centralized system, it becomes difficult to ensure consistent service and follow-up.

4. Limited Self-Service Options

Employees often have to reach out to HR for routine tasks that could be handled with a user-friendly self-service platform.

Why These Challenges Matter

Ignoring these issues can have far-reaching consequences:

 Decreased Employee Morale: When support is slow or unhelpful, employees feel undervalued.

 Increased Workload for HR: Time-consuming manual processes prevent HR from focusing on strategic initiatives.

 Lower Operational Efficiency: Repeated queries and unresolved issues lead to wasted time and effort.

 Compliance Risks: Miscommunication or unresolved issues can create legal vulnerabilities.

Oracle HCM: A Smart Solution to Modern HR Helpdesk Problems

Oracle Human Capital Management (HCM) is designed to tackle these challenges head-on. Its integrated HR Help Desk module combines intelligent automation with a user-friendly interface to streamline HR service delivery.

Here’s how Oracle HR Helpdesk makes a difference:

Contextual Routing

The system uses simple assignment rules to route helpdesk requests to the right agent based on various employee attributes. Whether it's location, business unit, job, department, or the category of the request, Oracle HR Helpdesk offers the flexibility to match your business needs.

Personalized Employee Experiences

Customize employee Redwood pages with Visual Builder to improve user experience and align with your business needs.

Whether you need to add custom fields to the service request intake page, validate input data, or auto-populate fields based on selected values, Oracle Redwood Helpdesk provides all these capabilities.

Integrated Knowledge Base

A robust knowledge base empowers employees to find answers quickly through self-service, reducing unnecessary HR workload.

Concise and well-structured knowledge articles enable employees to find the information they need efficiently. This empowers them to resolve issues independently, reducing the volume of calls to the service center and minimizing the reliance on Helpdesk agents.

Some tips to optimize knowledge articles.

 Create clear, concise knowledge article titles - Clear titles and subheadings help readers quickly decide if your article is relevant. Avoid vague wording that may confuse them.

 Stick to one topic per article - Avoid covering too many topics in one article. Focus on a single subject and link to related content for deeper insights.

 Use the customer's language - Use simple, everyday language instead of company jargon. It makes your content more relatable and easier to find through search

Multichannel Access

Employees can submit queries through the Web, Email, Telephony, or Chat, making support easily accessible anytime, anywhere.

💻️Start learning the basics of knowledge management in this course. 

Conclusion

A modern HR Helpdesk is not just about resolving employee issues—it’s about creating a seamless, supportive, and responsive experience that builds trust and engagement. Oracle HCM offers the tools organizations need to elevate HR service delivery, reduce manual workload, and improve employee satisfaction.

The Vellore Mutiny

The Vellore mutiny, or Vellore Revolution, occurred on 10 July 1806 and was

the first instance of a large-scale and violent mutiny by Indian sepoys

against the East India Company, predating the Indian Rebellion of 1857 by

half a century. The revolt, which took place in the South Indian city of

Vellore, lasted one full day, during which mutineers seized the Vellore

Fort and killed or wounded 200 British troops. The mutiny was subdued by

cavalry and artillery from Arcot. Total deaths amongst the mutineers were

approximately 350; with summary executions of about 100 during the

suppression of the outbreak, followed by the formal court-martial of

smaller numbers.

On 10th July 1806, the sepoys who had gathered killed 14 British officers

and 115 Englishmen of the 69th Regiment. The mutiny started during midnight

and by dawn, the fort had been captured by them. They raised the flag of

the Mysore Sultanate over the fort. They also declared Tipu Sultan’s son

Fateh Hyder the king. But a British officer who had escaped the fort

alerted the British force present at Arcot. From Arcot, British troops

arrived led by Sir Rollo Gillespie. He was able to quell the rebellion.

About 100 Indian soldiers were brought out of the palace where they had

sought refuge. They were then ordered to stand against a wall and shot

dead. In all, 350 Indian soldiers were killed and 350 wounded.

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vellore_mutiny

World Tuberculosis Day

World TB Day is celebrated on March 24 each year to raise public awareness

and understanding about the world’s deadliest infectious killer

tuberculosis and its devastating health, social and economic impact on

people around the world. March 24 marks the day in 1882 when Dr Robert Koch

announced that he had discovered the bacterium that causes TB, which opened

the way towards diagnosing and curing this disease. However, TB still

claims 4 100 people lives each day and close to 27 000 people fall ill with

this preventable and curable disease. World TB Day is an opportunity to

focus on the people affected by this disease and to call for accelerated

action to end TB suffering and deaths.

The theme of World TB Day 2024 - ‘Yes! We can end TB!’ – conveys a message

of hope that getting back-on-track to turn the tide against the TB epidemic

is possible through high level leadership, increased investments and faster

uptake of new WHO recommendations.

On the occasion of World Tuberculosis Day, CC are organising one event.

Leo Club

Event Name: World Tuberculosis Day Quiz

Platform: Quizziz

Event Description: The 24th of March is marked every year by World

Tuberculosis Day, a day that serves as a beacon of awareness against the

threatening consequences of a tuberculosis epidemic. This day marks Dr.

Robert Koch’s significant discovery of the causal bacterium of TB, leading

to groundbreaking milestones in the diagnosis and curing of TB. Let’s come

together to fuel a spirit of empathy for people suffering from TB around

the world, by taking part in VIT LEO Club’s “TB CureQuest”, an online

subject: Congratulations to Team TAMates on Securing Third Position at Planc’D – IIIT Bengaluru
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team TAMates from The AI & ML Club

 secured Third Position at Planc’D, a nationwide online hackathon

organized by the International Institute of Information Technology,

Bangalore (IIIT Bengaluru), held from 7th to 9th November.

The hackathon focused on Machine Learning with Quantum Computing, bringing

together innovative student teams from across the country to explore

advanced and emerging technologies.

Team Members:

 - Dhyanam Mahajan (24BCE2531)

 - Sahil Sadhwani (24BCT0294)

 - Shourya Thakur (24BCI0171)

 - Aarif Maaz (24BDS0343)

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to the team for their dedication,

technical excellence, and commendable performance. We also express our

sincere appreciation to the Faculty Coordinator, Dr. Monica Subashini (Emp

ID: 11817), for her guidance and continuous support.

Congratulations to Team TAMates for bringing laurels to VIT. We wish them

continued success in their future endeavours.

subject: Microsoft Summer Internship - 2027
body:
Microsoft Summer Internship - 2027

Timelines:

Activity

Date/Time

Apply on Microsoft careers portal as per the steps mentioned below.

07th Jan to 11th Jan

Interview Process (2 Rounds of interview)

Online Assessment – 13th Jan 7 Pm

Interviews – 23rd Jan 10 Am

Eligibility:

 - Current Degree & Branches: Enrolled in a B. Tech CSE related program

 passing out in 2027.

 - CGPA – 7 and Above with no active backlogs.

 - Year of graduation: 2027 only

Stipend : 1,25,000 per month

 Application Process:

 Below mentioned is the Job ID

Role

Job ID

Data Science Intern

200005588

 How to Apply: 

 1. Click on Microsoft Career Page

 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/home.html or directly Click

 Here https://apply.careers.microsoft.com/careers/job/1970393556625290 to

 apply

 2. You will be asked to sign in using 4 options. Please sign in with

 your personal email address.

 3. Fill in the application form completely and correctly.

 4. Fields like contact information/experience/education/additional

 information are required to be filled in the form.

 5. Please answer all the questions correctly.

 6. Ensure your resume is attached. In case you miss attaching your

 resume, the hiring team will not be able to view your complete profile and

 may lead to disqualification.

 7. Carefully complete your application process and hit the submit

 button.

 Instructions: 

 - Please make sure you apply to the correct Job ID as per the role.

 - Fill in your complete college name and do not use abbreviations.

 - Please ensure you complete the entire application. Incomplete

 applications will be disqualified.

Candidates with Disabilities: 

 - At Microsoft fostering a hiring process that is inclusive of

 candidates with disabilities is a top priority, which is why we’ve made it

 easier to request accommodations that allow candidates to fully participate

 and show their capabilities during the interview. [Accommodations are

 appropriate changes and adjustments to the application or hiring process

 that create an equitable interview process for candidates with

 disabilities.]

 - A candidate may request accommodations prior to being scheduled for an

 interview by filling out the accessibility request form

 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/accessibility.html?gcsPageView=support

on

 the Microsoft careers site. (screenshot below)

 - This is not application dependent, can be submitted at any stage. Kindly

 keep your Microsoft POC informed about the same.

 - If scheduled for an interview, candidates will be asked to complete a

 separate form in the Action Center of their profile.

It is mandatory for all students participating in the hiring process to

apply for the role via the Microsoft Careers site. Applications submitted

solely through the college will not be considered unless the candidate

completes the application on the Microsoft Careers portal within the

stipulated timeframe.

Dead line to Register on both links"

07th Jan to 11th Jan

Important Notes from Microsoft:

 - The platform strictly prohibits copying code, pasting any external

 content, or navigating away from the test window/switching tabs will be

 flagged, recorded, and considered a violation. Any such malpractice will

 result in immediate disqualification from the hiring process for the entire

 year.

 - Always uphold the highest standards of academic and professional

 integrity.

 - Refrain from any form of malpractice, including but not limited to

 plagiarism, external assistance, or use of unfair means during assessments.

 - Attention to detail is key! Make sure to read the questions thoroughly

 and address ALL the components.

 Best Practices Before You Begin

 To ensure a seamless and fair assessment experience, please adhere to the

following guidelines:

 - Use only a laptop or desktop computer to take the test. The use of

 mobile phones, tablets, or any other electronic devices is strictly

Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-66 (10th July-Wednesday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTEST

TOPIC:

 Elements of Design

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence in a

 unique and interesting way?

 - Capturing campus vibes in stunning photographs.

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by tomorrow 05:00

 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts tomorrow morning at 06:00 am and ends

by 05:00 pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

body:
Dear Learners, 
 

Thank you for enrolling in this NPTEL course and we hope you have gone through the contents for this week and also attempted the assignment. 

We value your feedback and wish to know how you found the videos and the questions asked - whether they were easy, difficult, as per your expectations, etc 

We shall use this to make the course better and we can also know from the feedback which concepts need more explanation, etc. 

Please do spare some time to give your feedback - comprises just 5 questions - should not take more than a minute, but makes a lot of difference for us as we know what the Learners feel. 

Here is the link to the form: 
 https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdNGAWqEmsdT3ixHSVd5GZI3t8HY58v8J-oExpDbISzs83FsA/viewform
 
 

NPTEL Team

subject: Reminder: Hackathon 2025: Celebrating 10 years of innovation
body:
UBS Campus Hackathon 2025 is here - where talent meets tech and coding

skills are put to the test!

We’re excited to invite students from your campus to join our on-site

Hackathon at offices in Mumbai and Pune, where they’ll collaborate and

compete in a professional, dynamic environment.

As we celebrate 10 years of impact in India, we remain committed to

engineering

excellence, simplification, and continuous learning to deliver

best-in-class solutions to our colleagues and clients.

What’s in it for them?

· Tackle real-world tech challenges

· Receive mentorship from industry experts

· Engage with UBS senior leadership

· Get a chance to fast-track into our Graduate Program

· What’s more? Winner gets a Home Pod mini by Apple; 1st Runner Up gets

JBL Live headphones and 2nd Runner up gets the JBL Bud earphones

How can they join?

The journey starts with a HackerRank test at your respective campus. The

top performers will qualify for the in-person Hackathon in March 2025!

HackerRank test details

· Test dates: 27 / 28 February (final date as confirmed by Training and

Placement Office)

· Test link: Sent one day in advance to eligible candidates via email

· Eligibility: Students pursuing their second/third year of Bachelor’s

Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics and

Communication, Data Science with a CGPA of 8+ (applications to be

processed through campus Training and Placement Office)

· Results announced: Between 28 February to 1 March (confirmation from

respective Training and Placement Office)

Hackathon details

· Teams of up to six members

· In-person event at UBS Mumbai and Pune offices in March 2025

· UBS will cover travel, accommodation, and meals for outstation

participants

Local candidates from Mumbai and Pune will manage their own travel. UBS

will cover flights and cabs for outstation participants.

Interested and eligible students can register in the link below on or

before 21st Feb 2025 on or before 5.00 pmWithout fail.

https://forms.gle/TqNV5eCJ3Pc5Ejkq6

It is observed on November 23 annually to honor one of the most influential

mathematicians of the Middle Ages namely Leonardo Bonacci. Let us read in

brought this series. He is one of the most leading mathematicians of the

Middle Ages. The day recognises the significance and cost of Fibonacci's

contributions to mathematics.

It is observed on November 23 because the digits of this date form a

Fibonacci sequence. Or we can say that when the date is written in mm/dd

World UFO Day is an awareness day for people to gather together and watch

the skies for unidentified flying objects. July 2 commemorates the supposed

UFO crash in the 1947 Roswell UFO Incident. In the late 1940s and through

the 1950s, UFOs became popularly known as ‘flying saucers’ or ‘flying

discs’. Today, many believe that we are not alone in the universe and that

extraterrestrial life that did not originate on Earth exists.

Dear PG Students,

Greetings.

Project Title: Investigation of efficiency enhancement of chalcogenide

based thin film solar cells

Abstract: As we know India is gearing up for attainment of 500 GW

renewable energy through non-fossil fuel till 2030. In that case, solar

cells are vastly used for the above energy production. The following

project is based on the above motivation with the supporting investigations

from thin film solar cells. This project has the following problem

statements to solve:

i. Achieving higher efficiency of SnSe based solar cells

ii. Designing specific architecture for efficiency enhancement

iii. Comparison with the different chalcogenides based thin films

iv. Investigations of different machine learning approaches for efficiency

enhancement

From this project, the candidate will go through rigorous training in solar

cell study through various experiments and simulations. The concerned

student will learn the basic understanding of solar cells design for thin

film-based applications. Finally, it will help to provide scientific

communication through journal papers and conference proceedings.

No. of Open positions: 2 PG students 

Duration: 6 months

Last date to apply: 31th July 2026

subject: Green Tiger Mobility Dream Internship Registration – 2027 Batch.
body:
Green Tiger Mobility Dream Internship Registration – 2027 Batch. 

Green Tiger Mobility, India’s largest EV retrofit and innovating power

electronics company. Founded in Bengaluru, we are working towards

transforming India’s 30+ crore petrol two-wheelers into cleaner, smarter,

and more affordable mobility solutions.

We hold 6 patents on our technology which spans ARAI/RTO approved EV

retrofit systems, Battery Management Systems (BMS), Vehicle Control Units

(VCU), telematics platforms, fleet analytics, and

hybrid mobility solutions. Our work has received recognition and support

from institutions like ARAI, IIM Bangalore, Ministry of Heavy Industries,

Meaty, BITS Pilani, NASSCOM, and FICCI. We are well funded by

Institutional investors as well industry players like Bajaj Motors, etc.

As Green Tiger continues its growth journey and expands across India and

South Asia, we are looking to engage talented students who aspire to build

careers in Mobility, Power Electronics, AI and Operations.

Why Green Tiger?

Most internships allow students to observe business operations. However,

at Green Tiger, interns become part of the team responsible for building

and scaling them. They work closely with leaders and experts on real

business challenges across functions. Their recommendations are not

confined to presentations—they often translate into actions that directly

impact business performance.

Areas of Internship

 - Strategy & Business Planning

 - Program Management

 - Operations Excellence

 - Product & Process Improvement

 - Business Analytics & Dashboarding

 - Customer Experience & Service Operations

 - Growth & Market Expansion

What Students Will Gain

· Exposure to one of India's most exciting and rapidly evolving industries

· Opportunity to work directly with senior leadership and decision-makers

· Experience solving real operational and business challenges in a

high-growth environment

· Cross-functional exposure across technology, operations, customer

experience, and business strategy

· Development of problem-solving, stakeholder management, analytical, and

execution skills that are critical for future leadership roles

At Green Tiger, we believe the best learning happens when students are

trusted with responsibility and encouraged to create measurable impact. We

look forward to collaborate with your institution and provide students with

an opportunity to contribute, learn, and grow while helping shape the

future of mobility in India

Internship and Placement Details – Green Tiger Mobility

1. Stipend / CTC Details

· Monthly stipend for interns: ₹15,000 – ₹20,000 per month.

· Selected candidates may be considered for full-time roles based on

business requirements and performance. The detailed CTC structure for

full-time employment will be shared at the time of PPO/full-time

conversion, It will be between 4 LPA to 8 LPA.

2. Duration of Internship

· The internship duration is expected to be 10–12 months, providing

students with extensive industry exposure and hands-on experience.

3. Work Location & Mode

· Location: Bommanahalli, Bengaluru.

· Mode of Work: On-site (In-office).

4. Eligibility Criteria

60% or 6cgpa in 10th, 12th, UG ,PG

· Preferred branches:

o All M.Tech cse branches

o All M.Tech ece branches

o All M.Tech mechanical branches

o All M.Tech Electrical branches.

· Candidates with relevant skills and interest in the automotive and EV

domain are encouraged to apply.

5. Selection Process

The hiring process consists of the following stages:

1. Resume/CV evaluation.

2. Written test.

3. Two rounds of operational interviews.

7. PPO (Pre-Placement Offer) Opportunities

· PPO opportunities are available for high-performing interns.

· Full-time employment and compensation details will be determined based

on the candidate’s performance and organizational requirements.

Note:

All the interested and eligible students kindly register in the NEO PAT

portal on or before 18-06-2026 8.00am.

National Tourism Day

Every year, January 25 is celebrated as the National Tourism Day in India.

This day has been marked by the government in order to promote tourism in

the nation. It is dedicated to educate and inform people about the vital

role of tourism in the country and how it plays a crucial role in the

Indian economy. India is a diverse country and is filled with the alluring

beauty of culture and history. Every state has its own different cultures

and diversification.

National Tourism Day is a glorious day in India’s history. Our country has

a special place all over the world because of its beautiful tourist

destinations. The terrain, language, and the way of living changes here

every few kilometres. National Tourism Day is celebrated every year to

acknowledge this beautiful diversity.

National Voters' Day

National Voters' Day has been celebrated on January 25 every year since

2011, all across the country to mark the foundation day of the Election

Commission of India on January 25, 1950. The main purpose of the NVD

celebration is to encourage, facilitate and maximise enrolment, especially

for the new voters.

Dedicated to the voters of the country, the day is utilised to spread

awareness among the voters and for promoting informed participation in the

electoral process. New voters are felicitated and handed over their Elector

Photo Identity Card (EPIC) in the NVD functions.

basics of Kotlin which could be the very start of their careers as an App

Developer in Android.

program features dynamic panel talks and workshops addressing voting

democracy.

subject: Production Mini-plants in mobile containers. Co-investment Program
body: The Financial News, May 2002 Production Mini-plants in mobile containers. Co-investment Program =22...Science Network will supply to countries and developing regions the technology and the necessary support for the production in series of Mini-plants in mobile containers (40-foot). The Mini-plant system is designed in such a way that all the production machinery is fixed on the platform of the container, with all wiring, piping, and installation parts; that is to say, they are fully equipped... and the mini-plant is ready for production.=22 More than 700 portable production systems: Bakeries, Steel Nails, Welding Electrodes, Tire Retreading, Reinforcement Bar Bending for Construction Framework, Sheeting for Roofing, Ceilings and Façades, Plated Drums, Aluminum Buckets, Injected Polypropylene Housewares, Pressed Melamine Items (Glasses, Cups, Plates, Mugs, etc.), Mufflers, Construction Electrically Welded Mesh, Plastic Bags and Packaging, Mobile units of medical assistance, Sanitary Material, Hypodermic Syringes, Hemostatic Clamps, etc. Science Network has started a process of Co-investment for the installation of small Assembly plants to manufacture in series the Mini-plants of portable production on the site, region or country where they may be required. One of the most relevant features is the fact that these plants will be connected to the World Trade System (WTS) with access to more than 50 million raw materials, products and services and automatic transactions for world trade. Because of financial reasons, involving cost and social impact, the right thing to do is to set up assembly plants in the same countries and regions, using local resources (labor, some equipment, etc.) For more information: 3D=22mailto:reports=40the-financial-news.com=22 Mini-plants in mobile containers By Steven P. Leibacher, The Financial News, Editor Mini-plantas de produccion en contenedores moviles. Programa de Co-inversion =22...Science Network s uministrara a paises y regiones en vias de desarrollo la tecnologia y el apoyo necesario para la fabricacion en serie de Mini-plantas de produccion en contenedores moviles (40-foot) . El sistema de mini-plantas esta diseñado de forma que todas las maquinas de produccion van instaladas fijas sobre la propia plataforma del contenedor, con el cableado, tuberias e instalaciones; es decir, completamente equipadas... y a partir de ese momento están listas para producir.=22 Mas de 700 sistemas de produccion portatil: Panaderias, Producción de clavos de acero, Electrodos para soldadura, Recauchutado de neumaticos, Curvado de hierro para armaduras de construccion, Lamina perfilada para cubiertas, techos y cerramientos de fachada, Bidones de chapa, Cubos de aluminio, Menaje de polipropileno inyectado, Piezas de melamina prensada (vasos, platos, tazas, cafeteras, etc.) Silenciadores para vehiculos, Malla electrosoldada para la construccion, Bolsas y envases de plastico, Unidades moviles de asistencia medica, Material sanitario (jeringas hipodermicas, Pinzas hemostaticas, etc.) Science Network ha puesto en marcha un proceso de Co-inversion para la instalacion de pequeñas Plantas ensambladoras para fabricar en serie las Mini-plantas de produccion portatil, en el lugar, region o pais que lo necesite. Una de las características relevantes es el hecho de que dichas plantas quedaran conectadas al Sistema del Comercio Mundial (WTS) con acceso a mas de 50 millones de mercancias, materia primas, productos, servicios y las operaciones automaticas de comercio internacional. subject: The LEHIGH UNIVERSITY, USA - Flagship program - HDSE program
body:
The LEHIGH UNIVERSITY, USA presents "Humanitarian Design and Social

Enterprise (HDSE) Leadership Intensive"

A few slots are open for students from India for this flagship program.

Dates: June 2-6, 2025

Venue: Agastya International Foundation https://www.agastya.org/, Innovation

Campus https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RehhwwviGFY, Kuppam

Eligibility Criteria:

•⁠ ⁠Currently enrolled in a Bachelors or Masters Degree Program at an

IUCEE-affiliated college or university

•⁠ ⁠Fully Complete Application Package

•⁠ ⁠Accepted participants will be expected to complete the HDSE Virtual

Academy https://creativeinquiry.lehigh.edu/outreach/hdse-virtual-academy

before

June 1

Program Summary:

The HDSE Leadership Intensive is envisioned as a high-octane, in-person

workshop that will bring together an interdisciplinary cohort of highly

motivated students from across India for a week of inspiration,

collaboration, and social innovation. Set on the beautiful Agastya

International Foundation Innovation Campus in Kuppam, just three hours from

Bengaluru, this hands-on, hearts-on experience will foster transformative

learning and entrepreneurial action.

Guided by Global Social Impact Fellows from Lehigh University, participants

will work closely with nonprofit leaders and K-12 education innovators to

co-create practical, innovative, and sustainable solutions that can amplify

Agastya’s mission of nurturing a new generation of tinkerers, innovators,

and solution-seekers in India. Through immersive, real-world projects,

participants will develop the skillsets, mindsets, and portfolios necessary

to tackle complex societal challenges. The pursuit of sustainable impact is

at the core of this experience, preparing students to lead lives of purpose

and create lasting change.

For further details, follow the link

https://creativeinquiry.lehigh.edu/outreach/hdse-leadership-intensive

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.SeenivasanDirector -International RelationsVIT -Vellore Institute of

Technology, Vellore-632 014,Tamil Nadu, India

subject: YANTRA'26: Day-4 Events (10-02-26) - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details: Yantra 2026: A Week of Technical

Innovation

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 4:

CODECHEF VIT

Event Name : DevSOC'26

Date : 08-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 2 PM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details: DevSOC (Developers' Sprint Of Code), in its seventh

edition, is the flagship annual event by CodeChef-VIT, aiming at empowering

young minds by fostering meaningful connections between tech enthusiasts

and innovators. This 48-hour sprint-style hackathon is designed to

encourage creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving in an intense yet

engaging environment. As a Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) event,

DevSOC’26 emphasizes innovation, teamwork, and technological advancement

over four days of continuous ideation and development.

SOCIETY OF MANUFACTURING ENGINEERS (SME)

Event Name : ManuHack

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 2 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : ManuHack is a one-day design-a-thon where teams receive a

random manufactured product and creatively communicate its value. Instead,

they focus on explaining the product’s manufacturing process, quality

standards, applications and social responsibility in a simple and engaging

way. Teams may choose to present their ideas through a website mockup,

pitch deck, brochure or visual process flow.

BULLS AND BEARS CLUB

Event Name : Protocol X-Change

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Protocol X-change is an immersive simulation where

participants step into a live, blockchain-inspired digital economy that is

already in motion. There are no turns, no pauses, and no reset points. From

the moment participants enter, prices fluctuate, risks exist, and every

decision made is recorded within the system. Actions are executed

transparently, outcomes are rule-driven, and no single authority controls

the market. The system does not guide participants toward a single path.

Instead, it allows them to choose how they want to survive, grow, and

influence the economy through their decisions. The experience is designed

to reflect how modern Web3 systems operate, testing decision-making under

uncertainty, risk awareness, strategic thinking, and adaptability in

response to unexpected changes in market conditions.

SOLAR ENERGY SOCIETY OF INDIA

Event Name : Powering Care

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : BHAGAT SINGH GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Powering Care is a high-intensity technical event that

challenge participants to engineer next-generation healthcare systems using

W3 technologies. The event focuses on distributed system design, fault

tolerance, autonomous execution, and verifiable trust, rather than

conventional application development. Participants work on one of two

predefined problem statements and move from deep system-level ideation to

core prototype implementation, demonstrating how decentralized

architectures and W3 logic can be applied to life-critical healthcare

infrastructure and data governance systems.

INSTITUTE OF ELECTRICAL & ELECTRONICS ENGINEERING (IEEE)Event Name : Red

Flag

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY - TT

Event Details : Red Flag is an immersive workshop that shows you how

cryptocurrencies actually work by guiding you through building your own

Ethereum-based token from scratch. You will explore the fundamentals of

blockchain, understand the difference between coins and tokens, learn how

smart contracts define rules in code, and see how wallets and transactions

function in practice. The highlight of the event is deploying a custom

ERC-20 token on a local Ethereum blockchain and using wallets like MetaMask

to transfer and manage it. You will observe transactions, blocks, and gas

usage in real time while simulating how tokens can be used within a

community. By the end, you will walk away with a working token and a clear,

practical understanding of blockchain and cryptocurrencies.

ROBOVITICS

Event Name : Cruise the Web3Verse

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Step into the future of technology with a 2-day Web3

workshop designed to bridge theory and real-world impact. Participants will

dive into blockchain fundamentals, smart contracts, and decentralized

identity, then experience these concepts in action through an interactive,

multiplayer game. Teams will play unique roles in a dynamic simulation,

navigating challenges, earning points, and facing real-time chaos as they

manage digital certificates and system integrity. The workshop blends

lectures, hands-on coding, and live simulations, making complex Web3

concepts accessible and exciting. With quizzes and expert guidance, this

event is perfect for anyone curious about blockchain, smart contracts, and

digital innovation. You’ll also get the chance to build real blockchain

projects and see how Web2 and Web3 approaches differ in practice.

STUDENTS ASSOCIATION OF BIO-ENGINEERING SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY

(SABEST)Event Name : Crop Crypt

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY - SJT

Event Details : Crop Crypt is an interdisciplinary ideathon where

participants are introduced to the fundamentals of Genetically Modified

Crops (GMOs) and Web3 technologies. Based on this, participants engage in

an ideathon where they apply these concepts to address ethical issues

associated with GMOs through innovative Web3-based solutions. These will

then be assessed across various mediums, including a Shipwreck round, and

ultimately a presentation to the panel of judges.

STUDENTS FOR THE EXPLORATION AND DEVELOPMENT OF SPACE (SEDS) & AMERICAN

SOCIETY OF MECHANICAL ENGINEERS (ASME)

Event Name : HERMES

Date : 10-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SHAKESPEARE GALLERY - TT

Event Details : The Satellite Design Challenge is a 36-hour competition

where teams of 2–4 participants design, document, and demonstrate

innovative small satellite concepts. The event begins with a Fusion 360

workshop, followed by two rounds: documentation and final working model

presentation. Participants tackle real-world challenges such as

environmental monitoring, disaster response, and Earth observation,

designing feasible satellite systems with defined payloads, power budgets,

and orbits. All submissions are made through the official event website.

Judged by experts, HERMES encourages creativity, technical precision, and

teamwork, offering participants a deep dive into practical aerospace

systems design. The top three designs will be specially rewarded with a

physical 3D-printed model of their satellite, bringing the best concepts

from screen to reality.

THE AI & ML CLUB - TAM

Event Name : RedHandedDate : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 5 PM

Venue : AMBEDKAR AUDITORIUM - TT

Event Details : This workshop is a security-first, hands-on deep dive

into modern cyber defense systems where participants learn how real-world

attacks occur, why traditional logging systems fail, and how to design

tamper-proof security architectures. Participants will explore

cybersecurity fundamentals, threat modeling, and attack forensics, followed

by building a blockchain-backed event logging system that ensures log

integrity, immutability, and verifiable audit trails—without focusing on

cryptocurrency or mining. The workshop culminates in integrating AI-based

anomaly detection to identify suspicious behavior patterns directly from

immutable security logs, demonstrating how AI augments—not

replaces—cybersecurity controls. By the end of the session, participants

will have built an end-to-end cyber event monitoring system that simulates

attacks, proves tampering cryptographically, and detects anomalies

intelligently—mirroring how SIEM, audit, and SOC systems operate in

industry.

IEEE COMPUTER SOCIETY (IEEE-CS)

Event Name : BattleCode

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 10 AM to 6 PM

Venue : KAMARAJ AUDITORIUM - TT

Event Details : Battlecode is a multi stage competitive programming

tournament that transforms traditional coding contests into a real time,

strategy driven battle arena. Designed to test not only algorithmic

knowledge but also decision making under pressure, Battlecode combines

synchronous rounds, live 1v1 duels, dynamic matchmaking, bounty challenges,

and a final hacking phase into a single cohesive experience. Unlike static

contests where participants solve problems in isolation, Battlecode

introduces direct player interaction, adaptive difficulty, and live

leaderboard movement. As participants progress, the competition evolves

from individual problem solving to head to head matches and finally into a

high stakes elite round where participants must both defend their solutions

and analyze other’s code.

ADVANCE DEVELOPERS CLUB

Event Name : SharkTech 2.0Date : 09-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : This is a 24-hour event that incorporates a designathon

and a hackathon with a Shark Tank format that focuses on using Artificial

Intelligence for social causes. This event aims to develop solutions using

Artificial Intelligence to solve some of the most pressing problems faced

by society today, which include eradicating poverty, ensuring quality

education for all, women’s equality, ensuring inclusivity in healthcare

facilities, and conservation of the environment.

CUBING CLUB

Event Name : Code Your Cube

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 3 PM to 7 PM

Venue : PRP ANNEX 203

Event Details : A hands-on workshop demonstrating how algorithms can

solve a 3×3 Rubik’s Cube, with insights into how puzzles like 2×2, 4×4, and

megaminx differ and why they require separate solving approaches.

IEEE ENGINEERING IN MEDICINE & BIOLOGY SOCIETY (IEEE-EMBS)

Event Name : Crypt-a-Pharm

Date : 10-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SMV 110

Event Details : Delve into the fusion of Web3 and healthcare as you

explore how to secure patient data and inventory management. You will

explore the journey of a drug from manufacturer to patient and how Web3

authenticates every step of the way.

subject: Tata -Cornell University USA -Scholarship
body:
Tata Scholarship for Students from India

Thanks to a generous gift from the Tata Education and Development Trust — a

philanthropic affiliate of India’s Tata Group — a $25 million endowment

provides financial aid to Cornell undergraduate students from India.

The Tata Scholarship Fund supports approximately 20 scholars at any point

in time and ensures that the very best Indian students have access to

Cornell, regardless of their financial circumstances. Cornell awards these

scholarships annually, and recipients receive the scholarship for the

duration of their undergraduate studies at Cornell.

Ratan Tata ’59, B. Arch ’62, is a Cornell trustee and the chairman of Tata

Sons, the holding company of the Tata Group, one of India’s oldest,

largest, and most respected business conglomerates. Mr. Tata is one of the

most respected business leaders in the world and has received numerous

prestigious honors recognizing his impact through his work and philanthropy.

To receive the undergraduate scholarship, a recipient must be:

 - a citizen of India who has attended secondary school in India;

 - offered admission to Cornell as an undergraduate student;

 - eligible for need-based financial aid.

The Tata Scholarship selection process gives preference to qualified

students accepted to the following programs:

 - College of Architecture, Art and Planning

 - College of Engineering

 - Applied Economics and Management major in the Cornell SC Johnson

 College of Business

 - Majors across colleges in the biological sciences, physical sciences,

 and other sciences, as well as the social sciences.

Is the Tata Scholarship guaranteed until graduation?

As long as Tata Scholars have financial need, Cornell is committed to

providing them with Tata Scholarship funding. With the exception of the

five-year program in architecture, which requires ten semesters of

full-time enrollment, Cornell will provide up to eight semesters of

funding. Funding for additional semesters due to double majors or dual

degrees is not available.

Application Process

Undergraduate applicants eligible for the Tata Scholarship will be

considered if they complete the admission application and apply for

financial aid. All applicants must apply for financial aid by completing

the CSS Profile

subject: Congratulations to Team Foresight for their Achievement at RedShield National Hackathon - MSAJCE, Chennai
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Foresight delivered an outstanding

performance at the RedShield National Hackathon, conducted at Mohamed

Sathak A. J. College of Engineering, Chennai, held on 6–7 April 2026.

The hackathon witnessed participation from over 60 teams and was conducted

through three rigorous evaluation rounds, where participants were assessed

based on innovation, technical implementation, and real-world applicability

of their solutions.

Representing VIT, Team Foresight developed a project titled “Foresight

Crime Detection Platform”. The solution aims to transform traditional

policing into a proactive, intelligence-driven ecosystem using predictive

analytics, spatial intelligence, and real-time decision support systems.

The project demonstrated features such as predictive crime analysis, patrol

optimization, real-time SOS handling, dynamic risk evaluation, and smart

resource allocation, showcasing a strong industry-oriented solution.

Through their innovative approach and technical execution, the team was

recognized among the top teams in the competition and was awarded a 90-day

paid internship opportunity with Cytnexus, along with a stipend of

₹10,000 per month.

Team Members:

 1. Mohammed Kaif K – 23MIS0258

 2. Deepak Kumar D – 23MIS0247

 3. Gowsik V – 23MIS0303

 4. Gowtham G – 23MIS0520

We sincerely acknowledge the invaluable guidance and continuous support of

the Faculty Coordinator, R. Mangayarkarasi (Emp. ID: 10964), whose

mentorship significantly contributed to this achievement.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Team Foresight on this

commendable achievement and wish them continued success in their future

endeavors.

subject: Indo-US Science and Technology Forum (IUSSTF) and The Viterbi School of Engineering, University of Southern California (USC)- Research Internship Programme 2025
body:
Dear Students,

The Indo-US Science and Technology Forum (IUSSTF) and The Viterbi School of

Engineering, University of Southern California (USC) have partnered to

support the IUSSTF-Viterbi Program.

This program provides opportunities to Indian students to undertake

research internship at the Viterbi School of Engineering in the summer of

2025 for a period of 8 weeks.

The IUSSTF-Viterbi Program is envisaged to :

-Provide an opportunity to the best and brightest Indian students to gain

exposure and access to world class research facilities in the Viterbi

School.

-Promote research and capacity building in frontline areas of engineering

and technology.

-Encourage outstanding students to take up research as a career.

-Pave the way for the next generation engineers from India to interact with

American peers, thus help building long-term R&D linkages and

collaborations.

Eligibility https://iusstf.org/iusstf-viterbi-program#ppd-tab0 Scholarship

includes https://iusstf.org/iusstf-viterbi-program#ppd-tab1 Awards

https://iusstf.org/iusstf-viterbi-program#awards Resources

https://iusstf.org/iusstf-viterbi-program#resource

 - Indian students currently pursuing a Bachelors or Master’s degree at

 recognized institutions of higher education in India.

 - Open to students of Electrical Engineering, Electronics &

 Communication Engineering, Computer Engineering and Computational Sciences.

 - Grade Point Average (GPA) of 8.5 or higher (or equivalent of 3.5 GPA

 on a 4.0 scale); Percentage equivalent: 80% and higher.

Applications should be submitted using our Online Application Portal for

Visitation Programs. http://49.50.66.168/flowchart.aspx Hard copies and

electronic copies of the application forms will not be accepted.

For additional information about the program please visit:-

https://viterbischool.usc.edu/globalization/summer-research-projects/.

https://viterbischool.usc.edu/globalization/summer-research-projects/

Submission Deadline : 30 November 2024

Contact Information

 Indo-US Science and Technology Forum, New Delhi

viterbi-india@iusstf.org

https://iusstf.org/iusstf-viterbi-program

 USC Viterbi School of Engineering University of Southern California

raghu@usc.edu

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations

subject: Congratulations to Toastmasters International VIT on Achievement at Annual Division C Conference 2025
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Aniruddha Deshmukh (23BEE0114), a member

of Toastmasters International, secured 3rd Prize in the Humorous Speech

Contest at the Annual Division C Conference, held at the Social Club, T.

Nagar, Chennai, on 2nd November 2025.

The Annual Division C Conference is a prestigious platform that brings

together talented speakers from various institutions to showcase excellence

in communication and public speaking. Through his engaging delivery and

effective use of humor, Aniruddha demonstrated exceptional oratory skills,

bringing laurels to both the Toastmasters chapter and VIT.

We also extend our sincere gratitude to the Faculty Coordinator, Dr.

Abhishek Das (Emp ID: 17006), for their guidance, encouragement, and

continuous support in nurturing students’ communication and leadership

skills.

We congratulate Aniruddha Deshmukh on this commendable achievement and wish

him continued success in his journey of personal and professional growth.

We are delighted to announce that the VIT Cultural Teams achieved

outstanding success at Saarang 2026, the prestigious cultural

festival of IIT

Madras, held from 8th to 12th January 2026.

Participants from the English Literary Association (ELA), The Fine Arts

Club (TFAC), Technology and Gaming Club (TAG), VIT Dramatics Club, VIT

Music Club, and other cultural teams showcased exceptional talent,

creativity, and professionalism throughout the competitions. Their

remarkable performances have brought significant recognition and honour to

our University.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to all participants and faculty

coordinators for their dedication and brilliant performances, which have

once again elevated VIT’s cultural legacy.

Report Immediately: TCS Pre-placement Talk & Placement Policy Orientation

is Scheduled on 14th July 2026 at 1.30 pm at SJT Ground

The CDC office has updated the details in Neopat portal students who have

applied (Vellore, Chennai and Amaravati) and are eligible for the TCS

process. We have attached a few more students who are eligible, Students

having more than one backlog are not eligible for the process.

Please find the attached Applied students list and verified

status. Students who have not applied still will be given one more chance

to apply, they are asked to register on or before 14th July 2026 3:00 pm in

the below link without fail.

https://forms.gle/bbCtYkXVtnWg71eK8

Students who are not registering will be not eligible for further campus

recruitment and they will be blocked in the Neopat portal.

Students who are not eligible as per the TCS eligibility criteria alone are

asked to register in the link below. The CDC office will verify the details.

https://forms.gle/TwPeG3Esu9pibdWT9

Please attend the session in formals

As per TCS Eligibility criteria students having more than 1 backlog and

less than 6 CGPA (throught) are not eligible for the TCS Process.

Please note that no more extension will be given.

For More details please refer to the below registration mail sent earlier,

Students who are facing issues in filling the application but got CT / DT

no also can register in the above link.

Scholar Program. Please find the attached list

must complete the registration on the platform to confirm their

participation.

involve identifying Visteon Scholar Campus Champions from your institution.

attached document. We kindly request the institution to share the name(s)

of the Champions by Nov 21, 2025.

We shall be having a meeting with the TPOs and the Identified Champions in

the coming week, which will be followed by an Orientation Program for all

the Champions on Dec 3, 2025 at Visteon Bangalore office, between 10AM to

2PM. Kindly request you to plan your travel accordingly.

last 13 years to Top Universities across the world. He is an engineering

subject: DRUG AWARD SESSION- Invitation
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

The Office of Students’ Welfare is pleased to invite you to a Drug

Awareness Session, organized in collaboration with the Indian Red Cross

Society (IRCS), Vellore District Branch. This interactive session aims to

educate students on the risks associated with substance abuse, promote

informed decision-making, and encourage healthy lifestyle choices.

Session Details

 -

 Date: 23 January 2026

 -

 Time: 10:30 AM – 12:30 PM

 -

 Venue: Anna Auditorium

 -

 Chief Guest: Tmt. Subbulaxmi, IAS, District Collector, Vellore

Drug abuse and substance misuse can affect individuals across all sections

of society. Awareness, early identification, and timely intervention play a

crucial role in prevention. This session will provide practical insights

into understanding the risks of substance abuse, recognizing early warning

signs, resisting peer pressure, and making responsible choices for a safe

and healthy life.

As part of the programme, a skit on drug abuse will be performed by the

students of Ethiraj School, Sathuvachari, followed by an expert talk on

drug awareness by Ms. Priyanka Kalaiselvan, Clinical Psychologist.

All are cordially invited to attend and actively participate in this

meaningful session.

subject: Online Info Session on Pécs Summer School 2026 – Affordable Study Abroad in Hungary - January 29 Thursday, 18.00 PM CET
body:
Dear Student,

Would you like to earn credits, explore Central Europe, and make

friends from around the world next summer?

Join our online info session and learn all about the Pécs Summer School

2026 programs at the University of Pécs, Hungary – one of Central

Europe’s most welcoming university cities, full of culture, history, and

vibrant student life!

 - Date: Thursday, January 29

 - Time: 18:00 Central European Time (CET) 

 - Format: Online via Microsoft Teams

Register for the session: https://forms.gle/dUDcesTqsHyZaonr7

https://forms.gle/dUDcesTqsHyZaonr7

During the session, you will hear about:

 - Academic programs and ECTS credits

 - Program fees and accommodation

 - Exciting cultural and social events that make the experience

 unforgettable

Pécs Summer School 2026 Programs:

Two-week programs | July 4–18, 2026 | 6 ECTS credits each | €1,050–€1,450

 1. European Studies Summer School (1,050 EUR)

 Explore the political, cultural, and social achievements of Europe

 through engaging lectures on art, gastronomy, migration, and diversity.

 2. Leadership Skills Summer School (1,050 EUR)

 Develop essential leadership, communication, and teamwork skills to

 become an effective and confident leader.

 3. Sustainability – Social Ecology (1,050 EUR)

 Combine theory and practice as you engage with local NGOs on

 sustainability and inclusion projects.

 4. International Human Rights Law (1,450 EUR)

 Gain insight into major international human rights issues, EU human

 rights law, and humanitarian protection.

 (Open only to Law students.)

 5. Debate Academy (July 19 – August 2, 1,050 EUR)

 Strengthen your critical thinking and public speaking in this hands-on,

 international debate program.

Four-week Combined Programs | July 5 – August 2, 2026

Combine any of the above with the Debate Academy for a four-week

experience and double your learning and intercultural exposure:

 - European Studies + Debate Academy (2,100 EUR)

 - Leadership Skills + Debate Academy (2,100 EUR)

 - Sustainability + Debate Academy (2,100 EUR)

 - International Human Rights Law + Debate Academy (2,500 EUR)

Program fees include:

✔ Tuition and materials

✔ Dormitory accommodation

✔ Lunch on teaching days + two dinners per week

✔ Cultural and social programs: sightseeing, Intercultural Evening, Quiz

Night, wine tasting, dragon boat race, darts contest, pool party, museum

visits

Why you should choose our Summer Schools:

 - Earn up to 12 ECTS credits

 - Join students from 40+ countries

 - Experience affordable, high-quality education in Europe’s hidden gem

Watch our 2025 highlights: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RPfokv5CvEQ

Visit our website: https://summerschool.pte.hu/

Follow us on Instagram: @pecssummerschool

The Pécs Summer School Program was founded in 2016 with the aim of

organizing an increasing number of summer schools each year. In 2026, we

are planning to host 150 students from all across the world, studying a

wide range of disciplines in our two- and four-week summer programs.

Participants will attend very enjoyable social and cultural programs

together, offering a unique intercultural student experience in one of

Central Europe’s most beautiful cities, the 2,000-year-old city of Pécs.

We look forward to welcoming you online on January 29 — and hopefully to

Pécs this summer!

 Best Regards,

R Seenivasan

subject: Final Call for Papers - International Conference on Recent Advances in Industrial and Systems Engineering (RAISE) 2023 - reg.
body:
Dear Colleagues, Scholars and Students

Greetings!

The School of Mechanical Engineering, Vellore Institute of Technology,

Vellore is hosting the International Conference on Recent Advances in

Industrial and Systems Engineering (RAISE 2023) in collaboration with

the Institute

of Industrial and Systems Engineers (USA), Royal Academy of Engineering

(UK), Oklahoma State University (USA), Northern Illinois University (USA),

Cranfield University (UK), University of Sussex (UK), and University of

Derby (UK) from 20 to 22 December 2023.

The conference will provide an excellent platform for knowledge exchange

between researchers working in the areas of Digitalization and

Sustainability Challenges in Resilient Manufacturing and Service

Operations. Prospective authors are invited to submit a full paper (not

exceeding 10 pages).

Call for Papers:Authors are invited to submit original, unpublished

papers. Topics include but are not limited to:

· Resilient manufacturing and service operations.

· Digitalization and resilient in manufacturing operations.

· Digitalization and resilient service operations.

· Sustainable manufacturing and service systems.

(For a complete list of topics please refer to the conference website)

Conference Proceedings

Springer Proceedings:

Accepted papers of RAISE 2023 will be published as a book volume in the

Lecture Notes in Multidisciplinary Industrial Engineering series by

Springer Nature (https://www.springer.com/series/15734).

Proceedings with ISBN:

We would like to inform the authors that the approval of your manuscript

for publication in Springer Proceedings will depend on the selection

process by Springer. Kindly note that Springer may exercise additional

quality control of the manuscript as it may decide at its sole discretion. If

your paper is not considered by Springer to publish in Lecture Notes on

Multidisciplinary Industrial Engineering, it will be published in a

Proceeding with ISBN number with no additional cost.

Special Issues in the Scopus/SCIE/ESCI indexed Journals

Quality manuscripts presented at the conference will be short-listed for

consideration for publication in the Special Issues of International

Journals. This is a post-conference activity, and the short-listed authors

will be invited to submit the extended and revised version of their

manuscript. The manuscripts are handled by guest editors from the

initiation of the review process until the final decision. The details

about the level of revision expected and the timeline for the Special Issue

publication will be provided in the invitation letter. The list of Journals

for which the special issue approvals are obtained is made available in the

‘Publication’ sub-menu under the ‘Submission’ menu of the conference

webpage.

Conference Website :

https://vit.ac.in/RAISE2023/

Paper submission link :

https://easychair.org/my/conference?conf=raise20230

Contact us at email : raise@vit.ac.in

Important Dates:Full Paper submission Due : 30

November 2023

Paper acceptance notification : 07 December 2023

Final paper submission due : 10 December 2023

Registration due : 10 December 2023

Kindly circulate the mail to your peers as well.

Thank you

Finance Hackathon, held as part of Techkriti ’25 at IIT Kanpur in

collaboration with the National Financial Reporting Authority (NFRA),

subject: Congratulations to VIT RoboVITics for Achievement at NeuroHack – Shaastra 2026 | IIT Madras
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that one of the teams of VIT RoboVITics, Team

NeuroVITix, has secured First Place at NeuroHack, conducted on 6th January

2026 as part of Shaastra 2026, the annual technical festival of the Indian

Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras.

During the hackathon, the team worked on applying AI/ML techniques to EEG

datasets to accurately classify human emotions, showcasing strong

technical expertise, innovation, and collaborative problem-solving skills.

Their exceptional performance enabled them to emerge as winners among

strong national-level competition.

Team Members (RoboVITics – Team NeuroVITix):

1. Tharun J – 24BME0044

2. Dhruv Kamboj – 24BIT0290

3. Aarushi Jha – 24BCB0025

4. Avaram Mahmood Ul Hasan – 24BAI0210

We express our sincere appreciation to the Faculty Coordinators —Dr. G.

Kalaiarassan (Emp.ID: 14035), Dr. Abraham Sampson (Emp ID: 15484), Dr.

Radhakrishnan Delhibabu (Emp ID: 15251), and Dr. Brisilla M.(Emp

ID: 15387), for their continuous guidance, encouragement, and unwavering

support, which greatly contributed to the team’s success.

Congratulations to VIT RoboVITics and Team NeuroVITix on this

remarkable achievement.

subject: 6th March - Quality Week: Special Events by Clubs & Chapters - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students' Welfare presents Special Events by Clubs & Chapters

as part of Quality Week Celebrations.

Quiz Quest

IEEE COMSOC proudly presents Quiz Quest - Unlocking Your Competitive Edge

Week! Prepare to embark on a journey of self-discovery and skill

enhancement as we delve into the realm of competitiveness in academia and

beyond. Whether you're a seasoned academician or just starting your

journey, this event offers valuable opportunities to maximize your

potential and drive personal and institutional growth. Join us as we pave

the way for a future of excellence!

Date: 06.03.2024

Time: 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM

Venue: CS Hall

Verbal Victory

Join us for an exhilarating intellectual showdown at our debate

competition, where participants will engage in dynamic discussions on the

topic of realising one's competitive potential. Participants will explore

various strategies, challenges and opportunities associated with unlocking

one's competitive edge within a specified time frame. Speakers will delve

into the psychology of competition. Whether you're a seasoned debater, a

curious observer, or someone seeking inspiration to unlock your own

potential, this event promises to offer valuable insights and

thought-provoking discussion!!! Participants will draw upon real-world

examples and personal experiences to illustrate their view points.

Date: 06.03.2024

Time: 03:00 PM to 05:00 PM

Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium

Note Nirvana

Note Nirvana, a quality week event hosted in collaboration with Dance Club,

SPIC-MACAY and VIT Music Club promises to engage the audience through the

beauty of the performing arts. Embrace the profound theme of 'Realizing

your Competitive Potential' as the VIT Dance Club graces the dance floor

with their presence. This event promises an unparalleled blend of elegance

and enlightenment. Embark on a rhythmic journey with SPIC MACAY - VIT,

which promises to transport you through time, showcasing India's diverse

dance traditions while embracing the theme of "realising your competitive

potential". Witness the blending of grace, energy, and the fluidity of

classical dances.

Date: 06.03.2024

Time: 06:00 PM to 07:30 PM

Venue: Greenos - Foodys

body:
Attention : All Pre-final UG/Pre-final year M.Tech (Integrated) / First

year PG Students

Pleased to share with you details of the 2025 round of The Australian

National University (ANU) Future Research Talent (FRT)

https://science.anu.edu.au/study/scholarships/future-research-talent-awards-india

 program.

The Future Research Talent (FRT) awards are jointly offered by ANU College

of Science and Medicine, ANU College of Systems and Society and ANU College

of Law, Governance and Policy to exceptional students from India.

The FRT is a competitive and prestigious program that attracts the very

best international students from high-quality Indian institutions and

provides them exposure to ANU research in the Sciences, Technology,

Engineering, Mathematics, and Medical research disciplines. The program

offers a valuable opportunity for India’s emerging research talent to form

international linkages and develop research skills at one of the world's

leading universities (ANU is ranked #30 in the world in QS World

University Rankings 2025).

The program will provide an opportunity to travel to ANU in 2025 to pursue

collaborative research projects. Each FRT scholar will receive AUD$8,500 to

support their travel to Canberra, Australia and cover living costs.

Interested students are requested to fill out the form

https://tinyurl.com/a77t5tku on or before 17.01.2025.

program and that ANU academic staff should not be contacted during the

application process.
