subject: Congratulations to TFAC for their Achievement at Mood Indigo 2025 – IIT Bombay
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team Shapeshifters from The Fine Arts Club

(TFAC) secured Second Place in the “Turn It Into Art” (Junk to Art)

competition at Mood Indigo 2025, the prestigious cultural festival of IIT

Bombay held from 15th to 18th December 2025. The competition challenged

participants to transform discarded materials into meaningful works of art,

and the team’s creativity, innovation, and artistic vision earned them

recognition at a national level.

Team Members

1. Suryansh Saraswat – 23BBS0084

2. Ashish Umesh Rekha – 24BME0209

3. Arwaz Mughal – 24BME0520

4. Nallapareddy Rishva Reddy – 24BDE0090

We extend our sincere appreciation to the Faculty Coordinator Dr. Pradheep

T (Emp ID: 15226) for his continuous guidance and support throughout the

preparation and participation in the event.

Congratulations to The Fine Arts Club (TFAC) and Team Shapeshifters for

this commendable achievement and for bringing laurels to VIT.

subject: Loire Valley Summer School - From June 22 to July 10, 2026 - University of Tours (France) - Application deadline extended !
body:
Dear Students,

The Office of International Relations is pleased to announce that University

of Tours 1st summer school is now open to all its partners!

The "Loire Valley Summer School" will take place from June 22 to July 10,

2026, in Tours (France). 

Students will have the opportunity to take part in an ambitious summer

program in France combining

1 core curriculum + 1 academic track up to choice.

------------------------------

Core curriculum = French language & culture (45h) 

+

 Track 1 : French cinema and/in the world (36h) 

 OR 

Track 2: Sustainable & Eco-responsible management (36h)

------------------------------

This innovative 3-weeks program is designed for students with a B1 or B2

level in French (in accordance with the CEFR

https://europass.europa.eu/en/what-common-european-framework-languages-cefr

).

It includes:

 - 81 hours of classes (45h French Language&Culture + 36h disciplinary

 track)

 - Practical workshops and field visits

 - Cultural excursions to discover Touraine and the Loire Valley

Participants will receive a certificate of participation at the end of the

program and a recognition of 3 ECTS credits is possible.

The application deadline has been extended until May 11th !

Find all about practical information and registration on this webpage

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/short-programs/loire-valley-summer-school-2026.

Here is a direct link for students to apply: REGISTER NOW

https://forms.office.com/e/ucW5cAsSP1

For any information about this summer program, please do not hesitate to

contact : summer-school@univ-tours.fr

subject: Yantra'25 - Winners Announcement-reg
body:
Dear VITians,

We are thrilled to celebrate the grand success of Yantra’25 - A week of

Technical Innovation, the 5th edition of VIT’s flagship techno-event, held

under the vibrant banner of VIT’s 40th year of excellence. This week-long

festival of innovation witnessed participation from students, bringing

together bright minds across disciplines to engage in cutting-edge

workshops, technical talks, hackathons, and competitions.

At the heart of Yantra'25 was Central Hack—VIT’s biggest and most

prestigious hackathon, where students collaborated to develop

interdisciplinary solutions addressing real-world challenges. This year’s

theme, AI for Sustainable Development Goals, provided a platform for young

innovators to craft impactful solutions that align with global economic,

social, and environmental progress.

We are delighted to announce the winners of all the events, and their

details are available in the attachment.

Checkout the results at yantra.swvit.in

Congratulations to all participants and winners for making Yantra’25 a

resounding success! Your passion, creativity, and dedication have truly

embodied the spirit of technological excellence and collaboration.

For any queries or clarifications, feel free to reach out to us at

yantra.sw@vit.ac.in.

body:
VIT faculty and Students,

We invite you all to the Faculty and Student Interactive Session "Learning

by Doing" , by Dr Manish Jain , Professor,IIT Gandhinagar.

Topic: Learning by Doing - Transistor to Transformation

Date: 07/11/2025( FRIDAY)

Time: 10.00AM to 01.00PM

Venue : Gallery I

OD will be given to all the students who attended.

These are the highlights of the talk.

Inspiring NextGen Hardware Innovators: Project Madhava: From Transistor to

Transformation

Along with cutting-edge semiconductor chips, the most significant strategic

vulnerability and possibly a largest market opportunity in India —lies in

the high-volume, low-margin (HVLM) chips that power 99% of everyday

electronics. True self-reliance (Atmanirbhar Bharat) will be achieved by

winning this foundational market, but we face a critical bottleneck: a

systemic failure in our educational pipeline. We are producing graduates

who are rich in theory but poor in the practical, hands-on skills required

to design, test, and build the hardware that startups need to innovate.

This talk outlines a scalable, "learning by doing" framework designed to

solve this talent gap at its root, building an 'army of creators' for the

HVLM ecosystem.

Having implemented a 8 Bit RISC processor (with 23 7400 IC's), multipliers,

Tetris with Indigenous VEGA processor, Center for Creative Learning

IITGandhinagar, is designing Hands-on Hardware program at scale (1L

students) for High Schools and Colleges called Project Madhava. Using CCL

designed Courses, Kits, Video, Workshops, students will get their hands

dirty making their own clocks, calculators, displays,

microprocessors/controllers and products they see in daily life.

In the talk professor will share learnings from running one of India's

largest STEM lab and program India, sending its STEM content to 200,000

schools , working with over 6L subscribers and 11CR views, via hugely

popular online programs 3030 EKLAVYA and Curiosity.

Dear Students,

This is for your information.

 -------------------

Greetings from EducationUSA@USIEF, Chennai!

We invite your students to attend the 2023 EducationUSA 'Study in the

U.S.' University Fair to be held on Saturday, September 2, 2023, from

12.15 p.m. - 5 p.m. at Hyatt Regency, Teynampet, Chennai. Entry is FREE!

save time at the time of entry.

The fair will provide a unique opportunity for students to connect with

representatives from 29 accredited U.S. colleges and universities and

explore different academic options in the United States. Participants will

gain valuable information about academic requirements, campus life,

financial aid options, application procedures, and student visa

information.

Highlights of the fair:

· Meet U.S. university representatives directly and get your

questions answered.

· Interact with EducationUSA India advisers on the U.S.

university application process.

· Attend useful and engaging sessions on various aspects of the

application, admissions, and student visa process.

EducationUSA is a U.S. Department of State network and the official source

of information on U.S. higher education.

subject: Live Project to Learn & Upskill in Machine Learning (ML)
body:
Dear VIT students,

Finlatics is pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Machine Learning program, an online live project that helps students learn and gain experience in using machine learning algorithms.

Along with the Vellore Institute of Technology, this project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, IIM Bangalore and BITS Pilani, among others.

It was curated at the prestigious Atal Incubation Centre, supported by the Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, and the Government of India.

STRUCTURE of the live project:

1. Learn the core concepts around Machine Learning algorithms

2. Become proficient in using the Google Colab Notebook for machine learning

3. Engage in data preprocessing - a critical activity to prepare data sets for building machine learning algorithms

4. Gain an understanding of supervised and unsupervisedmachine learning algorithms using Python libraries

5. Complete an industry-specific case project to understand the application of Machine Learning in business scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Proficiency in Machine Learning

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch with them:

https://82e6v.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSlPYaV0LcO3ykXyRn8u/8TKaWGJVcCd5

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in the program. The program will impart all necessary training on Python and machine learning techniques.

Project Duration: 1 month /2 months (on student choice)

Project Start: Flexible start date option. Students can choose to start the project post-exams.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments. They can also take an extension on the project.

If selected, the project has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 2999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 25% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technology students on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 2199 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply using the link above.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

The fund is presently waiting in the Government Account named CBN/FGN INDEPENDENT REVENUE account number 400-939134 with J.P.MORGAN CHASE BANK,New York.You can do your independent verification of this. subject: Exclusive "Virtual Awareness Session" on the “Bridging Healthcare & Technology: Inside the DAIHS Master Journey”
body:
Dear All,

You are invited to attend an Exclusive "Virtual Awareness Session" on the

“Bridging Healthcare & Technology: Inside the DAIHS Master Journey”

The Indo-Italian Chamber of Commerce and Industry (IICCI), through

its Minerva

EduHub, is delighted to invite you to an exclusive "Virtual Awareness

Session" on the “Bridging Healthcare & Technology: Inside the DAIHS

Master Journey”

This unique 2-year Master’s degree is a Joint Program delivered by two

European giants:

 -

 Humanitas University (Renowned for Clinical Sciences & Research)

 -

 Bocconi University (World leader in Data Science, AI, and Economics)

Why attend this session?

Led by Associate Professor Mr Massimiliano Greco and Ms Serena

Monteforte, this webinar will explore how this program sits at the

intersection of healthcare, big data, and artificial intelligence -

equipping you with the skills to solve complex medical challenges.

We will cover:

 -

 The Curriculum: Merging medical knowledge with advanced data analytics

 and machine learning.

 -

 Real-World Application: How AI is reshaping diagnostics, personalised

 medicine, and patient care.

 -

 Admissions 2026: Entry requirements, eligibility, and scholarship

 opportunities.

 -

 Global Career Prospects: The surging global demand for health-data

 scientists.

 -

 Scholarship opportunities: for international students

The session will conclude with an interactive Q&A, allowing you to ask

questions directly to the university representatives.

—————————————————————

🎓 Session led by:

Mr. Massimiliano Greco (Associate Professor)

Ms. Serena Monteforte (Student Recruiting, Humanitas University)

You will have the opportunity to engage in an interactive Q&A session with

the speakers.

Online Session

https://zfrmz.in/ygeE19D8MnN18AeK7wPY

decade of medical innovation.

body:
Dear VITians,

"When the scarlet cardinal tellsHer dream to the dragonfly,And the lazy

breeze makes a nest in the trees,And murmurs a lullaby,"It is July."

-Susan Hartley Swett

July marked the beginning of a new semester and the arrival of freshers on

campus. We would first like to extend our heartiest welcome to all the

freshers and fervently hope that they have a fulfilling college experience.

This month, the Office of Students' Welfare conducted 115+ events across

the literary, cultural, technical, social outreach and wellness categories.

Kalakam, a play about the Vellore Sepoy Mutiny was staged by VIT Dramatics

to mark the Vellore Sepoy Mutiny in 1806.

To emphasise the importance of taking care of mental health, Kokoro, a

five-day session in mental health awareness was conducted by the Office of

Students' Welfare from 4th July 2033-8th July 2023. It emphasised on

understanding one's thoughts and staying happy. Staying true to its vibrant

culture of student activities on campus, the office also organised a

special performance by the music band, Butter Biscuits from Chennai on 29th

July 2023. It was a multilingual musical fiesta and Funk Fiesta, a dance

workshop on 30th July 2023.

subject: Congratulations to Parnika Prakash for National-Level Literary Achievement at Crooked Lines Literary Festival | Delhi
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Parnika Prakash (24BBT0242) has achieved a

notable literary milestone at the national level Competition.

Parnika’s short story titled “My Therapist” was shortlisted and awarded

as one of the Top Ten Stories at the Crooked Lines Literary Festival, a

national-level literature festival held on 14th and 15th November 2025 at Shiv

Nadar University (SNU), Delhi NCR.

The Crooked Lines Literary Festival is a reputed platform that celebrates

emerging voices in literature, and Parnika’s work stood out among numerous

entries from participants across the country. This recognition reflects her

creativity, narrative skill, and literary excellence.

We congratulate Parnika Prakash on this commendable achievement and

appreciate her efforts in bringing recognition to our institution at a

prestigious national literary forum.

discussions and interactive activities, participants will learn to

recognize signs, challenge misconceptions, and foster empathy toward those

subject: Fwd: Invitation for the Demonstration of Leica BLK 360 G2 Laser Scanner
body:
Dear Members of the VIT Community,

The School of Civil Engineering is pleased to announce the addition of

the Leica BLK 360 G2 Laser Scanner to our Digital Construction Lab.

The Leica BLK 360 G2 is a state-of-the-art imaging laser scanner designed

for exceptional speed and precision. Its high-speed data capturing

capabilities represent a significant advancement in digital twin creation

and spatial documentation. This cutting-edge technology enables highly

accurate 3D reality capture, supporting advanced research, design, and

analysis workflows.

The system has diverse applications across multiple domains, including:

 - Heritage Preservation

 - Construction Progress Monitoring

 - Topographic Surveying

 - Industrial Facility Management

 - Media Production

 - VR/AR Development

A technical demonstration will be conducted by an expert to showcase the

instrument’s capabilities, workflows, and practical applications.

Event Details:

Date: 19.02.2026

 Time: 10:30 am

 Venue: Advanced Strength of Materials Laboratory (CTS building; opp to

CS hall)

We warmly welcome all interested faculty members, research scholars, and

students to attend this session and explore how this advanced technology

can support your research, consultancy, and project work.

We look forward to your participation.

Thank You

With Regards,

Dr. M. P. Saravanakumar

Professor & Dean

>

subject: Invitation – One Day Workshop on "Build your First Quantum Algorithms: Hands-On with QFT, QML and QNN" (8th May 2026) - Reg.
body:
Dear Students,

We are pleased to invite faculty members, research scholars, and students

to participate in a One Day Workshop titled “Build your First Quantum

Algorithms: Hands-On with QFT, QML and QNN” to be held on 8th May 2026

at VIT, Vellore.

This workshop delivers hands-on training in the mathematical and conceptual

foundations of quantum computing.The program also introduces Quantum

Algorithms, Quantum Machine Learning (QML), Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs),

enabling learners to design simple models for basic learning tasks. By

combining theory with practical implementation, this workshop equips

researchers, developers, and enthusiasts with the skills needed to

effectively work with quantum programming tools and simulators.

Please find the workshop details below:

 - Workshop Title: Build your First Quantum Algorithms: Hands-On with

 QFT, QML and QNN

 - Date: 8th May 2026

 - Duration: 1 Day

 - Mode: Hybrid

 - Offline at SJT 517, VIT Vellore for internal participants

 - Online for external participants

 - Timing: 09:30 AM – 05:00 PM

 - Registration Fee: ₹295 (Inclusive of GST)

 - Registration Link: https://events.vit.ac.in/

The workshop brochure is attached for your reference. We kindly request you

to encourage interested faculty members, research scholars, and students to

participate in the workshop.

We look forward to your participation and support.

With Regards,

Dr. N. Jaisankar, B.E., M.E., Ph.D

subject: Study and Research at UNAERP, Brazil • 2026/2027
body:
Kind Attention: Prefinal and Final year students!!

 UNAERP – University of Ribeirão Preto, Brazil invites applications

from international

students interested in studying at UNAERP in 2026-1:

The application deadline for

 - 1st Semester 2026 (February–June): Deadline October 31, 2025

 - 2nd Semester 2026 (August–December): Deadline May 30, 2026

Nomination & Application Procedures 

1. Partner institutions should nominate students by email to

intercambio@unaerp.br, including:

 - Full name

 - Email address

 - Current program of study at the home institution

2. Nominated students must:

 - Read the Application Guide

 https://unaerp.br/doclink/unaerp-application-guide-2026-2027/eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJzdWIiOiJ1bmFlcnAtYXBwbGljYXRpb24tZ3VpZGUtMjAyNi0yMDI3IiwiaWF0IjoxNzU2NDc5MDc5LCJleHAiOjE3NTY1NjU0Nzl9.D95mn_BSK4iHqGQ3cPKnw6ImSu7XEzYUNFzFFa-eIE4

 - Complete the Online Application Form

 https://forms.gle/xcHJC9YreagCQVKq7

 - Submit to intercambio@unaerp.br their Updated Academic Transcript by

 the deadlines above

Academic Programs 

International students may apply for:

 - Undergraduate Programs: Human Sciences, Health Sciences, Engineering

 https://unaerp.br/cursos/graduacao-presencial

 - Graduate Research Programs: Master’s and Doctorate

 https://unaerp.br/como-ingressar/veja-como-ingressar-em/mestrados-e-doutorados

 - Internship and Research Opportunities (contact us for more info)

Courses in Foreign Languages

For the 1st semester of 2026 (Feb-June), the following courses will be

offered:

· International Politics

· Democracy between consolidations and crisis

· International Management

· Portuguese for Foreigners - Basic Level

Additionally, selected Architecture & Urbanism and Business Administration

courses are “language-friendly,” with content taught in Portuguese but

support materials and assessments available in English/Spanish. Please,

write to intercambio@unaerp.br for more info.

A minimum number of students is required for the courses in foreign

languages to be offered. Classes will be confirmed in February 2026 when

the enrollment period for national students opens. If the minimum number of

registered students is not reached, international students will need to

choose only courses taught in Portuguese. Therefore, students should be

aware that it may be necessary to proceed only with courses in Portuguese

or a mix of courses in Portuguese and the English classes that have been

opened.

Campus Life & Student Integration

UNAERP offers several programs to support international students, including:

· Buddy Program

· Housing Program (assistance finding accommodation)

· Free Portuguese Language Classes

· Free access to sports activities and gym

· Cultural and social integration activities

Click here to explore their well-being and integration programs.

https://unaerp.br/study-at-unaerp/international-students-wellbeing

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s 17th October 

events.

Today's Events:

· Git Essentials

· Hashing Unlocked

· Say No to Crackers

Scroll down for more details

The Institution of Engineers and Technology

Event Name: Git Essentials

Event Time: 02:00 PM - 04:00 PM

Event Description: Get ready to dive into Git and GitHub, essential tools

for coding and collaboration! Whether you're just starting out or aiming to

make your first open-source contribution, this session will provide

valuable insights on managing your code, exploring branching, commits, pull

requests and more. Additionally, we'll guide you on how to contribute to

Hacktoberfest. Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to learn!

Venue: SJT 107

Registration: VTOP

Instagram : https://www.instagram.com/ietvit

IEEE TEMS

Event Name: Hashing Unlocked

Event Time: 09:00 PM - 11:30 PM

Event Description: As part of DSA Week, Hashing Unlocked is the second

event in IEEE TEMS’ week-long initiative designed to help students

strengthen their command over core Data Structures and Algorithms through

engaging problem-solving challenges. This session dives deep into the

concept of hashing—one of the most powerful tools for optimizing searches,

detecting duplicates, and managing data efficiently.

Participants will face a series of carefully curated problems that test

their understanding of hash-based logic, collision handling, and efficient

lookups. The event aims to help students grasp how hashing underpins

various algorithms and real-world systems, reinforcing their ability to

apply it confidently in competitive programming and interviews.

Venue: UNSTOP

Registration: VTOP

Unstop Link:

https://unstop.com/o/LfPFZiY?lb=Qvev5puv&utm_medium=Share&utm_source=IEEE-TEMS&utm_campaign=Online_coding_challenge

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/ieeetemsvit/

Natures Lovers' Club

Event Name: Say No to Crackers

Event Time: 10:00 AM - 06:00 PM

Event Description: Nature Lovers' Club presents 'Say No to Crackers', an

awareness program highlighting the harmful effects of firecrackers on

health and the environment. The event promotes eco-friendly celebrations,

encouraging students to embrace a safer, cleaner, and more sustainable

Diwali.

Venue: Woodys Pathway (Offline)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/natureclubvit?igsh=c2IybmFoNXJ3dHIz

subject: ICNAN 2025 Conference - Registration Fee Discount for VITians
body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Warm Greetings from the Centre for Nanotechnology Research, VIT, India.

We are pleased to inform you that the Centre for Nanotechnology Research,

VIT, is organising one of the premier events, the “3rd International

Conference on Nanoscience and Nanotechnology – ICNAN 2025,” from December

16 to 19, 2025. (https://icnan.vit.ac.in/)

 Based on various requests from VITians, we are glad to announce a

discounted registration fee for Students/Research scholars (INR 5000) and

faculty members (INR 7000).

To avail this special discount, please use the following link for

registration and payment.

 https://events.vit.ac.in/events/ICNANV (This link is applicable only for

VITians).

Nobel Laureate Dr.Moungi Bawendi, MIT, USA, will be inaugurating the event,

and more than 800 Material Scientists will be participating.

ICNAN-2025 aims to bring together the Indian and International communities

(students, scientists, engineers, and stakeholders from academia,

government laboratories, industry, and other organisations) working in the

field of Nanoscale science and technology to discuss new and exciting

advances in the field. The conference covers a broad theme in this area to

accommodate a wide range of interests and to facilitate interdisciplinary

collaboration/interaction in both academia and industry. The conference

will also provide an ideal environment to develop new collaborations and

opportunities to meet the experts working in various areas of this field.

Many senior experts, academicians from the US, Europe and Asian

Universities, including a Nobel Laureate and academicians/ researchers from

premier Indian Universities, have agreed to attend this conference and will

be giving special lectures in the following areas:

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [17th February] 

events.

· Init with CSI: Neural Networks 101

· SAE- Lights Out

· ELA101

· Basics of Asset Creation

· ElectroSpark

· Punarnavam

· Catalyse Connect

Scroll down for more details

CSI-VIT

Event Name: Init with CSI: Neural Networks 101

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 3:00 PM

Event Description: Join Init with CSI: Neural Networks 101, a hands-on

workshop demystifying Machine Learning! Dive into ML with code-along

projects and expert guidance on Kaggle, Colab, and Hugging Face. Build a

handwritten digit recognizer while mastering perceptrons, backpropagation,

and optimization. Whether you're a beginner or experienced, gain a new

perspective and apply ML to real-world problems!

Venue: VOC Gallery,TT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link:

https://www.instagram.com/csivitu?igsh=MXI2cnRreG5ibGJ1dw%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

SAE-VIT

Event Name: SAE- Lights Out

Event Time: 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Event Description: SAE-VIT is all about building a strong community, and we

are excited to welcome our juniors to an interactive session! This is your

chance to get insights into how SAE works, meet our board members, and

connect with your fellow junior core members. Don't miss out on this

opportunity to learn, network, and be a part of something bigger! See you

on Monday,17th February from 3pm to 6pm at Ambedkar auditorium.

Venue: Ambedkar Auditorium, TT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/sae_vit?igsh=dnJ2eG5pNWt4YnMz

ELA-VIT

Event Name: ELA 101

Event Time: 3:00 PM – 6:00 PM

Event Description: A session that showcases the various literary and

oratory events of ELA and also serves as a formal introduction to the

members of the club.

Venue: Homi Bhabha Gallery

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/elaavit?igsh=OGRkY2pkZjAzanAz

Technology and Gaming Club

Event Name: Basics of Asset Creation

Event Time: 2:30 PM – 5:30 PM

Event Description: TAG Club will be hosting a asset creation and design.

Whether you're just starting out or looking to refine your workflow, this

session will give you the key principles needed to create high-quality

assets that elevate your projects.

Venue: Shakespeare Gallery, TT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/tagclub.vit/?hl=en

TEC-VIT

Event Name: ElectroSpark

Event Time: 2:00 PM – 5:00 PM

Event Description: Electrospark – Ignite Your Passion for Electronics!

Curious about electronics and innovation? Whether you're just starting or

want to sharpen your skills, Electrospark is the perfect place to begin!

Dive into the world of circuits, explore essential components, and bring

your ideas to life with hands-on learning. Join us for an exciting session

where creativity meets technology—let’s spark something amazing together!

Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/tec.vit/?hl=en

MLA

Event Name: Punarnavam

Event Time: 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM

Event Description: Punarnavam is a dynamic Malayalam creative speaking

event with two rounds that test participants’ vocabulary, fluency and

diction. It features spontaneous challenges and interactive games,

providing an exciting platform for participants to showcase their language

skills and bond with others.

Venue: VOC Gallery, TT

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/mla_oruma/

SBE-VIT

Event Name: Catalyse Connect

Event Time: 4:30 PM – 7:00 PM

initiative designed to introduce students to the crucial role of enzymes in

vaccine development and their medical benefits. Through interactive

lectures, hands-on demonstrations, and discussions with experts, students

will explore how enzymology contributes to the effectiveness, stability,

subject: Deadline to Apply in Machine Learning using Python
body:
Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

As today, 11:59pm is the deadline to apply for the Machine Learning Program, please note:-

1. In case you have any upcoming assignment, examination, or personal commitment, you will have the option to pick a project start date that is after the completion of the same, to help the project fit in with your schedule.

2. You will be allowed a break during the project tenure, for any academic or personal commitment. You would also be allowed a Project Extension of an additional month.

3. No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of the program as training and mentorship will be provided.

4. You can go over project details using the copy of the mail below and can apply for the project using the following link :

https://www.finlatics.com/ml_application?src=vitvd

5. The Project Duration is: 1 month / 2 months (based on selected student choice) and the Time commitment required for the project is 2-4 hrs per week.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs.1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of technology students on the above mentioned minimal induction fee.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply before tonight's deadline.

Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Machine Learning program, an online live project that helps students learn and gain experience in using machine learning algorithms at Vellore Institute of Technology.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Learn the core concepts around Machine Learning algorithms

2. Become proficient in using the Google Colab Notebook for machine learning

3. Engage in data pre-processing - a critical activity to prepare data sets for building machine learning algorithms

4. Gain an understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Python libraries

5. Complete an industry-specific case project to understand the application of Machine Learning in business scenarios

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Proficiency in Machine Learning

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch:

https://www.finlatics.com/ml_application?src=vitv

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in the program. The program will impart all necessary training on Python and machine learning techniques.

Project Duration: 1 month / 2 months (on student choice)

Time Commitment: 3-4 hours per week.

Project Start: Flexible start date option on selected student choice.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

If selected, the project has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technology on the above mentioned minimal induction fee.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

subject: Wishing you all a happy Lohri, Pongal, Makar Sankranti, and Magh Bihu!
body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare wishes you all a Happy Lohri, Pongal, Makar

Sankranti, and Magh Bihu!

Lohri, Pongal, Makar Sankranti and Bihu are festivals that represent

different cultures but unite under one country – India. All the festivals

are loosely related to one single premise – crops, but vary depending on

the part of the country it is celebrated in. Let’s look at each of these

four festivals that people celebrate together.

Pongal, the four-day harvest festival celebrated in South India, especially

Tamil Nadu, will be celebrated with great enthusiasm from January 15-18

this year. Celebrated in mid-January every year, it also marks the

beginning of Uttarayan- the sun's journey towards the north and the end of

the winter season.

A large bonfire with people dancing, singing, and having a good time is

what contains the essence of this festival. Lohri is celebrated a day

before Makar Sankranti and is primarily celebrated in North India,

especially in the agricultural state of Punjab. It marks the end of the

sowing season. Delicacies and snacks, for example, Rewri, Peanuts, Sarson

Ka Saag, Makke Ki Roti, etc., are enjoyed with full vigor.

Makar Sankranti follows Lohri by a day and is a popular festival in most

parts of the country, but the festivity is at its prime, mainly in North

India. The festival marks the advent of the harvest season and also

signifies the end of Winter as the days start getting longer. Many people

dip in the sacred waters of the Ganga and offer their prayers to the Sun.

In many parts of North India, kites take over the skies, and delicious

sweets such as Til Ke Laddoo are enjoyed.

The same spirit and the same premise, when it travels all the way to North

East India, takes the shape of Magh Bihu. The end of the harvest season is

what the festival represents. Traditional dance, traditional games, and

activities such as Cooking in Meji (Bamboo Huts) define the festival in the

state of Assam.

subject: Annual Interdisciplinary Student Research Conference (AUI-AISRC) 2026-Al Akhawayn University in Ifrane (AUI), Morocco,
body:
Dear Students,

Following the success of its inaugural edition, our partner institution,

Al Akhawayn University in Ifrane (AUI), Morocco, is pleased to announce

the second edition of the Annual Interdisciplinary Student Research

Conference (AUI-AISRC).

The conference is organized by STTAR (Student Think Tank and Research) and

aims to provide a dynamic platform for academic exchange and collaboration

among students and faculty across disciplines.

Call for Participation

Students are invited to submit abstracts and participate in this

prestigious international conference, which promotes research, innovation,

and scholarly dialogue.

Why You Should Participate

 - Interdisciplinary Platform: Open to all fields including Social

 Sciences, Humanities, STEM, Law, Business, and Medicine.

 - Multilingual Presentations: Present your research in English,

 French, Arabic, Tamazight, or Darija.

 - Publication Opportunity: Selected papers may be published in

 ISBN-registered conference proceedings or considered for international

 journal special issues.

 - Global Exposure: Engage with undergraduate, postgraduate, PhD

 scholars, and faculty members from around the world.

Key Details

 - Conference Dates: 19–21 June 2026

 - Abstract Submission Deadline: 15 April 2026

 - Abstract Length: 250–400 words

 - Accommodation: On-campus guest rooms available from 150 MAD per night

Interested students are encouraged to refer to the attached Call for

Abstracts for detailed guidelines, submission procedures, and the

application link.

This is an excellent opportunity to showcase your research work on an

international platform and gain valuable academic exposure.

Further details are provided in the attached document.

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [19th August] event.

World Photo Day

World Photo Day originates from the invention of the Daguerreotype, a

photographic process developed by Frenchmen Louis Daguerre and Joseph

Nicephore Niepce in 1837. On January 9, 1839, the French Academy of

Sciences announced the Daguerreotype process. On August 19, the French

government purchased the patent and announced the invention as a gift “free

to the world”.

The Daguerreotype wasn’t the first permanent photographic image. In 1826,

Niepce captured the earliest known permanent photograph known as “View from

the Window at Le Gras” using a process called heliography.

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today's [22nd August] event.

World Sanskrit Day

World Sanskrit Day, also known as Vishvasamskritadinam (Sanskrit:

विश्वसंस्कृतदिनम्),

is an annual event focused around the ancient Indian language of Sanskrit

that incorporates lectures about the language and is aimed to promote its

revival and maintenance. Sanskrit is the ancient language of India. It has

a documented history of nearly 3,500 years, and is said to be the primary

liturgical language. The day was first celebrated in 1969 and comprises

various events that talk about the impact and importance of Sanskrit.

This Indo-Aryan language has been declared as a classical language that’s

identified for its scientific construction and is in excessive demand

throughout the world. This language is known to be one of the oldest

languages in the world. Also, many languages find their roots in Sanskrit

including Hindi, Gujarati, and Bengali, etc, etc

subject: Congratulations to Asmita Pal for setting World Records at the Global Mental Math Olympiad 2025 held in Dubai!
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Ms. Asmita Pal (Reg. No. 23BCE2200) has

brought immense pride to VIT Vellore by achieving remarkable success and

setting multiple world records at the Global Mental Math Olympiad (GMMO)

2025 and the Live Math World Record Events held in Dubai on 1st and

2nd November 2025.

Competing among participants from over 15 countries including Malaysia,

Japan, India, Romania, Bangladesh, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain, the USA,

Spain, South Africa, Zimbabwe, Mauritius, Nigeria, and Seychelles, Asmita

demonstrated exceptional mental agility and mathematical precision.

World Record Performances (3-minute time limit):

· Perfect Square Root of 6-digit Numbers – 88 correct answers

· 3-Digit ± 2-Digit Mixed Operations – 130 correct answers

· 2-Digit + 2-Digit Addition – 137 correct answers

Asmita also secured top ranks in multiple Olympiad categories:

· 1st Rank – Standard Mandatory Challenge (Perfect score: 1000/1000 in

4.40 minutes)

· 1st Rank – Addition–Subtraction (5-minute event)

· 2nd Rank – Multiplication event

Her exceptional performances highlight precision, consistency, and

determination on the global stage.

We congratulate Ms. Asmita Pal on this extraordinary accomplishment and

appreciate her for proudly representing VIT Vellore at an international

platform.

subject: TCS Registration – 2027 Batch
body:
TCS Registration – 2027 Batch

Greetings from Tata Consultancy Services!!!

We are pleased to invite eligible students from your institute to

participate in the TCS Priority Institution National Qualifier Test (NQT)

for the 2027 graduating batch. As TCS accelerates the enterprise adoption

of AI and Generative AI, students joining us will have opportunities to

work on AI-led transformation programs at scale, supported by enterprise AI

platforms, deep industry context, and global technology partnerships.

Kindly ensure that all eligibility criteria and validation checks are

completed before sharing the final student list with us on or before May

13, 2026. Please note, no changes will be permitted after the closure date.

TCS Eligibility Criteria:

Courses & Disciplines

Batch of 2027 Only.

Listed highest qualifications—B.Tech., M.Tech. (2yr & 5yr), M.C.A., M.Sc,

(2yr & 5yr),. from any discipline/department.

Course Type

Only Full-Time courses will be considered

(Part Time / Correspondence Courses will not be considered)

Percentage

Candidates must have a minimum aggregate of 60%

OR

6 CGPA in all semesters up to the latest declared results.

AND

Offer is valid only if the final degree or provisional certificate confirms

'FIRST CLASS' in the highest qualification, completed within the stipulated

time.

Backlogs / Arrears / ATKT:

Application & Test Process: The student should not have more than 1 (one)

pending or active backlog / arrear / ATKT at the time of appearing for

the TCS Selection process.

Onboarding Process: At the time of onboarding, no pending backlogs /

arrears / ATKT will be permitted.

Please note: All pending backlogs / arrears / ATKT should be cleared

within the course duration stipulated by the University.

Gap / Break in Education

Ensure any academic gaps during your education are declared and supported

with valid proof; breaks should not exceed 24 months.

Work Experience

Students with prior work experience of up to two years are eligible to

apply for this hiring process (Applicable only for postgraduate students).

Age

A student should be 18 to 28 years of age to participate in

the TCS Hiring Process.

Sl.No

Important Notes

1

Only students graduating in the year 2027 are eligible to apply, and this

must be clearly indicated in their TCS Application Form

2

All students must ensure that they use their Personal Email ID Only.

Please note: Email ID CANNOT be changed once submitted.

3

Reference ID series starting DT/CT 2023 onwards to be used, as older IDs

will not be accepted; if students have a reference ID prior to 2023, they

should contact us for profile deletion and re-registration should be

completed before the registration date.

4

Please do eligibility check for the candidate data at your end too and

eliminate any ineligible profiles.

All the students are asked to go through the entire mail before

registering.

TCS Registration Process:

1) Visit https://nextstep.tcsapps.com/indiacampus/#/

2) Click “Register Now”

3) Select category as “IT”

4) Fill in details to generate a Reference ID

5) Click “Apply for Drive”

If a candidate already has a Reference ID, please ensure “Apply for Drive”

is clicked.

The registration window for the assessment process will be open from 11

May to 13 May 2026.

VIT Link: https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

Registration in both links (TCS & VIT) is mandatory.

All the CDC internship selects are eligible for the TCS process, All are

asked to register without fail (if they eligible)

TCS National Qualifier Test (NQT) with Integrated Test Pattern:

Section

Duration (in Minutes)

Part A - Foundation Sections

Numerical Ability

25

Verbal Ability

25

Reasoning ability

25

Part B - Advanced Section

Advanced Quantitative and Reasoning Ability

25

Advanced Coding

90

Total Duration (in Minutes)

190

AI-focused Career Opportunities for Students

Students hired through this drive may be aligned to future-ready work

across areas such as AI and data engineering, machine learning, deep

learning and GenAI, cloud data platforms, intelligent automation, and

AI-enabled software engineering.

Career pathways may include AI and Data tracks, including roles such as ML

Engineer and GenAI-focused engineering roles, along with broader digital

roles where AI is embedded into delivery.

As the industry landscape undergoes significant shifts in required skills

and expertise, TCS offers students a strong opportunity to remain relevant,

continuously upskill, and build careers for the new era.

Additional 15% Student Nomination from Group Institutes

The Placement Officer of a TCS Priority Institute may share an additional

list of students who are interested in taking the TCS NQT for Priority

Institutes. This additional list will be limited to 15% of the eligible

students who have applied for the TCS NQT for Priority Institutes from the

parent institute. The eligibility criteria will remain the same as

mentioned above.

Disclaimer

 - Eligibility checks will be conducted at various stages of the hiring

 process

 - Any ineligible candidature or misrepresentation of information will

 lead to disqualification.

 - TCS does not send job offers or hiring-related communications from

 unofficial email IDs such as Gmail, Rediffmail, Yahoo Mail, Hotmail, etc.

 - TCS does not ask candidates to pay any money during the recruitment

 process.

 - TCS is not associated with any external agency or company for

 employment offers.

As part of our continued efforts to enhance the recruitment experience, we

are introducing the following key features for the current hiring cycle:

 - On-premise Internet-based Assessment (IBA) Model and interview

 process: The assessment and interview process will be conducted on

 campus, ensuring a seamless and convenient experience for students.

 - Immediate Release of Offer Letters: Offer Letters will be issued to

 selected candidates immediately upon completion of the hiring process.

 - Focused Candidate Engagement Initiatives: Targeted engagement

 activities aimed at enhancing students’ preparedness for industry readiness.

The registration window for the Priority NQT will be open from May 8,

2026, to May 13, 2026. We request your office to facilitate the

dissemination of the registration link, which will be shared separately, to

all eligible students through appropriate institutional channels. We have

also taken note of your point regarding enabling registrations post the

Pre-Placement Talk and that students would be available post return from

their vacation. We will review this internally and revert with an update

for enabling additional registrations.

Candidates will be assessed and shortlisted for the following roles based

on their overall performance across all stages of the selection process:

Offer Category

UG (CTC)

PG (CTC)

Prime : Exceptional candidates who demonstrate outstanding aptitude and

advanced proficiency in emerging technologies.

9.09 LPA

11.59 LPA

Digital: Candidates who exhibit excellent aptitude and strong capability

in leveraging digital technology.

7.09 LPA

7.39 LPA

As TCS accelerates its AI and Generative AI-led transformation for clients

globally, we remain equally committed to building future-ready talent for

this new era. Students joining through this program can look forward to

opportunities in emerging areas such as AI/ML, data engineering and

analytics, cloud, and automation, while working under a human + AI delivery

model. TCS also provides intensive upskilling opportunities to help

students stay aligned with evolving industry demands and build resilient

careers.

subject: Hearty Congratulations to Mr. Aravinda Loshan Sankara Narayanan, VIT Vellore Student's Achievement in the Global Arena
body:
Dear All,

We would like to congratulate Mr. Aravinda Loshan Sankara Narayanan (Reg

No: 21BDS0228) for his outstanding accomplishments. His dedication, hard

work, and passion have not only brought great pride to himself but have

also brought laurels to VIT. We are incredibly proud to have him as part of

our academic community.

I would like to highlight three transformative experiences that have

significantly shaped his academic journey and personal growth:

 1. Global Winner at the Harvard University HCONF Conference: In February

2024, he had the distinct honor of representing India at the HCONF

Conference hosted by Harvard University out of over 25000+ applicants. This

experience provided him with the opportunity to interact with industry

leaders and inspiring personalities from around the world. During the

conference, he participated in the Impact Challenge, where they were tasked

with solving a real-world business problem for Patagonia. Competing against

seasoned professionals, including global consultants from McKinsey, Bain,

BCG, and KPMG, he proposed a solution that was well-received by Patagonia's

Asia-Pacific Director, leading to him being awarded the title of “Global

Winner of the HCONF Impact Challenge.”

2. Letter of Commendation from NUS: In August 2023, he had the privilege

of attending the “Innovation for Young Entrepreneurs” course at the

National University of Singapore. During this course, he actively

participated in all activities and led a team of five in the final

presentation, competing against 20 other teams. He isi honored to have

received a Letter of Commendation from NUS for my contribution to the

winning team.

3.) Asia Youth International MUN (AYIMUN): Represented VIT at 14th

AYIMUN, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia where he was allocated to the UNESCO Council

where he represented the Kingdom of Bhutan. During this MUN, collectively

as delegates from over 28 countries worked together to form a resolution

that emphasized the implementation of digital transformation in education.

He is excited to share that he was in the top-tier delegate in his council.

Mr Aravinda Loshan says, "These experiences have not only broadened my

horizons but have also allowed me to represent VIT on international

platforms, showcasing the quality of education and opportunities our

institution provides"

Mr. Aravinda Loshan Sankara Narayanan (Reg No: 21BDS0228), we look forward

to witnessing your future successes and contributions as you continue to

excel in your endeavours.

Once again, Hearty congratulations on this remarkable achievement!

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [06th October] 

 events.

Wildlife Week

Wildlife Week is annually celebrated across India between the 2nd to 8th of

October, with an aim to protect and preserve the flora and fauna of India.

The first Wildlife Week was observed in 1957. The Indian Board of Wildlife

was constituted and the idea of Wildlife Week was conceptualized in 1952 to

raise awareness about the long-term goals of protecting the wildlife of

India. Initially, in 1955 Wildlife day was celebrated which was later

upgraded as Wildlife Week in 1957.

World Wildlife Day will be celebrated in 2022 under the theme "Recovering

key species for ecosystem restoration", as a way to draw attention to the

conservation status of some of the most critically endangered species of

wild fauna and flora and to drive discussions towards imagining and

implementing solutions to conserve them. This aligns with UN Sustainable

Development Goals 1, 2, 12, 13, 14, and 15, and their wide-ranging

commitments to alleviating poverty, ensuring sustainable use of resources,

and conserving life land.

subject: India–UK Workshop on Developing Future Researchers (DFR 2025) – VIT, 15 December 2025 – Reg.
body:
Dear Research Scholars and students,

We are pleased to inform you that the India–UK Workshop on Developing

Future Researchers: Designing and Demonstrating Research Impact (DFR 2025)

will be held as per the details below:

Date: 15 December 2025

Time: 10:00 AM – 05:00 PM

Venue: Rajaji Hall, Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), Vellore

This one-day international workshop is jointly organised by the School of

Mechanical Engineering (SMEC), in collaboration with Sponsored Research and

Industrial Consultancy (SpoRIC) and the Teaching Learning Centre of

Excellence (TLCE). The event is supported by SPARC (India), the EPSRC

IAA/UKIERI Programme, the British Council, the Royal Society of Edinburgh,

and the Erasmus Mundus Programme.

About the Workshop

The workshop aims to equip Master’s students and early-stage Ph.D.

researchers with essential skills to:

 -

 Design research projects with measurable impact

 -

 Structure competitive research proposals

 -

 Visualise and communicate research outcomes effectively

 -

 Understand pathways for successful doctoral progress

Sessions will be led by eminent experts from VIT, Heriot-Watt University

(UK), IIT Kanpur, ARCI, CSIR-CSIO, CeNS, and other leading institutions.

Eligibility

 -

 Final-year Master’s students aspiring for Ph.D. admission

 -

 Early-stage Ph.D. scholars

 -

 Faculty members

Note: Participation is restricted to 50 internal candidates to ensure

high-quality interaction and engagement.

Application Process

Interested candidates must submit a 100-word Statement of Interest

describing:

 -

 Why they wish to attend, and

 -

 How the workshop will benefit their research career.

Selected participants will be notified by 8 December 2025, along with the

detailed programme schedule.

Please find the attached brochure for more information.

subject: Events to commemorate the International Women's Day Celebration' 25-reg
body:
Dear VITians,

“A woman in harmony with her spirit is like a river flowing. She goes

where she will without pretense and arrives at her destination prepared to

be herself and only herself."

— Maya Angelou, late American memoirist, poet, and civil rights activist.

Greetings from the Office of Students’ Welfare!

40 Years of VIT, 40+ Events!

The exciting celebration of International Women’s Day is here, and this

time, we are going bigger than ever! As VIT proudly marks 40 years of

excellence, we are thrilled to bring you a weeklong celebration from March

3rd to March 7th, packed with 40+ events for female students, faculty,

staff, and research scholars, reflecting four decades of growth,

empowerment, and leadership.

This year's IWD theme: #AccelateAction

This special occasion is a tribute to the resilience, achievements, and

contributions of women in every sphere. With a diverse range of events

covering leadership, innovation, arts, and social impact, the week promises

a vibrant mix of learning, networking, and fun! Gear up for electrifying

cultural performances every evening as clubs, chapters, and literary

associations take the stage with mesmerizing acts at Greenos!

And to culminate this grand celebration, a special program is lined up on

March 8th to take this Women's Day celebration up a notch with inspiring

talks, recognitions, and memorable moments. Adding to the excitement,

special stalls will be set up on that day, bringing you a vibrant mix of

experiences, interactive activities, and delightful surprises.

Enjoy this weeklong celebration and be part of the excitement!

The registration links for students, faculty, staff, and research scholars

are given below and rules and regulations for the specific events are also

attached herewith.

Registration Links:

For Faculty/ Staff/ Research Scholars- https://forms.gle/kqEvDVLoVz3aEL876

For Students- https://forms.gle/PB7PSnqZ5LV8xXqi8

Stay tuned for more details on the schedule of events and activities

planned for this special occasion!

body: ilug , From;Mr.Michael Kamah and Family, Johannesburg,South Africa. My Dear , Good day.This very confidential request should come as a surprise to you.But it is because of the nature of what is happening to me and my family urged me to contact you, and I quite understand that this is not the best way to contact you because of the nature of my request and the attention it requires.I got your contact information from your country's information directory during my desperate search for someone who can assist me secretly and confidentially in relocating and managing some family fortunes. My name is Mr.Michael Kamah, the second son of Mr.Smith Kamah, of Beitbridge Zimbabwe.At the height of the present political crises in our country,in which the white farmers in our country are being slained and ripped off their belongings by the supporters of our president,Mr.Robert G.Mugabe,in their efforts to reclaim all the white owned farms in our country,my father and my elder brother were brutally slained to a painful death on the 13th of february,2002, in their struggle to protect some white farmers who ran to take refuge in our house.My father,during his life on earth was a prominent business man who trades on diamond and gold from some foreign countries .He publicly opposes the crude policies and crime against humanity on the white farmers by Mr.Robert Mugabe and his followers,which they enforced media law restrictions to protect their wicked acts.That not being enough,the president and his followers after winning the last undemocratic elections decided to block and ! confiscate all accounts and assets of our black indigenes[that included my fathers assets and accounts] who oppose his policies and render support to these white farmers,along with the assets of these white farmers themselves,that are being presently confiscated.I therefore decided to move my mother and younger sister to the Republic of South Africa,where we presently live without anything and without any source of livelyhood. During my fathers life on earth,he had deposited the sum of Eight Million and Six Hundred Thousand United States Dollars[$8.600.000.00],in a trunk box with a Finance and Security Company in the Republic of Togo for a cash and carry Diamond and Gold business with some foreign business customers, awaiting instructions to be moved to its destination,which he never completed before he met his untimely death on that faithful day.In view of this and as the only surviving son of my father,and with the present clamp down,killing and confiscation of his assets as one of those who render support to the white farmers in our country,I therefore humbly wish to inform you of my intentions to use your name and adress in making sure that this fund is lifted out of Africa finally,to the Europe office of the finance company and also seek for your honest and trustworthy assistance to help me clear and accommodate this money over there before it is dictated out and blocked by the present Mugabe's! regime.My mother is presently with the valid document covering this deposit. Now this is what I actually want you to do for me; 1. I want you to be presented to the Finance and Security company as the person I contacted to assist my family for this purpose, with whose name and adress myself and my mother will forward to them their office in the Republic of Togo as the person that will clear this money when they lift it out to their europe office. 2. To finally assist me in accommodating and managing this money in any lucrative business in your country for at least three years. Please,I hope you will grant and view this very request with favour and much understanding of our situation now,and will be a very honest and reliable person to deal with.And also bearing in mind the confidential nature of this my request,I emphasize please that you keep every bit of it to yourself so as to protect my familys future and yourself rendering this help.Thanking you in anticipation of your urgent response as soon as you read this very request. Best Regards, Mr.Michael Kamah and family. -- Irish Linux Users' Group: ilug@linux.ie http://www.linux.ie/mailman/listinfo/ilug for (un)subscription information. List maintainer: listmaster@linux.ie

subject: CALLING FOR PARTICIPATION: SEATECH HACKATHON 2023 (SUSTAINABILITY)- UTP, Malaysia
body:
Dear Students,

An exciting opportunity to gain hands-on experience - 

Visit to 

Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS (UTP), Malaysia

SEATECH HACKATHON 2023

There is an invitation to you all from UTP,Malaysia SEATECH HACKATHON 2023

, an exciting event focused on sustainability-related issues during the

month of November 4 th to November 6 th,2023 in UTP.

About SEATech Hackathon:

SEATech Hackathon is a platform for students to come together and tackle

challenges related to sustainability.

It's an opportunity for students to showcase their skills, connect with

like-minded individuals, and contribute to global sustainability-related

issues through an immersive design process.

52 HOURS HACKATHON.

3 SUSTAINABILITY DESIGN CHALLENGES.

1 WINNING SOLUTION.

Participation Fee: The fee per participant is MYR 100 .

Accommodation and meals will be covered during the event. 

Champion Prize: A prize of USD 1,000 will be awarded to the winning

team.

Registration Deadline: All participants are required to complete their

registration by October 25th, 2023.

Why Attend?

Network with peers and industry professionals, mentors and judges,as well

as with participating students and mentors of more than 10 universities in

the Southeast Asia countries.Gain hands-on experience in solving real-world

sustainability issues.Showcase your institution's commitment to

sustainability and innovation.

Registration:

To register your institution's participants, please visit our registration

page; https://bit.ly/SEATech2023 https://bit.ly/SEATech2023

or scan the QR code in the poster before the deadline.

For additional details regarding SEATech Hackathon 2023, kindly consult

the enclosed guidelines.

Those who are intersted can regsiter through the link given above and

fill the below form:

https://forms.gle/xiN9r6y85qasEPmP8 https://forms.gle/xiN9r6y85qasEPmP8

(This is for the follow up record to our VIT).

Director @ ir5@vit.ac.in,

The facility is listed in the CRF portal (https://crf.vit.ac.in/) under the

name HIGH TEMPERATURE SERVO HYDRAULIC FATIGUE TEST SYSTEM for slot

booking.

This equipment is capable of performing a wide range of mechanical and

fatigue-related tests, including:

 - Tensile Testing

 - Compression Testing

 - Flexural Testing

 - Low-Cycle Fatigue (LCF) Testing

 - High-Cycle Fatigue (HCF) Testing

 - Temperature-Assisted Fatigue Testing (up to 900°C)

 - Fracture Toughness Testing

 - Fatigue Pre- cracking

We hereby express our sincere gratitude to the management for their

continuous support and for providing additional funding towards the

establishment of this facility. We also thank the support extended by the Vice

Chancellor, Pro-Vice Chancellor, the Director of Purchase and his team; the

Director of Estates and his team throughout the procurement, installation,

and commissioning process.

We extend our sincere thanks to the FIST Implementation Team - Dr. Raja

Annamalai A, Dr. Vasudevan R, Dr. Ashish Kumar, Dr Anoj Giri and Dr.

Pandivelan C for their valuable contributions to the successful

establishment of this facility. We also appreciate the dedicated efforts of

the lab staff, Mr. Kamalakannan S and Mr. Kiran Kumar C M, along with other

SMEC staff members, during the installation and trial period of the

equipment.

The facility is now ready and open to all faculty, scholars, and students

for research and testing activities.

We are also glad to share that the equipment will be available for

24/7 operation during the testing period.

All are invited to make use of this facility!!

Thank you very much.

subject: ThinkSwiss Research Scholarships 2025 - Call for Application is Open!
body:
Dear Students,

I wanted to share with you that the call for applications for our very

successful and highly competitive ThinkSwiss Research Scholarships 2025

https://swissnex-dot-yamm-track.appspot.com/2uODX4IJ1jy9VjPX9TINS1lcYr55-0kfEgfPAkSmo6PMW999GkgGfaNHy8fBI7964On-c0iNoeu5CyUfKa9JVXEjW0DQDfKTKdnn_7-w5vqKfH1SQWy0knHa1EKK_dXzjRrks6t_471hStcQa7qxhsnH5384XLxDmsgOkJ8lz6EQYjS1JF7mnbp5bWEcNC_-dl4kBApxvnwis

currently open.

We would highly appreciate it if you could circulate the same at VIT,

Vellore.

 - About:

 The ThinkSwiss Research Scholarships offers students from India,

 Singapore and Australia fully-funded research stints in a Swiss laboratory

 of their choosing. This provides scholars with an opportunity to experience

 the Swiss research ecosystem first-hand and take the first step to a

 possible future research career in Switzerland

 - Eligibility:

 - Master students or Undergraduate students who have completed their

 2nd year, currently enrolled in an Indian university or institute.

 - The scholarship is open to students in all fields. However, we

 especially encourage students with an interest in Antimicrobial

Resistance

 (AMR), One Health, biodiversity or climate change and action to apply.

 - A written confirmation from a Professor at a Swiss university is

 required stating that he/she will accept you for a research stay

in his/her

 group.

 - Funding:

 This programme is funded by the Swissnex network, part of the Swiss

 State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI). The

 student will receive a stipend of CHF 60/day.

 - Duration: minimum of 2 months and up to a maximum of 3 months.

 - When: Anytime between 1 April 2025 and 31 December 2025.

 - Where: In a public-funded Swiss university or public-funded Swiss

 Research Institution (Discover more here)

 - Deadline for application: 31 January 2025.

subject: Springer Nature India Research Tour 2024 in Collaboration with the Indian Council of Social Science Research (MoE)
body:
Dear Professors and Research Scholars,

Greetings,

I trust this mail finds all you in good health and high spirits.

We are happy to take part in hosting The India Research Tour 2024

organized by Springer Nature in Collaboration with the Indian Council of

Social Science Research (MoE) on 15th October 2024 @ VIT, Vellore. We

believe that it is a strategic initiative aimed at strengthening the

country’s research landscape by nurturing talent, democratizing, fostering

conversations around accessibility, and promoting the UN’s SDGs, which is

aligned with our VIT Transformative process.

Date : 15th October,2024, Tuesday

Time : 10.00 to 12.30 PM

Venue: Dr. M. Channa Reddy Auditorium, Main Building, VIT, Vellore

The India Research Tour 2024 is a unique and promising initiative

organized by Springer Nature in collaboration with the Indian Council of

Social Science Research (MoE).

The India Research Tour 2024 is aimed at bringing together a diverse

range of key stakeholders, experts, and leaders to engage in meaningful

discussions and collaborate on fostering the advancement of research and

higher education in our nation. The ultimate goal is to leverage the power

of research to contribute positively to the holistic growth and progress of

India.

With these objectives in mind, the India Research Tour seeks to create a

platform where ideas are exchanged, partnerships are forged, and actionable

plans are developed. It is a unique space for researchers to learn in depth

about publishing opportunities, know about new ways of disseminating their

work on global platforms, educate themselves with new trends in research

publishing and harness the full potential of research for the betterment of

our nation.

As Part of the program we are having Panel Discussion on "Transformative

Agreement –Redefining Research Publishing- The impact of Transformative

Agreements on Access and Equity ", and the top 5 Women Researchers from

VIT will be recognized by Springer Nature.

It is mandatory for all the Research scholars and you are requested to fill

the registration form. Please find the registration link for Registration

Form of Springer Nature India Research Tour 2024 to VIT in Collaboration

with the Indian Council of Social Science Research (MoE).

 https://forms.gle/ixCE4P32VYr1dW6UA

Certificates will be issued to all the participants.

Note: Programme scheduled attached

We look forward to your enthusiastic participation and contribution to

the success of The India Research Tour 2024 .

Thanks and Regards

Yours Sincerely,

P.Arulmozhivarman

--------------------------------------------

Dr. P. Arulmozhivarman

Professor & Dean Academic Research

Vellore Institute of Technology

Vellore 632014, TN, India.

Phone: +91 416 220 2233

 -------------------------------------------

subject: Call for Raman-Charpak Fellowship Applications 2023
body:
Dear Students,

I am pleased to inform you that the call for applications for the Raman

Charpak Fellowship 2023 is open for French Masters and PhD students.

This scholarship program is implemented by the Franco-Indian Center for the

Promotion of Advanced Research (IFCPAR/CEFIPRA) and jointly funded by the

Department of Science and Technology (DST), the Government of India and the

Embassy of France in India / the French Institute in India (IFI), Ministry

of European and Foreign Affairs, Government of France.

The objective of this scholarship is to facilitate the exchange of doctoral

students and students between the two countries, in order to strengthen and

deepen exchanges in the fields of science, technology and innovation.

In short, the Raman-Charpak scholarship funds Indian PhDs and French

Masters and PhD - 2 to 6 months. Attached are the guidelines for more

information.

Topics:

 - Atmospheric Sciences, Earth Sciences and Environmental Sciences

 - Materials Sciences, Physical Sciences, Chemical Sciences

 - Engineering Science

 - Biological Sciences, Life and Medical Sciences

 - Mathematical and Computational Sciences.

Deadline:

until September 30, 2023

For any additional information, click on the link below.

https://www.cefipra.org/Raman_Charpak.aspx

All the best!

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

subject: Reminder: All foreign inbound and outbound academic activities entry in VTOP
body:
Reminder 

Ref:VIT/Regr./2025/106

 28 July 2025

CIRCULAR

Sub: All foreign inbound and outbound academic activities

All faculty members and students are hereby informed that, with effect

from 1 August 2025 (Friday), the following procedures will be mandatory on

the VTOP portal for all foreign inbound and outbound academic activities:

1. Inbound foreign students and faculty (Entering VIT)

All international students and faculty planning to join VIT for academic,

research, internship, exchange, or any other official purposes must

complete the following steps:

· VIT faculty members should submit a request on behalf of foreign

faculty members (all categories) /foreign students enrolled for an

internship/summer school programme for entry via

the “International Relations (IR)” section on VTOP.

Faculty Inbound Request Form (Incoming)

 - Upload required documents, including (1. Appointment Letter, 2.

 Invitation letter,

 3. Passport copy, 4. Visa copy )

 - Obtain mandatory approvals from:

 - Respective School Dean/Director

 - Director -International Relations Office

 - Registrar

 - Approval must be obtained at least two weeks before arrival at the VIT

 campus.

2. Outbound students and faculty (Travelling Abroad)

All students and faculty planning to travel abroad under institutional

agreements, exchange programs, internships, official trips, or research

collaborations must:

 - Initiate the “International Relations (IR)” section in VTOP

 -Faculty Outbound Request Form (Outgoing)

 - Submit supporting documents, including 1. Official invitation 2.

 Passport copy

 3. Visa copy 4. Funding by VIT/External funding, if yes, please attach

 the funding sanction letter 5. Any other support documents (1-5 documents).

 - Obtain mandatory approvals from:

 - Respective School Dean/Director

 - Director -International Relations Office

 - Registrar

 - Approval must be obtained at least 2 weeks before the departure date.

 - This measure is implemented to ensure institutional compliance,

 accurate data management for IQAC and RAAC, timely processing of

 reimbursements by the Finance Office, necessary HR approvals, Guest House

 booking, transport booking and effective coordination of international

 academic engagements abroad.

For further queries, please get in touch with the International Relations

Office (IRO) or email at international@vit.ac.in.

Registrar

subject: GREEN Olympiad for Youth (GO4Youth) - Reg.
body:
Dear Students,

UGC invites students from Higher Education Institutions (HEI) in India to

participate in the GREEN Olympiad for Youth (GO4Youth). This is MCQ based

online examination on issues related with environment and sustainability.

GO4Youth is endorsed by University Grants Commission (UGC), Ministry of

Environment, Forest and Climate Change (MoEFCC) and Ministry of Education

(MoE), Government of India.

Eligibility: Students in age group of 18- 25 years

What is in store for you?

• e- Certificates for all

• Merit and distinction e-Certificates for rank holders based on scores

• Cash awards for top three positions

• Become a member of TERI’s youth network

• Avail internship opportunities at TERI and other institutes of eminence

• Build up your environment portfolio

Important Dates

• Registration Deadline: February 25, 2024

• Examination: April 8 to 12, 2024

(Final date with time slots will be communicated to students after the

registration)

For more details, visit

https://go4youth.com/static/media/go4youth_poster.af9608d19f16c0f2d0a3.pdf

https://go4youth.com/static/media/go4youth_poster.af9608d19f16c0f2d0a3.pdf

Register at https://go4youth.com/student-Inlogin

https://go4youth.com/student-Inlogin

For queries, contact: 

Tel: 01124682100/ 41504900, Email: go4youth@teri.res.in

subject: Join us for a session on - From Idea to Investment
body:
Dear Students,

The Institution’s Innovation Council and Entrepreneurship Development Cell

(EDC) bring you an exciting session, “From Idea to Investment: Crafting

Winning Pitches”, featuring our VIT Alumnus & Entrepreneur : Achyut

Agrawal, Founder & CEO of Diagnovate (https://tinyurl.com/2jubwmcj).

If you’ve ever wondered how to capture investor interest, structure a

pitch, or navigate the funding landscape, this is where you’ll find your

answers. Achyut Agrawal will walk us through what makes a pitch stand out

and how to turn ideas into investments.

What’s in store?

• Breaking down the key elements of a solid business pitch

• Understanding what investors actually look for

• Insights from real-world fundraising experiences

📅 Date: 4th April

⏰ Time: 8:30 AM – 1:00 PM

📍 Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium, TT 7th Floor

Don’t miss this opportunity to elevate your pitching skills and take your

ideas to the next level. Join us and gain the confidence to turn your ideas

into investments!

Register using the link below:

https://forms.gle/Pdsa5nErwnHynS2S6

For queries, contact: Ayush Naugariya (+91 87709 33607)

Don't miss out on this amazing opportunity!

-- 

Thanks and Regards,

Dr. Leema Rose Viannie

President, Institution's Innovation Council,

VIT, Vellore.

subject: Day-26 (31st May-Friday)-Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!
body:
Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-26 (31st May-Friday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTESTTOPIC: No - Tobacco :

Adopt Healthier Habits

We would like to see your unique perspective of this on campus. Capture the

essence through your cell phone.

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence of our

 campus in a unique and interesting way?

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by tomorrow 05:00

 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts tomorrow morning at 06:00 am and ends

by 05:00 pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more information: events.sw@vit.ac.in

subject: Expression of Interest: NXP Innovation Challenge - "AI on the Edge"
body:
VIT – Semiconductor Prototyping, Assembly, Characterization and

Engineering Centre 

(V-SPACE)

NXP Innovation Challenge – "AI on the Edge" using MCX N94

Dear Students,

Greetings!

Following the successful establishment of the NXP Innovation Hub at VIT,

Vellore we have received NXP MCX N94 microcontroller boards along with

specialized learning resources. These tools, featuring Neutron NPU

acceleration, provide a unique opportunity for our students to master

industry-standard embedded development and "AI on the Edge" applications.

We invite student teams (3–5 members) in the NXP Innovation Challenge.

This initiative is designed to foster student-led innovation and

prototyping in the following domains:

Category

Sub-Category Examples

Industrial IoT

Smart Infrastructure, Smart Cities, Smart Homes

Medicare

Wearable Devices, Smart Healthcare Solutions

Robotics

Drones, Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMR), Humanoids

Automotive

Electric Vehicles, BMS, Infotainment, Autonomous Systems

Next Steps for the Students:

 1. Form Teams: 3–5 students per team (1 board per team).

 2. Review Resources: Utilize the eIQ Time Series Studio and Application

 Code Hub provided.

 3. Submit a Proposal: Use the attached Project Proposal MCX N94.docx

 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KZE6JOSx45c1FrmfzuJuRuNwcRK9yl34/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=101240343403385309628&rtpof=true&sd=true

 template.

Important Timeline:

Date

Milestone

Expected Outcome

12th May 2026

Proposal Submission

Project proposal in the recommended template

20th May 2026

NXP Feedback

Feedback from NXP team

30th May 2026

Kick‑start Meeting

Project scope and plan alignment

11th June 2026

1st Milestone

Initial design and project plan

30th June 2026

2nd Milestone

A working top-cut prototype developed

31st July 2026

Final Milestone

Final solution to be demonstrated and documentation to be submitted

Here are a few Resources to kick-start your activity:

 - eIQ Time Series Studio - NPU_Usecase_Share.pdf

 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rwliKikdW6FMIeb2Te1h7VoEWuPfNi0l/view?usp=drive_link:

Gives

 an overview of eIQ Time Series Studio, showcasing how to build, train,

 optimize and deploy time‑series ML models on MCX N94 devices using Neutron

 NPU acceleration

 - Concepts and workflows Demo.mp4:

 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1jwUPIxm_f19rRPCd_48AmfnvxFVJrUsj/view?usp=drive_linkA

 recorded technical session walking through the concepts and workflows

 covered in the above document.

 - Application Code Hub https://mcuxpresso.nxp.com/appcodehub : Application

 Code Hub for reference implementations, example applications, and

 software resources mapped to NXP’s microcontroller portfolio

 - MCX N94 Technical FAQ & Project Idea Guide:

 https://drive.google.com/file/d/1rwliKikdW6FMIeb2Te1h7VoEWuPfNi0l/view?usp=sharing

 This technical guide is designed to highlight the unique hardware

 capabilities of the MCX N94 and provide faculty with concrete project

 starting points using the eIQ Time Series Studio.

 - Automotive, IoT & Industrial Solutions | NXP Semiconductors

 https://www.nxp.com/ : About NXP’s portfolio

These resources are designed to help your team build a strong understanding

of MCX N94 microcontrollers, explore their capabilities, and gain exposure

to industry‑standard embedded development practices.

V-SPACE Support:

V-SPACE will facilitate direct hand-holding with the NXP team and provide

industry mentorship to help convert these student ideas into viable

products.

Please submit your project proposals

https://docs.google.com/document/d/1KZE6JOSx45c1FrmfzuJuRuNwcRK9yl34/edit?usp=drive_link&ouid=101240343403385309628&rtpof=true&sd=true

by 12th May 2026 through Google Form.

https://forms.gle/yU1mSA3qMVCmDZfr8

We look forward to seeing VIT’s faculty and students lead the way in edge

computing innovation.
