body:
Dear VITians,

I am delighted to share that research conducted at our CO₂ Centre by two

second-year M.Sc. Chemistry students, Ms. Sreeshma (Reg. No. 23MSH0019) and

Ms. Tharinidevi (Reg. No. 23MSH0124), in collaboration with the Department

of Chemistry, SAS, has been published in the prestigious Chemical

Engineering Journal (Elsevier, Impact Factor: 13.4). This achievement

builds upon their contributions to previous SET conferences.

Publication Details:

Yesudas K. Yashly, S.P. Sreeshma, S.K. Tharinidevi, G. Buvaneswari, and

Annamalai Senthil Kumar, "Tailoring spinel cobalt-oxide geometry for

ultrahigh-sensitive nonenzymatic electrocatalytic oxidation and sensing of

glucose in batch injection analysis."

Chemical Engineering Journal, 2025. [DOI: 10.1016/j.cej.2025.160611 (In

Press)]

https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/S1385894725014329?via%3Dihub

research project. Congratulations on this well-deserved accomplishment!

subject: Hearty Congratulations to our beloved Chancellor
body:
Dear All,

We are happy to announce that our Chancellor Dr. G. Viswanathan was awarded

the Doctor of Literature (D.Litt., Honoris Causa) by the prestigious St.

Xavier’s University, Kolkata on 15th February 2025. The honour was bestowed

upon him in recognition of his outstanding contributions to education,

leadership, public service, and humanitarian efforts.

This is the first time that an Indian university has conferred an honorary

doctorate upon him. Previously, he was honoured with an honorary doctorate

by West Virginia University, USA, in 2009 and more recently by the State

University of New York, Binghamton University, USA, in 2024.

The VIT family takes pride in saluting the monumental achievement of our

Chancellor and wishing him on all his future endeavours.

subject: Congratulations to Team Bithub for their Achievement at Code Cubicle Hackathon 5.0, Microsoft Bengaluru
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Bithub from VIT participated in the Code

Cubicle Hackathon 5.0, powered by Pathway, Trae, and Geek Room, hosted

at the Microsoft Campus, Bengaluru, on 27th September 2025.

Out of 1000+ participating teams, the team was shortlisted among the Top

250. Following the pitching round, the team advanced to the top 10

finalists.

In the grand finale, Team Bithub proudly secured the following accolades:

1. 1st Prize – Cybersecurity Track

2. 3rd Prize – Overall

The team was also awarded a cash prize, an internship offer, and

additional exciting perks.

This outstanding achievement stands as a testament to the team’s

innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence, bringing

national-level recognition to our institution.

Team Members:

1. Chirag S Das (23BIT0322) – Team Leader

2. Abhay Z (23BCT0065)

3. Manoj D J (23BIT0223)

4. Adhavan K (23BCE0839)

Hearty congratulations to Team Bithub for this remarkable accomplishment!

subject: Nyork Foods - Dream Core Internship - Food Science - 27 Batch
body:
Nyork Foods - Dream Core Internship - Food Science - 27 Batch 

Nyork Foods is a fast-growing food company engaged in the R&D, sourcing,

distribution, marketing, and development of high-quality food products

across multiple categories. We work with a diverse portfolio of frozen

foods and ambient food products, catering to the HoReCa, retail, and

institutional segments. Our focus is on delivering quality products while

continuously improving processes, food safety standards, and product

innovation.

The selected interns will primarily work on:

 -

 Frozen food products, including quality assurance, product evaluation,

 and process improvement.

 -

 Ambient food products, with exposure to quality control, product

 development, and shelf-life studies.

 -

 Food safety and quality management systems.

 -

 Documentation, regulatory compliance, and technical support activities.

 -

 Product trials, market feedback analysis, and continuous improvement

 initiatives.

This internship will provide candidates with practical industry exposure

and an opportunity to work closely with experienced professionals in a

dynamic food business environment.

Internship Details:

 -

 Stipend: ₹12,000 per month

 -

 Work Location: Nyork Foods Office, Chennai

 -

 Role: The internship will primarily involve working on frozen food

 products and ambient food products, with exposure to quality assurance,

 product development, food safety, and related technical activities.

Please note that while your primary work location will be our Chennai

office, the role may require occasional visits to manufacturing plants or

factories as part of product evaluations, quality assessments, or other

project requirements. Any travel or related expenses incurred for such

official visits will be reimbursed separately on an actual basis, in

accordance with the company's policy.

The deadline in the NEOPAT portal is on or before 6 pm today

subject: Launch of MBA 2026 Application | Apply Now Through VITBEE 2026- reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to announce the launch of application for the MBA 2026

batch across the prestigious VIT group of institutions, (VIT Vellore,

Chennai; VIT-AP and VIT-Bhopal).

Admissions to the MBA 2026 program will be through the VIT Business School

Entrance Examination (VITBEE 2026) conducted across 89 cities in India by

VIT for management aspirants nationwide.

📢 Note: Candidates with valid CAT / XAT / MAT scores are exempted

from appearing for VITBEE 2026.

Why to Choose VIT for Management Studies

v Globally Recognized Institution: Accredited by AACSB and ACBSP, and

ranked in the 551–600 band globally in QS World University Rankings

(Business & Management 2025) and 501–600 in THE World Rankings

(Business & Economics 2025).

v World class infrastructure.

v Relevant Curriculum: Focus on analytics, AI/ML, sustainability, and

leadership development.

v Immersive Learning Experience: Modern digital classrooms,

simulation-based pedagogy, and diverse peer learning environment.

v Global Exposure: International Transfer Program with partner

universities in the USA, UK, France, Singapore and Australia.

v Strong Alumni Network: Graduates leading in top organizations worldwide.

Placement Highlights

VITBS maintains a stellar placement record with leading recruiters such as

Shell, HPE, Deloitte, Accenture, Cognizant, PwC, TCS, and HDFC Bank.

The highest

CTC recorded was ₹18 LPA, and over 148 offers were made in the most

recent placement season. The school’s strong industry interface, global

collaborations, and focus on applied management ensure students are

well-equipped for leadership roles across sectors.

------------------------------

🗓 Important Dates

 - Applications Open: October 31, 2025

 - Entrance Exam (VITBEE 2026): 03-05-2026(Sunday)

 - Mode: Computer-Based Test (Across 89 test cities in India)

------------------------------

Take the next step in your leadership journey with VIT Business School,

where innovation meets management excellence.

👉 Apply Now:

https://admissions.vit.ac.in/mba-2026-application/login?utm_source=AL571LU&utm_campaign=mba2026

For any queries please contact 0416 - 2202050; 0416-2202060; 0416 -

2202188; 0416 - 2202055 or email to mbaadmission@vit.ac.in.

Yours Sincerely,

Dr. S.Sasikumar M.Sc., M.Phil., Ph.D., AMRSC.

Director - PG Admissions

Professor in Chemistry

subject: Congratulations to Team Mosambi – Achievement at Manipal BioTech Hackathon 2025
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Mosambi has brought laurels to VIT by

securing 1st Place at the online Manipal BioTech Hackathon 2025,

organised by Manipal-GoK Bioincubator – BioNEST, in association with the

Student Entrepreneurship Cell, Manipal School of Life Sciences (MSLS),

Department of Biotechnology (MIT), and Department of Biotherapeutics

Research, MAHE, Manipal.

The event, held virtually on 11th November 2025, aimed to promote

student-led innovation, foster biotech start-ups, and encourage critical

thinking to tackle pressing challenges in the biotechnology domain. This

year, a total of 130 teams participated in the final pitch presentations,

making the competition highly competitive and enriching.

Team Members:

 - Ratnadeep Das (23BBT0066)

 - Harshita Kumar (23BBT0130)

 - Soumil Binhani (22BDS0275)

 - Rachit Upadhyay (22BBT0120)

 - Krut Doshi (22BBT0134)

We extend our heartfelt appreciation to the team for their dedication,

innovation, and perseverance, which have made the VIT community proud.

Congratulations to Team Mosambi for this outstanding achievement, and best

wishes for their future endeavours!

subject: Student Startup Venture Call- 2024-25
body:
Dear Students,

Do you have a brilliant startup idea?

This is your chance to turn it into reality! We're inviting interested

students to participate in the Student Startup Venture (SSV) platform

designed to spark your entrepreneurial spirit and help you communicate your

ideas to the world.

SSV support has been extended to students since 2017, over 160 projects

have been supported and 19 startups have emerged…

Successful Startups like https://vicara.co/ https://vicara.co/ ;

https://alfaleus.in/

https://alfaleus.in/ ; https://www.punar.in/ https://www.punar.in/;

kuppismart solutions pvt ltd/ have emerged with the support of SSV.

SSV comes with a grant of up to Rs. 2.00 lakhs for prototype development

activities. The duration of the project will be from August 2024 to May

2025. All students of UG, PG programs, and Research Scholars on the campus

are eligible to apply. A faculty mentor is mandatory for every team

of SSV (Maximum of 3 students + 1 faculty mentor). Only those who are

engaged in technology product development (hardware) can apply. This call

is not for app development, pure software products and research activities.

This fund purely supports technology innovations leading to novel products,

prototypes, and venture creation.

Innovations in the following themes are encouraged.

1. Sustainability (including energy/ renewable energy technologies)

2. Cleantech/ GreenTech Revolution

3. HealthTech Horizons

4. Smart Cities and Digital Realities

5. AgriTech – including post-harvest technologies

6. Clean Energy Breakthroughs

7. Smart devices based on AI/ML (including consumer & enterprise AI

solutions), IoT and IIoT

8. BioTech and Life Sciences

9. Robotics, Drones and Automation

10. Sports tech

To avail of this opportunity, please register on the below link on or

before the 20thof July 2024.

 Registration link for SSV: https://tinyurl.com/SSV2024-25

Kindly find attached the guidelines, which will help you with the

submission process. Kindly make sure that the outcomes are met during the

completion of the project. Once the ideas have been shortlisted, we will

be contacting you on how to take further steps. The projects completed

through SSV will be given the opportunity to be Pre-incubated/ Incubated at

VIT-TBI.

 For Details Pls Contact:

Dr. Vidhya, E-Cell Co-ordinator

 ecell.coordinator@vit.ac.in <ecell.coordinator@vit.ac.in>

 Regards

Dr. C Ramesh KumarProfessor and Director

subject: YANTRA'26: Day-8 Events (14-02-26) - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details:

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 8:

SPECIAL EVENTS:

CENTRAL HACK

Date : 13-02-2026 to 15-02-2026

Time : 8 AM Onwards (56 hr hack - overnight)

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : The Yantra’26 is back with Central Hack, designed to bring

together the brightest minds, bold ideas, and passionate problem-solvers

from diverse academic backgrounds. With a prize pool of INR 6,00,000+,

Yantra Central Hack is a flagship 56-hour hackathon organized by the Office

of Students’ Welfare. The event brings together participants from multiple

disciplines to collaborate, innovate, and solve real-world challenges in an

intense, fast-paced environment.

BRAIN TO BRAND: BUSINESS CHALLENGE

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 1 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY - TT

Event Details : Brain to Brand is a dynamic business case challenge that

guides participants from innovative ideas to real-world execution. Spanning

three intense rounds, it evaluates business savvy, strategic thinking,

creativity, and pitching prowess as teams convert pressing real-world

challenges into viable, scalable brand and business solutions.

COMPUTER SOCIETY OF INDIA (CSI)

Event Name : DEVSPACE

Date : 12-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 8 PM

Venue : CS HALL

Event Details : Devspace is CSI-VIT’s flagship hackathon, held alongside

engaging and insightful speaker sessions led by professionals from the tech

world. It brings together developers, entrepreneurs, tech enthusiasts, and

students in a high-energy environment to learn, collaborate, and showcase

their skills under one roof, while offering organisations a unique

opportunity to connect with some of the brightest minds at VIT Vellore.

THE BIOTECH RESEARCH SOCIETY INDIA (BRSI)

Event Name : Bio-Chain

Date : 13-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SMV 110

Event Details : BIO-CHAIN: PHAGEWARS is a hands-on biotech event where

participants design engineered bacteriophage genomes using real data,

connect bioinformatics and explore blockchain-based systems for

transparent, tamper-proof storage of phage research and patient–phage

matching records.

IEEE ROBOTICS & AUTOMATION SOCIETY (IEEE-RAS)

Event Name : Reboot 3.0

Date : 13-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : HOMIBABA GALLERY

Event Details : REBOOT is a premier 36-hour overnight hackathon organized

by the IEEE Robotics and Automation Society (RAS). The event is designed to

move beyond traditional robotics competitions by fostering a high-intensity

environment focused on interdisciplinary innovation and real-world problem

solving.

PIXELATE CLUB

Event Name : Design Odyssey

Date : 14-02-2026 to 15-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY

Event Details : Design Odyssey 2.0, hosted by Pixelate — the design club of

VIT — is a 36-hour intensive design sprint that challenges participants to

go beyond crypto hype and design for what truly matters: people, trust, and

social responsibility. While Web3 promises decentralization and

transparency, it often struggles with poor accessibility and complex

interfaces. Design Odyssey 2.0 invites creators to bridge this gap, using

design as the link between decentralized technology and real-world users.

Working within thematic tracks such as transparency, inclusivity, ethics,

sustainability, and privacy, teams will craft intuitive digital experiences

that make responsible choices simple and engaging — from transparent

donation platforms to ethical identity interfaces. This is not a coding

hackathon.

IEEE TECHNOLOGY AND ENGINEERING MANAGEMENT SOCIETY ( IEEE-TEMS)

BENGALI LITERARY ASSOCIATION (AIKYATAAN)

Event Name : Culturix

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY

Event Details : Culturix organized by IEEE-TEMS in collaboration with BLA,

challenges participants to build technology-driven solutions leveraging

Web3 for social responsibility, inspired by culture, community, and

societal needs. Teams will ideate, design, and pitch innovative solutions

that are globally relevant, with culture serving only as inspiration.

CUBING CLUB

Event Name : Script Showdown

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 12 PM

Venue : CS HALL

Event Details : Script Showdown is a head‑to‑head programming battle where

two participants (one from each team) are brought on stage to solve

rapid‑fire questions on core programming concepts. Each duel tests how well

participants understand logic, data structures, syntax, and debugging under

time pressure. The event is designed to be entertaining for the audience

while showcasing clean thinking, code clarity, and problem‑solving speed.

VIT MODEL UNITED NATIONS SOCIETY (VITMUN)

Event Name : MUNtra 2.0

Date : 14-02-2026 to 15-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 5 PM

Venue : RAJAJI HALL

Event Details :The MUN Society’s two-day workshop, explores how Web3

technologies are transforming global systems. Through structured debates

and role-based discussions, participants will examine topics such as data

ownership, digital sovereignty, cross-border payments, decentralised

identity, and governance of borderless platforms. The workshop progresses

from Web3 fundamentals to real-world geopolitical and social responsibility

challenges, encouraging critical analysis of how technology influences

global power structures and international cooperation.

DREAM MERCHANTS

Event Name : TECHCRAFT 2.0

Date : 14-02-2026

Time : 1 PM to 8 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details :TechCraft 2.0 is a three-round, skill-based competitive

event designed to evaluate participants on financial awareness, strategic

thinking, design sense, and communication skills without requiring any

coding background. The event is structured to progress logically from

knowledge testing to solution building and finally to pitching, ensuring

consistent engagement and a realistic professional environment throughout

the day. It is carefully designed to remain accessible for beginners while

still being competitive for strong thinkers, making it suitable for

students from all academic backgrounds.

subject: Invitation for the VAC titled,"Millimeter Wave Radar and its applications-VAC2413"-attached -reg
body:
Dear All,

Department of Communication Engineering, School of Electronics Engineering,

VIT, Vellore is delighted to announce a value added course titled, “Millimeter

Wave Radar and its applications-VAC2413”, scheduled on

9-02-2025,11-02-2025,16-02-2025,02-3-2025 and 9-3-2025

The objective of the course is 

· To give an exposure to the radar system and the millimeter wave

radar systems

· To develop some applications using real time data from existing

millimeter wave radars namely

Ø Texas Instrument’s IWR6843-Single-chip 60-GHz to 64-GHz

Ø Infineon radar kit-BGT60TR13C

 To understand the domain possible applications like 1). Medical

applications,2). Robotics and automation applications,3). Automotive

applications,4). Security and surveillance and civilian applications, 5).

Milli meter wave radar with machine learning for detecting simple human

activity recognition(HAR) studies along with the reference paper is given

the following review paper (Given in the attachment).

A. Soumya, C. Krishna Mohan and Linga Reddy Cenkeramaddi, “Recent Advances

in mmWave-Radar-Based Sensing, Its Applications, and Machine Learning

Techniques: A Review”, Sensors 2023, 23, 8901

Interested UG /PG students and research scholars can register using

following link:

VIT Events https://events.vit.ac.in/

Last date for applying is 8-02-2025 –limited seats are available

body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Santri secured the position of 1st

Runner-Up at the E-Summit 2026 conducted by Indian Institute of Technology

Madras. The team participated in the flagship entrepreneurship event,

E-Thletics

2026, representing the institution among 50+ teams and over 250

participants from across the country.

The competition comprised multiple rigorous rounds of pitching and

strategic evaluation, where the team showcased exceptional innovation,

strategic thinking, and entrepreneurial acumen to emerge as the 1st

Runner-Up.

Team Members:

1. Mehul Arora – 23BAI0044

2. Karan Jain – 23BAI0177

3. Trishna Tanaya – 23BIT0432

4. Riya Hebbar – 23BEE0108

We congratulate Team Santri on this remarkable achievement and wish them

continued success in their future endeavors.

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [12th November]

 events.

Today's Events:

 - Mind Meets Machine: Exploring BCI

 - Mech Face-Off 1.11

 - Blog Fury 1.11 (Automated Robotic Arm)

 - Tech Elevate 1.18

 - Elemental Eye Spy

 - Energy Reimagined: Sustainable Future

Scroll down for more information

IEEE Communications Society (IEEE ComSoc)

Event Name: Mind Meets Machine: Exploring BCI

Time: 09:30AM to 12:00PM

Venue: VOC Gallery, TT (OFFLINE)

Event Description: IEEE COMSOC Organizes "Mind Meets Machine: Exploring

BCI". Join us for an exciting session on Brain-Computer Interface (BCI)

technology, where we dive into the fascinating world of connecting the

human brain with digital systems. Discover how BCI enables direct

communication between neural activity and computers, opening up new

possibilities in fields like healthcare, assistive technology, and beyond.

Registration: VTOP registration

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/vitieeecomsoc/

American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME-VIT)

Event Name: Mech Face-Off 1.11

Event Description: Get ready for ASME-VIT's Mech Face Off 1.11! In this

intense debate, Direct Injection vs Port Injection take centre stage, each

competing for the title of the technology for fuel injection. Our debaters

will explore the mechanics, performance, and sustainability of each

approach, shedding light on the future of fuel injections techniques. Which

technology will shape the course for tomorrow’s future? Join us for an

insightful exploration into the future of innovation!

 

Event Venue: GDN G07 (offline)

Registration: VTOP

American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME-VIT)

Event Name: Blog Fury 1.11 (Automated Robotic Arm)

Time: 4:30 PM to 6:00 PM

Prepare for an exciting edition blog fury! This time, writers will explore

the cutting-edge world of automated robotic arms, highlighting the design,

versatility, and applications of this remarkable technology. From

revolutionizing manufacturing to enhancing precision in various fields,

robotic arms represent the forefront of industrial automation. Could these

mechanical innovations be the key to future technological breakthroughs?

Join us as our bloggers uncover the potential of robotic arms and share

insights that could transform the future of automation and industry!

Event Venue: GDN G07

Registration: VTOP

American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME-VIT)

Event Name: Tech Elevate 1.18

Time: 11:00 A.M. - 1:00 P.M.

Join us at Tech Elevate 1.18 for an engaging session on Automotive NVH

(Noise, Vibration, and Harshness) Engineering! This talk dives into the

science of reducing unwanted noise, vibrations, and discomfort in vehicles,

enhancing overall comfort. Our expert speaker will cover key aspects of NVH

analysis, including source identification, simulations, testing, and design

optimization. Discover how cutting-edge materials and engineering methods

are driving advancements in vehicle performance.

Event Venue: CDMM 304

Registration: VTOP

The Catalyst Club

Event Name : Elemental Eye Spy

Event Time :2:00 pm to 3:30 pm

Event Venue : TT 513

Event Description: The Catalyst Club will be hosting a game-show styled

event where students participate in pairs and attempt a quick and engaging

game of identifying chemistry visuals (elements, lab equipment,

scientists). Each picture will set a playful tone for an interactive and

visually engaging event.

Registration Link: Register on VTOP

Institute of Industrial and Systems Engineers

Event Name: Energy Reimagined: Sustainable Future

Event Time: 11am to 12:30pm

Event Venue: GDN120

Description: Join us for an event focused on SDG Goal 7: Affordable and

Clean Energy, where our chapter members will share insights about the

future of renewable energy. The event aims to enlighten students about the

sustainable development goals and inspire them to contribute to a cleaner

and more sustainable energy future.

Registration: VTOP

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred to as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for

each paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev → Summer

Semester 2025-26→Paper Seeing. You can choose the course(s) you want to

apply for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, after 24 hours, the paper and question wise

marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need to use

the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After seeing

the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is not

sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need to

recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reasons for the same in the comments section

available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also need to be paid through the online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated only

after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and are in online mode only.

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by the CoE office . For

other components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode

courses) there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Summer Semester 2025-26

examination malpractices are not eligible for the paper seeing/

Re-valuation process.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

body: It was the Spring of 1979. I was just a tall, goofy looking kid in middle school with buck-teeth and freckles. Each day in the cafeteria, I walked from table to table ... Stealing other kids' lunch money. No, I didn't rob them with a gun or a knife - I just made them a little deal. "Let me borrow two dollars today," I said, "and I'll bring you five dollars next week." The investment was too good to pass up, and other kids were throwing their lunch money at me like gravy on mashed potatoes. Of course when "next week" rolled around and I couldn't pony up the cash, I promised to pay them even more the week after that, if they would just let me keep their investment a little bit longer. Eventually the end of the year came and went, high school started and with it came girls, and homework, and parties, and sports, and those poor kids from eighth grade had more things on their mind than last year's lunch money. subject: Congratulations to Our Best Outgoing Students – University Day & Annual Sports Day 2025
body:
Dear VITians,

On the momentous occasion of University Day & Annual Sports Day 2025 held

on 5th April 2025, we proudly celebrated the outstanding achievements of

our students. Among these, the Best Outgoing Students were honored for

their exceptional academic performance, leadership, and contributions to

the VIT community.

The prestigious Chancellor’s Gold Medal was awarded to the Best Outgoing

Engineering Student, while the Chancellor’s Special Awards recognized

excellence in six other categories: Non-Engineering, Three-Year UG,

Two-Year PG, Five-Year Integrated, Foreign, and NRI.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to the following winners:

Chancellor's Gold Medal (Engineering Category) - Ms. SHRUJANA K 

(21BBT0027)

"Shrujana, a final-year Biotechnology student at VIT Vellore, is a

dedicated researcher passionate about developing targeted therapeutics for

chronic illnesses. She has interned at prestigious institutes like IBAB,

InSTEM, MITACS, and Anthem Biosciences. As President of Brisa VIT, she

earned accolades from Toastmasters International for her contributions to

public speaking. Additionally, serving as a program representative and

student council member secretary honed her leadership and interpersonal

skills. Committed to scientific excellence, she aspires to pursue higher

education at top institutions and return to India as a researcher,

contributing meaningfully to the nation's scientific community."

Chancellor's Special Award (Non Engineering Category) - Ms. KISHORATHI D

K (21BAG0020)

"Kishorathi DK, a passionate B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture student at VIT, is

dedicated to advancing the agricultural sector while honoring a

five-generation family legacy. Committed to excellence, she has served as a

Program Representative for two consecutive years and as Vice Chairperson of

the Solai Club, showcasing her leadership and teamwork skills. Actively

participating in various VIT clubs and chapters, she has strengthened her

communication and organizational abilities. With a deep-rooted passion for

agriculture, she strives to make a meaningful impact in the field,

contributing to sustainable practices and community development."

Chancellor's Special Award (3 Year UG Category) - Ms. CHAMAN TAHSEEN K

N (22BHM0010)

"Chaman Tahseen, a final-year B.Sc. Hotel and Tourism Management student,

holds a stellar CGPA of 9.88 and has ranked first for five consecutive

semesters. A dynamic leader, he has served as Programme Representative,

Member Secretary, and now Executive Member of the Student Council. Gaining

hands-on experience, he interned at Vitara Guest House and contributed to

events like Gravitas, Yantra, and themed hospitality weeks. Beyond

academics, he channels his passion for baking into his home bakery, Brownie

and Cream in Ambur. With a blend of leadership, creativity, and excellence,

he aspires to make a mark in the hospitality industry."

Chancellor's Special Award (5 Year Integrated Category) - Ms. DURGA

SHREE N (20MIS0054)

"Durga Shree N is an accomplished researcher, having received prestigious

scholarships such as the Future Research Talent Award (Australia), DAAD

WISE (Germany), Mitacs Globalink (Canada), and the Khorana Scholarship

(USA). She is currently completing her final-year project at the

Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, Harvard, applying AI in cancer therapeutics.

With multiple research publications and conference presentations, she has

demonstrated academic excellence. As Head of Operations and Co-Secretary of

Sigma Xi at VIT, she promoted research awareness and mentored aspiring

researchers. Passionate about data science, she aims to bridge AI and life

sciences, driving impactful, data-driven innovations."

Chancellor's Special Award (2 Year PG Category) - Mr. ARUN KUMAR M 

(23MTW0026)

"Arun Kumar M is an interdisciplinary professional with a Master of Social

Work from VIT and a background in Mechanical Engineering. A Tamil Nadu

Chief Minister’s Fellow (2024–26) with the National Health Mission, he has

also earned the prestigious National Child Rights Research Fellowship

(NCRRF) from CRY, Mumbai. His diverse experience spans industrial

engineering, public policy, and community health, with internships at the

Centre for Public Policy Research and Christian Medical College. A

Chancellor’s Special Awardee and UGC NET JRF qualifier, he is pursuing a

postgraduate certificate in Public Policy at BIM Trichy, committed to

impactful community development."

Chancellor's Special Award - Best Performing Student (NRI) - Mr. BRYAN

ANTHONY GONSALVES (22BCS0180)

"Bryan Gonsalves is an outstanding student at VIT, excelling in academics,

leadership, and innovation. As Member Secretary of the Student Council and

a Senior Core Member of IEEE-CS, he spearheaded impactful events and

workshops. He secured a dream offer from PwC and contributed to fintech

development at FinMitr. His victory at the Toastmasters Toast-a-Thon

highlights his exceptional communication skills. Consistently ranking among

the top students, Bryan exemplifies excellence and initiative. With a

strong foundation in technology and leadership, he is poised to make

significant contributions to the industry."

Chancellor's Special Award - Best Performing Student (Foreign)- Mr. ISHAN

JAIN (21BCE3959)

"Ishan Jain, a BTech Computer Science student from Nepal, has been an

integral part of the VIT Vellore community, excelling in academics,

leadership, and cultural initiatives. As a two-year Student Council member,

he represented over 600 foreign students, advocating for their needs. He

spearheaded the Nepali New Year celebration, contributed significantly to

Yantra '25, and played a key role in events by the Office of Students'

Welfare. His leadership in multi-college fests and high-pressure events

showcases his dedication and adaptability. Ishan’s passion, persistence,

and commitment have left a lasting impact on the university community."

Each of these students has demonstrated excellence in academics,

leadership, and involvement in various clubs and chapters, setting a

benchmark for their peers. Their journey at VIT is an inspiration to all,

and we take immense pride in their achievements.

We wish them great success in their future endeavors and look forward to

seeing them make a meaningful impact in their respective fields.

Our next webinar is on the 14th August 14.30 IST on Future of Robotics by

Professor Nabil Aouf.

for the webinar:

https://city-ac-uk.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZIocO-qrT4pH9wjuRrZ2J3mf6BjnXmOyGkj

City student webinar for partner universities • City, University of London

https://connect.city.ac.uk/city/sst/city-student-webinar-for-partner-universities/_nocache

Each month will feature a new topic, delivered by an expert within the

field, and will showcase research and teaching currently taking place

within the School. Sessions will consist of an hour’s lecture followed by

30 minutes for audience questions. The webinars are designed for students

and are offered to all students from our partner universities in

India. Staff from partner universities are also welcome to attend.

subject: Project Type Courses under Discipline / Open Electives category
body:
Kind Attn:

1) 2023 & 2024 Batch B. Tech Students of all the Programmes (Except BBS

Programme)

2) 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025 Batch MSc Integrated (5 Years) Programmes of SAS

& SBST

Dear Student,

The following project type courses are listed in the curriculum, and those

who are interested in working on any of these project type courses may

refer to the content of this mail and proceed further.

Project Type Courses under Discipline / Open Electives category

1) Simulation Project

2) Special Project

3) Reading Course

4) Product Development Project

5) Design Project

6) Technical Answers to Real Problems Project

There are six project type courses for B. Tech Programmes and three / four

courses for 5 Year Integrated Non-Engineering Programmes (SAS & SBST) as

mentioned below:

PROJECT TYPE COURSES - 3 CREDITS FOR ALL THE COURSES

SCHOOL SIMULATION PROJECT SPECIAL PROJECT READING

COURSE PRODUCT DEVELOPMENT PROJECT DESIGN PROJECT TARP

SBST BBIT398J BBIT397J BBIT396J BBIT394J BBIT392J BBIT391J

SCHEME BCHE398J BCHE397J BCHE396J BCHE394J BCHE392J BCHE391J

SCE BCLE398J BCLE397J BCLE396J BCLE394J BCLE392J BCLE391J

SCOPE BCSE398J BCSE397J BCSE396J BCSE394J BCSE392J BCSE391J

SENSE BECE398J BECE397J BECE396J BECE394J BECE392J BECE391J

SELECT BEEE398J BEEE397J BEEE396J BEEE394J BEEE392J BEEE391J

SELECT BEIE398J BEIE397J BEIE396J BEIE394J BEIE392J BEIE391J

SITE BITE398J BITE397J BITE396J BITE394J BITE392J BITE391J

SMEC BMEE398J BMEE397J BMEE396J BMEE394J BMEE392J BMEE391J

SBST TBIT397J TBIT392J TBIT391J

SAS TCHY397J TCHY392J

SBST TFSI397J TFSI392J TFSI391J

SAS TMAT397J TMAT392J

SAS TPHY397J TPHY392J

Guidelines for course registration and evaluation process

# Students are advised to check the curriculum and plan accordingly.

For the students of B. Tech Core Programmes, this project type course will

be considered under Programme Elective Category and for the students of

"Specialization Programmes", it will be considered under "Open Elective

Category". If the students of "Specialization Programmes" have already

earned sufficient credits under "Open Elective Category", then it is not

necessary to register for this project type course.

# Students are expected to form a team and identify a faculty guide

from any School to initiate the process.

# Project Team should comprise a minimum of two to a maximum of five

students only from any B. Tech Programme of any School / Five Year

Integrated Programme as applicable. (students of B. Tech Programme and Five

Year Integrated Programme can not be in the same team)

# Domain specific / Interdisciplinary / Multidisciplinary /

Cross-disciplinary projects are encouraged.

# Guide will finalize the tentative title / area of the work and

the team of students to work on each project. Course Registration is opened on

VTOP Login for the faculty members (Guide). (Preliminary discussion between

the guide and the student is essential)

# Students can work for one project type course at any point of

time.

# Course Registration will be done by the respective Guide only. The

Guide will fill in the necessary data (Project title and the

Registration Number

of all the students proposed to work on each of the projects) on VTOP

Faculty Login.

# Subsequently, the course will reflect on the list of registered

courses for that particular semester on VTOP Student Login. This

three-credit course will not affect the upper limit of 27 credits allowed

for a regular semester.

# Once the Project work is completed and a tangible outcome (Research

/ Review Paper published/accepted in Scopus / WoS, Journal / Conference

Proceedings: Product Design / Patent Application) is reached, the Guide

will post the marks out of 100 for each student on VTOP and submit.

# HoDs will be given access to verify the outcome (Paper / Patent

etc) and approve for further processing.

# Absolute Grading System will be followed for the listed project

 type courses as per VIT Grading Policy

Faculty Members are requested to note the message and proceed accordingly.

Project Course Registration is enabled for all the faculty members on "VTOP

- Faculty Login"

 fields

 and related industries seeking to apply geospatial insights

 and Global Positioning System (GPS) technologies are transforming industries

 Spatial Sciences Institute

 and simulation to solve real-world problems

Constitution Day of India

Constitution Day also known as 'Samvidhan Divas', is celebrated in India on

26th November every year to commemorate the adoption of the Constitution of

India. On 26th November 1949, the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the

Constitution of India, which came into effect on 26th January 1950.

The Government of India declared 26 November as Constitution Day on 19

November 2015 by a gazette notification.

Constitution Day of India

On November 26 every year, India celebrates National Milk Day to

commemorate the efforts of Dr Verghese Kurien, the brain behind the White

Revolution. Dr Kurien played an instrumental role in the development of the

dairy industry. His efforts also made India self-sufficient as far as its

dairy needs were concerned.

Earlier, in 1970, the NDDB embarked on Operation Flood, a national

development project to establish a milk grid countrywide. White Revolution

is one of the largest programmes, called Operation Flood, which made India

one of the largest milk and its derivative providers on a global scale.

Whether you’re looking to get started with foundational knowledge or build deeper expertise, stay at the forefront of a rapidly evolving technology landscape.

Learn more  

New OCI Courses to Expand Your Cloud and AI Skills 

  The AI for You  course introduces you to core AI concepts and demonstrates their application across industries and Oracle Fusion Applications. You’ll learn how to leverage AI in real-world business scenarios, regardless of your technical background. Note: These courses are a great starting point for someone new to the cloud. Once you finish these and earn your completion badges, you can move on to the OCI Foundations Associate training and certification.

Validate your cloud expertise, maintain your certification with new features and enhancements, and boost team impact with these globally recognized credentials. Oracle University provides comprehensive learning paths and resources to best prepare you for certification exams.

Interested in maximizing your Oracle Cloud investment? We’ve got you covered. Our special episodes are packed with insider tips on Oracle Cloud Success Navigator and Fusion Cloud Applications. Discover how to streamline your cloud adoption, reduce risk, and accelerate innovation using Oracle’s cutting-edge AI tools, best practices, and personalized guidance.

subject: Congratulations Team-VIT V at iGEM 2024 Grand Jamboree-reg
body:
Dear VITian's,

We are delighted to inform you that our team VIT-V has represented VIT

Vellore and won a Silver Medal in the iGEM 2024 Grand Jamboree held at

Paris, France. VIT-V had the privilege of representing VIT in the 2024

International Genetically Engineered Machine (iGEM) competition. iGEM is a

renowned global synthetic biology competition that brings together students

to develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges through

bioengineering. The 2024 iGEM competition had over 4,500 participants. A

total of 400 teams from more than 50 countries competed this year,

fostering an environment of creativity, collaboration, and

interdisciplinary problem-solving.

Team VIT-V's Project

The project addresses high UV Index levels in Vellore, which contribute to

an increased risk of skin cancer. Under the guidance of our PI Dr. R. Siva

and Co-PI Dr. Kannan P, we engineered Escherichia coli to produce

carotenoids—natural pigments with antioxidant properties that can be used

for eco-friendly, broad-spectrum UV protection in skincare. This approach

supports both skin health and environmental sustainability.

Below is the list of the team members:

 1. D S Nishanth (21MSI0083)

 2. Pranjali Bhagat (21BBT0348)

 3. Naisarg Patel (22BBT0278)

 4. Ananya Pai (21BBT0093)

 5. Johan George (22BBT0245)

 11. Urvi Sinha (21BBT0223)

 12. ⁠Tanvi Duarah (21BBT0194)

 14. Mohak Bhattacharyya (22BBT0174)

 15. Aadithya Hrudhay (22BCB0044)

 16. Swasti Tyagi (21BBT0326)

We are immensely proud to see Team VIT-V on such a global platform and hope

this accomplishment inspires further participation and innovation. Please

join us in congratulating the team members under the guidance of Dr. R Siva

(Dean-SBST) and Dr. Kannan P, (Asst. Professor Sr. Grade 1-SBST). This

recognition is a testament to our team's hard work, collaboration, and

innovative efforts in synthetic biology.

subject: IEEE Women In Engineering Newsletter
body:
Dear Readers,

We are pleased to share with you the IEEE Women in Engineering Newsletter

2025.

This edition captures the journey of our chapter over the past year,

highlighting technical workshops, our flagship event 'Switchuation', alumni

sessions, competitions, social initiatives, and the remarkable achievements

of our members. It reflects our collective efforts, growth, and continued

commitment to fostering an inclusive and empowering engineering community.

We hope this newsletter provides an insightful overview of our initiatives

and inspires you to stay engaged with IEEE Women in Engineering. Your

presence and participation continue to shape and strengthen our community.

We invite you to stay connected with IEEE Women in Engineering through our

official social media platforms for future updates and initiatives.

Email: ieeewie@vit.ac.in

Instagram: @ieee_wie_vit

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ieee-women-in-engineering-vit/

Please find the newsletter attached.

Students from the first year / advanced years of their respective programme

(who have not applied earlier) and satisfy all the eligibility criteria

subject: LinkedIn | CoachIn Program 2026 | Registration Open- B. Tech/B.E across streams with no backlogs and graduating in 2028.
body:
LinkedIn | CoachIn Program 2026 | Registration Open

Greetings from LinkedIn!

We are excited to extend an exclusive invitation to your institution to

participate in CoachIn 2026, an initiative dedicated to empowering and

shaping the next generation of women engineers. This program is uniquely

crafted to provide your talented students with industry exposure,

mentorship, and personalized guidance from LinkedIn’s professionals.

Why Partner with CoachIn 2026?

Our vision is to bridge the gap between academic learning and industry

readiness, fostering a new wave of confident, skilled, and

industry-prepared women engineers. This program brings an opportunity to

your students to gain personalized coaching, industry insights, and a

platform to learn from experts.

What’s in it for Your Students?

•

Personalized Guidance: 1:1 mentoring for tailored support from experienced

mentors

•

Learning Paths: Curated learning path and resources on Problem Solving,

Data Structures and Algorithms.

•

Real-world Simulations: Monthly live session for problem-solving and

solution discussions

•

Engagement Sessions: Tech Talks, Fireside Chats, and more to inspire and

inform

•

Performance Tracking: Continuous improvement with feedback sessions

•

Mock Tests and Interviews: Simulate real-world scenarios for confident

performance

•

As an exciting bonus, they will also get an opportunity to interview for

LinkedIn’s Summer Internship program

Eligibility Criteria:

•

All women engineering students across India pursuing B. Tech/B.E across

streams with no backlogs and graduating in 2028.

•

Required to have a minimum 7 CGPA across two years of engineering degree.

Duration Of Program : Feb 2026 to June 2026

Participation Process: Interested students are encouraged to apply

through the link: [Click here]

https://welcomein.my.canva.site/coachin-2026.

Shortlisted candidates will be invited for a Hacker rank assessment

followed by Telephonic discussion, and the 100 Women engineering students

nationwide will be selected to join CoachIn program as mentees.

Call to Action for Universities:

•

We invite universities to promote this initiative among your students.

•

Attached is the digital poster that we would request you to put across the

university digital platform.

subject: 12th September - Today's events by Clubs and Chapters- reg
body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [12th September]

events

Today's Events:

 - “Sanskriti”- Arunima

 - Visualizing Hope: Suicide Prevention

 - Innovations in Wireless Communication

 - CASA: Healing Hearts and Minds

 - Property Odyssey (Finance carnival)

 - Tech Elevate 1.13

 - “Sanskriti"- Bookmark Designing competition

 - Sanskriti - Amigos et Amis: A cultural Celebration

 - Sanskriti - The Last Lesson

 - Anti-Addiction Screening!

Scroll down for more information

Kannada Literary Association (Kannada Kasthuri Club)

Event name: “Sanskriti”- Arunima

Time: 5pm - 8pm

Venue: Greenos

Event description: Arunima is a Kannada Cultural event to be conducted at

greenos.

This evening is a cultural extravaganza, celebrating Karnataka's rich

heritage through soulful singing, instrumental classics and energetic

dances inspired from Karnataka's folklore and movies. Join us for ultimate

fun and immerse yourself in the beauty of Kannada with us. We look forward

to seeing you there

REGISTRATION: VTOP

INSTITUTE OF INDUSTRIAL AND SYSTEMS ENGINEERS (IISE)

Event Name: Visualizing Hope: Suicide Prevention

Event Time: 2.30pm to 5.30pm

Description: Join us for a digital poster-making competition dedicated to

raising awareness about suicide prevention. This event invites artists,

graphic designers, and creative minds to use their talents to create

powerful and inspiring posters that convey messages of hope, support, and

mental health awareness. The competition is designed to inspire, educate,

and provoke thought through the power of visual art.

Event Platform: SJT606 (offline)

Registration: VTOP

IEEE-MICROWAVE THEORY AND TECHNIQUES SOCIETY (IEEE-MTTS)

Event Name: Innovations in Wireless Communication

Time: 9:00 am to 6:00 pm

Platform: Google Form

Event Description: This event focuses on the latest innovations in wireless

communication, introducing participants to modern developments such as 5G

technology, the Internet of Things (IoT), millimeter-wave communication,

and other emerging trends. Conducted as a Google Forms-based quiz with

simple, accessible questions, it provides insights into the current state

of wireless communication technologies and their future applications.

Designed to foster learning and awareness in an interactive manner, the

event is suitable for a broad audience interested in this rapidly evolving

field.

Registration: VTOP >> SW events >> Event Registration >> 🔎IEEE-MTTS

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/vit.ieee.mtts?igsh=cWdrcHBsaWNwcW41

LinkedIn link: https://www.linkedin.com/company/ieee-mtts-vit/mycompany/

Mozilla Firefox Club

Event Name : CASA: Healing Hearts and Minds

Time: 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM

Venue : Rajaji Hall

Event Description: Join us for an enlightening session on "Substance Abuse"

led by Dr. Mohd Owais Khan as part of the CASA (Campaign against substance

abuse). This offline event will delve into the critical issues surrounding

substance abuse, its impact on individuals and communities, and effective

prevention and recovery strategies. Dr.Mohd owais Khan, a renowned expert,

will offer valuable insights and engage participants in a meaningful

discussion to raise awareness and promote a healthier, substance-free life.

Event Registration: VTOP registration.

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/mfc_vit/

X :https://x.com/mfc_vit?t=vzRTWjhesLwFLpdQodugGQ&s=09

Bulls and Bears

Event Name: Property Odyssey (Finance carnival)

Time: 08:00 AM - 07:00 PM

Venue: Foodys

Event Details: It is an engaging event on the theme of Real Estate. In the

event, participants would be provided with a city map with different kinds

of plots and the profile of these plots. Students are expected to make

calculations and make prudential decisions of investment and analyse

potential return on investments over a period of time scaled down to the

event duration.

Registration link: VTOP Registration

Instagram link: https://instagram.com/bullsandbears_vit/

American Society of Mechanical Engineers (ASME-VIT)

Event Name: Tech Elevate 1.13

Time: 5:30 PM to 7:00 PM

Event Platform: Google Meet

Event Description: Prepare to be inspired as we delve into the cutting-edge

world of technology and innovation at Tech-Elevate 1.13. Hosted by

ASME-VIT, this captivating speaker session will feature a renowned expert,

Mr. Aliyar Javedi sharing their insights on the latest trends and

advancements in the field of mechanical engineering. Don't miss this unique

opportunity to elevate your knowledge at Tech Elevate!

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/asme.vit/

Design club- pixelate 

Event name: “Sanskriti"- Bookmark Designing competition

Time: 10:30pm - 4:30pm

Venue: VOC gallery (TT)

Event description: Design club pixelate presents Bookmark Designing

Competition. This event invites participants to channel their creativity

into crafting unique and visually engaging bookmarks that reflect the

spirit of literature. Open to all, the competition encourages both

traditional and digital art forms. Showcase your artistic talents and

contribute to a celebration of literature through your designs, making

reading even more delightful for everyone.

REGISTRATION: VTOP

https://www.instagram.com/pixelatevit?igsh=MXdmczgwZjk5dG56Ng==

FLA 

Event name: Sanskriti - Amigos et Amis: A cultural Celebration

Time: 2 to 3pm

Venue: Ambedkar Auditorium

Event description: Join us for a lively night at the French and Spanish

Literary Association's Dance Extravaganza! Dive into a vibrant blend of

French and Spanish music and dance. Enjoy dynamic live performances, pick

up new dance moves, and celebrate with friends. Everyone is invited!

Experience an evening brimming with exciting music, enchanting dance, and

rich cultural fusion. Do not miss out let the fiesta start!

Registration: On VTop

FLA

Event name: Sanskriti - The Last Lesson

Event time: 3 to 6pm

Event description: Join us for an unforgettable evening as the German and

French Literary Association present a compelling skit based on the poignant

story "The Last Lesson." Experience a dramatic portrayal that explores

themes of loss, nostalgia, and the power of language. Witness our talented

actors bring this moving narrative to life, offering a unique cultural

perspective. All are welcome to this engaging and emotional performance.

Refrigeration: on VTop

The Otaku Club

Event Name: Anti-Addiction Screening!

Time: 10:00 am to 1:00 pm

Venue: Ambedkar Auditorium

Event Details: The Otaku Club brings you their CASA event for the year 2024

a very informative screening where we will be showing "Zootopia". This is

a well structured commentary on societal exclusion and harmful effects of

drugs and stimulants on the mind. It aims to promote an inclusive society

where everyone supports each other and can pull one other out of struggling

circumstances through hope and compassion rather than ostracization and

exclusion. We'll also be having a guest speaker- Dr. Rita Bhattacharya-

Head Counsellor in VIT, to talk about these important topics after the

movie screening is done!

Registration: VTOP registration

https://www.instagram.com/theotakuclub_vit?igsh=dnFjcGp6bjZhZDly

subject: Proctor-Proctee hackathon - Yantra'26: Registration Live!
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings from the Office of Students’ Welfare!

We are pleased to announce the 2nd Edition of Proctor–Proctee Hackathon,

an exciting collaborative event conducted as part of the 6th Edition of Yantra

2026. This hackathon brings together proctors and proctees on a common

platform to collaborate, innovate, and develop impactful solutions to

real-world problem statements.

In this unique format, proctors will mentor and guide, while proctees

actively design and build solutions, fostering creativity, teamwork, and

hands-on problem-solving. Proctors may form teams with one or more

proctees, irrespective of their year of study, encouraging cross-year

collaboration and knowledge exchange.

This hackathon offers an excellent opportunity to strengthen

problem-solving skills, explore innovative ideas, and showcase creativity

in a supportive and collaborative environment.

Event Details:

 - Dates: 7th February 2026 – 8th February 2026

 - Venue: CS Hall

The tracks and detailed problem statements for the hackathon are attached

with this mail as a PDF for your reference.

Registration Link: https://forms.gle/jQgxTbhQaUvNjZU17

The registration deadline is 5 February 2026. Please note that only

proctors are allowed to fill out the Google Form.

For any queries, please feel free to reach out to us at yantra.sw@vit.ac.in

<yantra.sw@vit.ac.in>

Student Coordinator : Om Tilva - 9448437476

We look forward to your enthusiastic participation and active involvement

in making this event a grand success.

Project44 hiring interns for Chennai office :

Please find the internship details below:

We are looking students from M.Tech/M.Tech Integrated CSE

related background Students 

 B.Tech/B.Tech

Integrated CSE related background Students 

Eligibility criteria – 9 CGPA throughout

Note : B. Tech students should have completed all the required credits and

no subjects/Credits pending in the 7th & 8th semester.

Internship Details:

 -

 Company website : https://www.project44.com/

 - Job Location: Chennai

 -

 Duration: 6 Months ( 13th July 2026 to 13th Jan 2027)

 -

 Start Date: 3rd Week of July

 -

 Office Schedule: 5 days a week

 -

 Full-Time Conversion: Based on performance

 -

 Number of Positions: 4

 -

Stipend : 1,35,000 per month 

Selection Process:

 1. Technical Discussion

 2. Hiring Manager Round via Zoom

Why project44?

At project44 we’re on a mission - to make supply chains work.

project44 optimizes the movement of products globally, delivering better

resiliency, sustainability, and value for our customers. As the supply

chain connective tissue, we operate the most trusted end-to-end visibility

platform that tracks more than 1 billion shipments annually for the world’s

leading brands. The undisputed leader in the market, project44 was named

the Leader in the Gartner Magic Quadrant, #1 in FreightWaves’ FreightTech

25, and the Customer’s Choice in Gartner Peer Insights’ Voice of the

Customer report. project44 is headquartered in Chicago with a diverse and

fast-growing, global workforce.

If you’re eager to be part of a winning team that works together to solve

some of the most challenging supply chain challenges every day, let’s talk.

Description:

project44 is looking for a Intern - Software Engineer to join our

engineering team. You will work in a fast-paced Agile environment

designing, building, and implementing best-in-class products for our

customers around the world.

What we look for:

 - Java/Python as a programming language. Experience with SQL queries

 will be a plus.

 - Exposure to any one cloud platform.

 - Hands on AI exposure like Clude code.

 - Creating large scale micro-services (preferably leveraging Java,

 Spring Boot and the Spring portfolio)

 - Creating API's/web services: REST, OpenAPI/Swagger, etc.

 - Container-orchestration: Docker & Kubernetes

 - Enjoy database related work: MongoDB, Postgres, Snowflake

 - Real-time or near real-time streaming work in Kafka or another similar

 technology

 - Analytical approach to problem solving

 - Personal drive and maintaining a high pace - while taking

 responsibility for things working

 - Willingness to vocalize your ideas and pick yourself up if you get

 knocked down

 - Don't have everything listed? No problem! We'd still like to hear from

 you

In-office Commitment: This position requires a commitment to contribute

to our collaborative culture by working in-office Five days weekly. Location

: Chennai

Diversity & Inclusion

At project44, we're designing the future of how the world moves and is

connected through trade and global supply chains. As we work to deliver a

truly world-class product and experience, we are also intentionally

building teams that reflect the unique communities we serve. We’re focused

on creating a company where all team members can bring their authentic

selves to work every day.

We’re building a company that every one of us at project44 is proud to work

for, and our journey of becoming a more diverse, equitable and inclusive

organization, where all have a sense of belonging, is shaped through the

actions of our leadership, global teams, and individual team members. We

are resolute in our belief that each team member has an equal

responsibility to mold and uphold our culture.

project44 is an equal opportunity employer seeking to enrich our work

environment by creating opportunities for individuals of all backgrounds

and experiences to thrive. If you share our values and our passion for

helping the way the world moves, we’d love to review your application!

For any accommodation needed during the hiring process, . Even if you don’t

meet 100% of the above job description you should still seriously consider

applying. Studies show that you can still be considered for a role if you

meet just 50% of the role’s requirements.

More about project44

Since 2014, project44 has been transforming the way one of the largest,

most important global industries does business. As transportation and

logistics continue to evolve and customer expectations around delivery

become more demanding, industry technology must rise to the occasion. In

just a few short years, we have created a digital infrastructure that

eliminates the inefficiencies caused by dated technology and manual

processes. Our Advanced Visibility Platform is used by the world’s leading

brands to track shipments, collaborate with supply chain partners, drive

operational efficiencies, and create outstanding customer experiences.

neopat on or before 30-06-2026 (2 pm).

Note : B. Tech students should have completed all the required credits and

no subjects/Credits pending in the 7th & 8th semester.

body:
Dear Students,

The preparations for Riviera’26 — VIT’s International Sports and Cultural

Festival have officially begun!

Scheduled to be held from 26th February to 1st March 2026, Riviera’26

promises to be a grand celebration of talent, culture, and sportsmanship.

We are inviting enthusiastic and dedicated students from all years and

schools to be part of the Riviera’26 Organizing Committee. This is your

chance to contribute to one of India’s most vibrant and prestigious college

fests, showcase your leadership and creativity, and be part of an

unforgettable journey.

If you are passionate about event management, hospitality, logistics,

finance, publicity, or any other aspect of organizing large-scale events,

we want you on our team!

Fill out the Google Form to express your interest:

This is to inform you about latest information of JST New Program, which

is “India Young Researchers Invitation Program”, officially released as

from Monday, September 2.

Please have a look at the link below.

https://ssp.jst.go.jp/en/india/

This program supports graduate students and postdoctoral fellows enrolled

in Indian universities and the like for a research stay in Japan to conduct

joint instruction by both countries based on the experiences of past

exchange between Japan and India.

Through the promotion of research and other activities aimed at the

acquisition of a degree or the writing of a joint paper at a Japanese or

Indian university in the future, the program aims to promote the exchange

of global "knowledge", foster human resources with international brain

cycle who will strengthen research and innovation capabilities, and develop

their careers and activities in Japan.

subject: Information session on 3rd Nov'25 about the higher education opportunities in Arizona State University (ASU), USA
body:
Dear Students,

This is to inform you that

Dr.A.M. Kannan, Professor, The Polytechnic School, Graduate Program

Chair – Clean Energy Systems from Arizona State University (ASU), USA,

will be visiting our campus on 3rd November 2025. 

During his visit, he would like to interact with our students on higher

education opportunities at Arizona State University, and also about the 1+1

arrangement with VIT.

Interested students can join the session on 3rd Nov'25 at 10:00 AM in the

International Relations office, Dr.MGR Block, 105.

For more details, Please contact:

Dr.J.N.V.Raghuram,

Deputy Director- International Relations

Email:ir3@vit.ac.in <Email%3Air3@vit.ac.in>

Best Regards

R Seenivasan

Director International

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [20th September]

events.

International Day of University Sport

The International Day of University Sport (IDUS) is celebrated annually on

September 20. Proposed by the International University Sports Federation

(FISU), it is officially endorsed by the United Nations Education, Science,

and Culture Organisation (UNESCO). The day aims at confirming the

importance of sport in universities and the role of universities in the

community as responsible actors for consolidating and developing quality

physical and sports education at the service of citizens.

This day is an opportunity to underline the social role played by

universities and their curricula, making sport available for everyone in

order to foster the regular practice of physical activity in the greatest

number of people. It also allows UNESCO to reaffirm its committed support

to personal and collective development through sport and education, for the

spread of a genuine sports culture, which we believe is inherent to a

culture of peace.

Today's Events:

 - Architecting the Future: Designing Scalable and Resilient Systems

 - Quiz Royale: Stirling Engine

modular design, separation of concerns, and scalable architecture for both

front-end and back-end. We'll explore patterns such as microservices,

API-first design, state management, and database optimization to ensure

seamless scalability. Gain the skills to design future-proof systems that

grow without compromising performance.

subject: Université de Tours, France - Semester Exchange students - Nominations 2026/27
body:
Kind Attention: Pre-Final year students

University of Tours, France is opening the nomination period for

mobilities starting during the first semester of the 2026/27 academic

year.

In order for you to have a holistic overview upon the aspects connected to

this matter, please find a list of useful information enumerated below.

Academic calendar for nominations and online applications - incoming

exchange students

Term dates

First semester (autumn / winter semester): 4 months (September to December)

Second semester (spring / summer semester): 5 months (January to May)

Nota bene: should you have different term dates, please think about

prioritising mobilities that fit within our framework, in order to avoid

any unpleasant situation for the selected students (example: if your second

semester starts in February / March, you should prioritise mobilities

starting in September; we would be delighted to welcome your students for a

complete academic year)

Nominations calendar

Autumn / winter semester (or full academic year): starting in September 2025

Nomination period: 23.03.2026 – 10.05.2026

Application period: 30.03.2026 – 05.06.2026

Nota bene: a second nomination period will be opened in October – November

2026 for international mobilities of studies taking place during the second

semester of the 2026/27 academic year (starting in January 2027)

Nomination process for incoming exchange students

The International Relations Office has to officially nominate the outgoing

students for international mobility at the University of Tours.

The official nomination consists in completing an online form

https://forms.office.com/e/TaWdzFXZ6g:

 - Following nominations, the students will be contacted with all the

 instructions to follow as to pre-register at UT. The nominating person

 at the International Relations Office or the concerned service will also

 receive that e-mail, for efficient monitoring.

Why choose the University of Tours to study abroad in France?

 - Course offer

 - Online course catalogue (-> course name, credits, content, hours,

 coordinator, level) – disciplinary courses

Students can use our online catalogue, that lists the most popular courses

(French/English) for exchange students: Course Catalogue for Exchange

Students. https://cces.univ-tours.fr/Accueil.php?language=EN

Beyond disciplinary courses taught in French, UT also provides students

with more than 150 courses in English in different fields (Humanities,

Science and Technology). Only a beginner-intermediate level of French is

required if students choose disciplinary courses taught in English.

They have the right to choose courses in any discipline (from all faculties

apart from medicine), provided the conditions of our interinstitutional

agreement are fulfilled (the majority of their classes must be taken within

a specific field of studies, for example), that both their academic

coordinators approve it, and that their home university will recognize the

credits obtained in a different discipline than the student’s major at the

end of the mobility, these credits being relevant to the student’s academic

project.

 - French language and culture classes

Exchange students can complete their learning agreement with French courses

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/admission-process-for-exchange-students/6-learn-french-cuefee-crl

 provided by our University Center of French as a Foreign Language

(CUEFEE). They can select up to 3 courses (up to 72 hours), that are

completely free of charge for exchange students. Each course will give

students 4 ECTS, as follows:

§ Written language (24h/semester), 4 ECTS credits

§ Oral language (24h/semester), 4 ECTS credits

§ Cultural options (20h/semester), 4 ECTS credits (from B1 level)

Classes are taught beginning with the A1 CEFR level in French to C1. This

is the main scheme for international exchange students.

 - Individual support

The University of Tours assists international exchange students prior to

their mobility with every administrative aspect related to their arrival in

France, from the online pre-registration, to the visa procedure (if

applicable), and facilitates their accommodation request in a public

student residency.

 - Visa – Campus France procedure for exchange students that are not

 European citizens (not a citizen of one of the 27 EU member states), or

 citizens of a Schengen / EEA country

 - Accommodation – housing request for public student residencies

 - Learning Agreement and online course catalogue

 - French language and culture classes

 - Academic calendar and timetable

 - Integration – we value the integration of exchange students, and

 different resources exist in order to facilitate it

 - Buddy System: a French student to support them soon after their

 arrival in Tours

 - Erasmus Student Network

 https://www.instagram.com/esntoursofficiel/: the association

 organizes cooking activities, international dinners, theme

evenings. The

 membership gives access to preferential rates for the cultural events

 organized by the international relations office of the UT and

gives them

 the right to have discounts with the partners of the

association (Ryanair,

 local stores…).

 - Cultural programme

 - International Relations Service organizes a great cultural

 program

 https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/welcome-to-ut/cultural-programme

 me for the students with visits to the chateaux of the Loire

 Valley and many other unmissable spots of the region and France.

 - In addition, the cultural service of the university organizes

 many cultural events and offers discounts to the students who have the

 cultural pass (opera, cinema, shows…).

 - Sports

§ Students have access to a wide variety of sports at the UT. They can

subscribe to the Pack’Sport and take up to 3 different sport classes a

week, absolutely free of charge! They can also do sports trainings during

week-ends on different themes (hiking at the Mont-Saint-Michel, canyoning,

skiing…) and attend sport events or wellness activities (badminton, fitness

night, rugby…).

o Orientation maps

§ A map of UT’s campuses, faculties, and student services

https://www.google.com/maps/d/u/1/edit?mid=1Oe2Q_yuy9VbAkhtfCiHYJhzh8K8iYXA&usp=sharing

§ A map allowing students to discover the city

https://www.google.com/maps/d/viewer?mid=1KeCNJLFEccVbzUZTNfD3VfNAz-ktLv0&ll=47.38009226217868%2C0.688595800000007&z=13

from

an extracurricular point of view

· Our warm welcome

As a token of hospitality and deep interest in student welfare, UT welcomes

students individually upon their arrival to help them finalize their

registration, and give them all the practical information they need for

their settling in (presentation of the different useful university

services, organized events, information about the ESN, public

transportation, etc.). UT is available before, all along and after the

mobility to answer students’ questions.

Moreover, every September, the UT gathers many actors and welcome services

of international students in a single event, the International Students

Welcome Desk.

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/admission-process-for-exchange-students

UT’s Welcome Desk team is here to direct and give students advice to ensure

a coordinated and efficient setup in Tours.

Useful information - Admission process for Exchange students

You will find detailed information on the admission process for exchange

students (registration, accommodation, visa, learning agreement) on: UT -

Admission process for Exchange students (univ-tours.fr)

https://international.univ-tours.fr/english-version/admission-process-for-exchange-students

Useful resources for partners and students - UT Promotional Materials

Please consult our official web page intended for partner institutions and

exchange students, where you will find our communication toolkits (PPT,

Dear Students and Faculty Members,

We are delighted to invite you to VIT DeepTech Pitch Day, a flagship

initiative organized by VITIST (Office of Innovation, Startup & Technology

Transfer) in collaboration with IIC-VIT and EDC-VIT. This prestigious

event brings together six accomplished investors and partners from the

global startup ecosystem, offering an unparalleled opportunity for our

innovators to engage with leading venture capital experts.

pitching iterations and mentoring interventions guided by Dr. Rajat

Pandey, Adjunct Professor, VIT, whose deep experience in international

innovation ecosystems has enabled these founders to refine their business

models, strengthen their pitch narratives, and align their propositions for

potential investment. These ventures are now ready to present at the

DeepTech Pitch Day before esteemed investors.

 For students and faculty, this event presents a rare opportunity to

witness the complete arc of investment-oriented innovation — from ideation,

validation, and pitching, to market-fit assessments and investor feedback.

Attending these sessions will provide attendees valuable insights into

preparing deep-tech startups for real-world venture evaluation.

We warmly encourage all to join, interact, and learn from seasoned

investors and innovation leaders

Dr. C Ramesh Kumar

Langchain.py, a beginner-friendly workshop introducing the foundations of

Agentic AI. This session will guide participants through loaders,

templates, chaining, and orchestration in Langchain while working with

pre-trained LLMs. Designed for absolute newcomers, Langchain.py offers a

clear and structured entry point into building smart, efficient AI

scenarios.

subject: Live Project in Machine Learning using Python
body:
Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Machine Learning program, an online live project that helps students learn and gain experience in using machine learning algorithms at Vellore Institute of Technology.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Learn the core concepts around Machine Learning algorithms

2. Become proficient in using the Google Colab Notebook for machine learning

3. Engage in data pre-processing - a critical activity to prepare data sets for building machine learning algorithms

4. Gain an understanding of supervised and unsupervised machine learning algorithms using Python libraries

5. Complete an industry-specific case project to understand the application of Machine Learning in business scenarios

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Proficiency in Machine Learning

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch:

https://www.finlatics.com/ml_application?src=vitv

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in the program. The program will impart all necessary training on Python and machine learning techniques.

Project Duration: 1 month / 2 months (on student choice)

Time Commitment: 3-4 hours per week.

Project Start: Flexible start date option on selected student choice.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

If selected, the project has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technology on the above mentioned minimal induction fee.

We are excited to have a fruitful engagement.

body:

We are delighted to share that Team BaldMann has brought laurels to VIT

with their remarkable achievement at the Cardano Hackathon Asia 2025 –

blockchain-based medical records application designed to enable secure,

privacy-focused, and efficient healthcare data sharing among key

stakeholders, including patients, doctors, hospitals, and insurance

providers.

subject: 5G University Program-Qualcomm Academy
body:
Dear all,

Greetings!

I am excited to announce that the School of Electronics Engineering at

Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore has recently signed a Memorandum

of Understanding (MoU) with NanoCell Networks Pvt Ltd, Bangalore. This

partnership opens up the opportunity for the institute to offer

comprehensive training and certification programs, including Qualcomm

Wireless Academy’s 5G University Program and 5G Introductory-Level

Certification Exam.

This MoU offers an array of benefits such as free 5G training, the

opportunity to earn a 5G certification, and the chance to connect with

Qualcomm recruiters.

The 5G courses, which include "5G Primer" and "Fundamentals of Cellular

Communication & 5G," provide an in-depth understanding of 5G technology,

its functionality, and its global impact. These courses are available in an

eLearning format, allowing students to learn online at their own pace.

Furthermore, the courses are conducted in English and are taught by

industry-leading engineers from Qualcomm Technologies. Both courses are

estimated to take around 10 hours to complete.

For registrations, please visit:

https://assets.qualcomm.com/Qualcomm-Academy-University-Program-Registration.html

The certification exam is optional and requires a payment of Rs. 2400 for

interested students. NanoCell Networks Pvt Ltd, Bangalore, provides exam

coupons.

any of the following faculty members for more information.
