Dear VITians,

Greetings.

The 14th edition of graVITas, the graVITas'23, a Techno-Management

Extravaganza finally concluded on 24th of September, 2023. This year , 150+

events were held under different categories, 14500+ individual

registrations and internationally acclaimed events like Robowars, IDRL,

Aero-dominator etc. were conducted.

Team graVITas'23 would like to place their sincere gratitude to the

Honourable

Chancellor who is the source of all inspiration and motivation. Team

members thank the respected Vice Presidents, for their encouragement and

support in all stages of graVITas'23. Our sincere thanks to respected Vice

Chancellor for his support, respected Pro Vice Chancellor for

believing in us and providing suggestions and guidance at every step of

this megafest, respected Registrar for her valuable advice and necessary

approvals as and when required, all the faculty & student organizers who

had worked relentlessly, day in and day out with complete dedication and

team-work, all the Conveners, Co-Conveners, faculty coordinators, student

managers, coordinators and volunteers for their unconditional support,

understanding and willingness to stand up for the occasion in organizing

the mega fest and turning it into a grand success, faculty members who

served in various committees as Judges/Coordinators for their active

participation in all the stages of event execution,

Director (Students' Welfare), Assistant Directors & all the Staff Members

for their unconditional support and back-up throughout.

We thank Director (CDC), Director (Events management), Director

(Estates), Chief

Security Officer, Chief Finance Officer, Deputy Director Systems, Deputy

Director (Corporate Communications & Media), Director MH, Director LH,

Assistant

Director (Outreach), Senior Manager, Purchase and their team members, all

other Deans and Directors for their timely support.

Finally, we thank all the faculty members, lab in-charges and lab

assistants/technicians for their support in smoothly conducting the events.

Last but not the least, we sincerely thank all the students who had

keenly taken part in the various events to make this graVITas’23 a grand

success.

Finally, thanks for the opportunity given to us.

With Best Regards

Team graVITas'23

body:
Hello VITians,

Unleash Your Creativity this Summer: 70 Days of Online Contests!

DAY-46 (20th June-Thursday)CELLPHONE PHOTOGRAPHY CONTESTTOPIC:

 The World is One Family

World Refugee Day falls each year on 20th of June and is dedicated to

refugees around the globe. Together, we can champion their right to seek

safety and build support for their economic and social inclusion.

We would like to see your unique perspective of this. Capture a pic through

your cell phone!

Here's how to participate:

 - Take the most captivating photo showcasing the given topic.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public)

The winning photo will be chosen based on two factors:

 - Creativity and composition: Does your photo capture the essence in a

 unique and interesting way?

 - Engagement: How many likes does your photo receive by tomorrow 05:00

 pm.

 - Plagiarism: Uploading photos from any other sources will disqualify

 you from the contest.

The grand prize? A cool ₹500 as prize!

Contest Duration:The contest starts tomorrow morning at 06:00 am and ends

by 05:00 pm.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more information: events.sw@vit.ac.in

body:
Dear Students,

The Office of Students’ Welfare is pleased to invite you to the Valedictory

Ceremony of Yantra’26, scheduled to be held on 15th February 2026, from

5:00 PM to 7:00 PM.

Since its commencement on 7th February 2026, Yantra’26 has stood as a

vibrant celebration of innovation, technical excellence, and collaborative

spirit. With the successful conduct of over 65+ events across diverse

domains, the past days have truly reflected the enthusiasm, talent, and

dedication of our student community.

As we gather to mark the culmination of this remarkable journey, the

valedictory ceremony will celebrate the achievements of our participants,

appreciate the efforts of the organizing teams, and bring Yantra’26 to a

proud and memorable close.

We warmly invite all students to join us for this special occasion and be a

part of the concluding celebration of Yantra’26. Your presence will make

the evening truly meaningful.

subject: Guidelines – Course Registration (Fall Semester 2025 - 26)
body:
Guidelines – Course Registration (Fall Semester 2025 - 26)

 1. Senior Students and timed-out students of all the programmes except

 BSc (Agri), BSc Catering & Hotel Management, B. Des., B. Arc., BSc

 Multimedia, BSc Visual Communication, M. Des., MBA, M. Arc., MSW, B.

 Tech Computer Science and Business Systems are permitted to take part

 in the course registration.

 2. Course Registration is scheduled to be conducted on 28. 06. 2025.

 3. Information on courses offered for the Fall Semester 2025 - 26 is

 available on VTOP and the VITian Mobile App.

 4. Information on the course registration schedule for the Fall Semester

 2025 - 26 (time and duration for various groups of students) is available

 on VTOP and the VITian Mobile App.

 5. During the course registration process (on 28.06.2025), the system

 will prompt students to register for the applicable Soft Skill Course,

 English Course, SET and NASSCOM Course as per the curriculum of the

 respective programmes. Subsequently, UC: University Core, PC: Programme

 Core, FC: Foundation Core, DLESC: Discipline linked Engineering Sciences,

 DC: Discipline Core, PE: Programme Elective, UE: University Elective, DE:

 Discipline Elective, SPE: Specialization Elective, OE: Open Elective and

 compulsory courses with the following options will be permitted:

 Regular / Re-register / Substitution (UE / OE / DE / PE and also in

HSM / Language Basket)

 Regular (UC as UE, PE as UE, DE as OE, SPE as OE)

 Minor Programmes

Multidisciplinary Elective (applicable to the B. Tech Core Programmes only

except BBS): An option is provided to earn the required credits under the

Discipline Elective / Open Elective category by registering courses listed

under multidisciplinary electives. The eligibility criteria to register

course(s) under the multidisciplinary elective is to have completed a

minimum of 9 credits from the courses listed under the Discipline

Electives. The remaining credits can be earned from the courses listed

under either Discipline Electives or Multidisciplinary Electives to

complete credit requirements as per the curriculum.

 6. The add / Drop option will be enabled for all the students from

 09.07.25 to 11.07.2025. During the Add / Drop period, students can register

 for courses under Audit / Grade Improvement / Additional Course / Minor /

 Honour options.

 7. Removal of courses registered under the regular mode is not possible

 unless the course registered under ‘Additional’ is removed first.

 8. The student should generate an invoice on VTOP (in the timetable

 menu) and proceed for payment (under the menu – Online Payments) for the

 courses that demand course fees. The courses of fee defaulters will be

 deregistered after the deadline.

 9. Courses cannot be deleted or withdrawn if the fee payment is made.

 10. Students are required to go through the Academic Regulations for

 further clarification on the terminology.

 11. Queries related to course offerings should be addressed to the

 respective Head of the Department.

Project Registration R u l es

All eligible M. Tech./ MCA /MSc students who were admitted in 2024 -25 will

be permitted to register for Internship I/ Dissertation I during the Fall

Semester 2025-26 with a duration of 6 months.

Integrated students of MIC/MID/MIY who are admitted in 2021-22 will be

permitted to register Capstone project/ Master thesis with a duration of 12

months.

BXXX497J - Project I is compulsory for 2022-23 BTech batch students. During

the time of registration, students should select a guide and a tentative

title of the project.

Kindly note that there will be two options to register for Internship I /

Dissertation I / Capstone Project / Master Thesis:

a) ACAD - ACADEMICS

b) PAT - PLACEMENT AND TRAINING

Students who have already received an Internship offer through CDC have to

register for the course under “PAT - PLACEMENT AND TRAINING”. The remaining

students have to register under ACAD – Academics, for which a “Faculty

Guide” is to be selected. (Guide change option will be enabled during the

Add / Drop period)

Students can change the option from ACAD to PAT whenever an internship

offer is received in future by submitting proof (received from the CDC) and

a consent letter (from the Guide) to the Academics Office.

with regards

M. Anthony Xavior PhD

Dean Academics

Vellore Institute of Technology,

Vellore - 632014

Intercom: 2981

Mob. 9443687391

subject: Mandatory 2-Step Verification starting 21 January 2026 to access VIT Email Accounts
body:
Dear VITians,

To improve the security of our email system and to better protect user

accounts, an additional layer of security will be enforced. From 21

January 2026, 2-Step Verification (2FA) will be mandatory for all VIT

Email accounts.

This means that when you sign in using your username and password, you will

be required to verify your identity through a second step, such as:

 -

 A one-time code sent to your registered mobile number, or

 -

 A Google Authenticator app.

Important: Please note that VIT Email access will not be available from

21 January 2026 onwards if 2-Step Verification is not activated on your

account.

What you need to do:

 -

 Users who have already enrolled in 2-Step Verification may ignore this

 email.

 -

 Others are requested to enroll in 2-Step Verification on or before 20

 January 2026.

For assistance, please contact the CTS Helpdesk: https://helpdesk.vit.ac.in

Thank you for your cooperation in helping us keep our systems secure.

Thanks and Regards,

Dr. Anthoniraj Amalanathan, PhD.

Director Centre for Technical Support,

Professor School of Computer Science and Engineering,

VIT, Vellore - 632014

World Wide Web Day is celebrated on August 1 every year because it was on

this day in 1991 that Tim Berners-Lee posted a proposal for the World Wide

Web on the alt.hypertext newsgroup. The World Wide Web has had a profound

impact on the way we live, work, and learn. It has made information and

resources more accessible than ever before and created new opportunities

for communication, collaboration and commerce.

The day is a reminder of the power of the internet to connect people and

share information. It is also a day to celebrate the creativity and

innovation that has made the web what it is today. The World Wide Web is an

essential part of our lives today. It has revolutionized the way we

communicate, learn, and do business. New technologies are emerging that are

subject: Reminder: TCS Registration – 2027 Batch
body:
TCS Registration – 2027 Batch

Greetings from Tata Consultancy Services!!!

We are pleased to invite eligible students from your institute to

participate in the TCS Priority Institution National Qualifier Test (NQT)

for the 2027 graduating batch. As TCS accelerates the enterprise adoption

of AI and Generative AI, students joining us will have opportunities to

work on AI-led transformation programs at scale, supported by enterprise AI

platforms, deep industry context, and global technology partnerships.

Kindly ensure that all eligibility criteria and validation checks are

completed before sharing the final student list with us on or before May

15, 2026 9.00 am. Please note, no changes will be permitted after the

closure date.

TCS Eligibility Criteria:

Courses & Disciplines

Batch of 2027 Only.

Listed highest qualifications—B.Tech., M.Tech. (2yr & 5yr), M.C.A., M.Sc,

(2yr & 5yr),. from any discipline/department.

Course Type

Only Full-Time courses will be considered

(Part Time / Correspondence Courses will not be considered)

Percentage

Candidates must have a minimum aggregate of 60%

OR

6 CGPA in all semesters up to the latest declared results.

AND

Offer is valid only if the final degree or provisional certificate confirms

'FIRST CLASS' in the highest qualification, completed within the stipulated

time.

Backlogs / Arrears / ATKT:

Application & Test Process: The student should not have more than 1 (one)

pending or active backlog / arrear / ATKT at the time of appearing for

the TCS Selection process.

Onboarding Process: At the time of onboarding, no pending backlogs /

arrears / ATKT will be permitted.

Please note: All pending backlogs / arrears / ATKT should be cleared

within the course duration stipulated by the University.

Gap / Break in Education

Ensure any academic gaps during your education are declared and supported

with valid proof; breaks should not exceed 24 months.

Work Experience

Students with prior work experience of up to two years are eligible to

apply for this hiring process (Applicable only for postgraduate students).

Age

A student should be 18 to 28 years of age to participate in

the TCS Hiring Process.

Sl.No

Important Notes

1

Only students graduating in the year 2027 are eligible to apply, and this

must be clearly indicated in their TCS Application Form

2

All students must ensure that they use their Personal Email ID Only.

Please note: Email ID CANNOT be changed once submitted.

3

Reference ID series starting DT/CT 2023 onwards to be used, as older IDs

will not be accepted; if students have a reference ID prior to 2023, they

should contact us for profile deletion and re-registration should be

completed before the registration date.

4

Please do eligibility check for the candidate data at your end too and

eliminate any ineligible profiles.

All the students are asked to go through the entire mail before

registering.

TCS Registration Process:

1) Visit https://nextstep.tcsapps.com/indiacampus/#/

2) Click “Register Now”

3) Select category as “IT”

4) Fill in details to generate a Reference ID

5) Click “Apply for Drive”

If a candidate already has a Reference ID, please ensure “Apply for Drive”

is clicked.

The registration window for the assessment process will be open from 11

May to 15 May 2026 9.00 am.

VIT Link: https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

Registration in both links (TCS & VIT) is mandatory.

All the CDC internship selects are eligible for the TCS process, All are

asked to register without fail (if they are eligible), Students who are not

registering will be blacklisted on 16th May 2026.

TCS National Qualifier Test (NQT) with Integrated Test Pattern:

Section

Duration (in Minutes)

Part A - Foundation Sections

Numerical Ability

25

Verbal Ability

25

Reasoning ability

25

Part B - Advanced Section

Advanced Quantitative and Reasoning Ability

25

Advanced Coding

90

Total Duration (in Minutes)

190

AI-focused Career Opportunities for Students

Students hired through this drive may be aligned to future-ready work

across areas such as AI and data engineering, machine learning, deep

learning and GenAI, cloud data platforms, intelligent automation, and

AI-enabled software engineering.

Career pathways may include AI and Data tracks, including roles such as ML

Engineer and GenAI-focused engineering roles, along with broader digital

roles where AI is embedded into delivery.

As the industry landscape undergoes significant shifts in required skills

and expertise, TCS offers students a strong opportunity to remain relevant,

continuously upskill, and build careers for the new era.

Additional 15% Student Nomination from Group Institutes

The Placement Officer of a TCS Priority Institute may share an additional

list of students who are interested in taking the TCS NQT for Priority

Institutes. This additional list will be limited to 15% of the eligible

students who have applied for the TCS NQT for Priority Institutes from the

parent institute. The eligibility criteria will remain the same as

mentioned above.

Disclaimer

 - Eligibility checks will be conducted at various stages of the hiring

 process

 - Any ineligible candidature or misrepresentation of information will

 lead to disqualification.

 - TCS does not send job offers or hiring-related communications from

 unofficial email IDs such as Gmail, Rediffmail, Yahoo Mail, Hotmail, etc.

 - TCS does not ask candidates to pay any money during the recruitment

 process.

 - TCS is not associated with any external agency or company for

 employment offers.

As part of our continued efforts to enhance the recruitment experience, we

are introducing the following key features for the current hiring cycle:

 - On-premise Internet-based Assessment (IBA) Model and interview

 process: The assessment and interview process will be conducted on

 campus, ensuring a seamless and convenient experience for students.

 - Immediate Release of Offer Letters: Offer Letters will be issued to

 selected candidates immediately upon completion of the hiring process.

 - Focused Candidate Engagement Initiatives: Targeted engagement

 activities aimed at enhancing students’ preparedness for industry readiness.

The registration window for the Priority NQT will be open from May 8,

2026, to May 15, 2026 9.00 am. We request your office to facilitate the

dissemination of the registration link, which will be shared separately, to

all eligible students through appropriate institutional channels. We have

also taken note of your point regarding enabling registrations post the

Pre-Placement Talk and that students would be available post return from

their vacation. We will review this internally and revert with an update

for enabling additional registrations.

Candidates will be assessed and shortlisted for the following roles based

on their overall performance across all stages of the selection process:

Offer Category

UG (CTC)

PG (CTC)

Prime : Exceptional candidates who demonstrate outstanding aptitude and

advanced proficiency in emerging technologies.

9.09 LPA

11.59 LPA

Digital: Candidates who exhibit excellent aptitude and strong capability

in leveraging digital technology.

7.09 LPA

7.39 LPA

As TCS accelerates its AI and Generative AI-led transformation for clients

globally, we remain equally committed to building future-ready talent for

this new era. Students joining through this program can look forward to

opportunities in emerging areas such as AI/ML, data engineering and

analytics, cloud, and automation, while working under a human + AI delivery

model. TCS also provides intensive upskilling opportunities to help

students stay aligned with evolving industry demands and build resilient

careers.

sender: 'PROVC VIT, Vellore Campus' via B.Tech. - Comp  Sci Engg 2023 Group, Vellore Campus <23bce@vitstudent.ac.in>
subject: VITians contribution to 2025 Nobel Prize in Chemistry
body:
Dear VITians

Greetings. You will be happy to know that our colleague Dr Tamas Kumar

Panda, (Assistant Professor of Chemistry and Scientist of CCE) worked with

Professor Susumu Kitagawa (Recipient of Nobel Prize in Chemistry 2025) for

more than two years as a JSPS postdoctoral fellow at Kyoto University,

Japan.

The trio (photo attached) got the Nobel Prize for the development of

“Metal-Organic frameworks”. I am thrilled to share with you that our

Professor Dr Panda published a paper on the same topic with Prof Kitagawa

in 2017 as the first author. The paper titled “Mechanical alloying of metal

organic frame works” was published in Angewandte Chemie in 2017.

On behalf of VIT students, faculty members, staff members, alumni and

management, I would like to congratulate Dr Tamas Kumar Panda and his guide

Professor Susumu Kitagawa for this remarkable contribution to the society.

 Warm regards

PARTHA SHARATHI MALLICK, PhD

Pro-Vice Chancellor

Vellore Institute of Technology

Vellore, Tamilnadu, India.

Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), India -

 - Engineering and Technology: 142nd in the World and 9th in India (QS

 World University Rankings by Subject 2025)

 - Data Science and AI subject areas are within the Top 100 in the

 world. Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical, Electronics,

 Material Science subject areas are within the top 200 in the world (QS

 World University Rankings by Subject 2025)

 - Within the top 2 in India and top 600 in the world (Shanghai ARWU

 ranking 2025)

 - NAAC Accreditation with A++ grade (3.66 out of 4)

 - Within the top 20 in University, Research and Engineering

 categories in India (NIRF Ranking, Govt. of India 2025)

 - 396th in the world and 8th in India (QS World University Rankings :

 Sustainability 2025)

body:
Dear VITians,

We are proud to announce that the VIT Model United Nations Society (

VITMUNSOC) has brought great honor to our institution by winning the Best

Delegation Award at SRMR MUN 2025, held at SRM Ramapuram, Chennai from

April 4th to 6th, 2025.

The delegation demonstrated remarkable diplomatic acumen, critical

thinking, and public speaking abilities across various committees, earning 10

individual recognitions and a Vice-Chairperson position.

Awardees from VITMUNSOC – SRMR MUN 2025:

CRISIS Committee

 • Best Delegate: Aman Deo (23BEL0027)

 • Verbal Mention: Sanket Maniyar (23BEL0006)

UNHRC – United Nations Human Rights Council

 • Special Mention: Sachin Mehta (24BAI0333)

 • Verbal Mention: Bhamathi Shivraman (24BCM0179)

UNGA – United Nations General Assembly

 • Vice-Chairperson: Sushane Makkar (22BDS0312)

 • Special Mention: Guru Charan Sivakumar (23BCE0878)

International Press – Journalism

(Emp ID: 11882), for her steadfast mentorship and continuous

encouragement, which played a vital role in this success.

1. No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of this project.

2. If you have any upcoming assignment, examination, or personal commitment, you can pick a project start date after completing the same to help the project fit in with your schedule.

3. The project is doable in a 2-month duration. You will be allowed a break during the project tenure for any academic or personal commitment. You would also be entitled to a Project Extension of an additional month if you need more time to complete it.

4. You can go over the project details using the copy of the mail below and apply for the project using the following link :

https://www.finlatics.com/excel_applications?utm_src=vitvd

5. The time commitment required for the project is around 2 - 3 hours per week.

The program has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST

The first email circulated at the campus is attached below.

Hi ,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Excel Program, an online live project that helps students learn and gain experience in Microsoft Excel at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

This project runs at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, and BITS Pilani, among others. Finlatics was curated at the prestigious Atal Incubation Centre, supported by the Atal Innovation Mission, NITI Aayog, and the Government of India.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Learn the basics of MS Excel, including sorting and filtering data through various formulas and functions.

2. Become proficient in making dynamic Excel dashboards and practice on sales, finance and human resources datasets

3. Understand how to use various Excel techniques and simulations to perform profitability analysis and make pricing decisions

4. Gain an understanding of different Forecasting methods through MS Excel and how they can be used for decision-making

5. Complete industry-specific case projects to understand the application of MS Excel in real-time scenarios

The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Proficiency in Microsoft Excel

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

To apply, students can fill out the form below, and we will get in touch:

https://www.finlatics.com/excel_applications?utm_src=vitv

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to participate in the program. The program will impart all necessary training in MS Excel

Altair Engineering India Pvt Ltd (A Siemens Company) - Online test is

scheduled on 09-04-2026 by 6pm @ Own location

please find below the test instructions and the list of shortlisted

students with the details:

Please find below the test slots:

Test Date : 09th April 2026(Thursday)

Test start time : 06.00PM

Window closing time : 06.20PM

Duration : 1 - 1.45 hours

The test will automatically stop if the candidate switches through the

window tabs.

Online Test Instructions (To be shared with candidates):

 - Candidate should check the test link well in advance, we won’t

 entertain the last moment changes like resharing of invites/extending the

 time.

 - If Invite is not in inbox, check the Spam/Junk/Trash folder.

 - Candidate should appear for the online test using a webcam enabled

 laptop.

 - Snapshots of the candidate at random time interval will be captured.

 - Candidates are not allowed to toggle between the opened windows during

 the online test.

 - Test link will be shared to the candidates directly on their college

 email id.

 - Test will be open for 20 minutes, Open the test link at mentioned time

 else you'll be disqualified.

 - Uploading of Resume, Photo ID at the beginning of the test is

 Mandatory.

Note :

 - Students are requested to check both their personal and official

 email IDs for the test link.

 - The test link will be shared directly with the shortlisted

 candidates by the company via email. 

Instructions

 - Candidates must ensure a stable internet connection throughout the

 interview.

 - Join the meeting at least 10–15 minutes before the scheduled time.

 - Use a laptop/desktop (mobile phones are not recommended).

 - Ensure your camera and microphone are working properly.

 - Maintain a professional environment (quiet room, proper lighting,

 neutral background).

 - Formal attire is mandatory.

 - Keep your resume and necessary documents ready for reference.

 - Do not switch tabs, use mobile phones, or seek external help during

 the interview.

Note:

1. Students are requested to send their queries to their respective campus

email ID only.

2. Webcam Should be turned on till the test gets over.

Important Note:

1. Appear for the selection process in formal dress.

2. Carry your updated Resumes, photos, College photo ID and all other

relevant certificates... (Photo Copy of Mark Sheets - PG, UG, Higher

Secondary 10th).

subject: Bharti Airtel Scholarship Program - An Opportunity for Aspiring Engineering Students in Tech-Based Programs - Reg.
body:
Dear Students,

Bharti Airtel Foundation aims to support deserving students from diverse

socio-economic backgrounds with a focus on girl students, to become future

technology leaders. To achieve this goal, a merit-cum-means scholarship

program has been designed for students enrolled in technology based

engineering undergraduate (UG) courses and 5 Years Integrated Programmes

(as per the scholarship criteria mentioned below) in the top 50 NIRF

Engineering institutes including IITs.

Key Features:

 - Scholarships are for the full duration of the UG courses including

 integrated courses of up to 5 years (subject to meeting the renewal

 criteria).

 - Each scholarship covers 100% of annual fees as per the fee structure

 of the respective institute.

 - The hostel and mess fees shall be given to all selected scholars who

 apply for it.

 - For scholars staying in PG/outside hostel, the support shall be

 extended as per the hostel/mess charges of the institute.

 - A laptop for all Bharti Scholars.

 - Once the Bharti Scholars graduate & are subsequently gainfully

 employed, they will undertake to voluntarily extend financial support to at

 least 1 student at a school or college level at any point of time, to the

 extent they can.

Eligibility & Selection Criteria:

 - Confirmed admission in the first year (starting with the 2024 cohort)

 of the UG/5 year integrated courses in fields of Electronics &

 Communication, Telecom, Information Technology, Computer Sciences, Data

 Sciences, Aerospace and Emerging Technologies (AI, IoT, AR/VR, Machine

 Learning, Robotics) at the top 50 NIRF Engineering universities/institutes.

 - Must be a citizen and resident of India.

 - Family annual income from all sources should not exceed INR 8.5 Lakh.

 - Preference shall be given to girl students.

 - Should not be a recipient of any other scholarships/grants for the

 same purposes as those supported by Bharti Airtel Foundation.

 - Candidates will be shortlisted for the final selection on varied

 aspects such as merit-cum-means, a Statement of Purpose (SOP) detailing the

 candidate’s aspirations and leadership qualities etc.

 - Annual renewal of the scholarship shall be conditional on a minimum

 CGPA expectation (6 out of 10), attendance & conduct etc.

 - The university/institute will be expected to share track records of

 the Bharti Scholars’ academic performance, confirmation of meeting

 attendance & conduct criteria and also inform the Foundation if the cases

 arise, of any disciplinary action that may have been initiated

Last Date for Application: August 31, 2024

Link for Application:

https://bhartifoundation.org/%20bharti-airtel-scholarship/

https://bhartifoundation.org/%20bharti-airtel-scholarship/

For any further queries, please mail to bharti.foundation@bhartifoundation.org

<bharti.foundation@bhartifoundation.org>

subject: Grant Support for Agri-Tech Startups in Tamil Nadu - regarding
body:
Dear Students,

StartupTN invites Agri-Tech startups to make use of the Agri-Tech Grant

scheme offered by the Department of Agricultural Marketing & Agri Business,

Government of Tamil Nadu, and apply for financial support.

Grant Support Includes:

 Grant up to Rs. 10 lakh for early stage startups

 Grant up to Rs. 25 lakh for startups looking for market expansion

Note: The Startups working on Ready to eat products are not eligible for

the Grant.

Eligibility Criteria:

 Must be a Startup registered with DPIIT Portal (Startup India) and

headquartered in Tamil Nadu

 Must be registered as a Private Limited Company, LLP, or Partnership firm

 Average profit in the last three years must be less than Rs. 5 lakh

 Must be working on innovation, development, or improvement of

agricultural products or processes

 Should not be formed by splitting or reconstructing an existing business

 Must have no pending dues or blacklisting by Government agencies

 Must be an Indian startup with at least 51% Indian promoter shareholding

To Apply

Download Application: form.startuptn.in/AGF

Filled in Applications should be scanned and sent to

agrimarkstartuptech@gmail.com

Event Name: Deep Dive: The legacy of Rolls Royce

Event Time: 07:30 PM - 08:30 PM

Event Description:Join SAE VIT on 5th November from 7:30 PM to 8:30 PM for

Deep Dive: The Legacy of Rolls Royce. Explore the brand journey from its

historic beginnings to its modern innovations in luxury and engineering.

Discover how Rolls Royce became a global symbol of excellence,

craftsmanship, and timeless design. Tune in live on Google Meet for an

insightful session celebrating the spirit of automotive perfection.

before at Aviation Cyber Resilience, live on 5th November from 11:00 AM to

1:00 PM. Dive into the critical challenges of protecting Air Traffic

Management, onboard avionics, and ground operations from evolving cyber

threats. Engage with insights that reveal how the skies are kept safe in

every endeavor.

growth while minimising environmental harm. Using agricultural data and

scientific references, teams must justify their sustainable formulation and

subject: Application for Student Council - 2026-27.
body:
Dear Students,

The Student Council is a diverse group of students from across all

departments, working together to represent the needs and aspirations of the

entire student body. It coordinates with various other departments along

with the Office of Students' Welfare to execute various university level

events and put continuous efforts to make such events grand and

successful. If you're passionate about making VIT an even better place and

you are the leader who wants to make change, we encourage you to nominate

yourself!

The Office of Students' Welfare is inviting nominations for the

Student Council 2026-27. This is your opportunity to represent your

peers, contribute to student initiatives, and play a vital role in shaping

student life at VIT.

For submitting your nomination and more information on the nomination

process and the role of the Student Council, please visit the following

link.

Form Link: https://forms.gle/LWRneEJdv8cdNx8s6

https://forms.gle/LWRneEJdv8cdNx8s6

The link will be available only till 10th May . The applications

received will be scrutinized and called for an interview.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:

 1. Students who have been involved in any form of disciplinary action,

 either currently or in the past, are not eligible to hold any position.

 2. As of the Winter Semester 2025–26, only students in their pre-final

 year are eligible to apply for the post of Executive Member.

 3. As of the Winter Semester 2025–26, students in the 6th semester of a

 5-year degree programme (B.Arch. and Integrated Programmes) are also

 eligible to apply for the post of Executive Member.

 4. Students from all other years are eligible to apply for the post of

 Member Secretary.

 5. The position of Member Secretary is categorized into three

 specialized divisions: Technical, Cultural, and Digital.

 6. A minimum CGPA of 9.0 is required to be eligible for the posts of

 Executive Member and Member Secretary.

 7. A minimum CGPA of 8.5 is required to be eligible for the posts of

 Member Secretary – Cultural and Member Secretary – Technical.

 8. A minimum CGPA of 7.5 is required to be eligible for the post of

 Member Secretary – Digital.

 9. CGPA eligibility will be assessed based on the grades announced after

 the Winter Semester 2025–26.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF STUDENT COUNCIL MEMBERS:

 - To officially represent all the students in the school / institute.

 - To identify and help solve problems encountered by students in the

 school / institute.

 - To communicate its opinion to the school / institute administration on

 any subject that concerns students.

 - To promote and encourage the involvement of students in organizing

 school / institute level activities.

 - To inform students about any subject that concerns them.

 - To consult students on any issue of importance and bring it to the

 notice of the Students' Welfare office.

 - To support and contribute to achieve better / higher accreditation for

 the institute.

 - To participate in the development of the school activities.

 - To propose activities to the school/institute administration that

 would improve the quality of student life in the school/institute.

We look forward to receiving your nominations!

World Rabies Day

World Rabies Day is celebrated annually to raise awareness about rabies

prevention and to highlight progress in defeating this horrifying disease.

28 September also marks the anniversary of Louis Pasteur's death, the

French chemist and microbiologist, who developed the first rabies vaccine.

Today, safe and efficacious animal and human vaccines are among the

important tools that exist to eliminate human deaths from rabies while

awareness is the key driver for the success of communities to engage in

effective rabies prevention.

World Rabies Day aims to raise awareness about the impact of rabies on

humans and animals, provide information and advice on how to prevent the

disease in at-risk communities, and support advocacy for increased efforts

in rabies control. This year’s World Rabies Day theme is: “Rabies: Facts,

not Fear”.

subject: Congratulations to PB-TLA for their Achievements at Prometheus’26 – XIME, Chennai
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that students from the Paavendhar Bharathidasan

– Tamil Literary Association delivered an excellent performance at

Prometheus’26, conducted at the Xavier Institute of Management and

Entrepreneurship, Chennai, on 9 March 2026.

The event brought together participants from various institutions, where

students showcased their analytical thinking, creativity, and

problem-solving skills across multiple competitive events. Representing

VIT, the PB-TLA team secured First Prize in two events, demonstrating

outstanding performance.

 1. Rohan – 23BCE0971

Team Members:

the Faculty Coordinators, Dr. Maria Sebastian (Emp. ID: 14555), Dr. Vinoth

commendable achievement and wish them continued success in their future

endeavors.

Dear Students,

Please refer to the following on

ThinkSwiss Research Scholarships 2026 for a research stay in Switzerland

About:

ThinkSwiss Research Scholarships

https://swissnex-dot-yamm-track.appspot.com/2RY_jz6FsgziW8fv_jzgqEuGqqKsaTYM7VyT0y7rRcqO7nKjRmAFweKEh2QhwaCle00_wYmLm6QXUJs4aFr3zFwn28hrVzU0-HBc4PsK7tst8He74LS6O7y8-8mZYbOQp9rPX4WkldpB2-wXXfQ_HAoURj4yxIAerubQhYFgAuVYkvnCxNstdpgpRqWVgsM121qLeK6U0NA

aims to promote research opportunities in Switzerland for Indian students

to foster the exchange between Swiss and Indian universities &

institutions. This provides scholars with an opportunity to experience the

Swiss research ecosystem first-hand and take the first step to a possible

future research career in Switzerland

Eligibility:

 -

 Undergraduate students who have completed their 2nd year or Master's

 students, currently enrolled in or funded by an Indian university or

 institute.

 -

 The scholarship is open to students in all fields. However, we

 especially encourage students with an interest in Antimicrobial Resistance

 (AMR), One Health, biodiversity or climate change and action to apply.

 -

 A written confirmation from a Professor at a Swiss university is

 required stating that they will accept you for a research stay in their

 group.

Funding:

This programme is funded by the Swissnex network, part of the Swiss State

Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI). The student will

receive a stipend of CHF 60/day. Travel and visa cost will need to be borne

by the applicant.

Duration: 2 or 3 months.

When: Research stay anytime between 1 April 2026 - 31 December 2026.

Where: In a public-funded Swiss university or public-funded Swiss Research

Institution

Deadline for application: 31 January 2026.

World Children’s Day

World Children’s Day was first established in 1954 as Universal Children's

Day and is celebrated on 20 November each year to promote international

togetherness, and awareness among children worldwide, and to improve

children's welfare. Mothers and fathers, teachers, nurses and doctors,

government leaders and civil society activists, religious and community

elders, corporate moguls and media professionals, as well as young people

and children themselves, can play an important part in making World

Children's Day relevant for their societies, communities, and nations.

World Children's Day offers each of us an inspirational entry point to

advocate, promote and celebrate children's rights, translating into

dialogues and actions that will build a better world for children.

The World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims

The World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims takes place on 20th

November every year as the appropriate acknowledgment of victims of road

traffic crashes and their families. It was started by the British road

crash victim charity, Road Peace, in 1993 and was adopted by the United

Nations General Assembly in 2005.

The objectives of the World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims

 are to provide a platform for road traffic victims and their families to:

§ remember all people killed and seriously injured on the roads;

§ acknowledge the crucial work of the emergency services;

§ draw attention to the generally trivial legal response to culpable road

deaths and injuries;

§ advocate for better support for road traffic victims and victim families;

 § promote evidence-based actions to prevent and eventually stop

further road traffic deaths and injuries.

subject: Prima Vera'25 - Day-5 Events - reg
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

The Office of Students' Welfare invites you to spring into action on Day-5

as we dive into an exciting week filled with cultural vibrance. After long

schedules and academic fatigue, this is the perfect moment to unwind,

recharge, and rediscover the joy of campus life.

We proudly present the 6th edition of Prima Vera - a week-long cultural

festival celebrating the creativity, passion, and spirit of VIT’s dynamic

student community. Get ready for a series of thrilling competitions, each

designed to bring out your best and help you showcase your unique talents.

Expect energetic performances, artistic showdowns, and engaging events, all

culminating in an unforgettable cultural experience.

And yes — there are exciting cash prizes waiting for the winners, along

with the pride of taking center stage in one of VIT’s most anticipated

festivals.

Gear up, participate, cheer, and make Prima Vera’25 a celebration to

remember!

Day-5 Schedule

Débat d’Idées – Debate invites students to engage in thoughtful and

articulate discussions on contemporary topics, encouraging critical

thinking and persuasive communication. Participants present arguments,

defend perspectives, and respond to counterpoints in a structured and

intellectually stimulating environment. The event aims to develop clarity

of thought, confidence in speech, and the ability to analyse issues from

multiple viewpoints while promoting healthy dialogue and logical

reasoning.

Vogue Vortex – Fashion Fusion brings creativity, glamour, and

self-expression to the spotlight as students showcase innovative fashion

concepts through a dynamic runway performance. This event encourages

participants to experiment with themes, styling, and costume design while

blending aesthetic vision with confident presentation. It aims to celebrate

individuality, artistic flair, and fashion-forward thinking, offering a

vibrant platform for students to redefine style and creativity on stage.

Cinescatto – Reel Making offers students an exciting opportunity to dive

into digital storytelling through short-form video content. Participants

are encouraged to conceptualise, script, shoot, and edit engaging reels

that blend creativity, narrative clarity, and visual appeal. The event aims

to inspire budding creators to experiment with themes, explore cinematic

techniques, and showcase their filmmaking potential in an online format

that resonates with modern digital audiences.

Move N Grove – Group Dance (Western) showcases the vibrance and energy of

modern Western choreography, inviting teams to perform dynamic routines

across genres like hip-hop, contemporary, jazz, and fusion. This event

encourages creativity, precision, and strong stage presence as groups come

together to deliver impactful performances. It aims to spotlight teamwork,

innovation, and versatility while celebrating the global spirit of Western

dance.

Nritya Sangha – Group Dance (Eastern) celebrates the elegance and

cultural richness of Indian dance traditions, bringing together teams to

perform synchronised and expressive routines. This event encourages

participants to explore classical, semi-classical, or folk styles while

highlighting unity, rhythm, and collective storytelling. It aims to foster

teamwork, creativity, and artistic expression as groups create visually

captivating performances rooted in India’s diverse heritage.

Get ready to shine at the 6th edition of Prima Vera — our annual cultural

extravaganza packed with creativity, energy, and endless fun. This year’s

edition brings together a vibrant lineup of competitions, performances, and

showcases designed to highlight the incredible talents of our students.

Whether you’re stepping onto the stage, behind the lens, or into the

spotlight, Prima Vera’25 is your moment to express, explore, and excel.

Come be a part of the excitement, the artistry, and the unforgettable

memories waiting to be made!

Join us for an unforgettable celebration!

subject: Career Counselling and Higher education - 2025 SLOT 2 ADMISSION - CAT/ GRE/ GMAT/IELTS/ TOEFL/GATE-reg
body:
Dear Esteemed Students,

Greetings from the Career Development Centre (CDC) at VIT!!

VIT's Career Counselling and Higher Education facility, established in

2007, has been a guiding beacon for students, aiding them in their pursuit

of higher education both in India and abroad. Our program is committed to

helping students make well-informed decisions, aligning their academic

choices with personal interests and career goals.

Admission Slots:

We are pleased to offer two admission slots for your convenience:

- SLOT 1: February/March

- SLOT 2: August/September

This flexibility allows students to embark on their higher education

training journey at a time that suits their schedules and aspirations. The

inclusion of various agencies running courses within the VIT campus across

diverse disciplines enriches the program, exposing students to a broad

spectrum of educational possibilities. The strategic organization of

seminars during these admission periods is a commendable effort to foster

awareness and promote the significance of higher studies. These seminars

not only inform students about available courses but also inspire them to

explore and consider diverse fields of study.

Sunday Classes: (Offline mode)

Understanding the varied commitments students may have during weekdays,

offline classes are scheduled only on Sunday. This thoughtful consideration

ensures accessibility for a wider student demographic.

We also provide classes in Online mode(Live and Pre-recorded classes

whichever you select.

(Kindly check the google form below which will give you a clear picture)

Courses Offered:

Our array of courses, including GATE, GRE, GMAT, CAT, IELTS, and TOEFL,

reflects our holistic approach in addressing the diverse needs and

aspirations of our students.

--------------------------------------

The following are authorized training teams for higher education

programs—in-campus classes:

1. GradSquare

GradSquare has been selected for the following programs:

- CAT - Common Admission Test & XAT, NMAT, SNAP 

- GRE - Graduate Record Examinations & IELTS/TOEFL

- GMAT—The Graduate Management Admission Test

2. T.I.M.E. (Triumphant Institute of Management Education)

 T.I.M.E has been selected for the following programs:

- CAT - Common Admission Test & XAT, NMAT, SNAP

- GRE - Graduate Record Examinations

- GMAT—The Graduate Management Admission Test

- GATE—Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering

Welcome to Slot 2 Offline Admissions: August/September 2025 of Career

Counselling and Higher Education Admission Season

(GRE / GMAT / 

CAT / GATE / IELTS / TOEFL)

The authorized training teams of VIT (Gradsquare &TIME) are now open for

admissions. 

Please note the following important details:

Admission Process:

For a secure and streamlined payment process, all admissions will be

facilitated through VIT-CDC.

Students are kindly requested not to enroll directly with the training

institute.

Steps for Admission to

(GRE / GMAT / 

CAT / GATE / IELTS / TOEFL)

Step 1: Registration

Please select your preferred course and vendor in the Google form below.

Once you click the link below, you will get a clear picture of the

different courses, the authorized training teams of VIT who offer these

courses, and also the fee structure they are offering exclusively for VIT

students.

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSePX3rNumNa5w_xD3T-ylR4CN9U-5BFbS4n1Tro4RiaeIGCZQ/viewform

You are allowed to choose only 1 course.

Deadline to register:

2nd August 2025, 3 PM

No registration will be entertained after the deadline under any

circumstances.

Note: 

After the deadline, we will be closing the admission process and will be

mailing payment processes and all details related to payment to only

those students who have filled the google form . 

Step 2: Payment

All payments related to career counseling and higher education training

should be made only through the VIT-authorized payment processing platform

DABB.

 All those who have registered in the Google form above will be receiving

an Email with a payment link from

 university@mydabb.com <university@mydabb.com>

between 3rd August 2025 to 8th August 2025.

For any queries regarding payment process

You can contact

Payment Deadline:

 8th August, 12 pm

No payment should be made directly to any training teams. Only names in

our DABB database who have made the payment will be allowed for online

and offline classes.

The SLOT 2 class online and offline schedule will be communicated to you

by the respective training teams you have selected within 7 days after your

payment.

NO REFUND POLICY:

Once you have made the payment, under no

 circumstances: is there a refund.

We request you to discuss thoroughly with your parents

 and decide on the course and training team and then

 make the payment as there is no refund once payment is done.

For a secure and streamlined payment process, all admissions and

communication will be facilitated only through the VIT-CDC.

Students are kindly requested not to enroll directly with the training

institute.

For any other queries, please mail

anu.baisel@vit.ac.in

Happy Admissions!!!

subject: SBST-VIT Team Wins Grand Prize in 2025 Vivli AMR Surveillance Data Challenge - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings !

We are pleased and delighted to inform you all that Dr. George Priya

Doss C and his scholar from the School of Biosciences and Technology

(SBST), VIT Vellore, has been awarded the Grand Prize – AMR Global

Leadership Award in the prestigious 2025 Vivli AMR Surveillance Data

Challenge, an initiative supported by Johnson & Johnson, Paratek, Pfizer,

and the U.S. National Institutes of Health.

SBST winning submission, titled “Causal Inference of Antimicrobial

Resistance Trends: Evaluating the Impact of Climate and Pollution Using

Global AMR Data,” was adjudged the top global entry. The study employed

advanced causal inference methodologies to elucidate the influence of

environmental pollutants on antifungal resistance dynamics in Candida

glabrata. Notably, they uncovered a novel time-lagged correlation between

ambient air pollution levels and rising fluconazole resistance, offering

new insights into the environmental determinants of AMR evolution.

Dr. GEORGE PRIYA DOSS C

Designation : Professor Grade I

School / Centre : School of Bio Sciences & Technology

Department : Integrative Biology

Dr. Shraddha Karve – Ashoka University

Ms. Vasundhara Karthikeyan – Georg-August Universität Göttingen, Germany

The award includes a $10,000 USD cash prize and a $5,000 USD travel grant

to support the dissemination of our findings at upcoming international AMR

conferences.

We extend our sincere gratitude to SBST and VIT Vellore for their

unwavering institutional support and commitment to fostering a robust

research ecosystem. Their encouragement and infrastructure were

instrumental in achieving this milestone.

For a detailed overview of all winning entries and the challenge outcomes,

please refer to the official Vivli AMR Challenge press release.

Winners Announced for the 2025 Vivli AMR Surveillance Data Challenge,

funded by Johnson & Johnson, Paratek, Pfizer, and NIH - Vivli AMR

https://amr.vivli.org/winners-announced-for-the-2025-vivli-amr-surveillance-data-challenge-funded-by-johnson-johnson-paratek-pfizer-and-nih/

Congratulations to Dr. George Priya Doss C and his scholar for this

wonderful achievement and best wishes for their future endeavours !!

Points to Note :

 Participate in add/drop and finalize your timetable.

 Follow the academic related mails, guidelines and regulations strictly.

 Meet proctor regularly and keep informed about your progress.

 Follow the process and the communication hierarchy (Student----Proctor

 Make a daily study schedule and stick to it.

subject: Congratulations to Team RotorFPV for their Achievement at International Space Drone Challenge 2026
body:
Dear VITians,

We are thrilled to announce that Team RotorFPV has secured First Place in

the International Space Drone Challenge 2026. This prestigious technical

competition was held at the Manipal Institute of Technology, Manipal, from

28th January to 2nd February 2026.

The team, led by Ms. Saarika Rajen and Mr. Priyangshu Saha, navigated

through the competition, consisting of manually piloted science and

technology missions along with a business presentation. Team RotorFPV

secured first place among 25 National and International teams, successfully

defending the title once again.

Team Members:

innovation in drone technology, and precision piloting. Competing against

present at VIT.

Congratulations to every member of Team RotorFPV for this outstanding

victory and for flying the VIT flag high!

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [4th September]

events.

National Nutrition Week

India marks National Nutrition Week annually in the first week of September

(from September 1 to September 7). This event was launched by the Ministry

of Women and Child Development's Food and Nutrition Board in 1982 with the

objective to raise awareness of the importance of nutrition for the human

body. A well-balanced diet, with a combination of all the essential

nutrients, plays a pivotal role in the growth and development of our mind

and body. Hence, dieticians and health experts around the globe recommend

the inclusion of healthy vegetables in our daily diet.

According to a report published in 2017, globally, 1 in 5 men dies of poor

diet. The figures brought an alarming situation to managing a balanced diet

for every citizen. To remain healthy, and energetic, and have a better

immune system, you can replace your regular diet plan with a nutritious

diet plan.

subject: Amateur Radio License Campaign by VARC - Reg.
body:
Dear Students,

The VIT Amateur Radio Club (VARC) stands at the forefront of innovation in

radio communication. Based at VIT, they are committed to fostering a

community of technology enthusiasts and aspiring amateur radio operators.

The club is dedicated to promoting learning, exploration, and collaboration

through the fascinating world of HAM radio communication.

Discover more about their initiatives at https://vitarc.github.io.

HAM Radio, or amateur radio, is a globally recognized platform for

enthusiasts to engage in technical experimentation, emergency

communications, and cross-border collaboration through radio frequencies.

The Amateur Station Operator’s Certificate (ASOC), issued by the Ministry

of Communications, India, is a credential that authorizes individuals to

legally operate HAM radios.

VARC is thrilled to announce the license campaign for ASOC certification

and HAM Radio license. Inviting all faculty, students, research scholars,

and anyone with a passion for communication technology to take advantage of

this unique opportunity to become a licensed HAM radio operator. This

opportunity is open to all individuals, regardless of prior experience or

technical background.

The last date to submit your willingness through the form is 28-02-2025

(Friday) 11:59 pm. Join us to gain exclusive insights into the world of

radio communication and enhance your technical expertise.

Form Link: https://forms.gle/wvaEnmW9t4KQfw8Z6

To learn more about the certification process, eligibility criteria, and

training schedules, please visit the website or email us at vitarc@vit.ac.in.

Our team is ready to guide you through the application process and answer

any queries.

We look forward to welcoming you to the vibrant community of HAM radio

enthusiasts. Together, let’s explore the boundless possibilities of radio

communication!

International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction

Disasters impact everyone, but have a disproportionate impact on persons

with disabilities – not because of individual impairments, but because of

societal barriers. The International Day for Disaster Risk Reduction was

started in 1989, after a call by the United Nations General Assembly for a

day to promote a global culture of risk-awareness and disaster reduction.

To mobilize action, the UN agency is raising awareness of the brutal

inequality of disasters. It calls for fighting inequality for a resilient

future, which is the theme of the 2023 observance.

event.

body:
Dear Sir/Madam,

Warm Greetings from the Centre for Nanotechnology Research, VIT, India.

We are pleased to inform you that the Centre for Nanotechnology Research,

VIT, is organising one of the premier events, the “3rd International

Conference on Nanoscience and Nanotechnology – ICNAN 2025,” from December

16 to 19, 2025. (https://icnan.vit.ac.in/)

Based on various requests from VITians, we have extended the dates for

registration and glad to announce a discounted registration fee for

Students/Research scholars (INR 5000) and faculty members (INR 7000).

To avail this special discount, please use the following link for

registration and payment.

 https://events.vit.ac.in/events/ICNANV (This link is applicable only for

VITians).

Nobel Laureate Dr.Moungi Bawendi, MIT, USA, will be inaugurating the event,

and more than 800 Material Scientists will be participating.

ICNAN-2025 aims to bring together the Indian and International communities

(students, scientists, engineers, and stakeholders from academia,

government laboratories, industry, and other organisations) working in the

field of Nanoscale science and technology to discuss new and exciting

advances in the field. The conference covers a broad theme in this area to

accommodate a wide range of interests and to facilitate interdisciplinary

collaboration/interaction in both academia and industry. The conference

will also provide an ideal environment to develop new collaborations and

opportunities to meet the experts working in various areas of this field.

Many senior experts, academicians from the US, Europe and Asian

Universities, including a Nobel Laureate and academicians/ researchers from

Dear Sir/Madam,

Greetings from the Centre for Nanotechnology Research (CNR), VIT, Vellore.

We are delighted to inform you that we are organizing the 3rd International

Conference on Nanoscience and Nanotechnology (ICNAN’25) at VIT, Vellore,

from December 16th to 19th, 2025.(https://icnan.vit.ac.in/

https://icnan.vit.ac.in/)

Nobel Laureate Dr. Moungi G. Bawendi, Massachusetts Institute of

Technology (MIT), USA (Nobel Laureate in Chemistry, 2023 - Discovery of

Quantum Dots), will inaugurate the event with a special lecture.

Well-renowned Scientists and Professors from top QS-ranked universities,

Editors of Top Journals, and Industrial experts have agreed to be our

Plenary Speakers. We have more than 60 speakers across the globe who will

share their expertise at the event.

ICNAN-2025 aims to bring together Indian and International communities

(students, scientists, engineers, and stakeholders from academia,

government laboratories, industry, and other organizations) working in

Nanoscale science and technology to discuss new and exciting advances in

the field. The conference covers a broad theme in this area to accommodate

a wide range of interests and to facilitate interdisciplinary

collaboration/interaction in both academia and industry. The conference

will also provide an ideal environment for developing new collaborations

and opportunities to meet experts in various areas of this field.

Highlights of ICNAN 2025

 - Special Lecture by Nobel Laureate

 - Lectures from renowned speakers and Editors from Top Journals

 - Speakers from more than 20 countries

 - A special session on Women in Science and Technology

 - Speakers from Top-Ranked Universities

 - ACS Journals Presentation Awards (ACS Energy Letters, ACS Applied

 Nano Materials, ACS Applied Energy Materials, ACS Materials Au, ACS

 Nanoscience Au, ACS Omega) + Rs 3000/- cash prize and a journal certificate

 from ACS.

 - Ten best presentations in ICNAN 2025 will be awarded a certificate

 from RSC Journals - Nanoscale and Nanoscale Advances, as well as a gift

 voucher from the Royal Society of Chemistry.

 - Best Presentation awards for the participants from IOP Nanotechnology

 – Each winner will get a journal certificate.

 - Wiley Best Presentation Awards - Eight Best Presentation awards will

 be given to participants from Wiley. Each winner will receive a journal

 - ICNAN Young Researcher Awards - The “Young Researcher Awards” is an

 a certificate of appreciation.

 - ICNAN Women Researcher Awards - Best presentation awards from Women

subject: AlphaForge 3.0-Reg
body:
Dear all,

Greetings !

What if your next idea could go beyond theory and become a real-world

solution? 📊

On the eve of SBST’s Silver Jubilee celebrations, we are excited to

announce the launch of AlphaForge 3.0 — the flagship biotechnology

entrepreneurship event by the Alpha Bio Cell (ABC).

Scheduled from 26th to 28th March at the Homi Bhabha Gallery, SJT, this

three-day ideathon is designed to push boundaries and spark innovation.

AlphaForge 3.0 challenges participants to think critically, develop

impactful solutions, and present their ideas with clarity and confidence.

Get ready to innovate, collaborate, and transform your ideas into reality.

Throughout the event, you will work in teams to solve real-world

biotechnology problem statements, develop and present scientific posters,

engage in an investor-style auction round, and test your knowledge in Alpha

Jeopardy. The journey culminates in pitching a comprehensive business model

to an expert panel, simulating real-world entrepreneurial evaluation.

AlphaForge 3.0 is not just a competition, it is an opportunity to develop

practical skills in innovation, teamwork, and business strategy, while

learning how to translate scientific ideas into market-ready solutions.

Top-performing teams will also compete for a prize pool worth 15K+.

Registrations are now open on VTOP. We strongly encourage you to take part

in this unique experience and challenge yourself beyond the classroom.

Register here:

https://events.vit.ac.in/Home/eventDetails/000950

We look forward to your participation! 🚀”

Thank you

subject: Reminder: NPTEL: Exam Registration is open now for Jan 2026 courses!
body:
Dear Learner,

Here is the much-awaited announcement on registering for the Jan 2026 NPTEL course certification exam. 

1. The registration for the certification exam is open only to those learners who have enrolled in the course. 

2. If you want to register for the exam for this course, login here using the same email id which you had used to enroll to the course in Swayam portal. Please note that Assignments submitted through the exam registered email id ALONE will be taken into consideration towards final consolidated score & certification. 

3. 
Date of exam: April 17, 2026

CLICK HERE
 
to register for the exam.

Choose from the Cities where exam will be conducted:
 
Exam Cities

4. Exam fees: 

If you register for the exam and pay before 
Feb 09, 2026
, Exam fees will be 
Rs. 1000/- per exam.

5. 50% fee waiver for the following categories: 

Students belonging to the SC/ST category: please select Yes for the SC/ST option and upload the correct Community certificate.

Students belonging to the PwD category with more than 40% disability: please select Yes for the option and upload the relevant Disability certificate. 

6. 
Last date for exam registration: Feb 13, 2026 (Friday). 

7. 
Between Feb 09, 2026 & Feb 13, 2026 late fee will be applicable.

8. Mode of payment: Online payment - debit card/credit card/net banking/UPI. 

9. 
HALL TICKET: 

The hall ticket will be available for download tentatively by
 
2 weeks prior to the exam date
. We will confirm the same through an announcement once it is published. 

10. FOR CANDIDATES WHO WOULD LIKE TO WRITE MORE THAN 1 COURSE EXAM:- you can add or delete courses and pay separately – till the date when the exam form closes. Same day of exam – you can write exams for 2 courses in the 2 sessions. The same exam center will be allocated for both the sessions. 

11. 
Data changes: 

Last date for data changes: 
Feb 13, 2026: 

We will charge an additional fee of Rs. 200 to make any changes related to name, DOB, photo, signature, SC/ST and PWD certificates after the last date of data changes.

The following 6 fields can be changed (until the form closes) ONLY when there are NO courses in the course cart. And you will be able to edit those fields only if you: - 

REMOVE unpaid courses from the cart And/or - CANCEL paid courses 

1. Do you come under the SC/ST category? 

2. SC/ST Proof 

3. Are you a person with disabilities? 

4. Are you a person with disabilities above 40%? 

5. Disabilities Proof 

6. What is your role? 

Note: 
Once you remove or cancel a course, you will be able to edit these fields immediately. 

But, for canceled courses, refund of fees will be initiated only after 2 weeks. 

12. 
LAST DATE FOR CANCELING EXAMS and getting a refund: 
Feb 13, 2026 

13. Click here to view Timeline and Guideline :
 
Guideline

Domain Certification

Domain Certification helps learners to gain expertise in a specific Area/Domain. This can be helpful for learners who wish to work in a particular area as part of their job or research or for those appearing for some competitive exam or becoming job ready or specializing in an area of study. 

Every domain will comprise Core courses and Elective courses. Once a learner completes the requisite courses as per the mentioned criteria, you will receive a Domain Certificate showcasing your scores and the domain of expertise. Kindly refer to the following link for the list of courses available under each domain: 
https://nptel.ac.in/domains

Outside India Candidates

Candidates who are residing outside India may also fill the exam form and pay the fees. Mode of exam and other details will be communicated to you separately.

subject: MH Circular: Online Room reservation counseling for 2021 admitted B. Tech students (2023-24)
body:
Office of the Men’s Hostel, VIT, Vellore

29th November, 2023

CIRCULAR

Online Room reservation counseling for 2021 admitted B. Tech students

(2023-24)

 - This is to inform all 2021 admitted B. Tech Indian, NRI and

Foreign students

 of the Men’s Hostel that the online room reservation counselling for the

 winter semester-2023-24 will be held on December 18, 2023, from 10:30

 AM to 8:00 PM.

 - Mock room counselling will be conducted on 4th December 2023 from

 10:30 AM to 8:00 PM.

 - Students will be checked into the allotted rooms only if the fee

 payment procedure is complete.

 - Fee payment through VTop will be enabled from Dec 21st, 2023, 3.00 PM

 onward. Room and mess type details can be viewed immediately on payment.

 Caterer details will be made available from 31st Dec 2023 onward.

NCGPA Based Ranking: Priority will be given based on students’ academic

performance as well as the Code of Conduct. Normalized CGPA of the

students’ will be calculated as stated below:

NCGPA = CGPA X (GROUP TOPPER CGPA / BRANCH TOPPER CGPA)

Counselling Process: 

 1. NCGPA rank of the students taking part in the counselling process

 will be displayed in their respective student login ONE day in advance

 before Mock room counselling.

 2. Students can select their room partners as per their preferences.

 Indians can choose NRI & Foreign students as their roommates as well.

 3. Student having a higher rank is allowed to group students with lower

 NCGPA and apply for a shared accommodation (1, 2, 3, 4, 6 & 8 bedded rooms).

Application Flow

 1. Login to the Hostel Counselling Portal (Link will be made available

 in the VTOP spotlight)

 2. Please note your Rank. Read the instructions available as FAQ

 thoroughly.

 3. Click on ‘Create Basket’. Create the basket for the room type you

 prefer to stay.

 4. Add group members (friends) you wish to include as in-mates of that

 respective bed type. Now the system will trigger OTP to your friend’s

 registered VIT email ID.

 5. Your friend can share his consent for joining with you by sharing his

 OTP.

 6. You may enter the OTP and finalize the request.

 7. Repeat Step 03 to Step 06 for each basket and friends included in the

 basket

 8. After finalizing all the baskets, click on ‘Block Selection’.

 9. Select the basket you have created, followed by this the system will

 list the blocks where the respective room-bed type is available.

 10. Click ‘Add’ to include this block as one of your preference.

 11. Repeat Step 09 and 10 for providing the list of block preferences.

 12. You can edit the priority.

 13. Now you can log out from the application.

 Note:

 1. OTP will be triggered while adding a friend under various bed types.

 2. Deletion of block choice is not possible. However, you can least

 prioritize the same.

SDOT Training Schedule for B.Tech (Batch 4 ) Students (30hrs) is scheduled

on 31st March 2026 onwards

 Please find the attached revised students list with their

Trainer, Classroom details.

Career Development Centre (CDC) has scheduled training programmes in phases

starting 31st March 2026 onwards

The training will be conducted in the evenings and during weekends.

Periodical tests during the training and after the training also will be

conducted.

Please note that attending the training and tests are mandatory to attend

Super Dream and Dream companies.

CDC will monitor the training attendance and the test scores and will allow

only those students who do well in the assessments to appear for the super

dream and dream (IT/Core) companies. This is done to give opportunity for

those students who are sincere and may have a lesser CGPA. All the students

(including 9 pointers) have to attend the training and assessments.

This measure is taken to mitigate the industry slowdown which is impacting

the campus placements that may be seen with the current year placements.

The CDC Office will inform the hostel authorities for the later hour food

up to 9.30 pm.

Students who are coming late will not be allowed for

the training sessions. Even if they are coming 10 mins late also will not

be allowed.

Students are asked to bring their own laptop for the lab classes.

subject: Call for Nominations – Student Council 2025-26
body:
Dear Students,

The Student Council is a diverse group of students from across all

departments, working together to represent the needs and aspirations of the

entire student body. It coordinates with various other departments along

with the Office of Students' Welfare to execute various university level

events and put continuous efforts to make such events grand and

successful. If you're passionate about making VIT an even better place and

you are the leader who wants to make change, we encourage you to nominate

yourself!

The Office of Students' Welfare is inviting nominations for the Student

Council 2025-26. This is your opportunity to represent your peers,

contribute to student initiatives, and play a vital role in shaping student

life at VIT.

For submitting your nomination and more information on the nomination

process and the role of the Student Council, please visit the following

link.

Form Link: https://forms.gle/BopJsUumVu6Z92h2A

https://forms.gle/BopJsUumVu6Z92h2A

The link will be available only till 15.05.2025, 5:00 PM. The

applications received will be scrutinized and called for an interview.

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:

 1. Students who have been involved in any form of disciplinary action,

 either currently or in the past, are not eligible to hold any position.

 2. As of the Winter Semester 2024–25, only students in their pre-final

 year are eligible to apply for the post of Executive Member.

 3. As of the Winter Semester 2024–25, students in the 6th semester of a

 5-year degree programme (B.Arch. and Integrated Programmes) are also

 eligible to apply for the post of Executive Member.

 4. Students from all other years are eligible to apply for the post of

 Member Secretary.

 5. The position of Member Secretary is categorized into three

 specialized divisions: Technical, Cultural, and Digital.

 6. A minimum CGPA of 9.0 is required to be eligible for the posts of

 Executive Member and Member Secretary.

 7. A minimum CGPA of 8.5 is required to be eligible for the posts of

 Member Secretary – Cultural and Member Secretary – Technical.

 8. A minimum CGPA of 7.5 is required to be eligible for the post of

 Member Secretary – Digital.

 9. CGPA eligibility will be assessed based on the grades announced after

 the Winter Semester 2024–25.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF STUDENT COUNCIL MEMBERS:

 - To officially represent all the students in the school / institute.

 - To identify and help solve problems encountered by students in the

 school / institute.

 - To communicate its opinion to the school / institute administration on

 any subject that concerns students.

 - To promote and encourage the involvement of students in organizing

 school / institute level activities.

 - To inform students about any subject that concerns them.

 - To consult students on any issue of importance and bring it to the

 notice of the Students' Welfare office.

 - To support and contribute to achieve better / higher accreditation for

 the institute.

 - To participate in the development of the school activities.

 - To propose activities to the school/institute administration that

 would improve the quality of student life in the school/institute.

We look forward to receiving your nominations!

body:
Dear VIT students,

As today, 11.59 pm, is the deadline to applyfor the Finlatics Business Analyst Experience Program, please note:

1. Please note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of this project

2. If you have any upcoming assignments, examinations, or personal commitments, you can pick a project start date after completing the same to help the project fit in with your schedule.

3. You can pick to do the project in 1 or 2 months based on your schedule. You will be allowed a break during the project tenure for any academic or personal commitment. You would also be allowed a Project Extension of an additional month in case you cannot complete it in the required duration.

4. You can apply for the project using the link:

https://82e6v.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSlPYaV0LcO3ykXyRn8u/10WVYJJvVB3a

5. The time commitment required for the project is around 2 - 4 hours per week.

6. Live Sessions would also be conducted to help students learn data analysis via Microsoft Excel by covering topics like Regression Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis and Scenario Building.

The program has a minimal induction fee of Rs. 1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A fee waiver of 15 - 25%shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technologystudents on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1690 + GST / Rs. 2199 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, please apply before today's deadline.

The first mail circulated at the campus is attached below:

Dear VIT students,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Business Analyst Experience Program, an online live project that helps students gain work experience in data-driven decision-making at the Vellore Institute of Technology.

This project is running at leading campuses, including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Delhi, IIM Bangalore, and BITS Pilani among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Understand research, types of data analytics, their usage, and their benefits across industry segments like Consumer Goods, Tourism, and e-commerce, among others, through a case study-driven approach.

2. Assess business projects and propose solutions using a data-driven decision-making approach

3. Solve business problems of technology-oriented businesses that impact their profitability.

4. Learn & Apply Power BI, a pan-industry business intelligence tool used to analyze data to gain insights into marketing campaigns.

Live Sessions would also be conducted for learning data analysis via Microsoft Excel by covering topics like Regression Analysis, Sensitivity Analysis and Scenario Building.

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificates of Work Experience as a Business Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation on performance

3. Certificate of Proficiency in Power BI.

To apply, students can fill out the form below :

https://82e6v.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSHurZ4EnekNmuuTEX5Q/AlSP0R-sV2dw

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge is required to be a part of the program. All necessary training on data-driven decision-making & Power BI will be imparted to the program. The project is doable along with any other commitment due to its work-from-home and online structure.

Project Duration: 1 month /2 months (on student choice)

Time commitment: 3 - 4 hours per week

Project Start: Flexible start date option on selected student choice. Students can choose to start the project post-exams.

Project Break & Extension: Selected students will be eligible for a break or extension during the project if needed for any exams, assignments, or personal commitments.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee of Rs.1999 + GST / Rs. 2999 + GST (on student choice).

Fee Waiver: A 15 - 25% fee waiver shall be given to all Vellore Institute of Technologystudents on the abovementioned minimal induction fee. This waiver will reduce the fee to Rs. 1690 + GST / Rs. 2199 + GST.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply through the above mentioned link only.

The application process will take 2-3 mins of your time and is free.
