World Children’s Day

World Children’s Day was first established in 1954 as Universal Children's

Day and is celebrated on 20 November each year to promote international

togetherness, and awareness among children worldwide, and to improve

children's welfare. Mothers and fathers, teachers, nurses and doctors,

government leaders and civil society activists, religious and community

elders, corporate moguls and media professionals, as well as young people

and children themselves, can play an important part in making World

Children's Day relevant for their societies, communities, and nations.

World Children's Day offers each of us an inspirational entry point to

advocate, promote and celebrate children's rights, translating into

dialogues and actions that will build a better world for children.

The World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims

The World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims takes place on 20th

November every year as the appropriate acknowledgment of victims of road

traffic crashes and their families. It was started by the British road

crash victim charity, Road Peace, in 1993 and was adopted by the United

Nations General Assembly in 2005.

The objectives of the World Day of Remembrance for Road Traffic Victims

 are to provide a platform for road traffic victims and their families to:

§ remember all people killed and seriously injured on the roads;

§ acknowledge the crucial work of the emergency services;

§ draw attention to the generally trivial legal response to culpable road

deaths and injuries;

§ advocate for better support for road traffic victims and victim families;

 § promote evidence-based actions to prevent and eventually stop

further road traffic deaths and injuries.

subject: REREMINDER: VIT Central Library Book Exhibition - Last 2 Days (Ends Tomorrow!)
body:
Dear Students, Scholars, and Faculty,

This is a timely reminder that the Book Exhibition organized by the VIT

Periyar EVR Central Library, Vellore, is currently running successfully at

the Anna Auditorium.

The exhibition, which began on November 19th, is now in its second day

and concludes tomorrow, November 21st, 2020.

We have successfully gathered 25 leading publishers and vendors who are

proudly showcasing their newest titles and books across various academic

disciplines.

We sincerely request all members of the VIT community—students, scholars,

and faculty—to visit the Anna Auditorium today or tomorrow. Your

participation is vital for two reasons:

1. Library Enrichment: Please review the collection and identify any

valuable titles that are currently unavailable in the Central Library. Your

selections will be prioritized for purchase to enhance our library

resources.

2. Personal Collection: This is a perfect opportunity to purchase new

and essential books directly from the vendors for your own personal use.

Don't miss out on this excellent opportunity to update your reading

materials and contribute to the growth of our library.

We look forward to seeing you there!

Hello Students,

Congratulations on being shortlisted for the internship program!

[IMPORTANT]

We are excited to announce the Unlox - Tech driven

https://unlox.com/ 3-month Job Bridge Program 2025 for UG/PG students, in

collaboration with the 83+ Academic and Employment Partners, NATIONAL SKILL

DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (NSDC).

Fill out the Google Form today to reserve your place in the program:

 https://forms.gle/TT9bzrTVywGFe4n98

https://forms.gle/TT9bzrTVywGFe4n98 

Here is an outline of the program's structure.

1. Training Outline

 - Live Mentoring with Industry Experts: Evening classes (6:30 PM -

 8:00 PM) are conducted live (Which is only Live) on the Zoom platform to

 fit your schedule. Get guidance at every step.

- From Basics to Advanced: Perfect for beginners and those looking to

 refine advanced skills, starting from scratch.

 - BLU AI-Powered Development Made Easy: Build applications with

 minimal coding, create innovative solutions using BLU AI, and easily design

 effective AI prompts.

 - LMS Access for Flexibility: Recorded live sessions will be uploaded

 to the Learning Management System (LMS) and available for 6 months from the

 batch start date. Login credentials will be shared after registration,

 ensuring uninterrupted learning at your own pace.

2. Internship Conduct

 - 10+ Minor Project: The minor project is an individual project,

 where students will work on projects related to each topic they are

 learning.

 - Major Project (CAPSTONE): The major project is a group project, and

 you will work in a group of 3-4 interns, with specific responsibilities

 assigned to each intern. The company will provide you with all the required

 data and materials for the project.

 - Resume Building: Get expert guidance to craft a standout resume that

 gets noticed.

 - Mock Interviews: Receive feedback from industry experts to sharpen

 your interview skills.

 - Masterclasses: Learn from top leaders in global companies through

 exclusive sessions.

Certifications Provided

 - Blu – Your AI Mentor: Get 24/7 support with instant doubt solutions

 and personalized learning feedback.

 - Edu-let Tablet – Built for Learning: Stay focused with your

 dedicated tablet preloaded with content & mentor access. Learn on campus

 or at home—no distractions

 - Course Certificate: Receive a prestigious certificate from Unlox

 Verified by Skill India, Startup India.

 - Internship Certificate: Earn a certificate from our partnered MNCs &

 StartUps.

 - Career Launchpad – Powered by PrepFree https://www.prepfree.in/

 -

 Smart, ATS-friendly resume building

 -

 AI-powered mock interviews for real-time feedback

 -

 Weekly boot camps led by industry experts

 -

 Job Recommendations matched to your skills and goals

subject: FIFA World Cup Final Prediction Contest – Win Exciting Prizes!
body:
Dear Students,

The Office of Students' Welfare invites you to participate in the FIFA

World Cup Football Final Prediction Contest.

Put your football knowledge to the test by predicting the outcome of the

FIFA World Cup Final between Argentina and Spain. Share your predictions

and stand a chance to win exciting prizes!

Registration Form:

https://forms.gle/S1bcvMWTqi7k7kiE6

Please use the Google Form link above to submit your predictions.

Rules & Regulations:

 - Please ensure you are logged in with your VIT Gmail ID to access the

 form.

 - Only one entry per participant is permitted.

 - Only entries submitted before 11:59 PM on 19 July will be considered.

 - Predict whether the match will be decided in regular time, extra time,

 or a penalty shootout.

 - Predict the number of goals scored by each team (excluding penalty

 shootout goals) and the goal difference.

 - Winners will be selected based on the highest number of correct

 predictions.

 -

 - If multiple participants have the same highest score, the winner(s)

 will be selected through a random pick.

 - The decision of the judges will be final and binding.

 - Exciting prizes await the winners!

Prizes:

Exciting cash prizes await our top predictors! There are 5 prizes of ₹2500

each, with one winner selected from each of the following course categories:

- 2-Year PG Course

- 3-Year Course

- 4-Year Course

- 5-Year Course

- Freshers

Submit your entries before the poll ends tonight and may the best

predictions win!

We look forward to your participation. Best of luck!

proficient in soldering, PCB designing, microcontroller programming,

embedded programming, MATLAB, circuit designing, and industrial wiring.

2. Website Development Internship: Ideal for students with skills in

React J.S., software development, frontend, and backend development.

3. App Development Internship: Perfect for those interested in mobile app

development.

4. Market Research, Survey, and Strategy Planning Internship: Open to MBA

students with a knack for market analysis and strategic planning.

5. ML and AI Development Internship: Suited for students passionate about

machine learning and artificial intelligence.

6. Designer Internship: Requires proficiency in design software like

Canva for creating posters and other visual content.

7. Content Writing Internship: For students with strong writing skills

and a passion for creating engaging content, particularly in the form of

blogs.

8. 3D designing and Printing: Requires proficiency in 3D printing &

design, CAD

Duration: Starts from June 1st. The internship will span 45 days with

no stipend provided during the probation period. If performance is

exceptional, the opportunity for an internship role with a stipend will be

considered

- Certificate of Completion

experts

- Enhancement of Your Resume

subject: Congratulations to Team Epigen for their Achievement in BioBuzz – Shaastra 2026 | IIT Madras
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Epigen has secured First Place in

the BioBuzz Competition at Shaastra 2026, the annual technical festival

of the Indian Institute of Technology (IIT) Madras, held from 2nd to 6th

January 2026.

BioBuzz was a national-level quiz competition that tested participants on

advanced concepts in cell biology, molecular biology, genetics,

biotechnology, immunology, and recent innovations in biological sciences.

Team Members:

1. Sharanya Pal – 22MSI0160

2. A. Chetana Aasritha – 22MSI0159

3. Tanisha Rakshit – 22MSI0180

We congratulate Team Epigen on this remarkable accomplishment and

appreciate their efforts in representing our institution with excellence at

a prestigious national platform.

online information webinar for our students.

Overview of the QMUL Summer Programme

Application process and key deadlines

Required documents and eligibility

Tips for preparing a strong application

Opportunity to ask questions directly to QMUL representatives

📌 Who Should Attend?

Students who have already applied

Students planning to apply soon

Anyone interested in international summer study opportunities

Supporting materials can be found on the website:

VIT currently hosts a vibrant range of clubs and chapters across diverse

domains such as Arts & Culture, Technical, Social Outreach, Health &

subject: Congratulations to Rohit N for Achievement under PRISM Scheme - DSIR
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Rohit N (21MID0138), a final-year student

of M.Tech. (Integrated) – Computer Science and Engineering with

Specialization in Data Science, has achieved a remarkable milestone under

the PRISM Scheme (Promoting Innovations in Individuals, Start-ups, and

MSMEs) of the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research (DSIR),

Ministry of Science & Technology, Government of India.

His project titled “Autonomous Bee Hives” has been selected under

the Student

Innovator category with a total approved budget of Rs. 5,00,000.

Rohit.N has officially received the Grant Sanction Order for his first

installment from Dr. Sarika Madan, Scientist ‘E’, DSIR, at the Ministry

of Science & Technology, Technology Bhawan, New Delhi on 25th August 2025.

We also acknowledge the invaluable guidance and mentorship of Dr.

Kannadasan R [Emp ID: 12378], Associate Professor (Grade 1), School of

Computer Science and Engineering (SCOPE), under whose supervision the

project was developed and submitted for the PRISM grant.

This outstanding achievement reflects the spirit of innovation and

technological excellence nurtured at VIT and brings immense pride to the

institution.

Heartiest congratulations to Rohit N for this prestigious recognition from

the Government of India.

subject: Invitation to Participate - National Space Science Symposium (NSSS-2026)
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that the National Space Science Symposium

(NSSS-2026) will be held at NESAC, Umiam, Meghalaya, from February 23–27,

2026, organized by ISRO. This symposium offers a unique opportunity for

students to gain exposure to India’s space science programme, discuss novel

ideas, and interact with eminent space leaders.

Opportunities for Students:

 -

 Exposure to India’s space science programme

 -

 Be vocal on India’s science exploration plan

 -

 Discuss novel ideas and place opinions

 -

 Be heard by space leaders

Program Highlights:

 -

 Invited lectures & plenary sessions by eminent space scientists

 -

 Theme-based oral & poster presentations (student research & innovations)

 -

 Interactive sessions with senior scientists

Eligibility: Postgraduate and undergraduate students of Physics, Chemistry,

Mathematics, Computer Science, Astrobiology, and Technology studying in

recognized institutions across India.

Deadline for pan-India student registration: 15 September 2025

Registration Link: https://jigyasa.iirs.gov.in/nsss

We encourage all interested students to register and actively participate

in this prestigious event.

subject: Option to earn Internship Credits through Certification Courses
body:
Dear Student,

As per the curriculum requirements, students are expected to earn their

internship credits by completing a minimum of 28 days of training in a

domain-specific industry.

However, it is recognized that some students may not have the opportunity

to undertake the internship in an industry. In such cases, an alternative

pathway has been provided, allowing students to earn the required credits

by registering and successfully completing an approved certification course.

The following guidelines pertain to the certification courses offered and

the Internship Credit eligibility criteria. Please note that pursuing a

certification is entirely optional.

Credit Eligibility:

Only the professional proctored certification examination will be

considered for summer internship credit.

Course completion certificates will not be accepted under any circumstances.

Course Selection & Preference:

Students may take up to two courses; however, only one proctored

certification examination will be considered for internship credit. The

second course, if chosen, may be pursued for skilling or personal

development purposes.

Any course failing to meet the minimum threshold of 50 selections will be

discontinued.

Training and Payment:

Upon commencement of the course, students will have one week to complete

the payment. Within this period, students may switch to another course or

certification. Once the payment is made, the student is required to

continue with that particular certification. Students may attend the

one-week training session and proceed with payment upon satisfaction.

List of Certifications:

be hosting a live webinar to give you an overview of the engineering

articulation programs available within the Strathclyde and VIT

collaborative partnership. The session will cover the undergraduate 2+2

body: Dear Sir, My name is Mr. Obi W, the manager, credit and foreign bills of Eco Bank Plc. I am writing in respect of a foreign customer of my bank with account number 14-255-2004/utb/t who perished in a plane crash [Korean Air Flight 801] with the whole passengers aboard on August 6, 1997. Since the demise of this our customer, I personally has watched with keen interest to see the next of kin but all has proved abortive as no one has come to claim his funds of usd.20.5 m, [twenty million five hundred thousand united states dollars] which has been with my branch for a very long time. On this note, I decided to seek for whom his name shall be used as the next of kin as no one has come up to be the next of kin. And the banking ethics here does not allow such money to stay more than five years, because money will be recalled to the bank treasury as unclaimed after this period. In view of this I got your contact through a trade journal after realizing that your name and country is similar to the deceased. I will give you 25% of the total. Upon the receipt of your response, I will send you by fax or e-mail the application, bank's fax number and the next step to take. I will not fail to bring to your notice that this business is hitch free and that you should not entertain any fear as all modalities for fund transfer can be finalized within five banking days, after you apply to the bank as a relation to the deceased. When you receive this letter. Kindly send me an e-mail signifying Your decision including your private Tel/Fax numbers for quick communication. Respectfully submitted, Obi W.

subject: Kind attention: Pre final year (​B.Tech Students) Super Dream SDOT Training Scheduled from 12th February 2026 onwards
body:
Kind attention: Pre final year (B.Tech Students) Super

Dream SDOT Training Scheduled from 12th February 2026 onwards

Kind attention: Pre-final year

Career Development Centre (CDC) will be conducting training programmes in

phases starting from 12th February 2026 onwards (tentative (Batch by batch)

other details will be shared at the earliest.

The training will be conducted in the evenings and during weekends.

Periodical tests during the training and after the training also will be

conducted.

Please note that attending the training and tests are mandatory to attend

Super Dream and Dream companies.

CDC will monitor the training attendance and the test scores and will allow

only those students who do well in the assessments to appear for the super

dream and dream (IT/Core) companies. This is done to give opportunity for

those students who are sincere and may have a lesser CGPA. All the students

(including 9 pointers) have to attend the training and assessments.

This measure is taken to mitigate the industry slowdown which is impacting

the campus placements that may be seen with the current year placements.

Note: OD will be given if the training is conducted during the class hours

All PAT registered are asked to fill in the below link on or before 6th

February 2026 10.00 am without fail. If any student is not registered in

the below link, the CDC office will allot the trainer and language

preference as Advance Java. 

https://forms.gle/rNBwajhoTgiUyGQB6

NOTE: Based on the trainer availability, CDC will allocate the trainer to

the candidates

subject: Final Deadline (July 15, 2026): 2nd IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Systems at the Edge (ICEdge 2026), IISc Bangalore
body:
Dear Colleagues and Researchers,

We are pleased to invite you to submit your latest research to the 2nd

IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Computing and Systems at the

Edge (ICEdge 2026). The conference will be held at the Indian Institute

of Science (IISc) Bangalore, India, from December 17–19, 2026.

About the Conference

The rapid progress in Artificial Intelligence (AI), the Internet of Things

(IoT), and edge computing technologies has created unprecedented

opportunities for innovation and system-level efficiency. ICEdge 2026 aims

to bring together leading researchers, practitioners, and industry experts

to exchange discoveries and insights spanning devices, architectures, EDA

tools, security, and Edge AI applications.

 - Format: Manuscripts must follow the IEEE template, utilizing a

 double-column format in 9- or 10-point font. Submissions must be in

 readable PDF format and must not exceed 6 pages (excluding references,

 - Double-Blind Review: Submissions must be fully anonymous. Do not

 include author names, affiliations, or PDF metadata containing identifying

 details. Citations to prior work must be written in the third person;

 phrases like "omitted for blind review" are not permitted.

subject: Wall Street's dirty little secret ...
body: It was the Spring of 1979. I was just a tall, goofy looking kid in middle school with buck-teeth and freckles. Each day in the cafeteria, I walked from table to table ... Stealing other kids' lunch money. No, I didn't rob them with a gun or a knife - I just made them a little deal. "Let me borrow two dollars today," I said, "and I'll bring you five dollars next week." The investment was too good to pass up, and other kids were throwing their lunch money at me like gravy on mashed potatoes. Of course when "next week" rolled around and I couldn't pony up the cash, I promised to pay them even more the week after that, if they would just let me keep their investment a little bit longer. Eventually the end of the year came and went, high school started and with it came girls, and homework, and parties, and sports, and those poor kids from eighth grade had more things on their mind than last year's lunch money. I made off with a tidy sum for a middle school kid, and I didn't even get beat up. Hidden inside this story are the two greatest stock market secrets you will ever learn. First of all, greed is your number one enemy. You're not going to turn $2 into $5 in a week, so cash out when you're ahead. Don't wait for the boat to sink before grabbing the lifejacket. Second, never trust an investment adviser of any kind. They are looking out for their own money, not yours. The "professionals", those stuffy investment counselors and money managers, will always tell you that the best time to buy is NOW. According to those guys, the longer you keep your money in the market, the more money you're going to make. Ask them when is the best time to sell and their answer is "NEVER". In a sense, they are right. If you put $250,000 in an index fund right now, you'll probably have over a million dollars in thirty or forty years. But here's the problem: Do you want to WAIT thirty or forty years to be rich? Hell no! You want the money NOW - so you can enjoy it. It's hard to make use of your fortune when you're seventy years old in a wheelchair. If you could make a million dollars in the next few years, what would you do with it? Where would you travel? What kind of car would you buy? The fact is ... youth is the best time to be rich. If your goal is to make quick profits in the market, volatility is your ally, and stability your enemy. You want to see those large upswings, two hundred points in a day, followed by the four hundred point crash a week later. You don't care if the market went up or down 20% this year as long it was UNSTABLE. That's how you're going to make the money. What I'm talking about here is day trading. My father invests the traditional way; he holds some good stocks and he goes up 30K and down 30K. In the long term of 5-10 years he makes money. The day trader buys or sells 5,000 shares of XYZ for a $25,000 profit in a 5-10 minute trade. He acts quickly, taking advantage of all the information at his disposal about a certain stock, and estimating whether it will go up or down within hours, sometimes within minutes. I can teach you how to do this - and how to make amazing amounts of money at it. It's not rocket science, and you only need to learn a few basic principles to get started. Society would have you believe that successful trading is complicated and requires formal training. The truth is, wealthy people use very simple investment strategies to make money. Popular media and investment professionals portray successful trading as difficult and complex to scare you out of the boxing ring. They don't want the competetion - and they sure as hell don't want you paying a few dollars to an online trading firm to execute a trade for which they'd charge you forty or fifty dollars. They make their money only if you believe two lies: 1) That investing is too difficult and risky for the average person. 2) That using an investment adviser who charges a high commission is safer than trading online for a few bucks per trade. Here is what the financial gurus in today's society absolutely, positively DO NOT WANT YOU TO KNOW ... The strategies for profitable day trading are in fact so simple that anyone can do it - provided they spend a few hours of studying. After reading over 200 financial books and publications during the past decade, and after using day trading to successfully make more than four million dollars in the stock market, I've learned the following lessons: ** Achieving financial success is incredibly simple. ** Anyone can do it. ** It only takes a few hours to learn. The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [14th April

Puthandu/Vishu/Bihu/Baishakhi/Pohela Boishakh/Jude Sheetal / Cheiraoba

People in Tamil Nadu are gearing up to celebrate Puthandu (Tamil for new

year) today. Set with the lunisolar Hindu calendar’s solar cycle, it is the

first day of the traditional Tamil new year. The new year begins with the

first month of the Tamil solar calendar, Chittirai.

While Tamilians across the world celebrate Puthandu, many other

communities across India celebrate their traditional new year on the same

day or (14th or 15th April) - it is Vishu for people in Kerala, Bihu for

those in Assam, Baishakhi in Punjab and Pohela Boishakh in West Bengal.

Notably, states like Manipur, Tripura, Odisha, Bihar, Uttar Pradesh,

Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Rajasthan, too commemorate their new year

The Office of Students’ Welfare maintains a log and inventory of items

handed over by the Security Office as lost or misplaced within the

campus. These items primarily include Bags, Helmets, Umbrellas, Airpods,

Welfare, located in PRP Annex (Room No. 204), to check for their items.

verification.

subject: You are invited:International Seminar on “Digital Dreamscapes: Youth Navigating AI, Creativity & Virtual Expression”at VIT : S​ponsored by the Department of Youth Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India
body:
Dear All,

Kind Attention: Faculty Members, Research Scholars and Students

We are pleased to announce that the VIT International Relations Office is

organizing the International Seminar on the theme “Digital Dreamscapes:

Youth Navigating AI, Creativity & Virtual Expression” sponsored by the

Department of Youth Affairs, Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports,

Government of India having a special focus on the leveraging AI and

emerging tech to reimagine performing arts, architecture, and content

creation with ethical foresight.

The main objective of this international seminar is to provide Indian youth

with a comprehensive understanding of global issues and international research,

and to equip them with perspectives on themes relevant to their context,

thereby enhancing their knowledge and confidence to articulate their views

at international forums.

Organised by: International Relations Office, VIT

Date of the event: 26th March 2026, Thursday

Venue: Dr. M. Channa Reddy Auditorium

Time: 10:00 am 

We warmly invite our faculty members, research scholars and students to

participate in this important initiative.

Seats are limited, and early registration is strongly encouraged as

confirmations will be made on a first-come, first-served basis.

Registration is free. 

Last date for Registration: Saturday, 28th February 2026

Note: Participants who attend this event will receive participation

certificates.

Registration link:

https://forms.gle/bzgCQt9bf1vCfLXd8

For more details, please contact

Convenor, International Seminar-2026

iconclave@vit.ac.in <iconclave@vit.ac.in>

Thank you,

Best Wishes,

Dr.R.Seenivasan

Director -International Relations

subject: Immediate Reply Needed
body: Dear Sir, I am Dr James Alabi, the chairman of contract award and review committee set up by the federal government of Nigeria under the new civilian dispensation to award new contracts and review existing ones. I came to know of you in my search for a reliable and reputable person to handle a very confidential transaction, which involves the transfer of a huge sum of money to a foreign account. There were series of contracts executed by a consortium of multi-nationals in the oil industry in favor of N.N.P.C. The original values of these contracts were deliberately over invoiced to the sum of US$12,320,000.00 (Twelve Million Three Hundred and Twenty Thousand United State Dollars). This amount has now been approved and is now ready to be transferred being that the companies that actually executed these contracts have been fully Paid and the projects officially commissioned. Consequently, my colleagues and I are willing to transfer the total amount to your account for subsequent disbursement, since we as civil servants are prohibited by the code of conduct bureau (civil service law) from operating and/or opening foreign accounts in our names. Needless to say, the trust reposed on you at this juncture is enormous, in return, we have agreed to offer you 20% of the transferred sum, while 10% shall be set aside for incidental expenses (internal and external) between both parties in the course of the transaction you will be mandated to remit the balance to other accounts in due course. Modalities have been worked out at the highest level of the Ministry of Finance and the Central Bank of Nigeria for the immediate transfer of the funds within 7 working days subject to your satisfaction of the above stated terms. Our assurance is that your role is risk free. To accord this transaction the legality it deserves and for mutual security of the funds the whole approval procedures will officially and legally processed with your name or the name of any company you may nominate as the bonefide beneficiary. Once more I want you to understand that having put in over twenty-five years in the civil service of my country, I am averse to having my image and career dented. This matter should therefore be treated with utmost secrecy and urgency it deserves. Please you should signify your intention to assist by sending me a reply to this email to state your position on this transaction, if favorable we will take further steps to brief you the full details of this viable transaction. I want to assure you that this business proposal is 100% risk free as we have done our homework properly. I quite believe that you will protect our interest by taking this deal strictly confidential, as we are still in government service, which we intend to retire from in full honor. Kindly expedite action as we are behind schedule to enable us include this transfer in the next batch which would constitute the new quarter payments for the 2002 financial year. Thank you and God bless. Dr James Alabi

subject: AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF)
body:
Dear Students,

 This is a reminder email regarding the AICTE Productization Fellowship

(APF) . Interested students can apply. Below are the details which is

already been shared with all the students on 28th May. Use this

opportunity.

Thanks and regards

C Ramesh Kumar 

Director Innovations

Apply for the AICTE Productization Fellowship (APF), aimed at identifying

and supporting student innovations that are ready to be translated into

real-world products.

We are particularly looking for projects at Technology Readiness Levels

(TRL) 1 to 6, accompanied by a basic Minimum Viable Product (MVP)

or a Proof

of Concept (PoC). The product does not have to be perfect—our goal is to

validate the feasibility and innovation potential. If you don't have a PoC

or MVP, you are still eligible to apply just with an idea.

Key Highlights:

 -

 Eligibility: Open to student teams (average 3 members) from

 AICTE-approved institutions, including recent graduates (within the last 2

 years).

 -

 Funding Support:

 -

 Stage 1: ₹37,000 per team member per month for 12 months.

 -

 Contingency Grant: ₹50,000 per team per year.

 -

 Additional Benefits:

 -

 Access to incubation facilities.

 -

 Expert mentorship.

 -

 Opportunity for Stage-2 funding based on project progress.

 -

 Application Deadline: 15th June 2025.

Below are the pilot steps for students to follow:

------------------------------

Pilot Steps for Students:

 1.

 Upload Innovation on YUKTI Portal

 Visit https://yukti.mic.gov.in, log in or register, and upload the

 innovation details. Students can register directly through this link

 https://yukti.mic.gov.in/registration/SUMyMDE4MTA3ODM

 2.

 Obtain Innovation ID

 Upon submission, an Innovation ID will be generated. This is required

 for the fellowship application.

 3.

 Fill the Google Form

 Submit the Innovation ID and other required details through the official

 application form. Last Date for Internal Registration (Google Form): 10th

 June 2025. Upon this, you'll receive a mail if you are eligible to apply

 for the fellowship.

 Guidelines Document: Link

 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1WE5TZe2jLnQg2yD04GOD3jkChcC7djzePM_UuWGXIOI/

 Google Form: Link https://forms.gle/7CApjzktyLnwdeQC7

------------------------------

 (Ref. - https://www.nbaind.org/accreditationprogram

and the institution overall, it reconfirms our strong student support,

governance and leadership (Ref. NBA criteria). It will solve many

recognition of VIT degrees, and it will improve student mobility.

team, SDC Team, IR Team, Transport Team, HR Team, Outreach Team, PRO Team,

Finance Team, Purchase Team, Guest House Team and the Security Team for

New York at Binghamton, USA

students seeking an introduction to U.S. higher education in a dynamic and

subject: Yantra'25 Events and Guest Details-reg
body:
Dear VITians,

As we celebrate 40 years of VIT, we are excited to present the 5th

edition of Yantra. To embark on an exhilarating journey of innovation and

technology at Yantra 2025, the highly anticipated fifth edition of VIT’s

weeklong tech festival, scheduled to take place from February 3rd to

February 9th, 2025, featuring 60+ diverse events designed to inspire,

educate, and challenge participants from all backgrounds.

Theme: “AI for SDGs” (Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Development

Goals)

Highlights:

 - 20+ Hackathons

 - 20+ Hands-on Workshops

 - 8+ Insightful Tech Talks,

 - 15+ Thrilling Tech Competitions

This year, Yantra 2025 brings an exciting lineup of 20+ hackathons across

10+ specialized tracks, focusing on AI, ML, and Sustainable Development

Goals. These hackathons will provide a collaborative platform where

participants can develop innovative solutions to real-world challenges.

Additionally, the festival will host 20+ hands-on workshops, covering the

latest advancements and emerging trends in technology, offering valuable

practical learning experiences.

For those eager to test their skills, 15+ thrilling tech competitions

will push the boundaries of creativity and problem-solving. Furthermore,

the event will feature 8 insightful tech talks, where industry leaders

and experts will share their knowledge on topics such as cloud services,

electrical design, augmented reality, and more.

Whether you are a student, tech enthusiast, or seasoned professional,

Yantra 2025 provides an exceptional platform for learning, networking, and

exploring the future of technology. With exciting prizes, groundbreaking

innovations, and limitless possibilities, this week-long festival is set to

be an unforgettable experience.

Join us at Yantra 2025 and be a part of the future of technology!

Don't miss out! Register (VTop) now to network with tech professionals and

students.

Please find the attachment below containing a list of event schedules,

categorized by day and type along with the Guest list.

subject: Deadline to Apply in Investment Banking Live Project
body:
Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

As today, 11.59pm is the deadline to apply for the Finlatics Investment Banking Experience Program (IBEP), please note:

1. In case you have any upcoming assignment, examination, or personal commitment, you will have the option to pick a project start date that is after its completion to help the project fit in with your schedule.

2. You will be allowed a break during the project tenure, for any academic or personal commitment. You would also be allowed a Project Extension of an additional month.

3. Please note that no prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of the project as it comes with training and live sessions.

4. You can apply for the project using the following link :

https://www.finlatics.com/ibep_application?src=vitd

5. The Project Duration is: 1 month / 2 months (based on selected student choice) and the time commitment required for the project is 3 - 5 hrs per week.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee: Rs.1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all students of Vellore Institute of Technology on the above-mentioned minimal induction fee.

To be eligible for the waiver, kindly apply before tonight's deadline.

The first mail circulated at the campus is attached below.

Hi NAYAN SHARMA,

We're pleased to extend applications for the Finlatics Investment Banking Experience Program (IBEP), an online live project that helps students gain work experience in private equity & venture capital at the Vellore Institute of Technology. The project provides glimpses into start-ups, their way of working, and financing.

The project is running at leading campuses including IIT Bombay, IIT Madras, IIT Kanpur and BITS Pilani among others.

STRUCTURE of the Live Project:

1. Investment banking, private equity & venture capital-oriented project

2. Assess investment proposals and identify start-ups with high growth potential

3. From a private equity fund perspective, understand various stages of PE investing

4. Engage in the set-up of a Private Equity Fund, with emphasis on investor onboarding, investing cycles & sectoral orientation

5. Author case-based projects on successful exits in the private e quity space, by analyzing mergers & acquisitions

6. Learn how to apply Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) Valuation & Excel-based modeling to companies

Student OUTCOMES:

1. Certificate of Work Experience as an Investment Banking Analyst

2. Letter of Recommendation based on performance

Apply Here (takes 2-3 mins):

https://www.finlatics.com/ibep_application?src=vit

No prerequisites or prior domain knowledge are required to be a part of this project. All necessary training and mentoring will be imparted.

Project Duration: 1 month / 2 months (on selected student choice, with a flexible start date option on selected student choice.

Students will also be eligible for a break or extension during the project if they need it for any academic or personal commitments.

If selected, the program has a minimal induction fee: Rs. 1999 + GST.

Fee Waiver: A 15% fee waiver shall be given to all students of Vellore Institute of Technology on the above-mentioned minimal induction fee.

To be eligible for the fee waiver, kindly apply through the above link only.

We are looking forward to a fruitful engagement.

subject: Congratulations to Team DORA for Achievement in SHIELD 1.0 National Security Challenge | Jaipur
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team DORA emerged as the winners in one of

the four tracks at SHIELD 1.0, a high-intensity 24-hour national

security challenge organized by the Bureau of Police Research and

Development (BPR&D – CDTI), Jaipur, in collaboration with Malaviya

National Institute of Technology (MNIT), Jaipur from 29th to 30th December

2025.

Team DORA comprised:

 - Ketan Chouhan (22BML0090)

 - Shreya Agarwal (22BCE2179)

The team secured the winning position in their respective track with an

innovative solution to the problem statement titled “Real-Time Database

for Delivery Personnel Verification (Gig Workers) & Banking Agents.”

The competition brought together innovators and technologists from across

the country to develop solutions aimed at strengthening internal security,

public safety, and law-enforcement efficiency, making it a highly impactful

and enriching learning experience.

We congratulate Team DORA on this commendable national-level achievement.

National Farmers' Day

Kisan Diwas or National Farmers' Day is observed on December 23, the birth

anniversary of Chaudhary Charan Singh, the fifth prime minister of India.

Born into a farmer's family, Chaudhary Charan Singh was known for his

farmer-friendly policies. He was the prime minister between July 1979 and

January 1980. During his short time as prime minister, Chaudhary Charan

Singh worked hard for the welfare of Indian farmers. He introduced several

welfare schemes for the farmers. The government, in 2001, decided to mark

Charan Singh's birth anniversary as Kisan Diwas.

Kisan Diwas is a day to remember the role of Indian farmers in the economy.

Chaudhary Charan Singh played a key role in bringing the issues of small

and marginal farmers to the forefront. He always fought and stood for

farmers' rights.

subject: Congratulations to Team Sphinx on Achievement at Pravega XII (2026), IISc Bengaluru
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Sphinx secured 1st Place in the event

Robo Sprint (FPV RC Car Event) at Pravega XII (2026), the annual fest

conducted by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc), Bengaluru, held on

7th and 8th February 2026. The team represented the institution among 60+

teams and approximately 160 participants from across the country.

The team achieved 1st Place in Robo Sprint with an official lap time of

30.5 seconds, completing the run with zero penalties, resulting in a final

effective timing of 5 seconds, making it the fastest bot of the event. The

team was awarded a cash prize of ₹15,000 /-.

Team Members:

1. Roshni Mitra – 24BCE0856

2. Pranay Kumar Mahato – 24BIT0594

3. Shruthika Rakesh Nair – 24BME0226

4. Harshita Kumawat – 24BKT0141

We sincerely express our gratitude to the Faculty Mentor, Dr. Somasundaram

S K (Emp. ID: 19612), whose guidance and mentorship played a key role in

the team’s success.

We congratulate Team Sphinx on this remarkable achievement and wish them

continued success in their future endeavours.

subject: Fwd: Last Session Details: Publishing 101 with Taylor & Francis - Author Engagement Program
body:
Dear Research Scholars, and Professors,

Greetings,

As part of ‘Publishing 101 with Taylor & Francis’, we are glad to invite

researchers and academic faculty for the last exclusive session of this

series organized by Taylor & Francis Group on ‘Ethics Focus: Plagiarism &

Text Recycling, Authorship & Conflicts of Interest’.

Date & Time: 13th Nov, 3.00 – 4.30 PM IST

Speakers: 

 - Didi Peng, Research Integrity Manager, Taylor & Francis Group

 - Fulu Akinduro-Aje, Research Integrity Manager, Taylor & Francis Group

Registration Link:

https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/2864509708110778459?source=VIT

https://attendee.gotowebinar.com/register/2864509708110778459?source=VIT

About the Session:

A researcher’s career rests on the originality and integrity of their

contributions to the scholarly record. In this session, we will examine the

ethical challenges and responsibilities that come with authorship,

conflicts of interest, plagiarism, and text recycling—vital areas to

understand for building a credible and responsible publishing record.

This session will cover:

 - Defining Authorship, Author Responsibilities, and Competing Interests:

 Understand how Taylor & Francis defines authorship, including the roles of

 author and corresponding author, and the responsibilities each carries.

 We’ll explore common issues such as ghost authorship, gift authorship, and

 authorship for sale, as well as guidelines for acknowledging competing

 interests behind authorship.

 - Taylor & Francis’ AI and Authorship Policy: Learn how the use of AI

 interacts with authorship ethics.

 - Plagiarism & Text Recycling: Gain clarity on plagiarism types, where

 the boundaries lie in acceptable similarity under publication standards,

 and the complexities of text recycling. We’ll discuss how Taylor & Francis

 detects plagiarism, handles incidents when it’s found, and where the grey

 areas exist—especially concerning reuse of one’s own prior work.

Why attend? You’ll leave with a well-rounded understanding of how Taylor

& Francis approaches these ethical concerns. By the end, you will feel

equipped to avoid and address issues in authorship, conflicts of interest,

and plagiarism in your work, enhancing your ability to publish responsibly

and transparently.

About the Speakers:

 - Dr Fulu (Olufolake) Akinduro-Aje is a Research Integrity Manager

 within the Publishing Ethics and Integrity Team at Taylor and Francis Group

 Journals where she provides investigative support and advice on research

 ethics and integrity cases and contributes to the continuous improvement of

 editorial processes and policies.

 - Didi Peng is a Research Integrity Manager within the Publishing Ethics

 & Integrity department and as a team they are responsible for providing

 specialist advice and support on ethical, research integrity, and policy

 matters with the aim of minimising risk and ensuring compliance to the

 highest publication ethics standards across Taylor & Francis Journals.

 Looking forward your active participation

Thanks and Regards

Yours Sincerely,

P.Arulmozhivarman

subject: Paper Seeing and Revaluation for Summer Semester 2024-25 FAT – Theory
body:
Office of the Controller of

Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2025/25010

Date: 11-July-2025

Paper Seeing and Revaluation for 

Summer Semester 2024-25 FAT – Theory 

 Paper Seeing and Revaluation:

· In the VTop student login, (“Examination → Marks → Summer Semester

2024-25”) Marks for the Courses to which FAT was held during July 2025 has

been made available now.

· Actual Grades will be released on 14 July 2025 (Monday). The

Pass criteria and Grading Procedure are available in Academics → Regulations

Tab in your login.

· If you want to know the question wise marks awarded to your

answers by the evaluator, you need to apply for it through V-Top. This is

referred to as “Paper Seeing” process. It requires payment of Rs. 100 for

each paper. You can apply through: Examinations →Papersee/Rev →

Summer Semester

2024-25→Paper Seeing. You can choose the course(s) you want to apply

for paper seeing. After Generating the Invoice, you need to make a

payment through “Online Payments” Tab in the same V-Top login.

· Once you have paid, after 24 hours, the paper and question wise

marks awarded will be made available in CodeTantra login. You need to use

the same portal https://vit.codetantra.com for this process. After seeing

the paper, if you feel the mark awarded to a particular question is not

sufficient and the evaluator has missed something and there is a need to

recheck the mark, then you can apply for Revaluation of the Course. You

need to give suitable reasons for the same in the comments section

available just below the mark awarded by the faculty.

· Please note that the Revaluation has to be applied only in V-Top

(in the same way as you have applied for paper seeing) and necessary

payments also need to be paid through the online payments tab. (Rs. 300 per

paper). Revaluation approval process in codetantra will be initiated only

after publishing the Grades, until then the status remains ‘approval

pending’ . Paper seeing and feedback / comments are mandatory for

re-evaluation and are in online mode only.

· Also note that “Paper seeing” and Revaluation is applicable only

for the Theory Courses to which FAT was conducted by the CoE office . For

other components and Courses (like Laboratory / Project Courses IBL mode

courses) there is No Paper seeing and Revaluation Process.

· The students who were involved in Summer Semester 2024-25

examination malpractices are not eligible for paper seeing/ Re-valuation

process.

Particulars

Dates

Paper seeing registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 100]

 11- July-2025 to 12 - July-2025

Revaluation registration link / payment [per paper Rs. 300]

 12- July -2025 to 13- July -2025

Paper Seeing in https://vit.codetantra.com/

https://vit.codetantra.com/

 12- July -2025 to 13- July -2025

 Once the Paper seeing request is approved, the evaluated copy of answer

sheets would be made available in CodeTantra as per the above

schedule. Use your VTop login credentials for login.

· After login, follow the instructions given in the platform for

giving comments to the questions which need to be re-examined.

· Give your feedback with respect to the need for revaluation. If

no feedback is given for any question, your answer script will not be

considered for revaluation and No refund will be given for any approved

requests.

· Students should not approach or give any sort of request to any

faculty related to revaluation (increase of marks or grades). If we

receive any complaints from faculty, it will be treated as ‘Malpractice’

and revaluation requests will summarily be rejected.

Controller of Examinations

With Regards

Prof.S.Sivabalan Ph.D

Dear Students,

We are pleased to inform you that the School of Electronics (SENSE) has

made available a set of C-DAC VEGA processor–based development boards,

including ARIES Micro v1.0, ARIES IoT v2.0, and ARIES V-3.0. These boards

are now open for use in your project work.

This is an excellent opportunity to work with India’s indigenous

RISC-V–based VEGA processors, developed by C-DAC. These processors are

designed for low-power, high-performance embedded and IoT applications,

making them ideal for student projects in modern electronics and computer

engineering.

About C-DAC VEGA Processors:

VEGA processors are fully indigenous, energy-efficient RISC-V CPUs with

support for C/C++ programming, on-chip peripherals, GPIOs, communication

interfaces, and extensive development tools. They are well-suited for

projects in embedded systems, IoT, automation, robotics, and edge computing.

More details: https://vegaprocessors.in/

 Edge computing and lightweight AI implementations

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [24th April

] events.

International Day of Multilateralism and Diplomacy for PeaceWorld peace

has been a topic of conversation and concern ever since the end of the

First World War in 1918. A need to foster peace on a global level became a

priority for every nation, and establishing an organization that would

cater to that responsibility was the first plan of action.

The League of Nations was the first intergovernmental organization tasked

with the mission of world peace. It was founded after World War I by the

Paris Peace Conference. After 26 years, the league was dissolved due to it

not being able to hold off aggressions from the Axis Powers during World

War II. Multilateralism is the concept in which the U.N. was established.

Simply put, multilateralism is the union or alliance of multiple countries

toward a common goal. It is anti-unilateralism, meaning even the smallest

powers are given a voice in global matters. The U.N. has become the most

visible symbol for multilateralism, and the foundation for the creation of

other multilateralism efforts such as the World Health Organization, the

World Bank, the World Trade Organization, and even the North Atlantic

Treaty Organization (NATO).

National Panchayati Raj Day

The Panchayati Raj Day, recognized annually by the Ministry of Panchayati

Raj on 24th April, commemorates the 73rd Amendment Act, 1992 of the

Constitution coming into effect in the year 1993. This day celebrates the

national local self-governance and democratic decentralization. The

Ministry of Panchayati Raj, the nodal ministry, works on the mission of

empowerment, enablement and accountability of Panchayati Raj Institutions

to ensure inclusive development with social justice and efficient delivery

of services.

A strengthened local self-government would strengthen the commitment of

rural India towards self- reliance promoting social, economic and cultural

change transforming the lives of our rural population. This year, 2022, the

National Panchayati Raj Day is being celebrated along with the year-long

celebration of the Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav. In the occasion of the same,

subject: Invitation to Participate in MAR-a-THON: India’s Maritime Hackathon 2025
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that the Sagarmala Startup Innovation Initiative

(S212), under the aegis of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

(MoPSW), in collaboration with the National Technology Centre for Ports,

Waterways & Coasts (NTCPWC), IIT Madras, IMU, IIT-KGP, and IIT-B, is

organizing MAR-a-THON : India’s Maritime Hackathon 2025

This initiative aims to accelerate innovation across the maritime sector by

harnessing entrepreneurial prowess of Indian startups to devise, develop,

and deploy cutting-edge solutions. Selected startups will also receive funding

support up to ₹1 Crore, based on the maturity of their solutions.

Key Details

 -

 Event: MAR-a-THON : INDIA’S MARITIME HACKATHON 2025

 -

 Application Window for Startups: 25 August 2025 – 29 September 2025

 -

 Hackathon Dates: 16 – 18 October 2025

 -

 Award Ceremony & Signing of Agreements: During Maritime India Week 2025

 (Exact date to be announced)

 -

 Official Website: https://ntcpwcit.in/hackathon/

Funding Support Categories

 -

 Proof of Concept: Up to Rs.10 Lakhs

 -

 Seed Funding Grant (Developing Minimum Viable Product): Up to Rs. 60

 Lakhs

 -

 Tech Pilot Grant (Scale-Up Commercialized Solution): Up to Rs. 1 Crore

Attachments:

 -

 Official Invitation Letter

 -

 Event Brochure (with detailed timeline & highlights)

We strongly encourage students with registered startups to actively

participate and leverage this excellent opportunity to innovate in India’s

maritime sector.

subject: Call for Applications: 4+1 MECPS Program at the University of California, Irvine (UCI), USA – a VIT Partner
body:
Kind Attention: Final-year B.Tech. students interested in the 4+1

Professional Master of Embedded and Cyber-Physical Systems (MECPS) program

Dear Students,

Greetings from the International Relations Office!

The University of California, Irvine (UCI), USA-one of VIT’s partner

universities—recently conducted an orientation session on various

partnership programs for all VIT campuses. One such opportunity is the 4+1

Professional Master of Embedded and Cyber-Physical Systems (MECPS) program

offered at UCI.

The details are provided below.

Application Deadline:

Students must apply directly through the MECPS website. The application

deadline is January 15, 2026.

Early submission is encouraged, as applications are reviewed on a rolling

basis and decisions may be communicated earlier. Application link:

https://mecps.uci.edu/mecps/apply/#application

The brochures related to the MECPS program are attached herewith.

Admission Requirements:

 -

 Applicants are expected to hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer

 Engineering, Computer Science, or Electrical Engineering (final year or

 graduated students). Students from other disciplines may also be considered

 if they can demonstrate sufficient foundational knowledge in embedded

 systems.

 -

 A minimum undergraduate GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale is required.

 -

 TOEFL (for international applicants): Minimum score of 80, or other

 acceptable evidence of English language proficiency.

For queries regarding the program, please visit the International Relations

Office at your respective VIT campus.

subject: Congratulations to Team Deeps for Securing 1st Place at Chakravyuha 1.0
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Deeps secured 1st Prize in the

domain of Blockchain at Chakravyuha 1.0, conducted at Sri Sairam

Engineering College, Chennai, held on 24–25 March 2026, and received a cash

prize of ₹5,000.

Representing VIT, Team Deeps developed a project titled “CreatorChain –

Decentralized Creator Economy Platform”. The solution addresses challenges

related to digital content ownership, plagiarism, and transparent royalty

distribution. The platform enables creators to upload digital assets,

verify originality using hashing techniques, mint NFTs for ownership, and

receive automated royalty payments through smart contracts.

The team successfully implemented a fully functional blockchain-based

system integrating NFT minting, smart contract-based royalty distribution,

IPFS-based decentralized storage, and duplicate detection mechanisms, which

was highly appreciated by the judging panel.

Team Members:

 1. Gowsik V – 23MIS0303

 2. Pendekanti Sai Deepthi – 23MIS0195

 3. Akshaya S – 23MIS0297

 4. Deepak Kumar D – 23MIS0247

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Team Deeps on this commendable

achievement and wish them continued success in their future endeavors.

Pollution Control Board (CPCB) is organizing a National Hackathon on

Pollution Reduction Campaign.

The hackathon aims to provide a platform to:

 Showcase innovative efforts to develop eco-alternatives to banned Single

 Use Plastic (SUP) items

 -

 Identify the best scalable, eco-friendly, and economically viable

 Start-ups registered under various Government schemes

 -

 Science, research & educational institutions

 -

 Industrial entities

Problem Statements:

 1.

 Develop an eco-friendly, economically viable, and scalable alternative

 to banned thin plastic carry bags (less than 120 μm thickness)

subject: [Oracle University Learning Community] Julie Stirling-Oracle Started a new discussion. Rethinking Receivables: New Controls to Streamline Manual and Imported Transactions
body:
Oracle University Learning Community http://community.oracle.com/ou/

Julie Stirling-Oracle Started a new discussion. Rethinking Receivables: New Controls to Streamline Manual and Imported Transactions

In today’s fast-paced business world, finance teams need more than just efficiency; they need control, transparency, and accountability. 

For many organizations, the Receivables team is crucial in protecting revenue integrity and keeping strong customer relationships.

But what happens when manual errors and unauthorized invoice processing slip through? 

Oracle Fusion Cloud Receivables is stepping up to address this issue with a new feature: Receivables Transaction Review and Control, introduced in update 24D and improved in 25A. 

Let’s explore the challenges this feature addresses and why it’s a significant advancement for Accounts Receivables (AR) teams. 

The Hidden Risks of Manual Receivables Processing

Despite more automation, most Finance teams still create some invoices and credit memos manually. This practice carries various risks: 

Lack of Review Before Completion: There was previously no built-in approval step for manually created transactions. This allowed incorrect or incomplete invoices to be finalized and sent to customers. 

Limited Audit Trail Tracking: Who reviewed or approved a transaction often depended on emails and offline logs, resulting in poor visibility and compliance gaps.

No Control Over Auto-Invoice Imports: Organizations using Auto-Invoice to import transactions from third-party systems could not pause and review these transactions before completion. 

Why It Matters 

Ignoring these processes can have serious consequences: 

Revenue Leakage: Mistakes in invoice amounts, dates, and tax can delay payments or lead to disputes. 

Compliance Risks: Being ready for audits requires clear, traceable approval records. 

Operational Inefficiencies: Without system-driven controls, Finance teams revert to spreadsheets and manual follow-ups. 

What’s New in Oracle Fusion Cloud Receivables 24D and 25A? 

Oracle now offers complete control over the transaction completion process with the Receivables Transaction Review and Control feature. 

24D: Introducing Review and Approval for Manual Transactions 

This update introduces a review process for manually entered invoices and credit memos, allowing organizations to: 

Route transactions for review and approval before completion. 

Use role-based or user-based controls to define approvers. This has long been a common request from clients who wanted similar approval capabilities in Receivables, as seen in Payables and General Ledger.

Prevent transaction completion until approval is granted. 

View full approval history and audit trail in the Billing Work Area. 

Note: A new status, Pending Approval, is introduced. These transactions cannot be updated, printed, or sent to customers, ensuring only validated invoices reach completion. 

25A: Extending Control to Auto-Invoice Imports 

Update 25A goes further by including third-party imported transactions created through Auto-Invoice in the review process. You can: 

Apply the same approval controls to imported invoices and credit memos. 

Use the Transaction Approval info tile to easily view all pending approvals. 

Withdraw transactions needing rework before approval. 

Sweep pending transactions to a future accounting period if they cannot be approved before the period closes. 

Review instalments and payment schedules before approving transactions. 

This update places Auto-Invoice transactions under the same governance, giving AR teams confidence to manage all transaction types and not just those entered manually. 

How It Works 

Getting started doesn’t need custom development or workflow setup. Here’s how: 

Set up control on your transaction sources and types. 

Define approval rules using the Simplified Rules Configuration (SRC) spreadsheet.

Assign approvers based on roles or specific users. 

Use the Manage Transactions and Review Transactions pages in the Billing Work Area to process approvals. 

Choosing the Right Type of Control for Your Transaction Source 

When setting up a transaction source, Oracle allows you to define how much control you want over transaction completion. You can choose from three options depending on your business needs: 

No Control Transactions: These can be created and completed without review or approval. 

Use Case: Best for low-risk, recurring billing scenarios like intercompany invoices or monthly fixed charges. These transactions are routine and standardized with minimal error risk, so speed and automation take precedence over review. 

Role-Based Control Only: Users with the “Approve Receivables Transaction” privilege (usually assigned via security roles) can approve transactions before completion. 

Use Case: Helpful for high-value or sensitive billing transactions needing approval by a Finance Manager or Controller, like invoices above a $100,000 threshold. This setup works well for centralized approval models. 

User-Based Control Approval: It is driven by specific users listed in the SRC spreadsheet. This option allows for precise control over who approves what, based on factors like business unit, customer account, transaction amount, or currency. 

Use Case: Suitable for project-driven or decentralized organizations where regions or service lines have designated approvers. For example, credit memos over a set amount might go to a specific controller for review. This approach offers the most flexibility in tailoring the approval process. These control types let you match the system behavior to your organization’s risk profile and approval structure without complex workflow customizations. 

Business Benefits 

Stronger Internal Controls: Enforce checks and balances for manual and imported transactions. 

Enhanced Audit Trail: Track reviewer details, timestamps, and comments for every approved transaction. 

No More Unintended Completions: Prevent incorrect invoices from being finalized or sent to customers. 

Improved Period Close Discipline: Sweep pending transactions and keep a clean subledger. 

A Modern Approach to Receivables Governance 

With the Receivables Transaction Review and Control feature, Oracle is changing how Finance teams manage both manual and imported transactions. Teams no longer need to rely on emails, offline spreadsheets, or post-facto approvals. 

Built-in workflows, visibility tools, and error-prevention mechanisms enable Finance teams to build a safer, smarter, and more controlled Receivables environment. 

Want to Get Started? 

Follow these steps: 

Explore the updated setup tasks: Manage Transaction Sources - Manage Transaction Types 

Manage User-Defined Rules for Receivables: Download and configure the SRC spreadsheet to define your approval process. 

Review these useful Oracle resources: 

Receivables Transaction Review and Control (24D)

Additional Options for Receivables Transaction Review and Control (25A)

Oracle University – Explore training and demonstrations. 

 

Final Thoughts 

Controlling transaction completion is now essential. Whether you’re manually creating invoices or importing them via Auto-Invoice, Oracle Fusion Cloud Receivables provides the tools to ensure every transaction is reviewed, approved, and ready for audits. The Receivables teams can now operate with confidence, control, and clarity, marking a significant change worth celebrating!

Check it out: http://community.oracle.com/ou/discussion/15450/rethinking-receivables-new-controls-to-streamline-manual-and-imported-transactions

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s 10th June, 2026 

events.

Today's Events

 - CPU Chronicles: Introduction to Assembly

 - Momentum of truth: World Milk Day Quiz

 - Awaken With Yoga

 - Scam Slam

 - ML Launchpad: Decoding Biological Decisions

IEEE CAS

Event Name: CPU Chronicles: Introduction to Assembly

Event Time: 04:00 PM to 5:30 PM

Event Description: CPU Chronicles: Introduction to Assembly is a technical

session by IEEE CAS that introduces participants to ARM Assembly language

and processor architecture. The session covers ARM registers, CPSR, RISC

principles, and essential instructions for data processing, memory access,

and program flow, providing a strong foundation for embedded systems and

digital design.

Venue: MS Teams

Registration: VTOP

Event Time: 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM

Quizizz competition on milk and the dairy industry. The quiz covers milk

nutrition, dairy products, farming, processing, World Milk Day, and

sustainable practices. Through engaging questions, the event promotes

awareness of health, agriculture, and food security among students.

Venue: Quizizz App

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/p/DZW9QBso7v1/?igsh=MXFxZGdzc2hrejRrZA==

Event Time: 5:30 AM to 6:30 PM

Event Description: Join us for "Awaken With Yoga" and begin your day with

mindfulness, balance, and renewed energy. Experience guided yoga sessions

featuring simple postures, breathing techniques, stretching exercises, and

relaxation practices to enhance physical and mental well-being.

Venue: Anna Auditorium (Offline)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/vit_yoga_club?igsh=MWw2cW9oODNjcDgyOQ==

Indian Institute of Chemical Engineers (IIChE)

Event Name: Scam Slam

Event Time: 4:00 PM to 5:30 PM

Event Description: IIChE-VIT presents Scam Slam.

Scam Slam is a fast-paced, cyberpunk-themed engineering competition where

participants act as forensic industrial auditors. Their mission is to

dismantle slick, hyped-up corporate startup pitches using the fundamental

laws of physics and chemical engineering.

Instead of building a project, teams are tasked with sabotaging a scam

before fake technology receives investment.

Venue: Google Meet

Registration: VTOP

Event Name: ML Launchpad: Decoding Biological Decisions

Date: 10-06-2026

Time: 09:30PM-10:30PM

Venue: Online GMEET

Event Details: Machine Learning is transforming how biological data is

interpreted and utilized. This session introduces the principles behind

biological decision-making and explores how ML techniques can uncover

patterns and support data-driven insights in biotechnology.

subject: TCS Registration – 2027 Batch - Reminder
body:
TCS Registration – 2027 Batch

Greetings from Tata Consultancy Services!!!

We are pleased to invite eligible students from your institute to

participate in the TCS Priority Institution National Qualifier Test (NQT)

for the 2027 graduating batch. As TCS accelerates the enterprise adoption

of AI and Generative AI, students joining us will have opportunities to

work on AI-led transformation programs at scale, supported by enterprise AI

platforms, deep industry context, and global technology partnerships.

Kindly ensure that all eligibility criteria and validation checks are

completed before sharing the final student list with us on or before May

16, 2026. Please note, no changes will be permitted after the closure date.

TCS Eligibility Criteria:

Courses & Disciplines

Batch of 2027 Only.

Listed highest qualifications—B.Tech., M.Tech. (2yr & 5yr), M.C.A., M.Sc,

(2yr & 5yr),. from any discipline/department.

Course Type

Only Full-Time courses will be considered

(Part Time / Correspondence Courses will not be considered)

Percentage

Candidates must have a minimum aggregate of 60%

OR

6 CGPA in all semesters up to the latest declared results.

AND

Offer is valid only if the final degree or provisional certificate confirms

'FIRST CLASS' in the highest qualification, completed within the stipulated

time.

Backlogs / Arrears / ATKT:

Application & Test Process: The student should not have more than 1 (one)

pending or active backlog / arrear / ATKT at the time of appearing for

the TCS Selection process.

Onboarding Process: At the time of onboarding, no pending backlogs /

arrears / ATKT will be permitted.

Please note: All pending backlogs / arrears / ATKT should be cleared

within the course duration stipulated by the University.

Gap / Break in Education

Ensure any academic gaps during your education are declared and supported

with valid proof; breaks should not exceed 24 months.

Work Experience

Students with prior work experience of up to two years are eligible to

apply for this hiring process (Applicable only for postgraduate students).

Age

A student should be 18 to 28 years of age to participate in

the TCS Hiring Process.

Sl.No

Important Notes

1

Only students graduating in the year 2027 are eligible to apply, and this

must be clearly indicated in their TCS Application Form

2

All students must ensure that they use their Personal Email ID Only.

Please note: Email ID CANNOT be changed once submitted.

3

Reference ID series starting DT/CT 2023 onwards to be used, as older IDs

will not be accepted; if students have a reference ID prior to 2023, they

should contact us for profile deletion and re-registration should be

completed before the registration date.

4

Please do eligibility check for the candidate data at your end too and

eliminate any ineligible profiles.

All the students are asked to go through the entire mail before

registering.

TCS Registration Process:

1) Visit https://nextstep.tcsapps.com/indiacampus/#/

2) Click “Register Now”

3) Select category as “IT”

4) Fill in details to generate a Reference ID

5) Click “Apply for Drive”

If a candidate already has a Reference ID, please ensure “Apply for Drive”

is clicked.

The registration window for the assessment process will be open from 11

May to 16 May 2026.

VIT Link: https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

https://forms.gle/QmYM3mtDNMxW5J3h8

Registration in both links (TCS & VIT) is mandatory.

All the CDC internship selects are eligible for the TCS process, All are

asked to register without fail (if they eligible)

All the M.Tech Integrated Students are asked to fill the highest

qualification as Bachelor of Engineering & Master of Science as of now.

TCS National Qualifier Test (NQT) with Integrated Test Pattern:

Section

Duration (in Minutes)

Part A - Foundation Sections

Numerical Ability

25

Verbal Ability

25

Reasoning ability

25

Part B - Advanced Section

Advanced Quantitative and Reasoning Ability

25

Advanced Coding

90

Total Duration (in Minutes)

190

AI-focused Career Opportunities for Students

Students hired through this drive may be aligned to future-ready work

across areas such as AI and data engineering, machine learning, deep

learning and GenAI, cloud data platforms, intelligent automation, and

AI-enabled software engineering.

Career pathways may include AI and Data tracks, including roles such as ML

Engineer and GenAI-focused engineering roles, along with broader digital

roles where AI is embedded into delivery.

As the industry landscape undergoes significant shifts in required skills

and expertise, TCS offers students a strong opportunity to remain relevant,

continuously upskill, and build careers for the new era.

Additional 15% Student Nomination from Group Institutes

The Placement Officer of a TCS Priority Institute may share an additional

list of students who are interested in taking the TCS NQT for Priority

Institutes. This additional list will be limited to 15% of the eligible

students who have applied for the TCS NQT for Priority Institutes from the

parent institute. The eligibility criteria will remain the same as

mentioned above.

Disclaimer

 - Eligibility checks will be conducted at various stages of the hiring

 process

 - Any ineligible candidature or misrepresentation of information will

 lead to disqualification.

 - TCS does not send job offers or hiring-related communications from

 unofficial email IDs such as Gmail, Rediffmail, Yahoo Mail, Hotmail, etc.

 - TCS does not ask candidates to pay any money during the recruitment

 process.

 - TCS is not associated with any external agency or company for

 employment offers.

As part of our continued efforts to enhance the recruitment experience, we

are introducing the following key features for the current hiring cycle:

 - On-premise Internet-based Assessment (IBA) Model and interview

 process: The assessment and interview process will be conducted on

 campus, ensuring a seamless and convenient experience for students.

 - Immediate Release of Offer Letters: Offer Letters will be issued to

 selected candidates immediately upon completion of the hiring process.

 - Focused Candidate Engagement Initiatives: Targeted engagement

 activities aimed at enhancing students’ preparedness for industry readiness.

The registration window for the Priority NQT will be open from May 8,

2026, to May 16, 2026. We request your office to facilitate the

dissemination of the registration link, which will be shared separately, to

all eligible students through appropriate institutional channels. We have

also taken note of your point regarding enabling registrations post the

Pre-Placement Talk and that students would be available post return from

their vacation. We will review this internally and revert with an update

for enabling additional registrations.

Candidates will be assessed and shortlisted for the following roles based

on their overall performance across all stages of the selection process:

Offer Category

UG (CTC)

PG (CTC)

Prime : Exceptional candidates who demonstrate outstanding aptitude and

advanced proficiency in emerging technologies.

9.09 LPA

11.59 LPA

Digital: Candidates who exhibit excellent aptitude and strong capability

in leveraging digital technology.

7.09 LPA

7.39 LPA

As TCS accelerates its AI and Generative AI-led transformation for clients

globally, we remain equally committed to building future-ready talent for

this new era. Students joining through this program can look forward to

opportunities in emerging areas such as AI/ML, data engineering and

analytics, cloud, and automation, while working under a human + AI delivery

model. TCS also provides intensive upskilling opportunities to help

students stay aligned with evolving industry demands and build resilient

careers.

body:
Dear Students,

The nomination and application procedures for exchange studies at

University West are now open.

All students must be nominated by their home institution before applying

online for exchange studies.

Partner universities nominate their students online at www.hv.se/nomination

http://www.hv.se/nomination

Please note that the nomination deadline is set for the 15th March

(nomination

form is now open). Interested students may contact Dr. Sainu Franco in the

IR Office, Main Building 105 for nomination purposes.

Once nomination has been submitted, an e-mail containing information on how

to apply for exchange studies will be sent to the nominating contact person

and to the nominated student.

Students will not have to upload a learning agreement as part of the

application, only transcripts of records and passport copy. They are

connected to EWP and can process digital learning agreements. The student

will also be able to set up and download a learning agreement as part of

the process following directly on the application if needed.

Deadline for online application for students:

15 April for autumn semester (starting in August/September)

Information on application process and online course list etc. is available

at www.hv.se/exchange http://www.hv.se/exchange.

Don't hesitate to contact us should you have any questions:

Veronika Strupf

International Coordinator

International Office

University West

461 86 TROLLHÄTTAN

subject: Smart India Hackathon '24 (SIH'24)-reg
body:
Dear Students,

We are happy to announce the conduct of Prelims for Smart India Hackathon

'24.

The Smart India Hackathon (SIH) is a nationwide initiative that provides

students with a platform to solve problems in daily life. The initiative is

led by the Government of India and aims to promote innovation and

out-of-the-box thinking among young minds. The SIH also aims to harness the

creativity and technical expertise of Indian students to benefit the

nation.

The SIH provides students with the opportunity to solve problems for

government departments, industries, and other organizations. The

participating teams tackle problem statements posted by departments of

Union Ministers and State governments. Themes for SIH'24 include:

 - Agriculture, FoodTech & Rural Development

 - Blockchain & Cybersecurity

 - Clean & Green Technology

 - Fitness & Sports

 - Heritage & Culture

 - MedTech/BioTech / Health Tech

 - Miscellaneous

 - Renewable / Sustainable Energy

 - Robotics and Drones

 - Smart Automation

 - Smart Vehicles

 - Travel & Tourism

 - Transportation & Logistics

 - Disaster Management

 - Smart Education

 - Toys & Games

 - Space Technology

 - Smart Resource Conservation

The SIH also aims to inculcate a culture of product innovation and a

mindset of problem solving.

The teams that are interested may fill out the form on or before 23/08/2024,

05:00 pm. Shortlisted teams will be called in for a presentation and

mentoring. We will be hosting prelim SIH internally to nominate the student

teams for SIH 24.

https://tinyurl.com/VIT-prelimSIH-24

Internal Hackathon:

To nominate the teams for Hackathon, we will have to conduct an Internal

Hackathon. So this form is created to collect your willingness to

participate.

Instructions:

https://policies.google.com/privacy?hl=en-IN

1.Team size should be 6 members with at least one female student included

mandatorily, else the team will be disqualified.

2. Adhere to the tracks/problem statement suggested by the organizers of

SIH, mentioned in the reference excel.

3. Internal Hackathon will be conducted and the winners will be nominated

to participate in SIH '24. Further details will be communicated to the

shortlisted teams.

4. All the members should be from VIT, Vellore.

5. Students from different branches are encouraged to form diverse teams.

6. This form will stop collecting the responses on 23/08/2024 (05:00 pm).

For More information: Dr. Naiju CD, SPOC, SIH '24

https://sih.gov.in/

#SmartIndiaHackathon#InnovationSeAtmanirbharBharat
