subject: Research Opportunity in Automotive Research Centre (ARC)
body:
Dear Student,

Greetings!

I am writing to you again regarding the research opportunity available in the Automotive Research Centre (ARC). ARC is an interdisciplinary centre that focuses its cutting-edge research that relates to the future direction of the global automotive industry. It is a unique centre that carries out research on Autonomous, Connected and Electric vehicle (ACE) technologies—electric vehicles, hybrid electric vehicles, autonomous vehicles, drones, battery management systems and fuel cells. The centre also focuses on the use of various gaseous fuels in IC engines, in particular, hydrogen as a fuel and new fuel formulations.

ARC has established state-of-the-art facilities to develop and test products in the field of self-driving vehicles. The centre has actively assisted automotive industries in niche areas and received grants from various agencies like DST, SERB, DRDO, ZF etc.,

ARC has research opportunities and is currently looking for students who are enthusiastic about learning and working on projects related to autonomous vehicles, drones, electric vehicles, battery management systems (BMS) and IC Engines. Our current projects often involve collaboration with an interdisciplinary team of faculty members across our institute and also from Binghamton University, USA.

Our research and development efforts are focused on the following domains:

1. Computer Science and Engineering

AI, ML, ROS developer. Sensor fusion, Perception, and mapping and Path planning.

2. Electrical & Electronics Engineering and Electronics and Communication Engineering

AI, ML, Control systems and Power electronics, Motor drives.

3. Mechanical Engineering

Application of AI, and ML in IC engines, Hydrogen and methanol engine development, and development of electronic control units for IC engines.

Eligibility:

 1. UG students from SMEC, SCOPE, SCORE, SENSE and SELECT can apply.

 2. PG students from Smart Mobility, Embedded Systems and Automotive Electronics programmes.

 3. Experienced students from other technical teams are preferred.

Research Outcomes:

 1. The opportunity to work in a cutting-edge research facility.

 2. Opportunity to work in a startup.

 3. Internship certificate on completion of the project.

 4. Letter of recommendation for higher studies.

 5. Research work leading to publications and patenting.

Interested students are requested to fill out the Google form given below before 19 December 2024.

subject: Congratulations to Rohit N for Receiving A+ Grade Certification – Carbon Management Program | New Delhi
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to announce that Rohit N (Reg. No: 21MID0138), a

final-year student of M.Tech. (Integrated) – Computer Science and

Engineering with Specialization in Data Science, has achieved a noteworthy

accomplishment as a Student Innovator and Entrepreneur.

He had the privilege of representing Vellore Institute of Technology

(VIT) at the Carbon Management Program, held on 3rd and 4th December

2025 at the India International Centre, New Delhi. During the program, he

presented his innovation work developed through his startup, Sri Naagha

Electronics and Systems Pvt. Ltd., and delivered a technical presentation

titled “Autonomous Beehive Systems for Quantification and Valuation of

Bees-Driven Nature-Based Carbon Credits.” The project focuses on

technology-driven sustainability and nature-based climate solutions.

As part of the program, Rohit also participated in the quiz competition and

secured a commendable score. In recognition of his overall contribution and

performance, he was awarded an A+ Grade Certification by Dr. Srikant

Nagulapalli, IAS, Secretary, Ministry of Power, Government of India.

We also acknowledge the invaluable guidance and mentorship of Dr. Priyanka

N (Employee ID: 19728), Assistant Professor Sr. Grade 1, Department of IoT,

School of Computer Science and Engineering, whose support played a

significant role in this achievement.

This accomplishment highlights the spirit of innovation, entrepreneurship,

and sustainability-driven research fostered at VIT and brings great pride

to the institution.

Heartiest congratulations to Rohit N on this prestigious recognition.

subject: Congratulations to Varun Suresh (Reg. No. 23BAI0097): Second Place in the All India National Mutual Fund Olympiad.
body:
Dear VITians,

We are proud to announce that Varun Suresh (Reg. No. 23BAI0097) has

secured the Second Place in the All India National Mutual Fund Olympiad.

The grand finale of this prestigious competition was organized by the FinX

Institute and held at the iconic Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).

Varun’s outstanding performance on such a significant financial platform

highlights his sharp analytical skills, financial acumen, and deep

understanding of investment strategies.

The award was presented by distinguished industry leaders:

 -

 Mr. Juzer Tambawalla, Director & CSO, Franklin Templeton Investments

 -

 Mr. Kailash Kulkarni, CEO, HSBC Bank

 -

 Mr. Boni Noronha, Executive Vice President, Axis Mutual Fund

 -

 Mr. Soumya Ranjan, COO, BFSI Sector Skill Council of India

We would like to extend my sincere gratitude to Dr. A. Dunstan Rajkumar

(Emp ID: 12218), SSL, whose constant guidance and support played a crucial

role in this achievement.

Congratulations to Varun for this remarkable achievement and for bringing

accolades to VIT Vellore!

body:
Dear Students,

Greetings from the Centre for VIT Happiness and Well-Being!

Happiness begins the moment you accept your life as it is, and choose to

rise from there, every single day.

Relationships play an important role in shaping our life and a healthier

one built in respect, trust, empathy and a clear communication among each

other, whether it may be friends, colleagues, peers, family or teachers. We

get emotional support and it helps us manage stress along with reminding us

that we are not alone in our life journey.

As students, learning to build a positive relationship also means setting

boundaries, expressing feelings honestly and being kind to each other.

Healthy connections in relationships contribute to academic success and

also emotional well-being with personal growth.

The Centre for VIT Happiness and Well-Being wishes you all a meaningful

connection and a balanced student life.

The VIT Centre for Happiness and Well-Being is here to support you

throughout your journey. If at any point you feel psychologically

body:
Dear Freshers,

Greetings from the Office of Innovation, Startup and Technology Transfer

(VIT-IST).

Didn't get a chance to register for RoboWars Workshop – Batch 1? Here's

your opportunity to join Batch 2!

The Office of Innovation, Startup and Technology Transfer (VIT-IST), in

association with the Institution's Innovation Council (IIC),

Entrepreneurship Development Cell (EDC), and Intellectual Property Rights &

Technology Transfer Cell (IPR & TT Cell), is pleased to invite first-year

(Fresher) students to participate in the RoboWars Workshop – Batch 2,

exclusively designed for freshers.

🤖 RoboWars Workshop – Batch 2

Theme: Design • Deploy • Dominate

📅

Date: 23 July 2026 (Thursday)🕤 Time: 9:30 AM – 5:00 PM📍 Venue: PRP

A-Block, Room No. 156

Before You Register

 - Form a team of five students including Team Lead 

 - Ensure your team is finalized before submitting the registration

 form.

Why Should You Attend?

 - Learn robotics from experienced mentors.

 - Design, build, and test your own robot through hands-on practical

 sessions.

 - Explore the fundamentals of robotics, automation, and innovation.

 - Receive a Certificate of Participation.

 - On Duty (OD) will be provided to participants.

 - Take your first step towards robotics competitions and innovation

 projects.

Important Registration Guidelines

 - This workshop is exclusively for first-year (Fresher) students.

 - Batch 2 registration is open only to students who missed registering

 for Batch 1.

 - Students who have already registered for Batch 1 are not permitted

 to register again for Batch 2.

 - Only 40 seats are available, and registrations will be accepted on a

subject: ​DTI Apprenticeship 2027 - Students Details Required
body:
DTI Apprenticeship 2027 - Students Details Required

We would like to invite applications for our Apprenticeship Programme 2027

in DTI.

As you all know the eligibility criteria is 7 CGPA & above without any

backlogs hence please share the details of the students interested in DBS

Tech India Apprenticeship Programme 2026 in the below format by 05.02.2026

6:00 pm

https://forms.gle/TV4DoZU7nfQdhLCq8

PPT & initial Test : 07.02.2026 , Anna Auditorium

Request you to share the details in an excel sheet as an attachment.

Note: Only CS/IT students’ details are to be shared. Other allied branches

like AI, ML, Cybersecurity, Data Science, are also considered.

 Apprenticeship Programme, DBS Tech India (DTI), Hyderabad

Business Function

At DBS, Group Technology and Operations (T&O) enables and empowers the bank

with an efficient, nimble and resilient infrastructure through a strategic

focus on productivity, quality & control, technology, people capability and

innovation. In Group T&O, we manage the majority of the Bank's operational

processes and inspire to delight our business partners through our multiple

banking delivery channels.

The Programme

Are you keen to apply your technological knowledge to real-world challenges?

Join the DTI Apprenticeship Programme where you can get a head start in

your technology career with DBS!

During this program, you will have the opportunity to learn and contribute

to DTI's growth story in digital transformation, as we strive to evolve

into a World-Class Engineering Organization. You will experience a

transformative journey with dynamic challenges through real-time projects,

unlocking multifaceted expertise providing springboard for your corporate

adventure.

This is a hybrid programme spanning - virtual for 8 months and 4 months

from our impressive workspace in Hyderabad.

Throughout the program's duration, you will receive a competitive stipend

and benefits while pursuing your studies.

Successful completion of the programme also offers an opportunity to secure

a spot in the Flagship DTI Skill Enhancement Education & Development (SEED)

Programme (Full-time opportunity with DBS).

Do refer to the below image for the journey of an apprentice with DTI.

Eligibility Criteria

 - Candidates currently in the third year (graduating in 2027) of their

 BE/BTech program in Computer Science or Information Technology, holding a

 GPA of 7 or above without any backlogs.

 - Committed to work from Hyderabad location for 4 months, commencing in

 February 2027.

 - Self-motivated team player who enjoys working in a fast-paced

 environment.

 - Adaptable, creative, decisive, and resilient, and demonstrate good

 interpersonal and communication skills.

Note: Interested & eligible students are said to apply in the below link

on or before 05.02.2026 (6:00 pm)

https://forms.gle/TV4DoZU7nfQdhLCq8

Greetings from Wakefit!!!

We are excited to announce a campus hiring opportunity for the role of

Intern - Graduate Engineer Trainee at Wakefit. We are looking for

become a part of our dynamic and growing team.

About Us: 

Wakefit.co is a research and innovation-driven home and sleep tech

solutions company established in March 2016. It was founded by Ankit Garg

and Chaitanya Ramalingegowda and holds a vision to be the most loved home

solutions company in India. With an ever-expanding portfolio that includes

mattresses, pillows, bed frames, mattress protectors, comforters,

bedsheets, pillows, back cushions, sofas, coffee tables, shoe racks,

lighting, décor and much more. Wakefit.co manufactures all of its products

in-house. The company sells across the country through its own online

portal and through other online marketplaces.

Wakefit.co prides itself on its customer experience, with over 10 Lakh

customers serviced across six years and over 3 lakh positive reviews

received online. The company has received Series A funding from marquee

investor Sequoia Capital India, Series B funding from Verlinvest and

Sequoia Capital India, and Series C funding from SIG, Verlinvest and

Sequoia Capital India. It has recorded 3x revenue growth year-on-year since

2016 and is currently valued at 2800 crores. Wakefit.co follows a unique

delivery model. It has a product-oriented approach that invests heavily on

research and innovation to create products that are ahead of the industry

curve. It ships products to its customers directly from the factory, thus

ensuring significant cost reduction which gets passed on to the customer.

The USP of the brand lies in the fact that its products are made after

extensive customer interviews and extensive research.

body:
Dear Student,
Greetings from NPTEL!
We are excited to introduce the 
NPTEL Post Baccalaureate Fellowships
, a unique opportunity for students interested in pursuing a 
Master’s or PhD
 at top institutes.
Key Details:
Duration:
 Up to 
one year
Eligibility:
 Open to all 
NPTEL Stars
 
& Toppers of selective courses 
with a 
Bachelor’s or Master’s
 degree
Requirement:
 Must hold a 
BTech or equivalent degree before 01-August-2026
Total Fellowship Amount: 
₹4,00,000 per year, inclusive of the monthly stipend and contingency grant as given below
Monthly Stipend: 
₹25,000+HRA per month for a duration of 12 months.
Contingency Grant: 
An additional ₹1,00,000 per year for research-related expenses.
Mode:
 
In-person
 at the 
institute where you are selected for Fellowship
Project Selection Process:
Faculty-led research projects will be advertised by each institute through NPTEL
You can apply to 
up to five projects
, ranking your preferences.
Faculty will select students based on 
resumes, short videos, and interviews
.
Important Notes:
The fellowship 
does not guarantee admission
 to an MS/PhD program.
The 
fellowship duration is one year
, contingent on 
satisfactory performance
.
Selected candidates should be available to join 
between June – August 2026
, based on mutual agreement. No further extension will be granted.
A BTech or equivalent degree is mandatory before August 1, 2026.
Accommodation & Travel:
On-campus housing is NOT provided
 – you will need to arrange your own accommodation.
No travel allowance
 is included.
Application Process:
The 
available projects and academic requirements
 are available in the form.
Review project listings and 
submit your application
, 
You can choose at most 
five projects
 in rank order of preferences.
Shortlisted candidates
 will be contacted for interviews.
Upon selection, you will receive an 
offer letter
 and confirm your 
start date
.
Candidates 
aged above 40 years
, if selected for the fellowship, must submit a fitness certificate confirming that they are medically fit to travel and stay at the institute.
We hope this 
NPTEL Post Bac Fellowship
 will give you valuable research experience at IITs and help you explore advanced academic opportunities.
Apply Here: 
https://internalapp.nptel.ac.in/student-form/
Application Deadline:
 April 03, 2026 (Final Extension)
(
For any queries please write to 
predoc@nptel.iitm.ac.in
)

subject: Be On Alert Against Being Conned Financially
body:
Dear All,

It has been brought to our notice that some VITians have been conned into

parting with details like debit/credit card numbers, CVVs, Aadhaar numbers,

etc. that are used by tricksters to cheat the victims out of their money.

In some other cases, the victims (non-VITians) have been threatened that

FIRs have been registered against them for non-bailable offenses, and the

money is needed to be paid to hush up the case(s). The threat of illegal

items being found in the parcel sent by/addressed to the victim(s) has also

been used.

In their own interest, all VITians are hereby requested to be on utmost

alert against such frauds. Do not part with your confidential details, no

matter how convincing the person at the other end sounds.

Approach the cyber-crime branch of Vellore police, Office of the

Superintendent of Police (ground floor, left-wing, behind

Collectorate), Sathuvachari, Vellore, if you have already lost money in

such crimes, or have been contacted via such calls (voice, or WhatsApp) or

e-mail messages.

You can also report cyber crimes through the National Cyber Crime Reporting

Portal (NCRP) at https://cybercrime.gov.in/.

Also, you can report cyber crimes by calling the helpline number 1930.

subject: UG Research Work -Appreciation – International Media Recognition
body:
Dear Students and Faculty Members,

Greetings!

Our UG students Aayushi Agrawal (21BEC2073), Akshit Saxena (21BEC2127),

Bhavya Nagrath (21BEC0399), CARMEL Sanjana Jayavanth (21BEC2095), and Shamita

Thulasidoss (21BML0014) have achieved a significant milestone by

publishing a research article in Scientific Reports as an outcome of their

Project Type Course under the Discipline / Open Electives category.

Their paper titled “Deep learning-driven IoT solution for smart tomato

farming” (https://www.nature.com/articles/s41598-025-15615-3) presents an

IoT-enabled smart greenhouse platform using ESP32-based sensors, Raspberry

Pi, and a YOLOv8 deep learning model to monitor environmental conditions

and classify tomato ripeness stages in real time, supporting precision

agriculture and sustainable tomato production.

Importantly, this work has been featured in the international agriculture

technology news portal

Hortidaily (https://www.hortidaily.com/article/9759011/deep-learning-solutions-to-aid-tomato-growers/

https://www.hortidaily.com/article/9759011/deep-learning-solutions-to-aid-tomato-growers/),

 for

its potential to aid tomato growers worldwide through deep learning–based

solutions.

This recognition highlights the practical relevance of the research, the

strength of our UG research culture, and the effective mentorship enabled

through our project-based learning ecosystem.

 Congratulations to the entire team and the faculty mentors, Dr. P.

Sasikumar, Professor & Assistant Dean – Academic Research, SENSE, and Dr.

S. Maheswri, SCOPE, Chennai Campus, on this achievement.

With best wishes

-- 

With high Regards,

subject: Announcement: A*STAR Research Attachment Programme in Singapore
body:
Dear All,

ASTAR Research Attachment Programme in Singapore

Trialect is pleased to share an exciting research opportunity in

collaboration with the Agency for Science, Technology and Research

(ASTAR), Singapore. The ASTAR Research Attachment Programme (ARAP)

provides international PhD students with the chance to spend 1–2 years at

leading ASTAR Research Institutes, working under the joint supervision of

ASTAR researchers and faculty from their home universities. International

PhD students only. Applicants from non-Partner Universities may also come

on the ARAP-Individual track, which works at a researcher-to-researcher

level of collaboration and does not require a formal agreement. This

prestigious program allows you to immerse yourself in Singapore’s vibrant

research ecosystem, gain world-class mentorship, and strengthen

international collaborations in biomedical sciences and beyond. Please

refer your students to explore in detail at View Full Details

http://r.sib5.trialect.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfsTSegNE8ApRcPrUegoMz4/fkQx39X_AuvH

Benefits include:

 - Monthly stipend of S$3,600

 - One-time airfare grant (S$1,500) and settling-in allowance (S$1,000)

 - Housing allowance, medical insurance, IT allowance

 - Conference allowance for academic dissemination

 - Certification upon completion

Fast-Track Trialect Partnered Mentored Fellowship Programs

Trialect has been facilitating mentored fellowships (2-12 weeks) connecting

biomedical scientists with world-class mentors through short, affordable,

exclusive Trialect-partnered fellowship programs in basic and

translational research. Backed by excellent Google reviews

http://r.sib5.trialect.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfuMSBBgChPHTyjff1Bb6va/9FboNs61h53G,

our programs are designed to help labs save resources, accelerate

publications, and expand collaborations. Please refer to your students as

the deadline is fast approaching. A Few of them are listed below:

Featured Research Programs

 - Drug Development and Precision Medicine in the Netherlands: Apply

 Here

 http://r.sib5.trialect.com/mk/cl/f/sh/7nVU1aA2nfwFRhgzBGdjWL3TpNgNqs6/SK3EYNt3SqqP

Day of the Seafarer

The International Maritime Organization, which is a specialized agency of

the United Nations responsible for regulating shipping, decided in 2010 to

designate June 25 as the Day of the Seafarer. This was done to highlight

the fact that almost everything we use in our daily lives is either

directly or indirectly affected by sea transport. Apart from highlighting

the work they do, the purpose of the day is to also thank them for their

contribution to civil society and the world economy. The role of seafarers

often goes underappreciated within the maritime industry and by the general

public. Seafarers are an essential component in world trade, keeping the

economy moving and delivering goods and fuels we use every day and

recognizing the contribution that seafarers make to our everyday lives.

It is hoped that by holding the Day of the Seafarer, the general public

will become more aware of the role that seafarers play in their lives and

why they are so fundamental in determining the prosperity of the worldwide

economy. Seafarers Day will continue to campaign for greater governmental

support for seafarers, while also highlighting the need for all seafarers

to receive the same standards of care when it comes to training

opportunities, safety standards and workplace welfare both now and in the

future.

World No Tobacco Day aims to draw attention to the business practices of

tobacco companies to capture generations of consumers and their

interference in policy decisions that undermine effective tobacco control.

It serves to highlight what WHO is doing to fight the tobacco epidemic that

kills up to half its users and contributes to more than eight million

people dying every year, and what people can do to protect future

generations and allow everyone the chance to claim their right to health.

Every year, the theme of World No Tobacco Day addresses a specific issue

related to tobacco and its industry. The theme for World No Tobacco Day

2024 is "Protecting children from tobacco industry interference". The

theme emphasises the need to protect future generations and ensure that

tobacco consumption continues to reduce.

subject: Invitation to Cultural Week ’26 celebration
body:
Dear VITians,

Connect. Celebrate. Belong.

The Office of Students’ Welfare warmly invites you to Cultural Week ’26, a

celebration of creativity, passion, and the vibrant spirit of the VIT

community.

Get ready for an unforgettable evening of music, dance, theatre and

captivating cultural performances that showcase the incredible talent and

artistic excellence of every VITian. More than just a celebration, Cultural

Week is an opportunity to come together, celebrate diversity, and

experience the energy, creativity, and traditions that make VIT truly

unique.

Whether you’re taking the stage or cheering from the audience, every moment

is an opportunity to celebrate talent, support one another, and create

memories that will last long after the curtains close.

CULTURAL WEEK’26

Venue: Greenos

Time: 6:00 PM – 8:00 PM

Join us as we celebrate the stories, passions, and performances that unite

our community. We look forward to welcoming you to Cultural Week ’26 and

sharing four unforgettable evenings of talent, inspiration, and celebration.

subject: Career opportunities in the Indian navy - 2027 Batch
body:
Kind Attention!!

Indian Navy celebrates Navy Day on 4th December every year to commemorate

the successful Naval operations during 1971 Indo - Pak war, particularly

the attack on the Karachi harbour. This day serves as a reminder of valor,

dedication and strategic prowess of the Indian Navy. We utilise this annual

opportunity to engage with the student community of our nation.

In line with the celebrations, Headquarters Tamil Nadu and Puducherry Naval

Area intents to conduct a Car Rally, which aims to visit various college/

school campuses in Tamil Nadu. Objective of the visit is to inspire and

motivate the students to choose their career in Indian Armed Forces,

specifically Indian Navy.

We have arranged a Career opportunities in the Indian navy session on

04-12-2025 at Dr.Channa Reddy Auditorium 1:00 pm, Interested students are

said to kindly fill the form on or before 28.11.2025 (12 Noon)

https://forms.gle/8XHQmvKQ1kvWo37a9

subject: Prima Vera'25 - Day-4 Events - reg
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings!

The Office of Students' Welfare invites you to spring into action on Day-4

as we dive into an exciting week filled with cultural vibrance. After long

schedules and academic fatigue, this is the perfect moment to unwind,

recharge, and rediscover the joy of campus life.

We proudly present the 6th edition of Prima Vera - a week-long cultural

festival celebrating the creativity, passion, and spirit of VIT’s dynamic

student community. Get ready for a series of thrilling competitions, each

designed to bring out your best and help you showcase your unique talents.

Expect energetic performances, artistic showdowns, and engaging events, all

culminating in an unforgettable cultural experience.

And yes — there are exciting cash prizes waiting for the winners, along

with the pride of taking center stage in one of VIT’s most anticipated

festivals.

Gear up, participate, cheer, and make Prima Vera’25 a celebration to

remember!

Day-4 Schedule

Quest Chronicles – Treasure Hunt brings adventure and teamwork to the

forefront, inviting participants to embark on a dynamic trail of clues,

puzzles, and challenges across the campus. This event encourages students

to think critically, communicate effectively, and strategise as they

navigate through each stage of the hunt. It aims to create an exciting and

immersive experience where problem-solving meets exploration, giving

participants a chance to test their wit, speed, and collaborative spirit in

a thrilling race to the finish.

Beat Street Arena – Street Battle brings the raw energy of street culture

to PRIMA VERA’25, providing a platform for dancers to express their

individuality through freestyle, hip-hop, popping, and urban dance forms.

This event celebrates rhythm, spontaneity, and creative movement,

encouraging performers to showcase bold techniques and dynamic attitude. It

aims to capture the spirit of street dance—fearless, expressive, and

electrifying—while inspiring participants to push their boundaries in an

energetic, competitive environment.

Pitch Perfect – AdZap invites students to combine creativity, humour, and

marketing flair by crafting spontaneous and engaging advertisements within

a limited timeframe. This event encourages participants to think on their

feet, improvise unique concepts, and deliver memorable performances that

captivate the audience. It aims to boost confidence, quick thinking, and

persuasive communication, giving students a fun platform to showcase their

storytelling and branding skills in a lively and interactive format.

Get ready to shine at the 6th edition of Prima Vera — our annual cultural

extravaganza packed with creativity, energy, and endless fun. This year’s

edition brings together a vibrant lineup of competitions, performances, and

showcases designed to highlight the incredible talents of our students.

Whether you’re stepping onto the stage, behind the lens, or into the

spotlight, Prima Vera’25 is your moment to express, explore, and excel.

Come be a part of the excitement, the artistry, and the unforgettable

memories waiting to be made!

Join us for an unforgettable celebration!

subject: Congratulations to Team iGEM - VIT Vellore for Winning Silver Medal at iGEM 2025 | Paris, France
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team iGEM - VIT Vellore has brought great

pride to our institution by securing the Silver Medal at the International

Genetically Engineered Machine (iGEM) Competition 2025, held at the Paris

Convention Centre, France, from October 28–31, 2025.

The iGEM Grand Jamboree is the world’s largest synthetic biology event,

bringing together students and researchers from over 50 countries to

design innovative biological systems addressing real-world challenges. The

competition, organized by the iGEM Foundation, promotes global

collaboration and innovation in synthetic biology toward a more sustainable

and resilient future.

This year, Team iGEM - VIT Vellore’s project focused on developing

a sustainable and cruelty-free alternative to ambergris through microbial

biosynthesis of ambrein, showcasing an outstanding combination

of scientific innovation and environmental responsibility. Among 400+

international teams, the team’s excellence was recognized with the Silver

Medal, celebrating their technical rigor, creativity, and commitment to

sustainability.

subject: FLIP 2024 : Patent filing campaign for the UG and PG students
body:
Dear Students,

Are you a budding innovator with a ground-breaking idea? IPR & TT Cell (in

collaboration with VITIST, IIC) invites you to explore the exciting world

of patent filing through the

 FLIP 2024 (Facilitating IP filing) campaign.

Why Patent Your Invention?

 - Protect Your Intellectual Property: Safeguard your innovative ideas

 and secure exclusive rights.

 - Commercialize Your Invention: Increase the potential for

 commercialization and licensing opportunities. You will earn a part of the

 revenue generated from licensing the IP.

We will facilitate money transfers to your bank account even after you

 graduate from the University if the filed IP is licensed to an industry. 

 - Enhance Your Academic Profile: Demonstrate your research capabilities

 and contribute to the university's intellectual property portfolio.

How to File a Patent:

· Identify Your Invention: The invention can be an outcome of a

short-term project/UGRE work/Capstone project/Project I/Project II/Set

conference projects etc. Clearly define the novelty and inventive step of

the work.

· Conduct a Prior art Search: Use online patent search software

available in our VIT library (request through IPR&TT Cell to assess the

patentability search software - Guidelines here:

https://vit.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Patent-search-software.pdf

https://vit.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2024/10/Patent-search-software.pdf).

· Submit the Invention disclosure form (IDF): Submit the IDF in

VTOP through your faculty mentor.

The IPR &TT Cell is here to Help: 

 - Guidance and Support: Our team of experts can guide the patent filing

 process, including patent searching, drafting, and filing.

 - An exclusive Q/A session will be arranged for the registrants to help

 them through filling out the required forms and filing process

The timeline for FLIP 2024:

S. No.

Sequence of Events

Date

1.

Expression of interest in filing a patent by submitting the G form (given

below)

11th Nov-25th Nov 2024

2.

 Q/A session for the registrants

20th Jan 2025-24th Jan 2025

3.

 Project work for IP filing

2nd Jan- April 30th 2025

4.

Submission of Invention Disclosure Form by Faculty Mentors and Internal

Assessment.

Get the forms (part I and II) at https://vit.ac.in/iprcell

1st May – 15th May 2025

5.

Assessment by the External Experts (Lawyers’ team already associated with

VIT) to judge patentability in terms of novelty, inventive step, and

industrial application

2nd May – 31st May 2025

6.

Filing Complete Specification / Patents with the help of the associated

patent lawyers.

1st June –30th June 2025

IMPORTANT:

To express your interest or for further information, please fill out the

form:

https://forms.gle/qumrx79fDzD9Ehbj8 https://forms.gle/qumrx79fDzD9Ehbj8

Thanking you,

Sincerely yours,

subject: Outstanding achievement of Team Orcus-reg
body:
Dear VITians,

With great pride, we celebrate the outstanding achievement of Team Orcus,

who have secured FIRST PLACE in the 15kg category at RoboWars, held as

part of Kurukshetra 2025 at Anna University on 21st February 2025. Their

hard work, technical expertise, and unwavering commitment have brought

laurels to VIT.

Team Members:

Rohan Agrawal - 21BCE3957

Abdealy Zaveri- 21BME0080

Chaitanya Tejaswi - 22BCT0285

Shivam Pasi - 22BEI0102

Harsh Trushar Patel - 23BEE0021

A special appreciation to Dr. Senthil Kumar M (Emp ID: 10347), SMEC, the

faculty coordinator for his mentorship and guidance, which played a crucial

role in the team’s success. This victory is a testament to the technical

brilliance and competitive spirit of our students, reaffirming VIT’s

excellence in robotics and innovation.

Once again, congratulations to the team for this phenomenal accomplishment!

subject: Registrations Open!!! Amazon WoW 27-28
body:
Kind Attention:

This is a kind reminder regarding the registration for the Skill Building

and Career Enhancement Program, open to all students from the 2027 and

2028 batches at your esteemed campus.

 Continuing our year-on-year partnership, we request you to kindly forward

this email to your students and request them to join Amazon Wow,

https://app.brazenconnect.com/a/asp-sdengineering/e/28N38 a channel for

skill building and career enhancement for women engineer Students and

complete registration

https://app.brazenconnect.com/a/asp-sdengineering/e/28N38.

https://app.brazenconnect.com/a/asp-sdengineering/e/28N38

Why join WoW?

Be part of a program designed to support career readiness for women in tech

and other careers. WoW will help you expand your network, learn about

different career paths, and build your leadership skills. Plus you’ll meet

women who will inspire you to keep moving forward.

What you'll learn

Our programming is designed to help you gain essential skills, discover

your ideal career, and get ready for your Amazon application and beyond.

Frequently asked questions

Who's eligible to participate?

Amazon WoW is open to all students who are studying at university or who

have graduated within the last 24 months.

Where can I register for the sessions?

Click on "Register now" icon on top of the page

Will this portal allow access to job opportunities at Amazon? If yes,

where can I find them?

The Amazon University team will periodically reach out to students

registered through the Amazon WoW portal to seek interest in full-time

graduate and internship opportunities.

Is there a cost to participate?

No. WoW is a free program with no membership fees.

subject: University of Miyazaki- Japan- Student Exchange Program for 2nd (Fall) semester 2026
body:
Dear Students,

The Global Support Office (GSO) at the University of Miyazaki, has announced

the exchange programme for the Fall 2026 semester and the application

period is officially open.

Please review the attached files for detailed information, including the

application requirements.

=============================================

Study Period: 6 months (one semester) or 1 year, starting from 1 October

2026

Nomination Deadline: 17:00 (JST) on Wednesday, 10th April 2026

Application Deadline (Email Submission): 17:00 (JST) on Wednesday, 15

April 2026 (For details regarding the types of required documents and how

to submit them, please refer to page 2 of the attached Word file:

"(1)-(3)_Application".)

=============================================

Original Documents:

Please contact Dr. Sainu Franco, International Relations Officer, MB 105,

and register your interest in person, on or before 10th April, 2026.

Please submit the documents via email first. We will check the data and ask

you to post the original documents once we verify there are no errors. (Please

do not post them in advance.)

<Important Notes>

l Strict Deadlines: Applications missing any required documents by the

deadline will not be considered.

l Starting from this intake, document (4) "Letter of recommendation" must

now be a "Letter of Recommendation from the university president, dean, or

graduate school director". A recommendation letter signed by the president,

dean, or graduate school director of the university is strictly required.

l Documents (8) "Health check" and (11) "Copy of passport" may take some

time to prepare. We kindly ask you to advise your prospective students to

begin preparing these early to ensure they meet the submission deadline.

l Additionally, please be advised that we regularly encounter errors and

omissions in the information provided for documents (1) through (3). To

address this, we have prepared the attached guide,

"Application_Guidelines_ENG.docx", which details specific points of

caution. We would be most grateful if you could consult this document and

supervise your students' preparation to prevent any incomplete submissions.

 Best Regards,

R Seenivasan

subject: Nominations Fontys University of Applied Sciences The Netherlands - cluster Technology - Fall 2026
body:
Kind attention --- Pre- Final year students!!

Fonty's University of Applied Sciences is opening nominations and

admissions for Fall 2026!

Fontys Cluster Technology

Concerning incoming and outgoing mobility Fontys study departments are

grouped based on their fields of study. This email focusses on the cluster

Technology, incoming students, and includes the following Fontys

departments:

 - Information and Communication Technology – contact person Georgiana

 Manolache

 - Engineering – contact person Irina Claessen

 - Technology and Logistics – contact person Franka van den Bongard

Programme offer for Fall 2026

You can find a complete overview of programmes available to exchange

students for the upcoming semester (including practical information) at

their webpage Fall semester exchange programmes

https://www.fontys.nl/en/Fontys-Study-Abroad/Fontys-Clusters/Cluster-Technology/Fall-semester-exchange-programmes.htm

.

Please note that they have 3 different campuses divided over two cities:

the city of Eindhoven and the city of Venlo. A combination of programmes

and/or locations is not possible. For their factsheet please see attachment.

Nominations

Please contact Dr. Sainu Franco, International Relations Officer, MB 105,

and register your interest in person, on or before 15th April, 2026.

Non-fee paying students can start the application process through the

link we will send them after we have received their nomination.

Fee paying students (free movers) will receive the application forms to

fill out and return to us after we have received the nomination.

Registration

Registration for students in our online registration programme is open

until May 15th, 2026.

After this date, students must be registered in the online programme,

documents can still be uploaded.

The team Study Technology Abroad is ready to answer any questions, so

please don’t hesitate to reach out to Franka van den Bongard.

subject: Code of Conduct for Students
body:
Ref: VIT/Regr./2025/043

 7 March 2025

CIRCULAR 

Sub.: Code of Conduct for Students

Dear VITians,

VIT upholds discipline, integrity, and responsible conduct as its core

values. In this regard, all students are advised to strictly adhere to the

following guidelines to maintain a safe and respectful environment within

and beyond the campus.

Students are strictly advised to avoid using unauthorized rental bikes,

as they pose safety risks and violate campus regulations. Using such

services can lead to unforeseen accidents and disciplinary consequences.

Similarly, students must refrain from visiting places that may compromise

their security or well-being. Engaging in activities in such locations can

lead to serious repercussions, and the university strongly discourages such

behaviour.

It has been observed that some students misuse the leave policies by

providing false information to obtain unnecessary leaves. Such actions

disrupt academic schedules and will not be tolerated. Leaves must only be

taken for genuine reasons and with proper approval. Likewise, student ID

cards are meant strictly for personal identification and campus access.

Any misuse, such as lending, duplicating, or tampering with ID cards, is a

serious offense that will invite strict action.

The university also expects students to uphold the reputation of VIT at

all times. Posting misleading, false, or defamatory content about the

institution or any entity associated with the institution on social media

platforms, creating unwanted WhatsApp groups and making any religious or

racist comments through social media channels in any form is strictly

prohibited. Students are advised to use social media responsibly and ensure

that their online conduct reflects integrity, courtesy and respect for the

institution.

We seek your kind cooperation in maintaining the decorum of the university.

Any violation of these guidelines will result in disciplinary action as per

university policies.

Please refer to the Code of Conduct for students at the link given below.

https://vit.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Student-Code-of-Conduct.pdf.

Registrar

To

All Students (Vellore Campus) / All VITians (Vellore Campus)

Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), India - - Engineering and

Technology: 212th best in the World and 9th best in India (QS World

University Rankings by Subject 2024)- 10th best University, 13th best

research institution and 11th best engineering institution in India (NIRF

Ranking, Govt. of India 2024)- 6th in India and 687th in the world (US News

2024)- NAAC Accreditation with A++ grade (3.66 out of 4)

Dell Technologies - Dell Futureminds AI Hackathon Registration - 2028

Batch

Batch – current 2nd year students only

Greetings from Dell Technologies.

We are pleased to invite your esteemed institution to participate in the

Dell Futureminds AI Hackathon, an inter-college AI-focused hackathon aimed

at identifying and nurturing future-ready technical talent. The hackathon is

planned to run during the mid- May to June/July 2026 timeframe.

Overview of the Hackathon

Dell Futureminds AI Hackathon is a multi-stage, inter-collegiate

competition where interested students will work on real-world problem

statements curated by Dell Technologies. The event is designed to assess

technical depth, problem-solving skills, collaboration, and innovation.

Participation Flow & Structure

The hackathon will be conducted in the following stages:

 1. Student Interest Registration

 Interested students from your college will register to participate.

 2. Eligibility Criteria: 2nd year students from CS, IT and relevant

 branches with 60% in 10th , 12th , and Graduation.

 3. Screening & Assessment

 - Dell will screen registrations based on defined eligibility

 criteria.

 - Eligible students will undergo a HackerRank assessment.

 4. Team Formation & Round 1 (College-Level)

 - Shortlisted students will form teams of 5 members each.

 - Dell will provide problem statements for the hackathon.

 - Colleges will be responsible for forming teams and conducting the

 first round of evaluation.

 - The top 4 teams from each college will qualify for Round 2.

 5. Round 2 (Dell Evaluation)

 - Qualified teams will be evaluated by Dell technical panels.

 - Based on performance, one team from each of the top 5 colleges will

 be selected for the final round.

 - All Round 2 qualifiers will receive digital participation

 certificates from Dell.

 6. Final Round – Onsite at Dell Bangalore Office

 - The final round will be conducted in person at the Dell Bangalore

 office.

 - Stay and accommodation will be arranged by Dell.

 - Travel arrangements will need to be managed by the qualifying

 teams.

 7. Rewards & Recognition

 - Exciting prizes will be awarded to the winning teams.

 - Finalists will gain invaluable exposure through interaction with

Dell leaders

 and experts.

 - Round 2 qualifiers will receive official digital certificates,

 enhancing their academic and professional profiles.

We believe this initiative will provide your students with a strong

platform to showcase their capabilities and gain hands-on experience with

industry-relevant AI challenges.

Neo PAT Portal as there would be shortlisting by the company for the

selection process.

relevant certificates.

subject: Hackathon on Cost-effective affordable Cloth bag- “The Bag-It Challenge” -Meendum Manjappai
body:
Dear All,

Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board has launched a

Hackathon on Cost-effective affordable Cloth bag- “The Bag-It Challenge”

Tamil Nadu Government banned the use of one-time use and throwaway plastics

irrespective of thickness as per vide GO. 84 dated 25.06.2018 effective

from 1st January 2019. Despite the rigorous implementation of these

regulations, including inspection raids and awareness campaigns throughout

the state, the use of single-use plastic carry bags continues to persist in

contravention of the bans. This persistence can be attributed to several

factors, including the cost-effectiveness and functional advantages of

plastic. Many alternatives such as paper or reusable bags, while more

environmentally friendly, tend to be more expensive and may not offer the

same level of durability and convenience as plastic."

The government of Tamil Nadu launched a people's campaign namely “Meendum

Manjappai” in December 2021. Meendum in Tamil means once again and

Manjappai means the yellow bag. The campaign has brought focus on the

age-old eco-friendly tradition of always carrying a yellow cloth bag. The

Meendum Manjappai campaign is a call for back-to-basics in the future.

To address this challenge, the Tamil Nadu Pollution Control Board has

planned a Hackathon with the primary objective to generate creative ideas

and develop cost-effective cloth bags that are appealing to a wide range of

people. By making eco-friendly options more attractive and accessible, the

hope is to eradicate the use of single-use carry bags. The hackathon will

be a valuable platform for entrepreneurs, innovators, and designers to

collaborate and create practical, appealing, and cost-effective cloth bags.

These bags can then be introduced into the market as alternatives to

single-use plastics. The hackathon may also involve identifying sustainable

materials and manufacturing methods, as well as strategies for promoting

the adoption of these eco-friendly bags among consumers.

-- 

Thanks and Regards,

Dr. Leema Rose Viannie

President, Institution's Innovation Council,

VIT, Vellore.

body:
Dear VITians,

We are thrilled to share the remarkable success story of Team MyPerro,

the proud innovators behind Perro Technocare Private Limited a Startup

Under TBI, VIT Vellore, who have brought great honor to our institution by

excelling in two prestigious competitions:

 - The Global Student Entrepreneur Awards (GSEA) Kerala by

 Entrepreneurs' Organization

 - Disrupt 2025 by IIT Guwahati

Saiprasad Pandilwar represented Team MyPerro at the GSEA Regionals held in

Kochi, Kerala. Competing against 150 participants, he advanced through

multiple rounds, showcasing exceptional entrepreneurial skills and a

visionary idea. Saiprasad secured the runner-up position, a cash prize of

₹50,000, and a coveted spot in the GSEA India Finals scheduled for March.

Simultaneously, Team MyPerro participated in Disrupt 2025, facing over 450

participants across four rigorous rounds: business plan submission, market

study, pitch deck creation, and finals. Led by Manan Vyas, the team

delivered an outstanding pitch at the IIT Guwahati campus, securing the

runner-up position and winning a cash prize of ₹40,000.

In addition to their success, the team impressed investors, who expressed

interest in their product. On 19th January, Team MyPerro will showcase

their innovation at a dedicated stall at IIT Guwahati, engaging with

students, investors, and participants.

subject: Proctees group chat feature enabled in SelfCare/VITian App
body:
Dear Proctors,

We’re happy to inform you that the group chat feature has been enabled

in SelfCare

app (for faculty) and the VITian app (for students). You can now use this

feature to communicate directly with your proctees, share important

updates, and address their queries more efficiently.

Please ensure that all communication within the chat is kept professional

and focused on academic and mentoring-related discussions. All discussions

and interactions with proctees should take place within this group to

ensure better coordination and transparency.

We extend our sincere appreciation to the Director, SDC, and his team for

their dedicated efforts in making this possible.

If you face any issues or have feedback regarding the feature, feel free to

reach out to the Students' Welfare.

The campus recruitment drive will be conducted on 16th and 17th July 2026.

We plan to complete the entire recruitment process within these two days,

including the pre placement talk, assessments, interviews, and offer

handover.

The selected candidates will be onboarded in July 2026, and they will be

with us till December 2026 as interns and then they will be allowed to

attend their university examinations in December. From January 2027

onwards, they will join us as full-time employees.

Note:- Candidates will be granted leave to attend their final semester

project viva.

Students who do not have any courses (except capstone) in their 4th year

alone are eligible for the process, others please do not register.

9 pointers (Having courses only in fall semester) also can register. If

they are selected they need to come and write FAT exams (Theory /

Practical) Physically CDC Office will provide OD .

subject: Winter Semester 2025-26 Make-up Examination Registration
body:
Office of the Controller of Examinations

 Ref.No. : VIT/CoE/2026/26008

 Date : 08-June-2026

 Winter Semester 2025-26 Make-up Examination Registration

To: All Students (Vellore Campus)

Sub: 

Make-up Examination Registration for Winter 2025-26 Registered

courses [Theory-only

course or a Theory course with an embedded laboratory component] in which

the students have appeared for the first time and failed to clear ['F' &

'N1' grades].

Note: Debarred, Malpractice, and students who were absent in FAT (N2, N4

and N3) are NOT Eligible.

Grading Policy:

The maximum grade that will be awarded in the Make-up Examination is an

‘E’, regardless of the absolute marks obtained.

Minimum passing conditions as per the academic regulations is as follows:

 - Theory Only: Minimum 40 marks in Make-up Examination and 50% in

 Grand Total for PASS.

 - Embedded: Minimum 40 marks in Make-up Theory Examination, 50%

(CAM+Make-up

 FAT) in Lab Examination and 50% in Grand Total (Embedded Theory and

 Lab) for PASS. If a student PASSED in one of the components, then

 he/she is allowed to write the exam only for the failed component.

 - Absent in the Make-up Exam FAT retains the earlier Grade obtained

 during the regular semester.

For the theory course with an embedded laboratory, the make exam is only

for the failed component. If a student fails in the Make-up Examination,

he/she is required to re-register for the course in a subsequent

semester. Make-up

Examination does not apply to any re-registered courses.

Registration Dates

Registration Link & Online Fee Payment 

[available in Student login – Examinations/Make-Up Exam Registration]

 08-June-2026 to 21-June-2026

· Under No circumstances late registration/ payment

will be entertained.

· Students should register in V-Top and make necessary

payments (Rs.3000

per course).

· Kindly contact SDC for any V-Top login related issues.

· FAT schedule for the Make-up examination will be released in the

third week of Aug. 2026 (Tentatively)

Controller of Examinations

With Regards

Prof.S.Sivabalan Ph.D

Controller of Examinations

Vellore Institute of Technology ( VIT)

Vellore 632014, TN, India

subject: Fwd: Call for Applications – Product Development Fund (Hardware Projects Only)
body:
Dear Professors and Students,

Greetings from EDC_VITIST!

We are pleased to announce the Product Development Fund—a structured

initiative designed to support early-stage innovation in hardware-based

student projects with a grant of ₹50,000 to student teams (3 members)

for Minimum Viable Product (MVP) and IP development. This fund acts as

a precursor

to the Student Startup Venture (SSV) program, bridging the crucial gap

between ideation and startup formation.

 - Projects must be hardware-focused (e.g., IoT, Robotics, Medical

 Devices / HealthTech, Embedded Systems, Consumer Electronics, Automotive

 & Mobility, Industrial Automation, Wearable Technology, Communication

 Hardware, Assistive and Rehabilitation Devices, AgriTech Devices, Energy

 and Power Systems, Quantum Hardware) and completed within 1 year under

 faculty mentorship.

 Expected outcomes include a provisional Patent/TRL-4 MVP/Startup

 roadmap.

 Successful teams will be prioritized for the Student Startup Venture

 (SSV) program after final review and evaluation.

Faculty members are kindly requested to actively mentor student teams and

guide them in choosing technically viable and IP-worthy product ideas

aligned with the objectives of this fund.

All interested student teams are encouraged to prepare their proposals and

submit them through the link provided below.

https://tinyurl.com/pdf2526edc

Deadline: 14.08.2025

For any clarifications or further information, please contact Dr. S.

Vidhya – Asst. Director -EDC (9994157325)

Let us nurture ideas today, to build startups of tomorrow!

Thanks and regards

C Ramesh Kumar

Director Innovations

subject: SW Newsletter_October 2023 - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

“In the entire circle of the year, there are no days so delightful as

those of a fine October.” - Alexander Smith

VIT embraced the enchanting hues of autumn and the thrills of October! As

the month unfolded, the campus witnessed an unforgettable season filled

with laughter, warmth, and a touch of enchantment.

The Office of Students' Welfare organised Newbie Festa 2023 for the

Freshers batch of 2023. The First Years rocked the stage with some

spectacular music and dance performances. As a welcome gesture, the seniors

also performed and motivated the first years.

Onam Celebration has been a custom in VIT for many years now. This year was

no different. "Thanima'23" was conducted on the 1st of October, 2023. Mr.

Gopi Sundar, Music Director and a National Award Winner was the Chief Guest

for the event. Our Honourable Chancellor, Vice Presidents, Pro-Vice

Chancellor and Registrar graced the occasion and wished the Malayalee

Community in VIT. The event saw the traditional and regional art forms like

Thiruvathirakali, Kalari Abhyasam, Mohiniyattam, Oppana, Vanjipaatu, Margam

Kali etc, followed by the traditional Onasadhya. The special performance by

the Chief Guest was thoroughly enjoyed by the audience.

Farewells are always emotional and difficult. The UG Farewell and

Chancellor's Dinner for the Class of 2024 was organised from 30th October

to 01st November, 2023. A photo session, cultural evening and Chancellor's

Dinner was arranged as part of it. Students had a great time as they

re-lived all their sweet memories on campus, took pictures and bid adieu to

their friends, juniors and faculty members.

The celebration of Ayudha Pooja fostered a sense of community and

encouraged everyone to appreciate each others' efforts to create a

harmonious and productive environment. The unity felt by the participants

of this celebration was a testament to the shared values of diligence and

craftsmanship.

"Meri Maati Mera Desh" programme is an initiative aimed at commemorating

the sacrifices of our courageous 'Veers' who have dedicated themselves to

serving our nation selflessly. This programme is envisioned as a

culminating event of Azadi Ka Amrit Mahotsav, a celebration of our

independence and the spirit of patriotism. The Nature Lover's Club

organised the event as a remembrance to the Five eminent brave-hearts Rani

Velu Nachiyar, Veerapandiya Kattabomman, Tirupur Kumaran, Subramani

Bharathi and Kumaraswami Kamaraj.

Find this and a lot more in the October edition of our Newsletter!

subject: Unleash Your Creativity: graVITas 2026 Official Merchandise Design Contest!
body:
Dear Students,

Greetings!

Are you ready to leave your mark on the biggest techno-management fest of

the year?

graVITas 2026 is right around the corner, and we are looking for creative

minds to design our official merchandise! If you have a flair for design

and want thousands of students to wear your art, this is your chance to

shine.

We are hosting an exclusive Merchandise Design Contest and inviting

submissions across multiple apparel categories.

What You Need to Design?

Bring your most innovative, tech-inspired, and trendy ideas to life for any

(or all) of the following categories:

 - Round Neck T-Shirts

 - Polo Shirts

 - Hoodies

 - Varsity Jackets

 - Cap

The Perks of Winning

If your design is selected, you won't just get bragging rights! The

winner(s) will receive:

 - 100% Fee Waiver: Free registration for ANY ONE graVITas 2026 event

 of your choice.

 - Free Merch: A complimentary piece of the official merchandise

 featuring your winning design!

Rules & Guidelines

 - Theme: Your design should reflect the energy, innovation, and

 techno-management spirit of graVITas 2026.

 - Originality: All artwork must be 100% original. Plagiarized designs

 will be instantly disqualified.

 - Format: Please submit your designs in high-resolution formats (PDF).

 Keep the raw/vector files (AI, PSD, SVG) handy, as they will be required if

 you win.

 - Selection: The final decision on the winning designs will be

 strictly made by the Core Organizing Team.

How to Submit?

 - Submission Link: https://forms.gle/aE3bYmTkyxKzAG6d6 (Use your VIT

 mail ID to access the google form)

 - Deadline: 28.05.2026, 5.00pm

Don't miss this opportunity to see your creativity worn by the entire

campus. Dust off your design tools, let your imagination run wild, and

submit your entries today!

For any queries, feel free to reply to this email or contact : 8056428833,

9751281395

subject: Warning on Use of Pirated or Unlicensed Software at VIT
body:
Ref:VIT/Regr./2025/100

 17 July 2025

CIRCULAR

Sub: Warning on Use of Pirated or Unlicensed Software at VIT

Dear All,

This is to issue a serious institutional warning regarding the use of

pirated, unlicensed, or unethical software within the VIT

network—including academic departments, administrative offices,

laboratories, and hostel networks. The use of such software is strictly

prohibited, as it:

· Violates software licensing and copyright laws,

· Introduces major cybersecurity vulnerabilities, and

· Endangers the university’s legal and reputational standing.

This applies to all faculty, staff, and students.

Mandatory Guidelines:

1. All required software (for academic, research, or administrative

purposes) must be procured only through the Centre for Technical Support

(CTS) to ensure compliance with licensing and institutional policies.

2. Students are strictly prohibited from using pirated, cracked, or

unauthorized software on any device connected to the campus or hostel

network.

3. Use of expired licenses, shared credentials, or unauthorized

installations will be treated as a serious violation.

4. Individuals or departments found non-compliant will be personally

responsible for any legal or disciplinary consequences.

Encourage use of Open-Source Software:

All users are strongly encouraged to adopt open-source alternatives wherever

possible. VIT promotes open-source solutions for sustainability,

transparency, and affordability. CTS will be happy to assist in identifying

suitable open-source options based on user requirements.

Let us all work together to ensure a secure, ethical, and legally compliant

software environment at VIT.

Registrar

Essay Writing Competition (Tamil)

Topic: Thiruvalluvarin Tamizh (திருவள்ளூவரின் தமிழ்)

Thiruvalluvar was a renowned Tamil poet-philosopher who is best known for

his work, the Thirukkural. He is considered one of the greatest Tamil poets

and his work is highly respected in Tamil culture. Thiruvalluvar's life and

times are not well-known, and there are many different accounts of his

life. However, it is generally believed that he lived sometime between the

3rd century BCE and the 5th century CE. He is said to have been born in

Mylapore, a suburb of present-day Chennai, India.

The Thirukkural is a collection of 1330 couplets that are divided into

three parts: Aram (virtue), Porul (wealth), and Inbam (love). The text

covers a wide range of topics, including ethics, politics, economics, and

love. The Thirukkural is known for its wisdom and its insights into human

nature. It has been translated into many languages and is considered one of

the most important works of Tamil literature.

Despite Tiruvalluvar’s reasonable tone, many of his ideas were

revolutionary. He dismissed the caste system: “One is not great because of

one’s birth in a noble family; one is not low because of one’s low birth.”

The poet maintained that goodness is its own reward and should not be

regarded as a mere means to a comfortable afterlife.

Thiruvalluvar says that the only indestructible wealth is education. He

says a person who shuns learning is akin to an animal. Comparing those who

read with those who do not is not an appropriate comparison, for how can

one compare man and beast?

Calling all writers! Share your insights on "Thiruvalluvarin Tamizh" in a

500-word essay.

subject: NITI Aayog Webinar (hybrid mode) on ‘Accelerating progress on SDGs’ - Reg.
body:
Dear Students,

The recently concluded G20 Summit under India’s Presidency has, among

other things, expressed concern regarding achieving the Sustainable

Development Goals (SDGs). The G20 New Delhi Leaders’ Declaration has listed

out a set of suggestions which need to be taken forward to ensure

acceleration to achieve the SDG targets by 2030.

Hon’ble Prime Minister has emphasised that India’s G20 Presidency has been

inclusive, ambitious, decisive, and action-oriented, where the

developmental concerns of the Global South have been actively voiced. He

has expressed confidence that this Summit will chart a new path in

inclusive development in a human-centric manner.

In this context, NITI Aayog is organising a webinar with think tanks and

universities on ‘Accelerating progress on SDGs’, which will be held between 10

am and 5 pm on 6th November 2023. 

Students are requested to attend the webinar using the following link:

https://youtube.com/live/l0p7f818ftc?feature=share

subject: Webinar on 2+2 Transfer to University of Edinburgh
body:
Webinar on 2+2 Transfer to University of Edinburgh

Dear Students,

This is to inform you all that on 17th Dec'25, we are organising a webinar

about the 2+2 international transfer to the University of Edinburgh, UK

at 6:00 PM. The webinar will address the application process and Timelines

for applying to the University of Edinburgh. Interested students can

register and join the session using the link given below.

https://ed-ac-uk.zoom.us/meeting/register/Byyv0_MmS32byYkS4_wpyA

Date: 17th Dec'25

Time:6:00 PM

Kindly note that the application deadline is 14th January and students

should apply through UCAS https://accounts.ucas.com/account/login.

Attached is the application guide which will help students through the

process.

Following the submission of the application, we may contact the student to

request additional documents such as their:

 - Transcript

 - English language qualification (such as IELTS or TOEFL or Class XII

 English)

 - Copy of their passport ID page (if they have this)

 - List of courses they are currently studying but have not yet completed

Students must submit their English language qualification by 30th April

2026 if they do not have this by the application deadline.

As a reminder, students should be on track for an 80% or above cumulative

GPA in order to be considered as well as good grades in

engineering-specific subjects. Our minimum English language requirements

are 6.5 overall and 5.5 in each component in IELTS (or equivalent).

In terms of tuition fees for entry in 2026/27 these are set to £34,800/year

and students will receive an automatic scholarship of £3,500/year. Costs

for the 3-week Transitional Course will be deducted from this, meaning

students will receive approximately £1,000 during their first year in

Edinburgh.

Edinburgh is the fourth-largest university in the United Kingdom by total

enrolment and the second largest university in Scotland, receiving over

66,000 undergraduate applications per year, making it the fifth-most

popular university in the UK by application volume. Notable alumni of the

University of Edinburgh include inventor Alexander Graham

Bell, naturalist Charles Darwin, philosopher David Hume, physicist James

Clerk Maxwell, and writers such as Oliver Goldsmith, Sir J. M. Barrie,

Sir Arthur Conan Doyle, Sir Walter Scott, and Robert Louis Stevenson.

The University of Edinburgh is a global top-tier university, consistently

ranked in the world's top 50, specifically placing 34th in the latest QS

World University Rankings (2026 edition)

"Transforming Database Operations" 

Empowering faculty and students with AI-powered database tools 

Teach and learn databases with natural language 

Experience how AI simplifies teaching and learning in database management workflows. 

Revolutionize learning with AI-driven database tools 

Join us for a groundbreaking webcast tailored specifically for global faculty and students. Discover how Oracle’s latest technologies are making database operations more accessible, intuitive, and relevant for teaching, learning, and beyond. 

For faculty: 

Learn how to seamlessly integrate cutting-edge AI-driven database tools into your curriculum. Our experts will demonstrate practical teaching methods to help students grasp concepts such as natural language processing (NLP)-powered database queries, schema analysis, and automated health checks—all using simple, everyday language rather than complex SQL. Gain insights and resources to enrich your classroom experience with hands-on, real-world examples.

For students: 

See how artificial intelligence and modern database systems come together to create dynamic learning opportunities. Experience live demonstrations where complex database operations are performed by simply typing commands like “Check DB health,” and watch as the underlying SQL is generated and executed in real time. Discover the skills and knowledge that will give you an edge in today’s tech-driven world. 

What to expect: 

Introduction to the MCP server—a program that enables AI agents to access data sets and tools for both educational and research needs.

Overview of OCI Generative AI models and their integration with database operations through natural language commands.

Live, interactive demo showcasing end-to-end workflows for teaching and learning.

Who should attend? 

University and college faculty seeking innovative teaching strategies, students eager to learn about the latest in AI and database technology, and academic leaders interested in advancing curriculum and research.

students!

VIT has a partnership with the Johns Hopkins Carey Business School, one

An exciting opportunity to participate in HackOn With Amazon 6.0, a

national-level hackathon organized by Amazon through Unstop.

This hackathon offers students a chance to showcase their coding,

problem-solving, and innovation skills while working on real-world

technology challenges from Amazon.

Key Highlights:

 -

 Team Size: 2 to 3 members

 -

 Eligibility:

 1.

 B.Tech / M.Tech / Integrated Dual Degree / MCA students

 2.

 Graduation Years: 2027 & 2028

 3.

 Eligible branches include CSE, IT, AI/ML, Data Science, Cyber

 Security, ECE, EEE, and related disciplines

 4.

 Minimum 6.5 CGPA required

 -

 Registration Deadline: 28 May 2026, 11:59 PM IST

 -

 Competition Rounds:

 1.

 100-minute Coding Challenge + GenAI MCQs

 2.

 48-Hour Virtual Hackathon

 3.

 Mentorship Round

 Grand Finale at Amazon

Rewards & Benefits:

 -

 Winner Prize & Runner-Up Prizes

 -

 Pre-Placement Interview Opportunities

 -

 Mentorship from Amazon Tech Leaders

 -

 Exciting Swags & Special Rewards for Top Coders

Students interested in participating are encouraged to form teams and

register at the earliest.

technical skills, and interact with professionals from Amazon.

We encourage all eligible students to actively participate and make the

best use of this opportunity

subject: Discover Design Thinking - Call for Design Contest
body:
Dear VITians,

We're thrilled to announce a Design contest sponsored by Microchip as a

part of VDAT-2024 hosted by Vellore Institute of Technology, Vellore.

The objective of this contest is to provide a platform for students and

research scholars to showcase innovative hardware and software solutions to

real-world problems. Whether it's enhancing efficiency, promoting

sustainability, improving accessibility, or addressing societal challenges,

we want to see your creative ideas come to life.

We are calling all talented designers to participate and showcase their

creativity and skills. The winner of the contest will have the opportunity

to work with us on a special project and will receive a cash prize.

We believe that this contest is a great opportunity for designers to

showcase their talents and gain recognition for their work. We hope that

you will consider participating in the contest and look forward to

receiving your submissions.

Idea Submission

 - Your idea submission should cover a description of the idea along with

 a block diagram of your idea

 - Benefits and value addition of your solution, example application

 scenarios.

 - Your team description along with your contact information with mailing

 address.

 - Faculty can be part, but lead author should be student. Presenter in

 the conference has to be student.

Steps for submission

 - 1. Use the design contest submission template provided. TEMPLATE

 https://vit.ac.in/vdat2024/Design-Contest-Submission-Template.docx

 - 2. Fill in all required details with a minimum font size: 10 pt, Times

 New Roman font. Max two pages including tables, diagrams, and references

 (if any).

 - 3. Submit a PDF version using the CMT portal. SUBMIT HERE

 https://cmt3.research.microsoft.com/User/Login?ReturnUrl=%2FVDAT2024

Eligibility

 - Participants should be full-time undergraduate/postgraduate/Phd.

 students from a reputed institute.

For more details, please visit the conference website:

https://vit.ac.in/vdat2024/design-contest.html

With Thanks and Regards,

Dr. Sivanantham S

Professor & Dean, School of Electronics Engineering,

Vellore Institute of Technology,

Vellore -632014, Tamil Nadu, India

E-mail: dean.sense@vit.ac.in; ssivanantham@vit.ac.in

Phone: 0416 - 220 2410/11

body:
Dear VITians,

VIT celebrates Quality Week 2025–2026, a week-long journey of learning,

innovation, and performance presented by the Office of Students' Welfare.

This year’s theme, “Quality: Drive for Innovation and Sustainability,”

reflects our commitment to fostering creativity, responsible growth, and a

culture of excellence in everything we do. The Office of Students’ Welfare

invites you to today’s Quality Week events, brought to you by the Student

Council and various Clubs and Chapters.

Day 2 Events:

 -

 SustainX: CAD for Quality and Sustainability

 -

 BizCon: Build. Bid. Brand

 -

 CHITRAYAN

 -

 AgriSphere- Smart Farming & Sustainable Systems

Scroll down for more details

Bengali Literary Association (Aikyataan)

Event Name: Chitrayan

Event Time: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM

Event Description: Chitrayan is an art showcase under Quality Week 2026

where participants present handmade or digital artworks based on the theme

“Drive for Innovation and Sustainability.” Students will submit and display

their work, expressing ideas on sustainability, innovation, and quality

through visual art. The event provides a platform to showcase creativity,

artistic skills, and meaningful concepts while promoting awareness through

impactful and high-quality artwork.

Venue: Google forms (online)

Registration: VTOP

Society of Automotive Engineering(SAE)

Event Name: SustainX: CAD for Quality and Sustainability

Event Time: 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM

Event Description: QW' 26: SustainX: CAD for Quality and Sustainability is

a 2-hour innovation challenge where teams redesign an existing product or

process to improve its quality, efficiency, and sustainability.

Participants analyze real-world problems and propose practical,

eco-friendly solutions using quality principles, encouraging innovative

thinking and responsible engineering.

Venue: TT VOC Gallery

Registration: VTOP

IEEE WOMEN IN ENGINEERING (IEEE-WIE)

Event Name: Chitrayan

Event Time: 02:00 PM - 07:00 PM

Event Description: BizCon is a business simulation event where teams

transform a sustainability related problem statement into a unique brand.

Participants build their concept and earn BizCoins through quick

challenges. Teams make strategic decisions involving mergers, acquisitions

and expansion while strengthening their business idea. Innovation

sustainability and smart thinking shape the journey leading to a final

pitch where teams present their evolved business model and vision.

Venue: TT-311

Registration: VTOP

THE AI & ML CLUB

Event Name: AgriSphere- Smart Farming & Sustainable Systems

Event Time: 08:00 PM - 11:00 PM

Event Description: This workshop explores how AI and IoT drive the More

from Less revolution, turning precision data into high yield, low impact

farming strategies. You will master predictive tools and computer vision to

build smarter, more sustainable food systems. It is a concise deep dive

into bridging the gap between raw data and real world agricultural impact.

Venue: Google meet (Online)

subject: Outstanding Achievements of Biotechnology Students in Franco-Indian Twinning Program
body:
Dear all,

Greetings!

We are pleased and delighted to share that three students from the M.Sc.

Biotechnology Franco-Indian Twinning Program have been selected to pursue

their Ph.D. studies in France. Two of these students are from the 2023

batch, and one is from the 2024 batch. All three have been awarded

prestigious fellowships (approximately €2000 per month) for a duration of

three years through highly competitive international grants funded by

the Government

of France.

Ms. Anisha Judith (2023–25 Phyto Batch) has been awarded the Eiffel

International Scholarship by Campus France. She will pursue her Ph.D. at

Claude Bernard University Lyon 1 under the guidance of Prof. Léa Payen and

Prof. Francesca Angileri, specializing in Cancer Biology and Toxicology

Ms. Ganga Girish (2023–25 Phyto Batch) has been awarded the INTERREG

Réunion Fellowship and has already commenced her Ph.D. at the University of

La Réunion. She began her doctoral research at CBST under my supervision as

part of an ongoing collaboration between VIT and the University of La

Réunion, in association with Prof. Christian Lefebvre d’Hellencourt and

Prof. Olivier Meilhac. Her research focuses on developing novel

therapeutics for cardiovascular diseases and stroke.

Ms. Varsha Gowri (2024–26 AI Batch) has also been awarded the Eiffel

International Scholarship by Campus France. She will pursue her Ph.D. at

the University of Poitiers under the supervision of Prof. Brigitte Vannier,

working in the area of disease biomarkers and bioinformatics.

I am also very happy to inform you that a total of 13 second-year M.Sc.

Biotechnology (Twinning Program) students and 4 second-year M.Tech.

Biotechnology Dual Degree students are currently undertaking their capstone

research projects in France. These students have secured fellowships and

travel grants through prestigious initiatives such as the Franco-Indian

Campus ILIADE Project, Erasmus+ mobilities, and the InnovoInOnco Graduate

Initiative

 We are thrilled to celebrate the remarkable achievement of our three

students, whose dedication, enthusiasm, and discipline have led to

outstanding success. This milestone fills us all with immense pride and

inspires confidence that many more students will continue to secure

opportunities at prestigious French institutions, bringing further laurels

to our institution.

Let’s continue to strive for excellence and make every moment count!

 I would like to express my heartfelt gratitude to Our Beloved and

Honourable Chancellor, the top management, the core group, the Dean of

Academics, COE, Admissions, Director IR, Prof. Vijayalakshmi, Dr. V.

Krishnan, and all others who have been instrumental in the successful

execution of this twinning program. Their unwavering support, guidance, and

dedication have been pivotal in achieving these milestones and in

strengthening our international academic collaborations.

 “Please refer to the forwarded email for more information.”

Thank you

subject: SW Newsletter_August 2023 - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

"A golden afternoon of August: every breath from the hills so full of life

that it seemed whoever respired it, though dying, might revive." -Emily

Brontë

August marked the conclusion of 76 years of Indian Independence. It also

marked the arrival of thousands of enthusiastic freshers joining several

4-year Bachelor of Technology programs with induction programmes taking

place from 7th to 14th August, 2023.

The induction of the STARS (Support the Advancement of Rural Students)

students happened on 4th August 2023 with much fervour. 10th August 2023

saw many VITians attend the TN Global Investors' Meet 2024.

15th August 2023 signified India's 77th Independence Day. Grand

celebrations commemorated the event, thanks to the concerted efforts from

the student community in VIT.

While our university saw the start of the careers of many young minds, it

also saw the beginning of a new journey in the form of Convocation 2023 for

the Class of 2023 on 18th August 2023 and 19th August 2023. We wish all the

students all the very best for their future endeavours.

To celebrate India's milestones in space exploration, the Chandrayaan III

soft landing was telecasted on 23rd August, 2023 at the Anna Auditorium.

It was a jubilant evening for all that were present to see India create

history.

Find all this and more in the August 2023 newsletter!
