subject: Unlock Your Career: IIT Bombay 2-Month Training & Internship Program
body:
Dear Students of VIT,

Greetings!

We are excited to announce a collaboration with IIT Bombay for a 2-month

Training and Internship Program. This program offers certifications from

top global companies like CISCO, META (Facebook), IBM, and several

other multinational corporations in both technical and non-technical

 domains.

Eligibility:

This opportunity is available only to shortlisted students from VIT.

Note: If any of your batchmates missed this notification, feel free to

forward this email to them.

Registration Deadline:

To apply, please fill out the Application Form

https://forms.gle/hquuD27paudh24GP7. Shortlisted candidates will receive

further instructions from our HR team.

LINK:https://forms.gle/hquuD27paudh24GP7

https://forms.gle/hquuD27paudh24GP7

Additionally, you can Join the WhatsApp Group for updates and details.

Program Details:First Month:

 - Live training from IIT Bombay, including interactive sessions and

 mentorship from industry experts. (Login credentials will be shared after

 registration).

Second Month:

 - Internship with Real-World Projects:

 - Individual Projects: 10 projects, each intern will complete tasks

 with guidance from a mentor.

 - Capstone Project: A group project involving 4-5 interns.

Program Format:

 - Blended Program/Recorded Classes: Access recorded lectures and

 attend live sessions on weekends for doubt clearing.

 - Mentor-Led/Live Classes: Live Zoom sessions 3-4 times a week at 6:30

 PM. Recordings will also be available.

 - Learning Management System (LMS): 6 months of access to the LMS

 portal.

Benefits Upon Completion:

 - IIT Bombay Certification.

 - Verified certificates through Wipro Dice ID.

 - Co-branded Internship Certificate from leading MNCs.

 - 100% Placement Assistance.

 - Access to a growing professional community.

 - Curriculum covering Generative AI and Prompt Engineering.

 - Exclusive Masterclasses with top global company founders and CXOs.

 - Personalized Mentorship for career guidance.

Who Should Apply:

This notification is for students who missed the scholarship opportunity in

previous batches (Oct-Nov, Nov-Dec, Dec-Jan).

Take the first step toward an exciting career and Submit Your Application

Now https://forms.gle/hquuD27paudh24GP7.

We look forward to your participation!

2025, an exciting hackathon designed to inspire innovation, creativity, and

Team Size: Minimum 3 members and Maximum 5 members

assist — they analyse, decide, and create real-world impact. Build AI

agents that can solve genuine business problems across industries like

retail, healthcare, logistics, finance, or smart manufacturing.

Xenovex Technologies!

subject: Register Now: Workshop on Drone Technology | Innovation Week 2026-reg
body:
Dear Students,

The Office of Innovation, Startup & Technology Transfer (VITIST) invites

you to participate in a two-day Workshop on Drone Technology, organized

as part of Innovation Week 2026. This hands-on workshop aims to provide

practical exposure to modern UAV systems, covering drone design,

operation, safety protocols, and real-world applications such as

agriculture, surveillance, and mapping, along with insights into career

opportunities, regulations, and the future scope of drone technology.

The workshop will be conducted on 23rd and 24th January 2026 at PRP 406,

VIT Vellore, in offline mode. The registration fee is ₹500 + GST, and

participation is limited to 60 students on a first-come, first-served

basis. The workshop is open to UG, PG, and PhD students.

Interested students are requested to register at the earliest using the

link https://events.vit.ac.in/, as seats are limited.

subject: 📌 Final Reminder : Official Off-Campus Internship Drive for VIT Students
body:
Dear VIT Student,

Congratulations.You have been selected to participate in the Official

Off-Campus Internship Drive, a collaborative initiative

between Skillumni and Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), recognized

by Startup India and the Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises

(MSME).

This program provides a structured, project-based learning

experience designed to help students gain practical, industry-relevant

skills through professional mentorship and real-world project execution.

------------------------------

How to Confirm Your Enrollment

Seats are limited and will be allocated on a first-come, first-served

basis.To confirm your participation, please complete the onboarding form

using the link below:

Enrollment Form: https://forms.gle/GUgP3tGQKGaej3jX8

https://forms.gle/GUgP3tGQKGaej3jX8

------------------------------

Internship Domains

Participants can gain hands-on experience in one or more of the following

areas:

 -

 Data Science with Python: Python programming, data preprocessing,

 machine learning, deep learning, NLP, and big data.

 -

 Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning: Neural networks (CNNs,

 RNNs), reinforcement learning, robotics, and NLP.

 -

 Web Development: Frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React.js) and Backend

 (Node.js, Laravel, Django).

 -

 Additional Domains: Cybersecurity, Cloud Computing, Digital Marketing,

 Business Analytics, Finance, and Human Resources.

------------------------------

Program Benefits

Upon successful completion, participants will receive:

 -

 An Internship Certificate from recognized partner organizations

 -

 A Course Completion Certificate co-branded by Skillumni and Microsoft

 -

 A Letter of Recommendation, based on performance and engagement

------------------------------

Key Program Features

 -

 Flexible start dates aligned with academic schedules

 -

 Option to pause during examination periods

 -

 Adjustable project timelines

 -

 Mentorship from experienced industry professionals

 -

 Structured modules with assessments and applied projects

------------------------------

Contact for Support

For any queries or assistance, please reach out via WhatsApp at +91 63638

79292.

We look forward to your participation in this initiative, which aims to

enhance your practical learning experience and prepare you for future

professional opportunities.

Best regards,The Skillumni Team(In collaboration with VIT)

subject: Riviera 2025 Pro-Shows – Guidelines to be followed
body:
Ref:

VIT/Regr./2025/036

 19 February 2025

CIRCULAR

Sub: Riviera 2025 Pro-Shows – Guidelines to be followed

The Riviera 2025 Pro-Show events will be held from 20.02.25 to 23.02.25 at

the SJT Ground from 6:00 p.m. onwards. The students are requested to abide

by the following guidelines for the same.

1. Students who have purchased tickets ONLY are permitted to enter the

venue from 5:00 p.m. onwards.

2. No students will be permitted after 7:00 p.m. to enter the venue.

3. Students are requested to confirm their registration through Face

Recognition System at the entry counter at the venue.

4. Pro-Shows tickets are not transferable under any circumstance

to other students.

5. Students have to undergo frisking before they reach the entry

counter.

6. Outside food, beverages, water bottles, backpacks, bags, and

all other takeaway items are strictly prohibited inside the venue.

7. Separate zones for standing and sitting have been arranged at the

venue. Zones B1 to B4 are for standing and Zones B5 to B8 are for sitting

on the boy’s side and similarly G1 and G2 are for standing and G3 and

G4 are for sitting on the girl’s side (Layout of the venue is attached

herewith).

8. A restricted number of students will be allowed in each zone and

they will be filled on first-cum-first-serve basis.

9. Students wanting to leave the venue in between the show will not be

permitted to

re-enter.

10. Any act of indiscipline by the student will be viewed seriously and

subject to severe actions as per the student code of conduct.

11. The Pro-Show venue is under CCTV surveillance.

12. Food stalls, drinking water, restrooms, and ambulance facilities are

available inside the venue. For any emergency, the student can contact the

faculty coordinators in the respective zones.

13. Eating places are provided near the food stalls. Taking food and

beverages inside the Zones is strictly prohibited.

14. Men's Hostel students are requested to enter the venue ONLY through

the Railway Underground Bridge (RUB) between SJT and PRP buildings. Entry

is not permitted through any other subway.

15. Day scholar boys will be permitted to enter the venue near RUB

adjacent to PRP (VAIAL entrance) through Gate 11 only.

16. Ladies Hostel students and day scholar girl students are requested to

enter the Pro-Show venue through the F-Block Ladies' Hostel gate. Day

scholar girls are allowed into the campus only through the Main Gate.

17. Students who are not attending the Pro-Shows are requested to leave

the campus before 7:00 p.m. from 20.02.25 to 23.02.25. The hostel-in-time

is 7:00 p.m. for students who are not attending the Pro-Shows.

18. Students are requested to collect their online deliveries before 5:00

p.m. from 20.02.25 to 23.02.25.

Your cooperation in this regard is highly solicited.

Enjoy the events and make Riviera 2025 a grand success!!!

Registrar

To

All Students (Vellore Campus) / All Research Scholars (Vellore Campus)

Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), India - - Engineering and

Technology: 212th best in the World and 9th best in India (QS World

University Rankings by Subject 2024)- 10th best University, 13th best

research institution and 11th best engineering institution in India (NIRF

Ranking, Govt. of India 2024)- 6th in India and 687th in the world (US News

2024)- NAAC Accreditation with A++ grade (3.66 out of 4)

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [20th

 October] events.

National Solidarity Day

OCTOBER 20 has come to acquire a special significance for us all. It was on

this date a few years ago that our northern neighbor, whom we had treated

like a friend, launched an attack on our borders. During the weeks that

followed this fateful day, the world witnessed the most heart-warming

demonstration of the basic unity and solidarity of the Indian people.

The observance of National Solidarity Day is an annual reminder of this

fundamental unity. On this day, the thoughts of the whole nation turn to

our Armed Forces who gallantly guard our extensive borders and who have,

throughout history, been famous for their courage and stamina.

Fifth Pillar

Event Name: Democracy: A Work in Progress

Time: 9:30 PM – 9:30 PM

Event Description: Fifth Pillar is excited to host a quiz on origin and

evolution of Democracy. It is a form of government in which the people have

the power to choose their leaders and make decisions about how their

country is run. This quiz event will test your knowledge of the history of

democracy, from its origins in ancient Greece to its modern-day forms.

Registration link: VTOP Registration

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/5pvit/

Facebook link: https://www.facebook.com/5pvit/

English Literary Association (ELA)

Event Name: Phantom Opus

Date: October 13th - 31st

Time: 9 PM - 9 PM

Event Platform: Google Forms

Event Description: Phantom Opus is here on the occasion of Halloween. Let

your creativity run wild as you craft spine-tingling stories that will send

shivers down the spines of readers. Whether you're an experienced writer or

just starting your literary journey, this event is a perfect opportunity to

celebrate the magic of Halloween through the power of words. So pick up

your laptop, keyboard (or a spooky typewriter) and unleash your inner

storyteller into an eerie and enchanting world.

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link : https://www.instagram.com/elaavit/?hl=en

subject: Interdisciplinary project from Janitri-reg
body:
Dear Students,

We are happy to bring to you an opportunity to work on a project from the

scratch to the prototype development leading to IPR.

Janitri Innovations Pvt Ltd, Bangalore is our MoU organisation which is

committed to transforming maternal and newborn healthcare through

innovative technologies.

As part of our collaboration with them, we invite you to take part in an

industry project where you will work on a real-world problem statement.

The project team is an interdisciplinary one and will have mentors from VIT

and Janitri as well. The project will be for a defined duration (nearly one

year) and requires commitment, teamwork, and creativity from participating

students. You will be working on this project in the VIT, Vellore campus

and have regular status review, updates and interactions with the mentor

from the organisation.

It is a valuable opportunity to apply your classroom learning, gain

industry exposure, and contribute to meaningful healthcare solutions.

If this excites you, register through this form found in the link

https://forms.gle/qsk82v8jxUMbR2ps9. Based on the details shared by you

students will be invited for the next round of interviews. Deadline to

register using the form is 16th October 2025.

Thanks and Regards,

Dr. Jasmine

Professor & Dean

Vellore -632014, Tamil Nadu, India

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [19th June]

World Sickle Cell Day

World Sickle Cell Day is a United Nations recognized day to raise awareness

of sickle cell at a national and international level on June 19th. On 22nd

December 2008, the United Nations General Assembly adopted a resolution

that recognizes sickle cell disease as a public health problem and “one of

the world’s foremost genetic diseases.” Sickle cell disease (SCD) is a

group of inherited red blood cell disorders. Healthy red blood cells are

round, and they move through small blood vessels to carry oxygen to all

parts of the body. In someone who has SCD, the red blood cells become hard

and sticky and look like a C-shaped farm tool called a “sickle”. The sickle

cells die early, which causes a constant shortage of red blood cells. Also,

when they travel through small blood vessels, they get stuck and clog the

blood flow.

People with sickle cell are also at risk of complications from stroke,

acute chest syndrome, blindness, bone damage, and priapism. Over time

people with sickle cell can experience damage to organs such as the liver,

kidney, lungs, heart, and spleen. Death can also result from complications

of the disorder. Treatment of sickle cell mostly focuses on preventing and

treating complications.

subject: 12th December, 2025 - Today's events by Clubs and Chapters-Reg
body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s 12th December,

2025 events.

Today's Events:

 - Decode the Standards

 - Fuel Cells & Thermodynamics: The Science Behind Next-Gen Energy

 Systems

 -

Say My Formula 

 - Ignite: Blade Element Theory for Propellors

 - Petro Brain Battle Grid

 - Hydrocarbon Hustle

Standards Club VIT

Event Name: Decode the Standards

Event Time: 5:00 PM - 8:00 PM

Event Description: The Standards Club is organizing an Indian standards

Training Program to help students understand the basics and importance of

IS codes in ensuring quality and safety. This session gives a quick

introduction to how standards work and why they are essential in academics,

engineering, and real-world applications. Join us to gain useful knowledge

and build a strong foundation in standards.

Venue: CDMM 304

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link :

https://www.instagram.com/p/DSE04-jjN4Z/?igsh=MTNxZjczZDA4bzR6OA==

Association of Energy Engineers (AEE)

Event Name: Fuel Cells & Thermodynamics: The Science Behind Next-Gen

Energy Systems

Event Time:4:00 PM - 5:00 PM

Event Description: Fuel cells are at the forefront of clean-energy

innovation, offering high-efficiency power generation with minimal

emissions. This technical seminar explores the thermodynamic principles

governing fuel cell operation, performance, and real-world applications.

Designed for engineering students passionate about energy technologies, the

event provides conceptual clarity and industry-aligned insights.

Venue: Rajaji Hall

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link : https://www.instagram.com/aee.vit/

The Catalyst Club

Event Name: Say My Formula

Event Time: 9:00 AM - 10:00 aM

Event Description: A thriling chemistry themed challenge inspired by

Breaking Bad. Step into the science behind the series from real reactions

to lab safety with a hint of pop culture chaos. Discover the right answers

as you go and show that you are the one who understands chemistry best.

Venue: Google Form

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link :

https://www.instagram.com/thecatalystclubvit?igsh=a20zbXc2MXUzdHV4thrillin

Society of Automotive Engineers

Event Name: Ignite: Blade Element Theory for Propellors

Event Time: 7:30 PM - 8:30 PM

Event Description: SAE VIT presents Blade Element Theory for Propellers &

Rotors on 12th December from 7:30 PM to 8:30 PM. This core technical

session breaks down how lift and thrust are generated along each blade

section using fundamental aerodynamics and mathematics. Learn how engineers

analyze performance, efficiency, and design of propellers and helicopter

rotors through real aviation examples. Ideal for students interested in

aircraft, drones, and propulsion systems.

Venue: Google Meet

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link : https://www.instagram.com/sae_vit?igsh=dnJ2eG5pNWt4YnMz

Society of Petroleum Engineers

Event Name: Petro Brain Battle Grid

Event Time: 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM

Event Description: Petro Brain Battle Grid is a fast-paced strategic trivia

battle where teams fight for dominance over a giant grid-based battlefield.

Each grid cell represents a territory that can be captured by answering oil

& gas questions correctly. With every correct answer, teams expand their

control, forming alliances and blocking opponents

Venue: SMV 101

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link : https://www.instagram.com/spe_vit?igsh=cHdweDh4eDdxdTV6

Society of Petroleum Engineers

Event Name: Hydrocarbon Hustle

Event Time: 3:00 PM - 5:00 PM

Event Description: Hydrocarbon Hustle is a dynamic and fast-paced product

identification and pathway-matching challenge where teams race to connect

crude oil samples to their correct refining routes and end-use products.

Using clue cards that hint at API gravity, color, sulfur content, boiling

ranges, and viscosity, participants must determine whether a sample becomes

LPG, gasoline, kerosene, diesel, fuel oil, or petrochemical feedstock.

Venue: SMV G10

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link : https://www.instagram.com/spe_vit?igsh=cHdweDh4eDdxdTV6

Vellore Institute of Technology shared a post: Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT), India, has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the University of Limerick (UL), Ireland. This collaboration is set to enhance the exchange of students and faculty, initiate joint research and development programs, and establish joint twinning programs. Furthermore, it will create Centres of Excellence in Science, Engineering, Technology, Management, and Humanities. 

Prominent figures from both institutions attended the MoU signing ceremony. Representing VIT were Chancellor Dr. G. Viswanathan, Vice President Mr. Sankar Viswanathan, Assistant Vice President Ms. Kadhambari S. Viswanathan, Vice Chancellor Dr. Kanchana Bhaaskaran, Pro-Vice-Chancellor Dr. Partha Sharathi Mallick, and Director of International Relations Dr. R. Seenivasan, along with other senior faculty members. From the University of Limerick, attendees included Prof. Syed Tofail, Chair of the UL India Committee and member of the Department of Physics; Mr. James Sergeant, UL Global Officer; Prof. Nanasaheb Thorat, member of the UL India Committee and Department of Physics; and Dr. Charlie O'Mahony, Researcher in the Department of Physics. 

This MoU represents a significant milestone in strengthening academic and research ties between the two esteemed institutions, fostering innovative educational and research opportunities.

subject: Invitation- UM-Dearborn USA Graduate Programme Virtual information Session
body:
Dear Students,

This is for your information and participation.

-------------

Greetings from the University of Michigan-Dearborn!

We are excited to invite you and your students to our upcoming Virtual Open

House, specifically designed for those interested in exploring our Graduate

Programs. If you have students considering furthering their education

through one of our graduate programs, this event is an excellent

opportunity to learn more about our offerings and how we can support their

academic journey.

Event details and RSVP links can be found at the link below. We have

several dates available, each hosted by individual colleges and departments

to provide tailored information on specific graduate programs.

https://umdearborn.edu/admissions/graduate-admissions/graduate-campus-visits-and-events/graduate-open-house

During the session, participants will:

 - Discover our diverse range of graduate programs.

 - Learn about our admissions process, financial aid opportunities, and

 how students can seamlessly transition from undergraduate to graduate

 studies.

 - Get answers to their questions in real-time from our admissions team,

 faculty, and staff.

We look forward to hopefully having some of your students join us virtually

and helping them take the next step toward a bright future at UM-Dearborn!

Please don't hesitate to reach out to us if you have any

additional questions.

subject: SW Special Event: International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit Trafficking Poster Competition - Reg.
body:
Hello Students,

Get ready to raise your voice against Drug abuse with a powerful poster!

In honor of The International Day against Drug Abuse and Illicit

Trafficking, or World Drug Day, we're hosting a poster-making competition

for all students. Let's work together to spread awareness about the dangers

of drugs and illicit trafficking and create a healthier and safer future.

2024 World Drug Day theme: "The evidence is clear: invest in prevention" 

Here's how you can participate:

Design: Create a compelling poster (Digital Poster or Scanned Copy of a

Hand-Made Poster) that conveys the message of a drugs free world. Be

creative and impactful!

Share: Upload your poster to Instagram.

Tag Us: Make sure to tag us @sw_vit in your post.

The Prize: The most impactful poster, chosen by our team, will win a cash

prize of Rs. 1000/-!

Posters to be uploaded on Instagram before 11:59 PM tonight (26.06.2024)!

Spread the Word: Share this email with your VIT friends and encourage them

to participate!

Let's use this competition to spark a conversation and inspire positive

change. We can't wait to see your amazing designs!

Please register via the following link: https://forms.gle/zVX3rswqzWWcV3xQ8

Faculty members and students with interests in AI, engineering, technology,

and innovation are strongly encouraged to attend.

For more details:

Dr.J.N.V.Raghuram,

Deputy Director- International Relations

subject: Yantra’26: A Week of Technical Innovation!
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings from the Office of Students' Welfare!

We cordially invite you to the inaugural ceremony of Yantra’26, scheduled

on 7th February 2026 (Saturday) at 10:00 AM at the Dr. Channa Reddy

Auditorium. This event marks the beginning of an inspiring journey focused

on creativity, innovation, and technical excellence among students.

We are honoured to have a distinguished alumnus of VIT, Mr. Piyush

Padmanabhan, an alumnus of the 2011 Biotechnology batch. He is the CEO and

Co-Founder & Director of Next Big Innovation Labs, and Co-Founder &

Director of Tissue Ink. A deep-tech entrepreneur dedicated to bridging the

gap between laboratory research and clinical practice by translating tissue

engineering, regenerative medicine, AI, and biofabrication into real-world

medical applications.

Event Details:

Date: 07/02/2026

Time: 10:00 AM

Venue: Dr. Channa Reddy Auditorium

To bring this vision to life, Yantra’26 features an extensive lineup of

events:

 - 27 Hackathons focused on innovation, collaboration, and social impact

 - 24 Competitions to challenge your skills, creativity, and

 problem-solving abilities

 - 19 Workshops offering hands-on learning across multiple technical

 and interdisciplinary domains

body:
Oracle University Learning Community http://community.oracle.com/ou/

Julie Stirling-Oracle Started a new discussion. Revolutionizing Manufacturing with Oracle Cloud’s AI

As industries pivot toward intelligent automation, OCI’s AI Services — including Vision, Forecasting, and NVIDIA-powered infrastructure — are empowering manufacturers to streamline operations, reduce downtime, and boost quality.

1. Smart Inventory with OCI Vision & Drones

Heavy industrial stock-taking is often slow, costly, and error prone. OCI Vision enables image-based automation of inventory, integrated with drones or robots.

How it works:

 Drone or robots captures images of stacked goods.

 OCI Vision custom models detect and count objects (e.g., pipes or steel roads etc.) using labeled training data.

 OCI Functions and Events automatically update supply-chain or ERP systems. This accelerates cycle counts, reduces errors, and frees up manpower.

2. Predictive Maintenance

Unexpected equipment failure is a major headache for manufacturers. OCI Services enables real-time monitoring of time-series sensor data to flag early signs of machine malfunction. Pre-built algorithms detect unusual patterns, trigger alerts, and prevent catastrophic breakdowns. This technology helps shift from reactive fixes to scheduled, cost-effective maintenance.

3. Optimized Production Monitoring 

OCI’s AI delivers more than predictive insights — it enables holistic production monitoring:

 Real-time blending of sensor and factory floor data.

 Dashboards highlighting bottlenecks or throughput dips.

Manufacturers can monitor multiple lines with precision, minimizing scrap rates and maximizing yield.

4. Advanced Simulations & HPC for Design

New product development cycles are accelerated with HPC-powered simulations:

 OCI HPC clusters enable complex engineering tasks (e.g., CFD, FEA) to run faster and at lower cost.

 With rapid simulation, engineers iterate designs quickly, reducing time-to-market.

5. Industrial Copilot: Tractian + OCI

A standout real-world case: Tractian, a specialist in AI driven industrial condition monitoring, has teamed up with OCI to provide “Industrial Copilot” solutions. Key benefits include:

 LLM-based guidance for maintenance teams, linking OEM datasheets to field operations.

 Reduced downtime through faster decision-making and supply readiness.

 High-performance training and scalability on NVIDIA H200 GPUs within OCI infrastructure.

6. Fast AI Deployment via OCI–NVIDIA Synergy

Oracle’s integration with NVIDIA delivers:

 Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) AI Blueprints are no-code, OCI-verified deployment packages for Generative AI workloads—perfect for launching and operating GenAI workloads with minimal friction.

 NVIDIA NIM microservices: Real-time inference engines deployable on bare-metal or Kubernetes.

 Vector search acceleration: Oracle Database 23ai leverages NVIDIA cuVS for lightning-fast embedding search.

Manufacturers benefit from accelerated rollout of AI assistants, defect detection, sensor analytics, and more. 

Why It Matters for Manufacturing

In Summary

OCI’s latest AI stack — from Vision and HPC to Blueprints and NVIDIA integrations — enables manufacturers to accelerate intelligent automation, enhance quality control, and optimize operations with scalable, ready-to-deploy solutions to:

 Automate mundane visual processes

 Predict failures before they occur

 Accelerate product development

 Empower technicians with AI copilots

 Deploy intelligent systems quickly and securely

This translates into tangible improvements in uptime, quality, cost-efficiency, and speed. The future of manufacturing is here — intelligent, data-driven, and operating at scale on OCI.

Dear VIT Student,

Congratulations on being shortlisted for the Internship Program!

As mentioned above, Teachnook in collaboration with IBM & IIT ROORKEE is

organizing a 2 Month Training + Internship program designed by IBM.

Interested students fill out the form, if you get shortlisted you will get

a call from our HR Team;

APPLY HERE: https://forms.gle/3sKEKetyu4URzA5TA

https://chat.whatsapp.com/Dnu8jR2hdSa7p4hEnwrx1S

Top Preferred Courses: 

✅

Artificial Intelligence.✅ Data Science.✅ Data Analytics.✅ Cyber Security.

✅ Full Stack Web Development.

Here is an outline of the program's structure.

First month: During the program's first month, IBM training will be

conducted in the form of live lectures, and you will have live mentorship

from industry professionals. You will have access to the IBM Portal, where

you can interact with the trainers and fellow students. Login credentials

will be provided to registered students.

Second month: Internship with live mentorship for projects from

professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will give students an experience

in solving real-world problems.

10+ Minor Project: The minor project is an individual project,

Where students will be doing projects on each topic they will be learning.

Major Project (CAPSTONE): The major project is a group project, and you

will work in a group of 3-4 interns, with specific responsibilities

assigned to each intern. The company will provide you with all the required

data and materials for the project.

Third month: Based on your performance during the program's first two

months, we will conduct a technical interview in the same company during

the third month. You will be offered a stipend-based Internship if you

perform well in the interview.

After Completion of the program, the student shall receive a :

✅

Program completion certificate issued by IBM.✅ Co-Branded Internship

certificate.

✅ Letter of Recommendation from IBM.

✅ Access to a growth community.

body:
Dear Faculty and Students,

IEEE DataPort institutional subscription is active for VIT Vellore. Any

user with the university email domain (vit.ac.in OR vitstudent.ac.in) can

log in to the platform with an IEEE account that uses that domain. Users

from the institution will automatically be able to access all of the

datasets (non-Open Access and Open Access).

Access IEEE DataPort for your institution: https://ieee-dataport.org/

Login Instructions for each user:

1. Once you click on the IEEE Dataport Homepage, find the text “Login” at

the top, right-hand corner of your screen. Click this text, then log in

with your IEEE personal account.

2. If you do not have an IEEE personal account with your institutional

email domain, you can create a free account here

https://www.ieee.org/profile/public/createwebaccount/showCreateAccount.html

.

3. Once you have logged in, you will have the ability to explore

https://ieee-dataport.org/search all data sets (by category/content) and

access any datasets on the platform.

Yours Sincerely,

Dr. Sasikumar P,

Assistant Dean, Academic Research,

Portal Onboarding Meeting for VIT

Dear Faculty, Scholars and Students,

We are pleased to invite you to an important onboarding meeting

focused on Accessing

Scientific Datasets via the IEEE DataPort Portal at VIT. This session will

provide a comprehensive guide on how to navigate, access, and effectively

utilize the vast collection of scientific datasets available through the

IEEE DataPort Portal.

The IEEE DataPort Portal is an invaluable resource for researchers,

offering a wide array of datasets that can significantly enhance your

studies and projects across various scientific and engineering disciplines.

We highly encourage all faculty members and scholars interested in

leveraging high-quality data for their research to attend.

Meeting Details:

 - Date: Monday, July 28, 2025

 - Time: 3:00 PM – 3:30 PM (India Standard Time)

 - Link: https://ieee.zoom.us/j/99833770188?pwd=LH6b86vlSJaW36zvPYTit8W0h8UEQS.1

 https://ieee.zoom.us/j/99833770188?pwd=LH6b86vlSJaW36zvPYTit8W0h8UEQS.1 

During this meeting, we will cover:

 - Introduction to the IEEE DataPort Portal and its benefits.

 - Step-by-step procedures for searching, accessing, and downloading

 datasets.

 - Tips for effective data utilization in your research.

 - Q&A session to address your queries.

Your participation is crucial to maximize the benefits of this valuable

resource. We look forward to your active involvement in making the IEEE

DataPort Portal a success for VIT's research community.

Kindly mark your calendars. We anticipate a productive session.

Yours Sincerely,

Dr. Sasikumar P,

subject: Second Call: Walk-In Interviews for graVITas 2026 Organizing Committees!
body:
Dear Students,

Due to the overwhelming response during our initial recruitment phase and

the expansion of our team requirements, we are excited to announce a Second

Call for Walk-in Interviews for the core organizing team of graVITas

2026.

If you missed the first round and want to be a part of the team driving

this year's gravitas 2026, this is your opportunity! We are specifically

looking for dedicated and dynamic students to join the following teams:

 - Sponsorship & MoU

 - Design & Printing

 - E-Sports & Creative Techno Sports

 - Publicity & Marketing (International) 

Interview Details:

 - Date: 06.05.2026

 - Time: 2.30pm – 6.00pm

 - Venue: Office of Students' Welfare

Important Eligibility Criteria & Rules:

Please read the following guidelines carefully before attending the walk-in

interview. Strict adherence to these rules is mandatory:

 - No Re-interviews: Students who have already attended an interview

 during the first phase are strictly restrained from attending this

 walk-in.

 - Graduation Year: Students graduating in the year 2026 are not

 eligible to apply.

 - Disciplinary Record: Students with any record of disciplinary

 action are not eligible to join the organizing team.

Please come prepared to showcase your skills, ideas, and enthusiasm for

your chosen committee.

We look forward to seeing fresh talent step up to make graVITas 2026 a

monumental success.

For Queries, Contact: 90035 09595

body:
Dear Students,

Greetings from CDC!

You will get an invitation from AWS Academia to join the AWS course after

Monday

- Click the invitation link to enroll in the course.

- Upon enrolling, you will be able to participate.

- After completion of the course and receiving your completion certificate,

you will gain access to the AWS Skill Builder.

- Follow the instructions below to complete the AWS Skill Builder practice

exercise.

- Subsequently, individuals who fulfill the requirements will receive an

email from AWS Academia containing complimentary vouchers.

Note: VIT is not connected with AWS free vouchers or Skill Builder; if

you have any queries, please contact the AWS support team.

=====================================================================================================

Step-by-step for AWS Academy students

Step 1: Login to Canvas and select an AWS Academy course enrolled into.

Step 2: Select the Modules menu item

Step 3: Scroll down to the last module named “AWS T&C Resources”. Review

the FAQs and select the link called “Activate Your AWS Skill Builder Offer”.

Then, follow the onscreen instructions.

Next

Next

Instructions for AWS Academy Approved Educators to activate their AWS

Skill Builder.

AWS Academy Approved Educator - Activate AWS Skill Builder

Step 1: Login to Canvas and select the “Educator Getting Started with AWS

Academy” course.

Step 2: Select the Modules menu item

Step 3: Scroll down to the last module named “AWS T&C Resources”. Review

the FAQs and select the link called “Activate Your AWS Skill Builder Offer”.

Step 4 onwards= please follow the onscreen instructions.

 Educators and Students will receive following Skill Builder invitation

message.

In Skill Builder Learning portal, Educators and Students can access all

paid SBS contents and Jam, Cloud Quest etc.

By clicking “view all training activity”, there are four per-enrolled exam

prep courses

After completing one of four practice exams, the system will issue one

free exam voucher accordingly.

Educator and student can claim for free exam voucher at all after

completing practice exams per SBST account.

Educator and Student will receive exam voucher details from Pearson VUE in

7-10 working days.

The exam voucher is valid for 6 months.

Using the TALK model for potential growth, IGTT could very well be trading in the .60 range in only a few months, with a market cap in excess of $250 million. This would be an increase of 1000%. So you see why IGTT has such great potential and the time is right for investors to get in on the ground floor. subject: Congratulations to Team Winnovators on Their Achievement at Confluence 2026 | PSG College of Technology
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to share that Team Winnovators secured First Place in

the Idea Pitching Competition at The Confluence 2026 — Research,

Innovation & Technology Summit, conducted by the Institution’s Innovation

Council (IIC), PSG College of Technology, on 6th February 2026.

The inter-college summit featured innovations under the TRL 3–5 category,

with participation from over 300 teams across institutions nationwide. The

team presented their project, TABM-100, which was recognized for its

innovation, technical feasibility, and strong practical application

potential.

For their outstanding performance, the team was awarded a cash prize of

₹30,000.

Team Members:

1. Rithwik Ravi Kumar – 24BCE2254

2. Parveshh Prabhu – 24BEC0084

Congratulations once again to Team Winnovators on this remarkable

achievement and for bringing pride to VIT Vellore.

subject: General Instructions - reg.
body:
Students,

 Stay safe. Welcome to the new era of learning and Fall Semester

and your first Academic Year 2023-24.

ADHERE TO THE GIVEN GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS STRICTLY.

1. Manage your time - Present yourself on time to your classes and for

examinations.

2. Proctor is the top in Hierarchy - The foremost important point.

ANY KIND OF REQUEST MUST BE SUBMITTED TO YOUR PROCTOR and YOUR PROCTOR

SHOULD ADDRESS TO US if necessary ONLY through mail and the same will be

addressed shortly. If your proctor is not aware of the processes, request

them to communicate with the year coordinator. If needed, they will take

the support of HoD. Even if they asked you to escalate the issue, address

only to HoD. DO NOT ADDRESS YOUR MAILS TO ALL THE KNOWN HIGHER OFFICIALS (Dean,

Academics office, International Relations office, Students Welfare office

etc). STRICTLY FOLLOW THIS to address your issues in a timely manner.

Official VIT student mail ID must be used for any kinds of communication.

If parents want to communicate, they need to send mails only from the

registered ID (as per your VTOP).

3. Leave: As per norms, a student can avail leave of any kind (including

medical reasons) to the permissible limit (25%). YOU MUST MAINTAIN 75%

attendance in all the courses. Any other kinds of leave request either from

parents or direct mail submissions won't be considered. Refer to academic

regulations available on our website and in your VTOP login for more

information. Only proctors should send the mail with supporting documents

if you are hospitalized for any reasons and treated as INPATIENT. DISCHARGE

SUMMARY, FITNESS CERTIFICATE and HOSPITAL BILLS are mandatory if your

proctor sends medical leave requests. OTHER KIND OF MEDICAL LEAVE REQUEST

WON'T BE ENTERTAINED. SUBMIT any kind of requests ON TIME (within a week's

time you avail leave).

4. Attendance Status: Faculty members post the attendance on a day-to-day

basis which will be frozen on every Monday. It is your responsibility to

verify your attendance daily. In case of discrepancies communicate only

with the course faculty members and sort out the same.

Only course faculty members can update any student's attendance. For no

reason, this kind of issue should be brought to our notice. If there are

issues with your biometric attendance, contact the CTS office for the same.

Even after that if your issue exists, you can request your course faculty

member to MANUALLY UPDATE your attendance at the end of the particular

class day. Other than this, there are no other options. If your account is

locked for some reasons, it is considered to be ABSENT and no one can

change the status. IF YOU ATTEND THE CLASSES WHEN YOUR ACCOUNT IS LOCKED,

REQUEST YOUR COURSE FACULTY MEMBER TO SEND A MAIL REQUEST WHEN YOUR

ATTENDANCE FALLS BELOW 75%. AVOID SENDING ANY OTHER KIND OF MAILS regarding

attendance update to school.

5. Internal Assessments and Evaluation: Course faculty members are the

owners for their courses. Adhere to the instructions given by them. No

other faculty members (including HoD) can intervene in their schedule or

evaluation strategies. Any kind of issues/requests must be discussed only

with them, and it should be resolved. Submit all the assignments on time

and present without fail for quizzes. Only faculty members must decide on

conduct of re-quiz or extension of assignment submission dates. School will

not interfere in this for any reason. IT IS ONLY UPTO THE DISCRETION OF THE

FACULTY MEMBERS TO CONSIDER YOUR REQUEST FOR Re-Quiz ON MEDICAL GROUNDS.

Updating marks is also carried out regularly. If there are mistakes, report

to the course faculty members on time. AVOID REQUESTING after all the

related processes are frozen.

6. Quality Circle Meeting: Usually the QCM meeting is conducted 3 times

in a semester to improve our teaching-learning process. Participate in

these meetings conducted by year coordinators and record your common

academic issues. School will initiate the necessary process to solve the

problems. Issues recorded only in QCM meetings will alone be considered and

suitable actions will be initiated. Don't submit any other means of

complaints against any course faculty member with HoD in person.

7. Discipline: Students, let us all be self-disciplined in all the

aspects starting from time management to display of behaviour in public. A

mail sent from the Registrar regarding mandatory wearing of ID cards will

be viewed seriously in all the places.

8. Bonafide Certificate: You can apply for bonafide from your VTOP login

for various reasons. Avoid requesting such certificates through mailto

school. Explore various options in your login and then apply. Such

applications will be processed by the Students Record Section and not by

schools. It will take some time for the process.

9. Stay Updated: Check your inbox at least twice in a day. Read all the

mails communicated from any officials without ignoring. They may contain

some vital information. Even though mails are communicated, some students

used to enquire about the same information which was already communicated.

10. Academic Calendar: Dean Academics has shared the details of all the

academic activities and the academic calendar is also available in your

login. Refer to the academic calendar and then plan everything. Understand

that schools are not scheduling any examinations. The exam schedules are

prepared by the Academics office (for CAT) and by the CoE office (for FAT)

and it won't be changed. Requests related to prepone or postpone can't be

considered from our side.

11. Finance related matters: Schools are not authorized to interfere in

the matters related to finance. Any such requests must be made only to the

respective offices. Schools do not have the permissions to LOCK/UNLOCK any

student's VTOP account. If your account is locked for any reasons, contact

respective offices based on your issue. Whenever your account is

locked, those days will be considered ONLY as ABSENT and no one will be

permitted to update the attendance (as already stated above)

12. On-Duty: If you are representing any events through some

clubs/chapters, OD must be initiated and updated by the respective offices

through concerned coordinators. If you want to request OD for other

academic events from school, the request must be submitted through proctor

subject: Congratulations to Team Foresight for Securing 1st Place at Sona TechZeal 2K26 Hackathon - Sona College of Technology, Salem
body:
Dear VITians,

We are delighted to share that Team Foresight secured 1st Place at the

Sona TechZeal 2K26 Hackathon, conducted at Sona College of Technology,

Salem on 28 March 2026, and received a cash prize of ₹10,000.

The hackathon witnessed participation from 36 teams and consisted of three

evaluation rounds, including problem statement presentation,

implementation, and final prototype demonstration. Throughout the

competition, teams were evaluated based on innovation, technical execution,

and the practical impact of their solutions.

Representing VIT, Team Foresight developed a project titled “Lexifyd”,

an AI-powered Tamil language learning system designed to provide

context-aware learning and adaptive feedback using modern technologies.

Demonstrating strong technical implementation and innovation, the team

successfully developed and presented a fully functional prototype, securing

the top position in the competition.

Team Members:

 1. Mohammed Kaif K – 23MIS0258

 2. Pravin G – 23MIS0325

 3. Yashmitha M S – 23MIS0265

 4. Gowtham G – 23MIS0520

We express our gratitude to the Faculty Coordinator, Vanitha M (Emp. ID:

10908), whose guidance and support played a key role in the team’s success.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Team Foresight on this

commendable achievement and wish them continued success in their future

endeavors.

World Health Day

World Health Day 2024 is celebrated every year on April 7th to raise

awareness around various health issues worldwide. From longevity to

happiness, health impacts all spheres of life. In modern times and

especially the post-pandemic era, it has assumed greater significance with

several aspects of our well-being taking centre stage.

The theme for World Health Day 2024 is 'My health, my right’. This year’s

theme was chosen to champion the right of everyone, everywhere to have

access to quality health services, education, and information, as well as

safe drinking water, clean air, good nutrition, quality housing, decent

working and environmental conditions, and freedom from discrimination.

body:
Dear Students,

A warm welcome to VIT! As you embark on this exciting new chapter, we

invite you to attend the VIT's Institution's Innovation Council (IIC-VIT)

latest event for an unforgettable Ice-Breaker event!

Date: 31st JulyTime: 11 A.M. to 1 P.M.Location: TT VOC GALLERY II [2nd

Floor]

 - Are you passionate about Innovation, Entrepreneurship, Inventions, and

 Adventure?

 - Do you dream of owning your business or collaborating with like-minded

 individuals to bring your design ideas to life?

Look no further! Our Fresher Ice-Breaker is the perfect platform to

kick-start your journey.

What we do at IIC:

- Witness a vibrant community that encourages innovation and

entrepreneurship.

- Access resources and support to turn your ideas into reality.

- Develop valuable skills and networks that will benefit you throughout

your academic journey and beyond.

What to Expect:

- Learn about the state-of-the-art facilities available in VIT to foster

your innovative ideas.

- Meet potential mentors who can guide and support you.

- Connect with fellow students who share your interests and passions.

- Engage in fun and interactive sessions designed to unlock your creative

potential.

We are an organization with boundless potential ready to add more firepower

into our ranks to take VIT forward in the world of advancing technologies.

Don't miss this fantastic opportunity to meet fellow innovators,

entrepreneurs, and inventors! Mark your calendars for 31st July and get

ready to break the ice.

Please contact our student coordinator, Abhranil Sarkar (+91 9800949008)

for further details.

We look forward to seeing you there!

subject: Innovation Week 2026 - Thank you
body:
Dear VITians,

Greetings. Our heartfelt thanks to all VITians for their enthusiastic

participation and support in making Innovation Week 2026 a grand success.

We thank our Honorable Chancellor and Core Group Members for their

encouragement and support in making this Innovation week a remarkable one.

Throughout the week, we witnessed an inspiring series of events including

the InnoHack Hackathon, Technology Transfer Sessions, HCC Fireside Chat,

Demo Day, Tech Showcase, Tech Conclave,IP conclave and Idea Showcases,

along with interactive workshops with our alumni and industry experts from

leading corporate industry such as Google and LinkedIn, Mahindra & Mahindra

and India Block Chain forum. 

 - On the first day, the InnoHack saw an active participation of 225

 teams (1000+ students) out of which 175 teams were from various

 institutions from South India.

 - Five agreements were signed with industries for transfer of

 technologies.

 - Two of our startup teams have received funding support from the

 investors during the DeepTech Pitching event conducted on the fourth day.

 - The five day event also witnessed exchange of MoUs with

 industries.

The active involvement of our faculty members in mentoring and guiding

students, along with the energetic participation of students, created a

vibrant environment of learning, experimentation, and knowledge exchange.

The discussions during the IP conclave, insights shared during the HCC

Fireside Chat and the hands-on exposure from industry-led workshops helped

bridge the gap between ideas and real-world applications.

Events like these are possible only because of your commitment to nurturing

a culture of innovation and continuous learning. We are proud of what we

have achieved together and look forward to even greater milestones in the

future.

Thank you once again for your valuable contributions and support.

A BIG thanks to the VIT Innovation Team (VIT Innovation, startup, TT, IPR

and IIC) for leading us from the front and for their tireless efforts

towards creating a vibrant innovation ecosystem in the campus.

subject: YANTRA'26: Day-6 Events (12-02-26) - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details:

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 6:

IEEE SOCIETY ON SOCIAL IMPLICATIONS OF TECHNOLOGY (IEEE-SSIT)

Event Name : Code4Change 3.0

Date : 10-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details: Continuing from the success of code4change 1.0 and 2.0,

IEEE-SSIT brings you code4change 3.0 where we'll be continuing our flagship

hackathon event for yantra considering the success we have had the past 2

years. It will be an overnight 48 hour hackathon event where we will have 4

panels of judges who will judge the teams and their ideas/products based on

a set rubrics.

INDIAN SOCIETY OF EARTHQUAKE TECHNOLOGY(ISET)

Event Name : Structur - A- Thon

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SJT Foodys

Event Details: Structr-a-Thon: Seismic Edition (Design, Test, Fail,

Improve, Survive the Shake) is a hands-on structural design challenge where

participants conceptualise, design, and construct scaled building models

and test their performance under simulated earthquake loading. The event

bridges theory and practice by allowing students to experience how

structures behave during seismic excitation and understand the principles

of earthquake-resistant design in a fun, competitive, and practical

environment. Teams will be provided with limited materials and a design

brief, after which they must create a structure optimised for stability,

strength, and ductility. These models will then be tested on a shake table

that simulates ground motion of varying intensity. Performance will be

evaluated based on structural integrity, damage patterns, lateral

displacement, and efficiency of material usage.

SOLAR ENERGY SOCIETY OF INDIA

Event Name : OriginX

Date : 11-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 2 PM

Venue : SJT G07

Event Details: This event challenges participants to solve the "First Mile

Problem," the difficulty of verifying data at the very start of a supply

chain. Teams must select a problem statement prone to fraud or unethical

practices. Their goal is to design a "Digital Product Passport"—a

blockchain-based system that tracks the item from raw material to the final

consumer.

FEP - SI

Event Name : NEXERA

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 1 PM

Venue : AMBEDKAR AUDITORIUM

Event Details:

NEXERA is a power packed tech talk on IT infrastructure and Agentic AI.

Learn how modern systems work. Understand how AI agents think and act.

Build your own AI agent from scratch. Clear. Practical. Future ready.

INDIAN CONCRETE INSTITUTE

Event Name : Blockchain Unchained: Theory to Application

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : CDMM 303

Event Details:

A high-velocity journey from Web3 theory to tangible action. Participants

move from understanding decentralization to deploying "Social Contracts"

on-chain, bridging the gap between blockchain hype and real-world social

utility.

COMPUTER SOCIETY OF INDIA (CSI) AND HEALTH CLUB

Event Name : Hack the Hospital

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 7 PM

Venue : KAMARAJ AUDITORIUM

Event Details: “Hack the Hospital” is a two-round collaborative technical

competition that challenges participants to solve real-world healthcare

problems using Web3 technologies. The event focuses on trust, transparency,

and accountability.

THE ELECTRONICS CLUB (TEC)

Event Name : SparkLab

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : SHAKESPEARE GALLERY

Event Details:

SparkLab is a structured academic technical event aimed at enhancing

students’ practical understanding of electronic system design through

PCB-centric development, while introducing emerging technology perspectives

such as Web3-enabled systems. The event provides participants with an

opportunity to conceptualize hardware solutions and translate them into

well-documented schematics and professionally designed PCB layouts, with

emphasis on fundamental electronics, appropriate component selection, and

manufacturable design practices. Selected problem statements may explore

the integration of PCB-based hardware with decentralized and secure Web3

applications, thereby promoting interdisciplinary learning aligned with

current technological trends.

COMPUTER SOCIETY OF INDIA (CSI)

Event Name : DEVSPACE

Date : 12-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 8 AM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : Devspace is CSI-VIT’s flagship hackathon, held alongside

engaging and insightful speaker sessions led by professionals from the tech

world. It brings together developers, entrepreneurs, tech enthusiasts, and

students in a high-energy environment to learn, collaborate, and showcase

their skills under one roof, while offering organisations a unique

opportunity to connect with some of the brightest minds at VIT Vellore.

VIT MATHEMATICAL ASSOCIATION (VITMAS)

Event Name : The Numbers Behind Web3

Date : 12-02-2026 to 14-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 2 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : This event is a technical talk/workshop that explores the

mathematical foundations powering decentralized systems. The session breaks

down how cryptographic hash functions, Merkle trees, zero-knowledge proofs,

and game theory enable trust, transparency, privacy, and fair governance in

Web3 applications. Rather than focusing on tools or hype, the event

emphasizes why these systems work and how mathematics makes Web3 a viable

framework for social responsibility and ethical digital infrastructure.

THE AI & ML CLUB - TAM AND ROTARACT CLUB

Event Name : Bidathon 2.0

Date : 12-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : HOMI BHABHA GALLERY

Event Details : Bidathon is a unique competitive hackathon that blends

technical innovation with strategic decision making. Unlike conventional

hackathons, Bidathon introduces a bidding-based constraint system, where

teams must strategically bid points to impose constraints on their own

projects mid way through development. Participants are challenged not only

on what they build, but also on how effectively they adapt under self

imposed limitations. Success depends on innovation, execution, risk

management, and smart planning.

ASSOCIATION FOR COMPUTING MACHINERY (ACM)

Event Name : Reverse Coding

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : ANNA AUDITORIUM

Event Details : Reverse Coding is ACM-VIT’s legacy event that puts a unique

twist on competitive coding. Instead of the traditional method of writing

code to produce an output, participants work backwards from the given

results to uncover the logic. The format is challenging, intuitive and will

challenge your logical thinking and teamwork throughout the event.

GOOGLE DEVELOPERS GROUPS (GDG)

Event Name : Hexathon

Date : 12-02-2026 to 13-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 6 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY

Event Details : Hexathon is a 24-hour long beginner-friendly designathon

that gives UI/UX designers and enthusiasts an opportunity to work on a

variety of real-life based problem statements. What makes this design

hackathon stand out is its unique marketplace system, where participants

can choose their problem statements and access a variety of design elements.

INDIAN INSTITUTE OF CHEMICAL ENGINEERS (IICHE)

Event Name : META - Materials. Energy. Trade. Advance

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 2 PM

Venue : VOC GALLERY

Event Details : Teams are given a problem, but the twist it they have to

build everything from scratch. That includes their supply chain, material

harvesting capabilities, and industrial ecosystem, as well as applying

their wits to best the other teams to prove their monopoly in the

competition. Different suppliers of various items and advisors who are

ready to stand by in the case of Difficulty is just one of the elements

that can trip up the teams in how they navigate their way through the

advancement of technology and society.

AMERICAN SOCIETY OF CIVIL ENGINEERS (ASCE)

Event Name : Build with Trust

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 2 PM to 7 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : Build with Trust is a technical poster-making competition

that highlights ethics, transparency, and social responsibility in civil

engineering. Participants visually present real-world infrastructure

challenges and propose responsible solutions inspired by Web3 values, with

emphasis on conceptual understanding and creative expression.

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS)

Event Name : WEB3VERSE 1.0

Date : 12-02-2026 to 12-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 6 PM

Venue : SAROJINI NAIDU GALLERY

Event Details : WEB3VERSE 1.0 is a one-day, team-based, fresher-friendly

Web3 experience designed to introduce students to the future of the

internet, Blockchain, Cryptocurrency, NFTs, and DAOs through interactive,

game-based learning. The event removes the intimidation of Web3 by focusing

on hands-on activities, simulations, and creative challenges, making it

accessible even to participants with zero prior technical knowledge.

subject: 12th November - Today's events by Clubs and Chapters-Reg
body:
The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s 12th November 

events.

Today's Events:

· CASA: Standards for Healthier

· Alumni Meet - Reconnecting Orbits

· SDG – Mathematics for a Sustainable World

· InfraQuest

· The Focus Curve

· CASA: Clear Minds, Bright Futures

· Mental Health Talk

· Ragam Reverse

· CASA: Mind Reset

· The Nobels 2.0

Scroll down for more details

Standards Club VIT

Event Name: CASA: Standards for Healthier

Event Time: 10:00 AM - 11:00 AM

Event Description: The Standards Club of VIT, under the Office of Students'

Welfare, presents CASA - Standards for Healthier Tomorrow, an awareness

event focusing on the importance of standards in promoting health, safety,

and well-being. CASA (Campaign Against Substance Abuse) aims to educate

students about the harmful effects of substance abuse and highlight how

Indian Standards contribute to creating a safer and healthier society. The

session will emphasize the role of standardization in ensuring product

safety, quality control, and public health protection.

Venue: CDMM 204

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/p/DQ4WRCDE9kV/?igsh=c2s0ejVpM2VreWNv

Astronomy Club-VIT Stellar

Event Name: Alumni Meet - Reconnecting Orbits

Event Time: 11:00 AM - 01:00 PM

Event Description: Hosted by Astronomy Club - VIT Stellar, this fun-filled

event brings together brilliant minds to share stories, laughter, and

cosmic energy! Get ready for an inspiring alumni talk, an engaging

discussion, and a lively "Then & Now" segment packed with surprises and

interactive moments. It's a celebration of memories, connections, and the

shared passion that keeps us all orbiting the same stars.

Venue: SJT G02

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/vit_stellar?utm_source=ig_web_button_share_sheet&igsh=ZDNlZDc0MzIxNw==

Mathverse

Event Name: SDG – Mathematics for a Sustainable World

Event Time: 9:30 PM - 11:00 AM

Event Description: Hosted by Mathverse, this session focuses on the theme

"Mathematics for a Sustainable World", highlighting how mathematical ideas

can be applied to create a better and more sustainable future. The speaker

will share insights on how mathematics supports real-world solutions to

environmental and societal challenges. Join us for an engaging talk that

connects numbers with nature and shows how math can truly make a difference.

Venue: TT513

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/mathverse_vit?igsh=a3o5NTFqaHZncGQw

American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE)

Event Name: InfraQuest

Event Time: 9:00 AM - 09:00 PM

Event Description: Engineering marvels don’t just shape skylines they

define a nation’s progress. InfraQuest is an Instagram quiz event by

ASCE-VIT that takes you through India’s most iconic mega projects and their

construction timelines. From record-breaking bridges to world-class transit

systems, test your knowledge of the projects that are transforming the

infrastructure landscape of India.

Venue: Instagram Stories

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/asce.vit?igsh=NGYxdHRvcXRsMDBj

LinkedIn link: https://www.linkedin.com/company/asce-vit-29b262194/

Smile Over Stress

Event Name: The Focus Curve

Event Time: 6:00 PM - 07:00 PM

Event Description: This interactive workshop blends a fast-paced group

activity with a simple psychological experiment to help students understand

how their minds react under pressure. Through the game, participants will

discover how performance changes with stress and learn to identify their

personal “focus curve.” The session concludes with a practical technique

students can use to find their ideal concentration level—just in time for

exam season.

Venue: TT204

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/sos_vit/

Computer Society Of India VIT

Event Name: CASA: Clear Minds, Bright Futures

Event Time: 11:00 AM - 01:00 PM

Event Description: Join us for CASA: Clear Minds, Bright Futures , an

insightful and interactive session on Substance Use Disorder, led by Mr.

Parthiban D. This session aims to create awareness about the psychological,

social, and biological aspects of substance use, and how it affects

individuals and communities. Participants will learn to identify early

signs of substance misuse, understand coping mechanisms, and explore

pathways to recovery and support.

Venue: SJT 307

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

https://www.instagram.com/csivitu?igsh=MXI2cnRreG5ibGJ1dw%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

VIT LEO Club

Event Name: Mental Health Talk

Event Time: 10:0 AM - 12:00 PM

Event Description: As part of our ongoing commitment to community service

and mental wellness, the VIT LEO Club is organizing a Mental Health Talk

exclusively for the residents and staff at the Shalom Foundation. Our club

members will be visiting the foundation to host a supportive and empathetic

session focused on the importance of mental health. The talk aims to create

a safe space for open discussion, share positive coping strategies, and

help break the stigma surrounding mental well-being. This initiative is

dedicated to offering support and fostering a sense of community for the

individuals at the Shalom Foundation.

Venue: Shalom Foundation

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/vit_leo_club/

Facebook Link: https://www.facebook.com/vitlionsclub/

Malayalam Literary Association

Event Name: Ragam Reverse

Event Time: 5:30 PM - 08:00 PM

Event Description: Lyrical ability testing event where participants have to

give their own spin on a song and theme given. They'll be tested on

vocabulary and fluency, as well as musical ability.

Venue: TT201

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link: https://www.instagram.com/mla_oruma/

Ayuda NGO Club

Event Name: CASA: Mind Reset

Event Time: 11:30 AM - 01:30 PM

Event Description: Mind Reset is a calm and comforting session organized

under CASA by Ayuda NGO Club, aimed at helping participants pause, reflect,

and reconnect with themselves. Guided by insightful speakers, the session

encourages understanding one’s thoughts, managing stress, and fostering

inner confidence. It offers a safe and supportive space to listen, share,

and reset the mind with positivity, peace, and clarity. 🌿✨

Venue: MB 210

Registration: VTOP

Instagram link:

The Catalyst Club

Event Name: The Nobels 2.0

Event Time: 12th Nov,8:15 AM - 13 Nov, 9:07 PM

Event Description: The Nobels 2.0 is a celebration of groundbreaking

achievements in science, literature, and peace, inspired by the spirit of

the Nobel Prizes. The event honors innovation, creativity, and impact,

recognizing individuals whose ideas and actions shape a better future

through knowledge, discovery, and human excellence.

Venue: Google forms

Registration: VTOP

Forms Link: https://forms.gle/4TZGgmaVagYabBdC7

Instagram:

https://www.instagram.com/thecatalystclubvit?igsh=a20zbXc2MXUzdHV4

subject: ​SDOT Training Schedule for B.Tech (Batch 4 ) Students (30hrs) is scheduled on 31st March 2026 onwards
body:
SDOT Training Schedule for B.Tech (Batch 4 ) Students (30hrs) is scheduled

on 31st March 2026 onwards

 Please find the attached students list with their

Trainer, Classroom details.

Career Development Centre (CDC) has scheduled training programmes in phases

starting 31st March 2026 onwards

The training will be conducted in the evenings and during weekends.

Periodical tests during the training and after the training also will be

conducted.

Please note that attending the training and tests are mandatory to attend

Super Dream and Dream companies.

CDC will monitor the training attendance and the test scores and will allow

only those students who do well in the assessments to appear for the super

dream and dream (IT/Core) companies. This is done to give opportunity for

those students who are sincere and may have a lesser CGPA. All the students

(including 9 pointers) have to attend the training and assessments.

This measure is taken to mitigate the industry slowdown which is impacting

the campus placements that may be seen with the current year placements.

The CDC Office will inform the hostel authorities for the later hour food

up to 9.30 pm.

Students who are coming late will not be allowed for

the training sessions. Even if they are coming 10 mins late also will not

be allowed.

Students are asked to bring their own laptop for the lab classes.

Students who are disturbing the training will be suspended from attending

the campus recruitments.

Please find the below schedule

 SDOT Training Schedule for B.Tech (Batch 4) Students (30hrs)

Date

Time

31st March 2026

1st & 2nd April 2026

7th – 9th April 2026

6.00 pm – 9.00 pm

4th & 5th April 2026

9.30 am – 12.30 pm

2.00 pm – 5.00 pm

Note:

1. OD will be given if the training is conducted during the class hours

2. For other students the training schedule will be shared at the

earliest

3. PG Students who have opted Advanced Python (Face) (170 students) will

be added in Batch 3 and tentative dates are mentioned below

subject: Call for Creators: graVITas 2026 Official Teaser Video Contest!
body:
Dear Students,

Greetings!

The countdown to the most anticipated techno-management fest of the year

has begun! As we gear up for graVITas 2026, we want to build the hype and

capture the true spirit of the fest—and we want you to be the ones to do it.

We are thrilled to announce the graVITas 2026 Teaser Video Contest. If

you have a talent for cinematography, video editing, or animation, this is

your platform to showcase your skills to the entire campus.

What We Are Looking For

We need a high-energy, captivating, and creative teaser video that sets the

tone for graVITas 2026. Whether it's through fast-paced edits, stunning

motion graphics, or compelling storytelling, your video should leave

everyone counting down the days until the fest.

The Grand Prize

The creator behind the chosen teaser will be rewarded with:

 - 100% Event Fee Waiver: Free registration for ANY ONE graVITas 2026

 event of your choice.

 - Exclusive Merch: A free official graVITas 2026 T-shirt!

Rules & Guidelines

 - Theme: Teaser should reflect the energy, innovation, and

 techno-management spirit of graVITas 2026. May be aligned with tagline

 “Driven by Innovation | Anchored in Sustainability”.

 - Duration: The teaser should be short, impactful, and ideally between

 30 to 60 seconds.

 - Originality: All footage, graphics, and audio must be original or

 copyright-free. Plagiarism will lead to immediate disqualification.

 - Quality: Submissions must be in high definition (1080p or 4K) in MP4

 format.

 - Selection: The final decision on the winning teaser video rests

 entirely with the Core Organizing Team.

How to Submit

 - Upload Link: https://forms.gle/NdLf7kHRF82Xgpcz6 (Use your VIT mail

 ID to access the google form)

 - Submission Deadline: 26.05.2026, 5.00pm

This is your chance to be the visual voice of the fest. We can't wait to

see the creativity you bring to the screen!

For any questions, feel free to reply to this email or reach out to

9003509595, 9942002947

I escaped along with my husband and two of our sons James Kongolo and Nzanga out of Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to Abidjan, Coted'ivoire where my family and I settled, while we later moved to settled in Morroco where my husband later died of cancer disease. However, due to this situation we decided to change most of my husband's billions of dollars deposited in Swiss bank and other countries into other forms of money coded for safe purpose because the new head of state of (Dr) Mr Laurent Kabila has made arrangement with the Swiss government and other European countries to freeze all my late husband's treasures deposited in some european countries. Hence, my children and I decided laying low in Africa to study the situation till when things gets better. Like now that president Kabila is dead and the son taking over (Joseph Kabila). One of my late husband's chateaux in Southern France was confiscated by the french government, and as such I had to change my identity so that my investment will not be traced and confiscated.I have deposited the sum Eighteen Million United State Dollars (US$18,000,000,00.) With a security company for safe keeping. What I want you to do is to indicate yourinterest that you can assist us in receiving the money on our behalf, so that I can introduce you to my son (Kongolo) who has the out modalities for the claim of the said funds. I want you to assist in investing this money, but I will not want my identity revealed.I will also want to acquire real/landed properties and stock in multi-national companies and to engage in other safe and non-speculative investments as adviseby your good self. May I at this point emphasize the high level of confidentiality, which this upcoming project demands,and hope you will not betray the trust and confidence, which I repose in you.In conclusion, if you want to assist us, my son (Kongolo) shall divulgeto you all briefs regarding this project, tell you where the funds are currently being maintained and also discuss remuneration for your services.For this reason kindly furnish us your contact information,that is your personal telephone and fax number for validation purpose and acknowledge receipt of this mail using the above email address. Yours sincerely, Mrs. Mariam M. Seseseko. -- Irish Linux Users' Group Social Events: social@linux.ie http://www.linux.ie/mailman/listinfo/social for (un)subscription information. On behalf of Lehigh University, IUCEE, and the Agastya International

Program Dates:

• Cohort 1: July 12–16, 2026

• Cohort 2: July 19–23, 2026

This is not a traditional lecture-based program. Participants will explore

through the HDSE Virtual Academy

 Collaborate in interdisciplinary teams to address real-world challenges

 -

 Engage with stakeholders to better understand needs and context

 -

 Co-develop scalable, impact-driven solutions

 -

 Translate ideas into actionable venture blueprints

 -

 Present their ventures at the end of the program, with top teams

 receiving awards.

Guided by mentors and social innovators, students will gain hands-on

experience in social entrepreneurship and humanitarian design while

building practical leadership, teamwork, and communication skills.

Program Cost:

The program fee is 13,000 INR, payable directly to the Agastya

International Foundation. For selected students from IUCEE-affiliated

colleges and universities, program costs will be covered, while students

are personally responsible for travel to and from Agastya’s campus in

Kuppam.

body:
10 DAY COURSE -TAUGHT AND CERTIFIED BY - National University of Singapore 

SCHOOL OF DESIGN AND ENGINEERING 

Robotics 

The ultimate intelligent machine is a robotic system endowed with a

flexible and adaptable electro-mechanical structure that is inherently safe

in its motions and interactions, coupled with intelligence at different

levels of granularity including cognitive capabilities approaching or

perhaps exceeding human capabilities in certain aspects.This course

provides a comprehensive introduction to robotic manipulators and systems.

Various related topics of importance are also introduced and discussed in

relation to the robotic system. It covers what robots can and cannot do

today and reviews the current challenges that scientists and technologists

are addressing. It will provide a preview of the future in which robotic

systems play a central role in our everyday lives.

PROGRAM DATES - December 10th - 20th

TAUGHT AND CERTIFIED BY - NUS SCHOOL OF DESIGN AND ENGINEERING 

 - Introduction to Robotics and Intelligent Machines

 - Robot Operating System (ROS),

 - Robot Navigation and Feedback Control

 - Simulation of Robots using Robot Operating System (ROS)

 - Sliding Autonomy

 - Omnipresence of Robotics and Intelligent Machines

 - Robot and Turtlebot

 - Robot Operating System (ROS)

 - Robot Navigation using ROS

 - Feedback Control using Proportional Integral Derivative (PID)

 - Simulation of Robots in Virtual Environments

 - Tuning of Control Parameters

 - Industry Visit 1 - Advanced Robotics Centre

 - Corporate Visit 2

 - Introduction to Robotics.- Effectors and Actuators

 - Robot Locomotion

 - Wheeled mobile robot kinematics

 - Sensor classification, sensor characteristics, selected sensors used

 in mobile robots.

 - Definitions and history of robotics

 - Robot components Applications

 - Types of joints

 - Position/orientation of rigid body Coordinate transformation

 - Robot kinematics

 - Legged mobile robots, leg configurations, stability, gaits

 - Wheeled mobile robots, basic wheel types, wheel geometry

 - Forward Kinematic models

 - Wheel Kinematic constraints

 - Robot Kinematic constraints

 - Manoeuvrability of mobile robot

 - Sensor classification

 - Sensor characteristics

 - Selected sensors used for mobile robots

At the end of the course, the participants will be able to:

Gain an understanding of what a robotic system is, its different components

and how they interact with each other;

Understand the different terminologies & terms and how they fit in the

bigger picture of an intelligent system;

Gain insight on what robots and robotic system can and cannot do today, the

challenges faced and what opportunities lies ahead.

Better decide how best to use a robotic system, and learn about their

applicability.

PROGRAM HIGHLIGHTS

Thematic discussions, Lectures and short practice sessions from NUS faculty

and teaching assistants.

The Lectures will cover hands-on exercises and in-depth discussions through

interactive breakout rooms.

The programme is designed with Continuous Assessments format to sharpen the

understanding and application of ideas learned during the lectures.

Mini Project – There will be a mini group project in which students will

solve and analyse a problem related to ROBOTICS.

 WHO SHOULD ATTEND

 University students majoring in Science, Technology, Engineering,

Computing, and Mathematics subjects. Professionals looking to understand

how AL/ML work and how they apply it in their workplace

 Successful participants who fulfill all program requirements, including

meeting the minimum attendance and passing the assessment, will be awarded

an e- Certificate of Completion and Assessment Report issued by NUS

 E-COMMENDATION LETTER

 Participants from the project team with the highest score for the group

project will also receive a commendation letter.

About the Program

Batch : 40 students accompanied & led by 2 Faculties from VIT.

Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [20th September]
