International Day of University Sport

The International Day of University Sport (IDUS) is celebrated annually on

September 20. Proposed by the International University Sports Federation

(FISU), it is officially endorsed by the United Nations Education, Science,

and Culture Organisation (UNESCO). The day aims at confirming the

importance of sport in universities and the role of universities in the

community as responsible actors for consolidating and developing quality

physical and sports education at the service of citizens.

This day is an opportunity to underline the social role played by

universities and their curricula, making sport available for everyone in

order to foster the regular practice of physical activity in the greatest

number of people. It also allows UNESCO to reaffirm its committed support

to personal and collective development through sport and education, for the

spread of a genuine sports culture, which we believe is inherent to a

culture of peace.

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [24th January] 

 events.

NATIONAL GIRL CHILD DAY

National Girl Child Day was first initiated in 2008 by the Ministry of

Women and Child Development. The purpose of this day is to spread awareness

about the gender-based discrimination that girls face in our society and to

bring change in the attitude towards girls. The objective behind

celebrating the National Girl Child Day is to provide support and

opportunities to the girls of India. It also aims towards promoting

awareness about the rights of the girl child and to increase awareness on

the importance of girl education, and their health and nutrition.

The Indian government has taken several steps over the years to change this

and improve the conditions of girls. Several campaigns and programs such as

Save the Girl Child, Beti Bachao Beti Padhao, free or subsidized education

for the girl children, reservations for women in colleges and universities

have been initiated to reduce this discrimination. Starting from female

infanticide to gender inequality to sexual abuse, there is no dearth of

issues. The main objective behind this is to highlight the inequalities

faced by girls, to promote awareness including the rights of a girl child,

the importance of education, health, and nutrition. Nowadays also gender

discrimination is a major problem that girls or women face

throughout their life.

Special Event: Cellphone Photography!

National Girl Child Day Photography Competition

Calling all VITians! Here's your chance to showcase your creativity and

support an important cause. Participate in our Cell Phone Photography

Competition as part of National Girl Child Day and stand a chance to win

exciting prizes in each category!

Topics to Capture

Choose from any of these themes to highlight the strength, beauty, and

potential of girls:

 - Empowered and Inspiring Girls – Capturing moments that reflect the

 strength, confidence, and resilience of girls.

 - Dreams in Focus – Showcasing the dreams and aspirations of young girls

 through creative visuals.

 - Education for Every Girl – Highlighting the importance of education

 and its transformative impact on girls.

 - Breaking Barriers – Photos of girls challenging stereotypes and

 excelling in unconventional roles or activities.

 - Her Smile, Her World – A focus on the happiness and positivity of

 girlhood, celebrating their unique stories.

Here's how to participate:

Guidelines:

 - Your submission must be original – no downloaded or stolen images.

 - Images must be taken using a cell phone camera.

 - Images should be captured inside the campus.

 - Each entry should reflect one of the listed topics and include a short

 caption or description.

 - Upload the photo on your Instagram page.

 - Tag SW page in the post @sw_vit (Make sure your post & profile are

 public).

 - Upload your photos before 06:00 PM today.

So, start clicking and share your best shots!

For more details about C&C: https://vit.ac.in/campuslife/studentswelfare

subject: YANTRA'26: Day-3 Events (09-02-26) - Reg.
body:
Dear VITians,

As VIT continues its journey of excellence and innovation, the Office of

Students’ Welfare is proud to invite you to the 6th edition of Yantra —

VIT’s flagship week-long technical fest. Yantra’26, scheduled from 7th

February to 15th February 2026, promises an engaging and impactful

exploration of technology, creativity, and innovation.

This edition features 70+ diverse events, thoughtfully curated to

inspire, educate, and challenge participants across disciplines and skill

levels. The theme for Yantra’26, “Leveraging Web3 for Social

Responsibility”, highlights the transformative role of decentralization

and blockchain technology in fostering safe and transparent systems,

driving growth, enhancing societal well-being, and delivering sustainable

solutions to real-world challenges.

Visit our website for more details: Yantra 2026: A Week of Technical

Innovation

https://yantra.vit.ac.in/?utm_source=mail&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=yantra_mail

Don’t miss this opportunity to showcase your talent, strengthen your

technical skills, and collaborate on ideas that create meaningful impact.

Following are the events scheduled for YANTRA’26 – Day 3:

CENTRE FOR SOCIAL ENTREPRENEURSHIP DEVELOPMENT (CSED)

Event Name : Code2Innovate

Date : 07-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 12 PM to 10 AM

Venue : Shakesphere Gallery, TT

Event Details : Code2Innovate is a 48-hour hackathon organized by CSED in

collaboration with MFC, focused on building innovative Web3-driven

solutions for real-world social challenges. Participants will work in teams

to design and develop impactful software or hardware projects using

blockchain, IoT, and emerging technologies, supported by expert mentorship

and speaker sessions.

THE INSTRUMENT SOCIETY OF INDIA (ISOI)Event Name : HACKOVATE 

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time: 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : SMV 209

Event Details : Experience 36 electrifying hours of creativity and

collaboration at Hackovate, the flagship hackathon by the Instrument

Society of India (ISOI) – VIT Student Chapter, part of Yantra 2026. On Feb

8–9 at VIT Vellore, solve real-world challenges across AI, IoT, robotics,

healthcare, and Web3. Code, connect, and build the future.

IEEE CIRCUITS AND SYSTEMS (IEEE-CAS)Event Name : ElectroHack 2.0

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : VOC Gallery, TT

Event Details : ElectroHack 2.0 is a hardware-centric hackathon that

brings together electronics and emerging digital technologies to build

innovative systems. Participants compete across three tracks - Embedded

Systems with IoT, VLSI Design, and PCB Designing - with an emphasis on

hardware implementation. The hackathon encourages exploration of

decentralized systems inspired by Web3, enabling teams to naturally

integrate such ideas into their designs where they add value. ElectroHack

2.0 fosters innovation, collaboration, and hands-on problem solving at the

intersection of modern hardware and evolving system architectures.

CODECHEF VITEvent Name : DevSOC'26

Date : 08-02-2026 to 11-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 2 PM

Venue : Anna Auditorium, TT

Event Details : DevSOC (Developers' Sprint Of Code), in its seventh

edition, is the flagship annual event by CodeChef-VIT, aiming at empowering

young minds by fostering meaningful connections between tech enthusiasts

and innovators. This 48-hour sprint-style hackathon is designed to

encourage creativity, collaboration, and problem-solving in an intense yet

engaging environment. As a Free and Open-Source Software (FOSS) event,

DevSOC’26 emphasizes innovation, teamwork, and technological advancement

over four days of continuous ideation and development.

IEEE PROFESSIONAL COMMUNICATION SOCIETY (IEEE-PCS) & IEEE - COMMUNICATIONS

SOCIETY (IEEE-COMSOC)Event Name : Connectron 2.0

Date : 08-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 9 PM to 6 AM

Venue : Sarojini Naidu Gallery, SJT

Event Details : Connectron 2.0 is a 36-hour overnight hackathon presented

through a collaboration between IEEE PCS, VIT Vellore and IEEE COMSOC, VIT

Vellore, set alongside the overarching theme of Yantra ’26: Web3-based

Solutions. The event brings together innovators to ideate and build

decentralized, future-ready solutions across three focused

tracks—Cybersecurity, Safety & Wellness, and Ethical AI—encouraging

participants to merge technical excellence with real-world impact through a

fast-paced, innovation-driven hackathon experience.

MATRIX- THE MULTIMEDIA CLUBEvent Name : Green Ledger Buildathon

Date : 09-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 AM

Venue : Kamaraj Auditorium, TT

Event Details : GreenLedger Build-a-thon is a high-octane

"Animation-thon" where creators architect multi-scene narratives bridging

Web3 logic with sustainability. Participants must bypass single-prompt AI

to build "Motion Logic" NFTs that visualize real-world impact. By merging

decentralized transparency with ownership, these digital assets transform

abstract environmental data into tangible, animated stories of global

change and verifiable ecological stewardship.

ADVANCE DEVELOPERS CLUBEvent Name : SharkTech 2.0

Date : 09-02-2026 to 10-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 8 PM

Venue : Homi Bhabha Gallery

Event Details :This is a 24-hour event that incorporates a designathon

and a hackathon with a Shark Tank format that focuses on using Artificial

Intelligence for social causes. This event aims to develop solutions using

Artificial Intelligence to solve some of the most pressing problems faced

by society today, which include eradicating poverty, ensuring quality

education for all, women’s equality, ensuring inclusivity in healthcare

facilities, and conservation of the environment.

AMERICAN SOCIETY OF CIVIL ENGINEERS (ASCE)Event Name : Green Credits

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : Bhagat Singh Gallery, SJT

Event Details :Green Credits is a 1-day Innovation Hackathon that

challenges civil engineering and technology students to design

blockchain-based incentive systems for sustainable construction.

Participants will conceptualise tokenized carbon credit platforms that

reward eco-friendly construction practices, align with international

sustainability standards (ASCE/COS 73-23, ISO 14040/44), and address the

construction industry's most urgent crisis: embodied carbon emissions.

SOCIETY FOR BIOLOGICAL ENGINEERING (SBE)Event Name : Block and Key

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 8 AM to 6 PM

Venue : MB 210

Event Details : A workshop on blockchain, its importance, applications

and a session on pseudocodes and their working was given pre-lunch.

Participants are given problem statements at the beginning of round 2 that

require them to create a blockchain model pseudocode (with loops that work

like a pathway) that would comprise valid checkpoints and pass the judgment

criteria on all fronts.

INTERNATIONAL SOCIETY OF AUTOMATION (ISA)Event Name : Binary Battles 3.0

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 10 AM to 7 PM

Venue : CS Hall

Event Details : Step into 'Binary Battles 3.0', where strategy, logic and

teamwork collide. Tackle high-energy challenges, crack cryptic Web3

challenges and race through an intense final CodeSprint where ideas turn

into execution. Collaborate, compete, and outthink the challenge!

INTERNET OF THINGS COMMUNITY (IOTHINC)Event Name : Link the Future

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : SMV 110

Event Details : Experience the internet’s next evolution in this

design-first challenge—no/minimal coding required. We kick off with a

beginner-friendly masterclass on the fundamentals of decentralisation and

digital ownership, followed by an architectural competition where you’ll

re-imagine iconic global brands for the blockchain era. Instead of writing

scripts, you will focus on high-level strategy and logic, blueprinting new

ecosystems of transparency and community governance for the world's biggest

products. Whether you are a creative strategist or a tech-curious thinker,

join us to transform today’s household names into the decentralized

powerhouses of tomorrow!

ALPHA BIO CELL (ABC)Event Name : The Data Detectives

Date : 09-02-2026 to 09-02-2026

Time : 9 AM to 7 PM

Venue : Ambedkar Auditorium, TT

Event Details : This immersive event explores themes like drug tampering,

medical record manipulation, forensic investigation and many more within

the biotechnology and healthcare ecosystem. It begins with a focused

workshop on using Web3 for social responsibility, followed by a round wise,

team-based challenge, where participants analyze blockchain-inspired

datasets to uncover discrepancies in clinical reports and pharmaceutical

data, ending with a high-stakes competitive round, where participants will

be tested on their understanding of Web3.

Anti- Drug Club & Standars Club

Event Name: Click & Conquer

Event Description:The Anti-Drug Club of VIT Vellore, in collaboration with

the Standards Club, presents a 2-hour offline event combining learning and

future.

subject: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Patent Incentive Claims – UG/ PG Students & Ph.D. Scholars
body:
Dear Students and Research Scholars,

The Intellectual Property Rights & Technology Transfer (IPR & TT) Cell has

formalized the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for Patent Incentive

Claims. This procedure applies to all Undergraduate (UG), Postgraduate

(PG) students, and Doctoral (Ph.D.) scholars who are recognized inventors

on successfully filed patents.

To ensure a seamless financial disbursement process, please carefully

review the three-phased workflow and structural timelines outlined below

(The detailed SOP document and final claim form are attached for your

reference):

🚨 Action Required:

 1. Verify VTOP Immediately: Please log in to VTOP right away and

 ensure your bank account details are entirely accurate. Keeping this

 updated guarantees you fall into the smooth, automated Phase A cycle.

 2. For Past-Due Incentives: If you have missed previous incentive

 cycles, please print the attached Form-3C, secure the required routing

 signatures, and submit the physical form to the IPR & TT Cell office

 immediately.

Please note that Phase C serves as your final manual opportunity to claim

past-due incentives for your patent filing cycle.

For any further queries, please visit the IPR & TT Cell Office.

This SOP is effective immediately and applies to all patents filed from 1st

April 2026 onwards.

subject: Paid Internship opportunities for VIT Vellore students (UG /Integrated M.Tech preferred)
body:
Dear Students,

Please apply if you are interested.

Paid Research Internship Opportunity

School of Science, UK–Liverpool Joint Campus (China)

Supervisor: Dr. Akhil Garg, Associate Professor

We are inviting two highly motivated undergraduate or Integrated M.Tech

students to join cutting-edge research in Electric Vertical Take-Off and

Landing (eVTOL) vehicles—future “flying taxis.” This field is rapidly

evolving in Europe, the US, and China, offering exceptional academic and

career opportunities.

------------------------------

Research Areas 1. Advanced Battery Thermal Management System Design

 -

 Objective:

 Design a cold plate for eVTOL battery packs to control high heat

 generation and maintain temperature stability within 10°C.

 -

 Methods:

 Use topology optimization and AI-based design approaches to develop

 a next-generation cooling system.

2. Intelligent Flight Control Algorithm Development

 -

 Objective:

 Develop and simulate robust flight control algorithms for safe

 low-altitude flight, focusing on obstacle avoidance and passenger safety.

 -

 Methods:

 Model eVTOL dynamics in Simulink and implement AI-driven control

 strategies.

------------------------------

Internship Details

 -

 Mode: Offline or Online

 -

 Stipend: ₹10,000 per month (higher stipend possible based on

 performance)

 -

 Progress Review: Every 10–12 days to ensure consistent development

 -

 Goal: Publication-oriented research with strong technical output

------------------------------

Eligibility

Students from the following backgrounds are encouraged to apply:

 -

 Mechanical Engineering

 -

 Aerospace Engineering

 -

 Electrical / Electronics Engineering

------------------------------

Training & Support

 -

 Initial simulation files, reading materials, and research papers will be

 provided.

 -

 Former Indian students from the lab will help with task-specific

 training.

 -

 Outstanding interns may be invited for Master’s or Doctoral studies at

 our China campus (degree awarded by the University of Liverpool).

------------------------------

Offline Internship (China)

Deserving students will receive guidance and support for obtaining a 3–6

month internship visa.

subject: Congratulations to Dhruv N on Receiving the Prestigious G. N. Ramachandran Fellowship Award
body:
Dear VITians,

We are pleased to announce that Dhruv N (24MSP0001), M.Sc. Physics

student has brought great pride to our institution through his exceptional

academic achievement.

Dhruv has been awarded the highly prestigious G. N. Ramachandran

Fellowship for young and promising researchers by IIT Madras on 26th

September 2025. This fellowship is instituted in honour of Professor G. N.

Ramachandran, one of India’s most eminent scientists and the pioneer of

the Ramachandran Plot.

Earlier this year, he was selected as one of only fourteen students

nationwide for the highly competitive Summer Research Fellowship Programme

(SRFP) at IIT Madras, which saw participation from students representing

top institutions such as IISc, IITs, NITs, and other premier universities

across India. Based on the quality of his research work and presentation

during the programme, he was conferred with this fellowship in recognition

of his outstanding research potential.

This honour marks a significant milestone in his academic journey and

further strengthens his pursuit of high-quality research in experimental

condensed matter physics and related interdisciplinary domains.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to Dhruv for this remarkable

achievement. His dedication and excellence stand as an inspiration to the

VIT community.

subject: Student Innovation Project Contest 2026 - Registration Regarding
body:
Dear Students,

 Greetings.

 The School of Computer Science and Engineering (SCOPE) is pleased to

announce the Student Innovation Project Contest 2026, an initiative aimed

at promoting innovation, creativity, and project-based learning among

students. The contest provides a platform for students to showcase their

technical ideas, prototypes, and interdisciplinary solutions that address

real-world problems using computing technologies.

Eligibility and Participation: The following criteria define who can

participate and the expectations for team composition and project nature:

• Students from B.Tech and Integrated M.Tech programmes are eligible to

participate

• Students from all years of SCOPE - currently working on real-time

projects, including those involving hardware integration, can apply.

• Faculty members guiding such projects are encouraged to motivate and

nominate eligible student teams for participation.

• Projects carried out as part of final year projects or any project-based

academic courses will not be considered. Only independent, innovative, and

real-time projects developed beyond regular curriculum requirements are

encouraged

• Each team can have a maximum of three members, and each team must have at

least one student from SCOPE.

Project Verticals: Projects should be aligned with one of the following

thematic areas reflecting core and interdisciplinary computing domains:

• Vertical 1: Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Intelligent Systems

• Vertical 2: Secure, Scalable and Distributed Computing Systems

• Vertical 3: Interdisciplinary Computing and Human-Centered Innovations

Registration and Selection Process: The registration and evaluation

process is designed to ensure fair selection of high-quality and impactful

projects:

• Interested teams must register through the Google Form link:

https://forms.gle/WwTxd82T59wi2r6C9 https://forms.gle/WwTxd82T59wi2r6C9

• Deadline for submission of entries: 30.03.2026

• Projects will be evaluated by a faculty review committee based on:

Innovation and novelty, technical depth, Societal relevance, Implementation

quality

• Completeness of the solution, including the development of an end-to-end

system with components such as a functional user interface, hardware

integration where applicable, and practical deployment considerations

• Technology Readiness Level (TRL), with an expected minimum level of TRL 4

(technology validated in a lab environment) and preference for higher

levels such as TRL 5 to TRL 7 demonstrating validation and prototyping in

relevant or operational environments

• Approximately 20 projects will be shortlisted and shortlisted teams will

present and demonstrate their projects during the final event

Event Details: The final presentation and evaluation of shortlisted

projects will be conducted as per the following schedule:

• Date: 9th April 2026

• Time: 10:00 AM to 1:30 PM

• Venue: Main Foodys, VIT

Final presentations will be evaluated by a jury panel comprising an

industry expert and faculty members

Awards and Recognition: Outstanding projects will be recognized and

rewarded with cash prizes and certificates to encourage innovation and

excellence:

• First Prize: ₹12,000 • Second Prize: ₹8,000 • Third Prize: ₹5,000

Note: Awards will be provided as Amazon gift vouchers, and certificates

will be issued to all shortlisted participants.

Faculty guides of the final-level participants will be presented with a

memento

Students are strongly encouraged to take part in this contest and showcase

their innovative capabilities.

This is an excellent opportunity to gain recognition, enhance practical

exposure, and contribute to impactful technological solutions.

For any queries, please contact the event coordinators from SCOPE: Prof. N.

Yuvaraj & Prof. A K P Kovendan.

Best regards,

Organizing Team—Student Innovation Project Contest 2026.

With Regards,

Dr. N. Jaisankar, B.E., M.E., Ph.D

Professor-HAG and Dean (i/c)

School of Computer Science and Engineering

subject: Report Immediately : Mediatek next round of selection process is scheduled on ​10th March 2026 by ​9:30 ​AM - C​DC Office, SJT 7th floor @ VIT Vellore campus
body:
Mediatek next round of selection process is scheduled on 10th March 2026

by 9:30 AM - CDC Office, SJT 7th floor @ VIT Vellore campus

Find the below attached Hardware shortlist for Physical Interview &

Virtual Interview (own location)

VIT Chennai campus shortlisted candidates should report to VIT Vellore

campus for the physical interview process.

Other campus candidates from physical interview shortlist will have

interviews in virtual mode (interview link will be shared by company)

Students who are scheduled for virtual mode will receive the interview link

directly from the company to their respective email IDs

Note: Candidates failed to attend the interview process will be

blacklisted from further placements

Note:

1. Students are requested to send their queries to their respective campus

email ID only.

2. Webcam Should be turned on till the test gets over.

Important Note:

1. Appear for the selection process in formal dress. Students are said to

bring their own Headphones

2. Carry your 2 sets updated Resumes, photos, College photo ID and all

other relevant certificates... (Photo Copy of Mark Sheets - PG, UG, Higher

Secondary 10th)

3. Latecomers will not be allowed to attend the selection process

body:
Dear VITians,

The Office of Students’ Welfare invites you for today’s [20th January] 

events.

Today's Events:

· Elysia

· Pixels to Perfection

· Git Set Go

· INIT to Win It

· Tech Elevate 1.20

Scroll down for more details

AICHE-VIT & SEDS-VIT

Event Name: Elysia

Time: 2:00 pm - 6:00 pm

Event Description: SEDS-VIT and AIChE present an exciting event where

participants design a habitable world as Earth becomes unlivable. Teams

will use astronomy and chemistry to create ideal atmospheres, manage

essential resources, and ensure life's survival. Blending science with

creativity, they will build a sustainable environment for humanity's future

among the stars.

Event Venue: VOC Gallery, TT

Registration: VTOP Registration

Instagram link :

https://www.instagram.com/aiche_vit/?hl=en

https://www.instagram.com/sedsvit?igsh=ZXpzbDVtamk5dWs0

Facebook link: https://www.facebook.com/aichevit/

LinkedIn link: https://www.linkedin.com/in/aiche-vit-student-chapter/

CODECHEF-VIT

Event title INIT to Win It

Event time: 9:00 AM - 11:00 AM

Event Description: Dive into the exciting world of hackathons, where

innovation meets teamwork to spark creativity. This Hackathon 101 session

is your starting point to explore how hackathons work and how they fuel

growth. Learn to brainstorm impactful ideas, craft winning pitches, build

balanced teams, and refine your approach with expert insights. Get ready to

tackle your next hackathon with confidence and be in it to win it!

Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium

Registration link: VTOP registration

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/codechefvit

CODECHEF-VIT

Event title: Git Set Go

Event time: 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM

Event Description: Dive into version control with Git, the essential tool

for tracking changes and seamless collaboration. This session covers

everything from basics to advanced workflows, equipping you to commit,

branch, and merge with confidence. Whether you're a beginner or sharpening

your skills, it's time to Git Set Go!

Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium

Registration link: VTOP registration

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/codechefvit

CODECHEF-VIT

Event title: Pixels to Perfection

Event time: 2:00 PM - 4:00 PM

Event Description: Dive into the art of design with our hands-on session on

UI/UX fundamentals, where you’ll craft intuitive and engaging and

attractive interfaces. We’ll explore the principles of user experience and

interface design, focusing on creating seamless digital interactions.

Whether you’re a beginner curious about design or an innovator ready to

enhance your creativity, join us to bring your ideas to life with precision

and style.

Venue: Kamaraj Auditorium

Registration link: VTOP registration

Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/codechefvit

ASME-VIT

Event title: Tech Elevate 1.20

Event time: 7:00 PM- 8:00 PM

Event Description: Self-driving cars, once a dream, are now a reality

thanks to AI. These vehicles use advanced tech like sensors and machine

learning to navigate and make decisions, transforming the way we travel.

This session explores how autonomous vehicles are making roads safer,

reducing emissions, and overcoming challenges like safety and ethics. From

the tech that powers them to their potential impact, this talk offers an

exciting glimpse into the future of transportation.

Event Platform: Google Meet (Online)

Registration: VTOP

Instagram Link: https://www.instagram.com/asme.vit/

Register through VTop and participate in the clubs and chapter events

For more details about C&C: https://vit.ac.in/campuslife/studentswelfare

We are pleased to inform you that an international expert will be visiting

VIT Vellore on April 1, 2026, and will be delivering an exclusive

 Horizon Europe programmes

 EU–India cooperation

 Joint research and funding calls

subject: 2026 NCKU Taiwan AISSM Semiconductor International Summer School
body:
Dear Students,

Please attend if you are interested

 NCKU TAIWAN AISSM Semiconductor Summer School 2026 to be held

at National

Cheng Kung University (NCKU), Tainan, Taiwan from July 28 – August 7,

2026.

Participants can choose one of the following 3‑credit courses:

A. Digital IC Design and Synthesis

B. Analog IC Design and Layout

C. Advanced Semiconductor Manufacturing and Packaging Testing

Key details:

Language of instruction: English

Target participants: Senior undergraduate and fresh graduate students

with relevant background

Intake: Maximum 25 students per course

Deliverables: NCKU transcript and certificate on successful completion

Features: Lab work and hands‑on training, interaction with industry

experts, research center and institute visits, international peer group

Nomination period: January 2026 – March 2026.

Interested students are requested to submit their nomination in person

(CV, transcript, Statement of Purpose and faculty recommendation) to Dr

Raghuram Dy Director International Office on or before 31 March 2026

For programme‑specific information, please refer to the NCKU Summer School

website or contact the coordinator mentioned in the brochure.
